AI.tldr: 本文在Bellissard协变可观测框架下，探讨扭转双层体系中蝴蝶状能谱与体带隙标签、拓扑响应的关联，并通过有限蜂窝双层的二阶矩恒等式与数值验证说明耦合对谱权重的重分布。
AI.motivation: Bellissard框架用协变可观测描述非周期固体。作者希望厘清扭转双层中蝴蝶状谱如何与体带隙标签及拓扑响应建立联系，并明确从原子尺度电子结构计算到大体态计数、拓扑响应所需的步骤。
AI.method: 体带隙允许定义谱投影算符和积分态密度；拓扑响应还需对该投影算符作额外配对。以一个可解析的有限蜂窝双层为例，用精确的二阶矩恒等式分离层间耦合对谱方差的贡献；结合角度分辨谱、有限态计数、未耦合参考体系以及尺寸与展宽检验进行分析。进而讨论原子尺度电子结构计算的要求，包括非正交轨道、投影态密度以及相对滑动中移动的基函数。
AI.result: 二阶矩恒等式分离出层间耦合对谱方差的贡献；角度分辨谱、有限态计数、未耦合参考与尺寸/展宽检验显示，耦合会重新分配谱权重，但并不能据此赋予体带隙标签。
AI.conclusion: 该框架给出了将原子尺度谱与体态计数及拓扑响应联系起来的必要步骤，同时指出耦合导致的谱权重重分布不等于体带隙标签的确定。

title: Optimal Slicing Problems
summary: Given a bounded open set $V\subset \mathbb{R}^2$, we consider the problem of slicing this set by a family of curves, whose average length is as small as possible. The first sections of the paper prove the existence of an optimal slicing and establish a connection with the problem of eradicating an invasive biological species from an island, considered in \cite{BMS}. Namely, an optimal slicing can be obtained as a limit of minimum time eradication strategies. The second part of the paper derives various necessary conditions for optimality, describing the behavior of an optimal slicing strategy in the interior of $V$ and near the boundary $\partial V$.

AI.tldr: 研究有界开集的最优切片问题，证明最优切片存在性，并将其与岛屿上入侵物种的最短时间根除策略建立联系，同时推导内点与边界附近的最优性必要条件。
AI.motivation: 将几何切分问题（用曲线族切割集合且使平均长度最小）与生物入侵控制中的最短时间根除问题联系起来，借助后者研究最优切片的存在性与结构性质。
AI.method: 在 $V\subset\mathbb{R}^2$ 上考虑曲线族切片，构造最优切片作为最短时间根除策略的极限；随后通过变分/几何分析推导最优性必要条件，刻画最优切片策略在 $V$ 内部与边界 $\partial V$ 附近的行为。
AI.result: 证明了最优切片的存在性；建立了最优切片与最短时间根除策略的极限关系；得到了最优切片在内点与边界附近的多项最优性必要条件。
AI.conclusion: 最优切片问题与入侵物种最短时间根除问题等价可联系，最优切片可由根除策略极限获得，其几何结构受内点与边界附近的最优性条件约束。

title: Localization Transition in Kinetically Deformed one-dimensional Aubry-André Model
summary: We propose a $q$-deformation in the single-particle kinetic energy and investigate how it modifies the localization in the one-dimensional Aubry-André (AA) model. We construct a Hermitian $q$-deformed kinetic operator as a nonlinear function of the lattice translation operator, preserving the uniform lattice and recovering the conventional AA Hamiltonian continuously in the undeformed limit $q\to1$. The deformation generates an infinite set of correlated odd-range kinetic processes, controlled by a single parameter q, rather than phenomenologically involving long-range hopping. Under the dual transformation, this long-range hopping appears as higher harmonics of the dual quasiperiodic potential, providing a controlled route for breaking the exact self-duality of the AA model, with $q$ as the control parameter, consequently modifying the localization structure for $q\neq1$. In contrast to the conventional AA model, where all eigenstates localize simultaneously at $λ_c=2$, the deformed model exhibits a fraction of delocalized states even beyond $λ_c =2$. An intermediate regime also emerges in the $q-λ$ plane where localized and extended eigenstates coexist across the spectrum. We also propose a possible experimental realization of the hierarchy produced in the $q$-deformed kinetic setting in a periodically driven AA model.

AI.tldr: 通过引入基于格点平移算符非线性函数的厄米$q$-变形动能项，构建了一维Aubry-André模型的$q$-变形版本，打破了AA模型精确自对偶性，导致部分本征态离域及局域-扩展共存相的出现。
AI.motivation: 一维Aubry-André模型在$λ_c=2$处所有本征态同时发生局域化转变，其精确自对偶性使得该转变具有"全或无"特征。作者希望通过引入$q$-变形破坏这种精确对偶性，从而获得更丰富的局域化结构（如部分离域、局域-扩展共存），并避免唯象地引入长程跃迁。
AI.method: 将单粒子动能项构造为格点平移算符的非线性函数（$q$-变形动能算符），保持格点均匀性，并在$q\to1$极限下连续恢复常规AA哈密顿量。该变形产生一组由单参数$q$控制的相关奇程动能过程。借助对偶变换，将其映射为对偶准周期势的高次谐波，从而以$q$为控制参量破坏精确自对偶性；同时在$q$-$λ$平面分析局域化相图，并提出周期驱动AA模型作为实验实现方案。
AI.result: 与常规AA模型在$λ_c=2$处所有本征态同时局域化不同，变形模型在$λ_c=2$之后仍存在一部分离域本征态；在$q$-$λ$平面出现局域态与扩展态在整个谱内共存的中间区域。
AI.conclusion: $q$-变形动能项以单一参量方式破坏AA模型的自对偶性，产生部分离域态及局域-扩展共存的中间相，丰富了该模型的局域化相图；并可通过周期驱动AA模型实验实现这一层级结构。

title: Calculating Hodge and weight filtrations on localizations
comment: 19 pages. Comments welcome. Macaulay2 code available at https://github.com/michaelPerlman/MixedHodgeModules
summary: We describe the Macaulay2 package MixedHodgeModules, which computes Hodge and weight filtrations on localizations S_f of a polynomial ring S at a non-constant reduced polynomial f, as well as on twisted localizations S_f f^{-α}, where α\in QQ is rational. The package includes functionality for computing Hodge ideals, weighted Hodge ideals, higher multiplier ideals, generation levels of Hodge filtrations, weight levels of elements, p-functions, and lengths of weight filtrations. It also provides routines for computing graded de Rham complexes, Du Bois complexes, and intersection Du Bois complexes of hypersurfaces.

AI.tldr: 介绍 Macaulay2 软件包 MixedHodgeModules，用于计算多项式环局部化（含扭局部化）上的 Hodge 滤链与权滤链及相关不变量。
AI.motivation: 为多项式环的局部化（普通与扭局部化）上混合 Hodge 模理论中的滤链与不变量提供可计算工具，弥补相关代数与几何计算软件的空白。
AI.method: 在 Macaulay2 中实现 MixedHodgeModules 包，对非平凡既约多项式 f 定义的局部化 S_f 及扭局部化 S_f f^{-α}（α∈QQ）计算 Hodge 与权滤链，并集成 Hodge 理想、加权 Hodge 理想、高阶乘子理想、Hodge 滤链生成层、元素的权层、p-函数、权滤链长度等例程，以及分级 de Rham 复形、Du Bois 复形与超曲面相交 Du Bois 复形的计算。
AI.result: 该包可计算上述滤链与不变量，并支持分级 de Rham 复形、Du Bois 复形及超曲面相交 Du Bois 复形等对象的计算。
AI.conclusion: MixedHodgeModules 为混合 Hodge 模相关计算提供了统一的 Macaulay2 实现，便于在代数与代数几何研究中直接计算相关滤链、理想与复形。

title: An Energy-Conserving Unstaggered Electromagnetic-Potential Particle-in-Cell Method, Part II: Fully Relativistic Formulation with an Adapted Higuera--Cary Pusher
summary: We develop a fully relativistic extension of the energy-conserving, unstaggered electromagnetic-potential particle-in-cell method introduced in our earlier nonrelativistic work. As in the nonrelativistic generalized-momentum formulation, the fields are advanced by a Crank--Nicolson discretization of the Lorenz-gauge potential equations, the current is deposited from particle orbits, and charge is advanced through the discrete continuity equation. The new ingredient is a generalized-momentum adaptation of the Higuera--Cary relativistic particle pusher. The vector-potential force is decomposed into an orbit-discrete-gradient part, which enforces the same finite-difference chain rule used in our earlier nonrelativistic formulation, and a skew part, which generates a Higuera--Cary magnetic rotation in mechanical momentum. For prescribed fields and frozen orbit data, this generalized-momentum Higuera--Cary map is a unit-Jacobian conjugacy of the mechanical Higuera--Cary map and preserves particle phase volume in $(\xx,\PP)$. For the fully coupled implicit step, the same orbit data define the current deposit, mesh-to-particle gather, vector-potential chain rule, and relativistic kinetic-energy secant velocity. The resulting particle work cancels the Crank--Nicolson field-energy balance, yielding exact relativistic total-energy conservation up to nonlinear solver tolerance, orbit-quadrature error, and roundoff. A self-adjoint Fourier projection removes modes on even-grid Nyquist planes while preserving the particle--grid work identity. Numerical tests are organized around cold relativistic two-stream and Weibel/filamentation instabilities, with diagnostics for energy drift, Gauss's law, the Lorenz gauge, particle--grid work, and the orbit chain rule.

AI.tldr: 本文将非相对论能量守恒电磁势PIC方法拓展至全相对论情形，核心是提出广义动量版Higuera–Cary推进器，实现精确相对论总能量守恒。
AI.motivation: 在非相对论广义动量PIC方法基础上，需建立兼容能量守恒结构的全相对论粒子推进方案，以在相对论等离子体模拟中保持总能量守恒与规范约束。
AI.method: 采用Lorenz规范势方程的Crank–Nicolson离散推进场，由粒子轨道沉积电流，并通过离散连续性方程推进电荷；引入广义动量版Higuera–Cary相对论推进器，将矢势力分解为轨道离散梯度部分（满足有限差分链式法则）与斜对称部分（在机械动量中产生Higuera–Cary磁旋转）；对全耦合隐式步，同一轨道数据用于电流沉积、网格到粒子映射、矢势链式法则及相对论动能割线速度；采用自伴Fourier投影消除偶网格Nyquist平面模态。
AI.result: 该广义动量Higuera–Cary映射在给定场与冻结轨道数据下是机械Higuera–Cary映射的单位雅可比共轭，保持(\xx,\PP)相体积；粒子做功抵消Crank–Nicolson场能平衡，实现精确相对论总能量守恒（至非线性求解容差、轨道求积误差与舍入）；自伴Fourier投影在消除Nyquist模态的同时保持粒子–网格做功恒等式。
AI.conclusion: 数值测试围绕冷相对论双流与Weibel/成丝不稳定性展开，并诊断能量漂移、Gauss定律、Lorenz规范、粒子–网格做功及轨道链式法则。

title: Ornstein-Uhlenbeck Is Hard to Beat, Yet Superlinear Drift Ships Lower Transport Costs
summary: Brešar and Mijatović \cite{bresar2025} show that Ornstein--Uhlenbeck diffusion is hard to beat in forward convergence under assumptions that exclude superlinear drift. We instead test superlinear Langevin diffusions for score-based image generation, computing their conditional scores numerically from a Fokker--Planck equation. In our experiments, the superlinear models beat the Ornstein--Uhlenbeck baseline on empirical Wasserstein distance across nearly the entire tested grid and show less variation across diffusion horizons. The ``hard to beat'' verdict of \cite{bresar2025} thus fails to be universal.

AI.tldr: 本文检验超线性 Langevin 扩散在基于分数的图像生成中的表现，通过数值求解 Fokker–Planck 方程计算条件分数，发现超线性模型在多数测试网格上优于 Ornstein–Uhlenbeck 基线，表明后者的"难以超越"结论并不普适。
AI.motivation: Brešar 与 Mijatović（2025）在排除超线性漂移的假设下证明 Ornstein–Uhlenbeck 扩散在前向收敛中"难以被超越"。本文旨在检验该结论在超线性漂移情形下是否仍然成立。
AI.method: 测试超线性 Langevin 扩散用于基于分数的图像生成；通过 Fokker–Planck 方程数值计算其条件分数。
AI.result: 实验中，超线性模型在几乎整个测试网格上于经验 Wasserstein 距离指标上优于 Ornstein–Uhlenbeck 基线，并在不同扩散视界下表现出更小的波动。
AI.conclusion: Brešar 与 Mijatović 关于 Ornstein–Uhlenbeck 扩散"难以超越"的论断并不具有普适性。

title: Derivation of the General Solution of the Black-Scholes Boundary-Value Problem
summary: There are infinitely many functions that satisfy the Black-Scholes partial differential equation and the terminal condition corresponding to the European call option. This means that the Black-Scholes formula, which led to the award of the 1997 Nobel Prize in Economic Sciences, is not the unique solution, as was once assumed. Consequently, it violates the law of one price, one of the fundamental laws of economics and finance. In this article, we present a rigorous derivation of these solutions to the Black-Scholes boundary value problem.

AI.tldr: 本文指出满足Black-Scholes偏微分方程及欧式看涨期权终端条件的函数有无穷多个，因此Black-Scholes公式并非唯一解，违背了一价定律；文章给出了这些解的严格推导。
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为Black-Scholes公式是Black-Scholes边值问题的唯一解，但作者发现满足同一偏微分方程与终端条件的函数实际上有无穷多个，这一非唯一性会动摇该公式的权威性并违反经济学的一价定律，故有必要加以严格论证。
AI.method: 通过严格的数学推导，求解Black-Scholes边界值问题，构造并刻画满足Black-Scholes偏微分方程和欧式看涨期权终端条件的全部解。
AI.result: 证明满足Black-Scholes偏微分方程与欧式看涨期权终端条件的解不唯一，存在无穷多个解，从而说明Black-Scholes公式并非唯一解，并因此违背一价定律。
AI.conclusion: Black-Scholes公式的唯一性假设不成立，其定价结论存在理论缺陷；作者给出的严格推导为重新审视期权定价理论提供了数学基础。

title: Binarization Flattens the Score Space
summary: Large language model (LLM) judges are often used as rewards to train policies on objectives that deterministic verifiers cannot capture. However, these rewards are often collapsed to pass/fail ({0, 1}), which reports the verdict but not how well a response met each criterion. We model each pass/fail verdict as a score on an unreported scale, compared with one cutoff. A stretch of that scale moves every score proportionally toward or away from the cutoff, but never across it, so no verdict changes. A policy is therefore free to apply any stretch without changing anything the panel reports. Under a joint-Gaussian model, a third grade adds a second threshold and removes this affine stretch ambiguity. On MATH and SciBench outputs from one seven-criterion judge, all 14 constructed criterionwise stretches were invisible after binarization but visible with three grades. At $n=1{,}024$, a test given both population laws had at least 96.5% power at a $1.5\times$ stress. Retaining grades closes one blind spot created by binarization, but verdicts alone remain insufficient as some changes are still indistinguishable from genuine improvement. These include arbitrary within-grade changes and fixed-covariance, loading-aligned mean shifts -- the signature of a sycophancy-shaped lift the panel reads as competence. The shared-factor reference approximation fit MATH and SciBench but not HealthBench, delineating its empirical scope. We recommend keeping at least three grades (for example, asking the judge whether each criterion is fully, partially, or not met and rewarding {0, 0.5, 1}), and externally validating gains along the remaining direction, which no finer scale removes.

AI.tldr: 二元化（pass/fail）奖励会掩盖评分尺度上的仿射拉伸变化；保留三档评分可消除这一盲点，但仍有无法由评分区分的变化（如顺从性抬升），需外部验证。
AI.motivation: LLM评委常被用作奖励信号，但奖励被坍缩为{0,1}的通过/失败判定，只报告结论而不报告响应在各标准上的达标程度，导致奖励信号信息损失。
AI.method: 将每个通过/失败判定建模为未报告尺度上的分数与单一阈值的比较；证明该尺度上的仿射拉伸不会跨越阈值、不改变任何判定。在联合高斯模型下引入第二阈值（三档评分）以消除这种拉伸歧义。在一个七标准评委的MATH与SciBench输出上构造14个逐标准拉伸进行检验，并在n=1024时对同时给定总体分布的检验做功效分析。
AI.result: 14个构造的逐标准拉伸在二元化后全部不可见，三档评分下可见。n=1024时，对同时给定总体分布的检验在1.5倍压力下功效至少96.5%。但三档评分仍无法识别类内任意变化，以及固定协方差、载荷对齐的均值漂移（面板误读为能力提升的顺从性特征）。共享因子参考近似拟合MATH与SciBench，但不拟合HealthBench。
AI.conclusion: 建议保留至少三档评分（如让评委判断每条标准为完全/部分/未满足并奖励{0,0.5,1}），并对剩余方向上的增益进行外部验证——该方向无法通过更细的评分尺度消除。

title: Renormalized Invariant Manifolds
summary: Invariant manifold theory for partial differential equations (PDEs) is technically challenging as we often lack spectral gaps. Motivated by recent progress using renormalization in various areas of mathematics, we introduce a spectral renormalization method for semilinear parabolic equations that creates an artificial spectral gap at high frequencies while leaving the low modes unchanged. For the resulting family of renormalized equations, classical inertial-manifold theory yields finite-dimensional invariant manifolds whose dimension diverges as the renormalization parameter tends to zero. We show that the reduced dynamics on these manifolds approximate the original semiflow through an approximate semi-conjugacy, with an $O(ε^2)$ error on bounded finite-time intervals. Under global incremental dissipativity, the semi-conjugacy is uniform in time and yields an $O(ε^2)$ Hausdorff estimate for the global attractors, if they exist. We also establish further dynamical properties of the spectral renormalization such as persistence of hyperbolic equilibria and their Morse indices. We illustrate the construction in settings with and without a natural spectral gap and embed it into a two-parameter fast-slow PDE framework, where the artificial gap enables us to construct slow manifolds for systems on bounded domains with arbitrary dimension. Thus our new approach provides a finite-dimensional dynamical approximation even in regimes where an exact inertial manifold for the original equation is not available. In particular, this provides a practical balance between fully invariant manifolds and direct estimates.

AI.tldr: 提出谱重正化方法为半线性抛物型方程在高频处人为构造谱间隙，借助经典惯性流形理论得到有限维不变流形，其约化动力学以O(ε²)精度近似原半流。
AI.motivation: PDE的不变流形理论因常缺乏谱间隙而技术困难，尤其在无自然谱间隙的情形下难以获得精确惯性流形，需要一种能兼顾不变性与直接估计的有限维近似手段。
AI.method: 对半线性抛物型方程引入谱重正化：在高频人为制造谱间隙而保持低模态不变；对重正化后方程族应用经典惯性流形理论，得到维数随重正化参数趋于零而发散的有限维不变流形，并通过近似半共轭联系约化动力学与原半流；进一步嵌入双参数快-慢PDE框架构造慢流形。
AI.result: 约化动力学在有限时间区间上以O(ε²)误差近似原半流；在全局增量耗散性下，半共轭关于时间一致，并给出全局吸引子的O(ε²) Hausdorff估计（若存在）。同时证明了双曲平衡点的持久性及其Morse指数的保持，并在有无自然谱间隙及任意维有界区域上验证了构造。
AI.conclusion: 谱重正化为缺乏精确惯性流形的方程提供了有限维动力学近似，在完全不变流形与直接估计之间取得了实用平衡。

title: Rheotaxis of a Microswimmer in Poiseuille Flow
summary: We investigate the motion of a spherical microswimmer in a planar Poiseuille flow using analytical calculations and numerical simulations. Our results show that the microswimmer's orientation undergoes periodic oscillations governed by pendulum-like dynamics. The oscillation period is proportional to the channel width and to the complete elliptic integral of the first kind evaluated at the maximum orientation angle, and inversely proportional to the square root of the product of the maximum flow speed and the self-propulsion speed. Based on the net displacement along the flow direction within one oscillation period and the signs of the maximum and minimum velocities, we identify five motion states: upstream, oscillatory upstream, zero-drift oscillatory, oscillatory downstream, and downstream motion. The net displacement is jointly determined by the ratio of the self-propulsion speed to the maximum flow speed and the complete elliptic integrals of the first and second kinds. The signs of the maximum and minimum velocities are determined by the speed ratio and the cosine of the orientation angle. Flow nonuniformity promotes upstream migration, whereas inertial lift produces negligible radial displacement during one oscillation period. These findings identify the key parameters governing the motion of spherical microswimmers and provide significant implications for understanding microorganism motility and designing microrobots with prescribed motion states.

AI.tldr: 本文通过解析计算与数值模拟，研究平面Poiseuille流中球形微游动器的运动，揭示其取向呈类单摆周期振荡，并识别出五种运动状态及其控制参数。
AI.motivation: 理解微游动器（如微生物、微型机器人）在非均匀流场中的输运规律，明确控制其运动状态的关键参数，为微生物运动学研究和具有指定运动状态的微机器人设计提供依据。
AI.method: 采用解析计算结合数值模拟，分析球形微游动器在平面Poiseuille流中的取向动力学（类单摆方程），推导振荡周期、净位移表达式，并依据速度极值符号划分运动状态。
AI.result: 取向呈类单摆周期振荡，周期正比于通道宽度与第一类完全椭圆积分（以最大取向角为参数），反比于最大流速与自推进速度乘积的平方根。依据一个振荡周期内沿流向的净位移及最大、最小速度符号，划分出五种运动状态：上游、振荡上游、零漂移振荡、振荡下游、下游运动。净位移由自推进速度与最大流速之比以及第一、第二类完全椭圆积分共同决定；速度极值符号由速度比与取向角余弦决定。流动非均匀性促进上游迁移，而惯性升力在一个振荡周期内的径向位移可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 研究确定了调控球形微游动器运动的关键参数，对理解微生物游动行为及设计具有预设运动状态的微机器人具有重要意义。

title: Geometry-Controlled Chern transfer and Flat Band Reconstruction in distorted kagome lattices
summary: Flat band formation and nontrivial topology are central manifestations of kagome electronic structure, yet they are commonly discussed in idealized lattice geometries. In distorted kagome materials, structural deformation reorganizes electronic propagation pathways, but a microscopic understanding of how such distortions govern flat band dispersion and band topology is still lacking. Using a distorted kagome tight-binding model with rotated angle dependent long-range hopping and intrinsic spin-orbit coupling, we show that distortion reconstructs both the dispersion and topology of the kagome band manifold. The flat band descendant develops distinct bandwidth regimes associated with a redistribution of its extrema in momentum space. Simultaneously, symmetry-related band inversions generate quantized Chern number transfer whose parity is fixed by the multiplicity of the touching points, thereby determining the gap-resolved Z2 topology. The accompanying Berry curvature evolution produces characteristic anomalous Hall and Nernst responses. These results identify geometric deformation as a common microscopic origin of flat band and topological reconstruction in kagome systems.

AI.tldr: 该文利用含旋转角依赖长程跃迁与内禀自旋轨道耦合的畸变kagome紧束缚模型，揭示几何形变如何同时重构平带色散与能带拓扑。
AI.motivation: 平带与拓扑是kagome电子结构的核心表现，但常基于理想晶格讨论；畸变kagome中结构变形如何微观地调控平带色散与拓扑仍缺乏理解。
AI.method: 构建畸变kagome紧束缚模型，引入随旋转角变化的长程跃迁和本征自旋轨道耦合，分析能带色散、对称性相关带反转、Chern数转移、Z2拓扑及Berry曲率演化。
AI.result: 平带派生带呈现不同带宽区间并伴随动量空间极值重分布；带反转导致量子化Chern数转移，其奇偶性由接触点重数决定，从而确定带隙分辨的Z2拓扑；Berry曲率演化产生特征性反常霍尔与能斯特响应。
AI.conclusion: 几何形变被确认为kagome体系中平带与拓扑重构的共同微观起源。

title: Tensor-Train Compressed Separable PINNs: A Curvature-Aware Optimization Framework for Parametric PDEs in High Dimensions
summary: In this work, we develop a second-order optimization framework for physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) applied to high-dimensional parametric partial differential equations (PDEs). The framework is built on the Gauss--Newton pullback metric, which provides an operator-informed notion of curvature in parameter space and connects the method to the broader family of natural gradient schemes. We show that, for coordinate-separable neural architectures and linear differential operators (or linearized operators in the nonlinear case) admitting a finite separable representation, the residual Jacobian inherits a structured separable factorization. This yields an exact compressed formulation of the Gauss--Newton step in a reduced space, without assembling the full residual Jacobian on the exponentially large tensor-product collocation grid. The dimension of the reduced space (the effective compressed dimension) is determined by the local collocation grid sizes, the separable operator structure, and the contraction pattern of the architecture, thereby avoiding dependence on the full tensor-product grid size and replacing dense linear algebra in parameter space by a substantially smaller structured problem. Within our framework, we investigate canonical polyadic and tensor-train parametrizations and derive their full algebraic characterization relevant to the Gauss--Newton method, including the structure of the residual Jacobian, the resulting compressed system, and its effective compressed dimension. Numerical experiments on high-dimensional PDEs, including parametric problems, demonstrate the high efficiency of the proposed compressed Gauss--Newton method, which achieves substantially lower errors than tensor-compressed first-order baselines with orders of magnitude fewer iterations and only a fraction of the computing time.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种针对高维参数偏微分方程的物理信息神经网络（PINNs）二阶优化框架，基于Gauss–Newton pullback度量，为坐标可分离网络与可分离线性算子导出残差雅可比的压缩分解，从而在缩减空间中精确求解Gauss–Newton步。
AI.motivation: 高维参数PDE中，PINNs的残差雅可比需在指数级张量积配点上组装，导致稠密线性代数代价过高；一阶优化方法收敛慢、误差大。因此需要一种利用问题结构与网络结构、避免全网格组装的高效二阶优化方法。
AI.method: 构建基于Gauss–Newton pullback度量的二阶优化框架，将其与自然梯度方法族相联系。针对坐标可分离架构与具有有限可分离表示的线性（或线性化）微分算子，证明残差雅可比具有结构化可分离因子分解，从而在缩减空间中精确压缩Gauss–Newton步，无需组装完整残差雅可比。有效压缩维度由局部配点网格尺寸、算子可分离结构与架构收缩模式决定。并对CP（canonical polyadic）与张量列（tensor-train）参数化给出完整代数刻画，包括残差雅可比结构、压缩系统及有效压缩维度。
AI.result: 在高维PDE（含参数化问题）上的数值实验表明，所提压缩Gauss–Newton方法效率显著：相比张量压缩的一阶基线，误差大幅降低，迭代次数少数个数量级，计算时间仅为其一小部分。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了可分离架构下PINNs二阶优化的压缩理论，用结构化缩减问题替代参数空间的稠密线性代数，有效规避对全张量积配点网格的依赖，为高维参数PDE求解提供了高效精准的优化途径。

title: Vanishing of degree $3$ unramified cohomology over finite fields
summary:
Let $k$ be a finite field of characteristic $p
eq 3$, let $E/k$ be the Fermat cubic curve, and let $\ell
eq p$ be a prime. If $p\equiv1\pmod3$, assume moreover that $\ell>3$. Then $H^3_{\mathrm{nr}}(k(E^3)/k,\mathbb{Q}_\ell/\mathbb{Z}_\ell(2))=0$ and the cycle map \[CH^2(E^3)_{\mathbb{Z}_\ell}\longrightarrow H^4(E^3,\mathbb{Z}_\ell(2))\] is surjective. In particular, $H^3_{\mathrm{nr}}(\overline{k}(E^3)/\overline{k},\mathbb{Q}_\ell/\mathbb{Z}_\ell(2))=0$.
  Assuming the Tate conjecture for surfaces over finite fields, we prove an analogous surjectivity result, for all but finitely many primes $\ell
eq p$, for the integral cycle maps for $1$-cycles on every smooth projective variety of dimension $d$ over a finite field of characteristic different from $2$ which admits a smooth projective lift to the ring of Witt vectors.
  We apply our results to a conjecture of Colliot-Thélène on the local--global principle for zero-cycles over global function fields. To further illustrate these results, we exhibit examples showing that vanishing of degree-$3$ unramified cohomology over the algebraic closure of the ground field does not imply vanishing over any finite subextension, not even for Fano varieties.

AI.tldr: 本文研究有限域上Fermat三次曲线三次乘积的未分歧上同调与整系数cycle map的满射性，并在Tate猜想下推广到一般光滑射影簇，应用于零闭链的局部-整体原则，并给出未分歧上同调在代数闭包与有限子扩张间不保持消失的反例。
AI.motivation: 围绕有限域上代数簇的Tate猜想、未分歧上同调与整系数cycle map的满射性，以及Colliot-Thélène关于整体函数域上零闭链局部-整体原则的猜想展开，旨在厘清这些算术几何对象之间的关系并给出具体验证与反例。
AI.method: 以特征p≠3的有限域上Fermat三次曲线E为对象，在p≡1 mod 3时要求ℓ>3，计算H^3_nr(k(E^3)/k,Q_ℓ/Z_ℓ(2))并分析cycle map；在假设有限域上曲面Tate猜想的前提下，对可由Witt向量环光滑射影提升、特征不为2的有限域上任意d维光滑射影簇的1-cycles，证明除有限多个ℓ≠p外整系数cycle map的满射性。
AI.result: 证明了H^3_nr(k(E^3)/k,Q_ℓ/Z_ℓ(2))=0及CH^2(E^3)_{Z_ℓ}→H^4(E^3,Z_ℓ(2))满射，特别地有H^3_nr(\bar{k}(E^3)/\bar{k},Q_ℓ/Z_ℓ(2))=0；在Tate猜想假设下得到上述一般簇的满射性结果；并构造出即便对Fano簇，度3未分歧上同调在基域代数闭包上消失也不蕴含在任何有限子扩张上消失的例子。
AI.conclusion: 有限域上Fermat三次曲线三次乘积的未分歧上同调消失且cycle map满射；在Tate猜想下该满射性可推广至可提升的光滑射影簇；结果用于Colliot-Thélène的零闭链局部-整体原则猜想，同时表明代数闭包上未分歧上同调消失与有限子扩张上的消失性存在本质差异。

title: A unified structure-preserving framework for geometric flows with coupled orientation and curvature dependence
summary: We develop a structure-preserving parametric finite element framework for geometric flows whose energy density couples the unit normal and the curvature. This class includes bending energies with orientation-dependent rigidity or spontaneous curvature. A common fully discrete formulation treats closed curves in two dimensions and closed surfaces in three dimensions, and accommodates the $L^2$ flow, curve or surface diffusion, and the area- or volume-constrained $L^2$ flow. The formulation couples the geometric and curvature updates so that their contributions satisfy a discrete energy inequality. It uses continuous piecewise linear elements, a surface energy matrix, and a mass-lumped projection of the curvature derivative of the density. For positive densities satisfying a directional condition and convexity in curvature, we prove energy dissipation without a time-step restriction. The diffusion and constrained flows also preserve the enclosed area or volume exactly. The analysis allows non-even anisotropies and nonseparable dependence on orientation and curvature. Numerical experiments exhibit approximately second-order convergence in the manifold distance and confirm the discrete structural properties. Shape relaxation under an anisotropic Helfrich-type energy illustrates the use of the framework for coupled directional and bending effects.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个保结构参数化有限元框架，用于处理能量密度同时耦合单位法向与曲率的几何流，包括方向依赖刚性或自发曲率的弯曲能量，统一涵盖二维闭合曲线与三维闭合曲面，以及L²流、曲线/曲面扩散和面积/体积约束的L²流。
AI.motivation: 几何流问题（如弯曲能量驱动的演化）中，能量密度常同时依赖单位法向与曲率，且涉及各向异性（方向依赖刚性）与自发曲率。已有离散格式多难以在无时间步限制下保持离散能量耗散，且常局限于偶各向异性或可分离形式，缺乏统一且保结构的数值框架。
AI.method: 构建统一的完全离散参数化有限元格式，采用连续分片线性元、表面能量矩阵以及曲率密度导数的质量集中投影；将几何更新与曲率更新耦合，使二者贡献满足离散能量不等式。
AI.result: 在密度为正、满足方向性条件且关于曲率凸的条件下，证明了无时间步限制的离散能量耗散；扩散流与约束流精确保持围合面积或体积；数值实验显示流形距离上近似二阶收敛，并验证离散结构性质；各向异性Helfrich型能量下的形状松弛展示了方向与弯曲耦合效应。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为法向-曲率耦合的几何流提供了统一、保结构的数值方法，理论分析允非偶各向异性及方向与曲率不可分离的依赖，数值结果验证了能量耗散与几何约束保持等结构性质。

title: A Finslerian Approach for Embedding Directed Data
summary: Many datasets carry an intrinsic directionality: citations point backward in time, cells differentiate along lineages, and traffic follows preferred routes. Spectral embedding methods, including most of their extensions to directed graphs, discard this information: they symmetrize the data and map it into a Euclidean space where asymmetry cannot be represented. We instead model directed data as sampled from a Finsler manifold, whose distance depends on the direction of travel, and study the kernel operator built from this asymmetric distance. Through a moment expansion of this operator, we show that its symmetric and antisymmetric parts separate geometry from direction. As the bandwidth of the kernel vanishes, the symmetric part converges to a weighted Laplacian, recovering diffusion maps in the Riemannian case, while the antisymmetric part converges to a first-order transport operator that encodes the directionality. We prove that the corresponding graph operators, built from finitely many samples, converge uniformly and almost surely to these limits. For Randers metrics, this vector field is explicit and yields an embedding algorithm recovering both the manifold structure, from the spectrum of the symmetric part, and the underlying drift. We illustrate the approach on synthetic directed graphs and point-clouds.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用Finsler流形对具有内在方向性的数据进行建模，通过核算子的矩展开分离对称（几何）与反对称（方向）部分，证明其分别收敛于加权Laplacian和输运算子，并给出针对Randers度量的嵌入算法。
AI.motivation: 许多数据集具有内在方向性（如引用指向过去、细胞沿谱系分化、交通遵循偏好路径），但现有谱嵌入方法（含多数有向图扩展）通过对称化丢弃了方向信息，并映射到无法表示非对称性的欧氏空间中。
AI.method: 将方向性数据建模为从Finsler流形采样，其距离依赖行进方向；研究由该非对称距离构造的核算子，通过矩展开将算子的对称部分与反对称部分分离；对带宽趋于零的极限及有限样本下图算子进行分析；针对Randers度量给出显式向量场与嵌入算法。
AI.result: 对称部分在带宽消失时收敛于加权Laplacian（Riemannian情形下恢复diffusion maps），反对称部分收敛于编码方向性的一阶输运算子；证明由有限样本构造的图算子几乎必然一致收敛到这两个极限；Randers度量下该向量场显式可得，嵌入算法能同时从对称部分的谱恢复流形结构与潜在漂移；在合成有向图与点云上进行了验证。
AI.conclusion: 通过Finsler流形建模与核算子的对称/反对称分解，可在统一框架下同时恢复数据的几何结构与方向性（漂移），为有向数据的谱嵌入提供了理论基础与可行算法。

title: From $3$-spin to Negative $r$-spin: Limits of Cohomological Field Theories and Tautological Relations
summary:
We prove that the negative $r$-spin tautological relations of Chidambaram--Garcia-Failde--Giacchetto are a consequence of Pixton's $3$-spin relations, for every $r\ge2$, and deduce that they hold in the tautological Chow ring of $\overline{\mathcal{M}}_{g,n}$. In particular, our result for $r=2$ implies that Kazarian--Norbury $K$-relations hold in Chow.
  The proof factors through two essential parts. The first part shows that the tautological relations arising from Chiodo's class imply the negative $r$-spin relations. This requires an intricate study of limiting behavior of the Givental--Teleman graph contributions. In the second part, we show that the Chiodo relations are a consequence of Pixton's $3$-spin relations as an application of a generalization of Janda's work on tautological relations from CohFTs.

AI.tldr: 该论文证明：对于任意 r≥2，Chidambaram–Garcia-Failde–Giacchetto 的负 r-旋量（negative r-spin）tautological 关系是 Pixton 3-旋量关系的推论，因此这些关系在 M̄_{g,n} 的 tautological Chow 环中成立；特别地，r=2 时 Kazarian–Norbury K-关系在 Chow 中成立。
AI.motivation: 负 r-旋量 tautological 关系此前由 Chidambaram–Garcia-Failde–Giacchetto 提出，但其与已有经典关系（Pixton 3-旋量关系）之间的联系以及在 Chow 环层面的有效性尚不明确。本文旨在建立这一联系，统一理解这些关系的来源，并推进 Kazarian–Norbury K-关系在 Chow 中的成立性。
AI.method: 证明分两大部分。第一部分：证明由 Chiodo 类产生的 tautological 关系可推出负 r-旋量关系，关键在于细致研究 Givental–Teleman 图贡献的极限行为。第二部分：将 Janda 关于 CohFT 导出 tautological 关系的工作进行推广，据此说明 Chiodo 关系是 Pixton 3-旋量关系的推论。
AI.result: 证明了对每个 r≥2，负 r-旋量 tautological 关系均由 Pixton 3-旋量关系推出，并由此得出这些关系在 M̄_{g,n} 的 tautological Chow 环中成立；作为特例，r=2 的情形给出 Kazarian–Norbury K-关系在 Chow 中成立。
AI.conclusion: 负 r-旋量关系并非独立的新关系，而是 Pixton 3-旋量关系的推论；这一归约同时确立了其在 tautological Chow 环中的有效性，并附带解决了 Kazarian–Norbury K-关系在 Chow 中的成立问题。

title: HeadGuard: Selective Head Protection for Low-Bit VLM KV-Cache Quantization
summary: Low-bit key-value (KV) cache quantization saves storage but can sharply degrade vision-language model (VLM) accuracy. We introduce HeadGuard, a composable head-protection method that augments a base KV-cache quantizer with a fixed high-precision mask. Image-sensitivity and output-sensitivity scores select physical KV heads offline, with approximately 1/8 protected in the main experiments; their image keys and optionally values remain in bfloat16 (BF16), while the base quantizes unprotected image entries. Across eight VLMs, three base quantizers, and eight benchmarks (six discriminative and two generative), HeadGuard recovers a substantial fraction of lost accuracy on weaker quantizers, with the strongest gains for Qwen and InternVL. At 2 bits, the six-task discriminative mean over eight models rises from 0.436 to 0.580 on the weakest base; protection can also improve generated answers and caption fidelity to BF16 outputs. Mean accuracy gains persist across all three quantizers with both tested calibration datasets. Keys-only protection retains substantial recovery at lower modeled storage cost. Evaluated through simulated quantization, HeadGuard offers a composable way to improve low-bit VLM accuracy without replacing the underlying quantizer.

AI.tldr: HeadGuard：一种可组合的头部保护方法，通过在KV缓存量化器中固定保留约1/8高精度KV头（BF16），显著缓解低比特VLM精度下降。
AI.motivation: 低比特KV缓存量化虽能节省存储，但会严重损害视觉语言模型（VLM）精度，需要在保留量化收益的同时恢复精度。
AI.method: HeadGuard在基础KV缓存量化器上加入固定高精度掩码：离线利用图像敏感度和输出敏感度评分选择物理KV头，主实验中保护约1/8的头部，其图像键（可选值）保持BF16，未保护的图像条目由基础量化器压缩。方法可组合于三种基础量化器，测试两套校准数据集，并可仅保护键以降低建模存储开销；实验通过模拟量化评估。
AI.result: 在八个VLM、三种基础量化器和八个基准（六个判别式、两个生成式）上，HeadGuard在较弱量化器上恢复了相当一部分丢失精度，Qwen与InternVL增益最强。2比特下，最弱基础量化器的八模型六任务判别均值由0.436升至0.580；还能提升生成答案与标题保真度至BF16输出水平。所有三种量化器均保持平均精度增益。
AI.conclusion: HeadGuard是一种可组合方案，无需替换底层量化器即可提升低比特VLM精度。

title: Morse index and spectral asymptotics of least-energy solutions to the Choquard equation in planar domains
summary:
We investigate the Morse index and spectral asymptotics of least-energy solutions to the planar Choquard equation \begin{equation*} \begin{cases}
  -Δu = \displaystyle\left(\int_Ω \frac{u^{p+1}(y)}{|x - y|^α}dy\right) u^p & \text{in } Ω, \\ u > 0 & \text{in } Ω, \\ u = 0 & \text{on } \partial Ω, \end{cases} \end{equation*} where $Ω\subset\mathbb R^2$ is a smooth bounded domain and $0<α<1$. Under some geometric assumptions, we obtain sharp asymptotics for the first four eigenpairs of the linearized problem as $p\to+\infty$. The first eigenvalue is exactly $(2p+1)^{-1}$. The second and third eigenfunctions give the translation modes of the limiting bubble, and their eigenvalue expansions are determined by the Hessian of the Robin function at the concentration point. The fourth eigenfunction gives the dilation mode with eigenvalue $1+3(4-α)/(2p)+o(p^{-1})$. As a consequence, we derive a comparison between the spectral indices of the solution and the critical-point indices of the Robin function.The proofs combine variational estimates, blow-up analysis and nonlocal Pohožaev identities.

AI.tldr: 本文研究平面Choquard方程在$p\to+\infty$时最小能量解的Morse指标与谱渐近，得到线性化问题前四特征对的精确渐近，并据此比较解谱指标与Robin函数临界点指标。
AI.motivation: 刻画非局部Choquard方程集中解在线性化算子谱层面的精细结构，建立谱指标与Robin函数临界点指标之间的联系。
AI.method: 变分估计、爆破分析（blow-up analysis）以及非局部Pohožaev恒等式。
AI.result: 在几何假设下获得线性化问题前四特征对当$p\to+\infty$时的精确渐近：第一特征值恰为$(2p+1)^{-1}$；第二、三特征函数对应极限气泡的平移模式，其展开由集中点处Robin函数Hessian决定；第四特征函数对应伸缩模式，特征值为$1+3(4-\alpha)/(2p)+o(p^{-1})$。
AI.conclusion: 由此导出解的谱指标与Robin函数临界点指标之间的比较关系。

title: Probabilistic Symbolic-Distillation Model of Droplet Collision for Spray Simulation at High Ambient Pressures
summary: Droplet collision governs droplet population dynamics in many chemical engineering processes, such as spray drying, spray cooling, agricultural spraying, and combustion. Existing analytical models impose deterministic, pairwise boundaries between collision outcomes, whereas machine-learning classifiers lack the explicit functional form required of analytical collision submodels. In this study, we develop a probabilistic symbolic-distillation model using nearly forty thousand experimental events spanning eight regimes and five dimensionless parameters, including over five thousand data for ambient pressure up to 50 atm. A machine-learning teacher learns the joint outcome-probability landscape from these data, and symbolic regression subsequently distils it into eight class-specific expressions that jointly define a coupled analytical model. The resulting analytical field replaces abrupt regime switching with finite-width fuzzy boundaries. It outperforms the evaluated conventional analytical boundary models and reveals that their main limitation is the inability of zero-width boundaries to represent gradual probability transitions. The "biased-dice" sampling scheme provides a statistically consistent and practically convenient model implementation for Eulerian-Lagrangian spray simulation.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出概率符号蒸馏模型，用近四万实验事件与机器学习教师模型学习液滴碰撞结果概率分布，再经符号回归蒸馏为八个类别的解析表达式，形成耦合解析模型，以有限宽度模糊边界替代传统突变异区切换。
AI.motivation: 液滴碰撞决定喷雾干燥、喷雾冷却、农业喷雾与燃烧等过程的液滴群体动力学。现有解析模型采用确定性、成对的碰撞结果边界，无法刻画概率渐变；而机器学习分类器又缺乏解析碰撞子模型所需的显式函数形式，因此需要兼顾概率刻画与解析可解释性的建模方法。
AI.method: 构建概率符号蒸馏模型：使用近四万个实验事件，覆盖八个碰撞区间及五个无量纲参数，其中包含五千余条环境压力至50 atm的数据。先以机器学习教师模型学习联合的“结果-概率”景观，再通过符号回归将其蒸馏为八个类别专属表达式，共同构成耦合解析模型；并采用“biased-dice”采样方案实现模型。
AI.result: 所得解析场以有限宽度的模糊边界取代突变异区切换，性能优于所评估的传统解析边界模型；分析揭示传统模型的主要局限在于零宽度边界无法表达渐进概率过渡。biased-dice采样方案为欧拉-拉格朗日喷雾模拟提供了统计一致且实用的模型实现。
AI.conclusion: 将机器学习概率学习与符号回归蒸馏相结合，可在保持解析显式形式的同时刻画液滴碰撞结果的概率渐变，克服传统零宽度边界模型的局限，并为喷雾数值模拟提供可实施的建模方案。

title: Conservation-Syndrome Quantum Error Correction for Lattice-Boltzmann Quantum Algorithms
summary: Reliable multistep quantum lattice-Boltzmann evolution requires controlling computational faults. When ideal collision preserves encoded mass and momentum exactly, changes in those charges can provide syndromes for selected faults at the post-collision checkpoint. A fault that shifts one population then leaves a unique mass-momentum residual labeled by the lattice velocity. A coherent reference register stores the expected charges, so the same test remains valid while the physical fluid charges vary across the lattice. Single bit flips on population number registers occupy disjoint syndrome sectors and satisfy the Knill-Laflamme condition. A state-vector demonstration on eighteen data qubits of the two-dimensional nine-velocity lattice (D2Q9) recovers that single-bit family to double-precision roundoff. Conservation still leaves a fifteen-dimensional kinetic nullspace on the three-dimensional nineteen-velocity lattice (D3Q19). Exact multiple-relaxation-time (MRT) streaming analysis ranks those charge-preserving modes by the order at which they return to density or momentum. A classical D3Q19 decaying-flow simulation at moderate Reynolds number then injects about $1.75\times10^4$ selected single-population shifts per realization. Recovery of that alphabet returns the trajectory to floating-point roundoff. The quantum statements assume an ideal charge-preserving collision and a reliable reference. The result is an inner recovery map for a stated charge-changing alphabet together with a kinetic classification of the unresolved sector.

AI.tldr: 利用量子格子玻尔兹曼演化中守恒量变化作为故障综合征，实现了单比特故障族的纠错恢复，并对守恒无法覆盖的零空间模式做了动理学分类。
AI.motivation: 可靠的多步量子格子玻尔兹曼演化需要控制计算故障。理想碰撞严格守恒编码的质量与动量，因此这些守恒荷的变化可作为碰撞后检查点处特定故障的综合征，从而在量子模拟中定位并纠正错误。
AI.method: 以理想守恒碰撞为前提，用相干参考寄存器存储期望电荷，使检测在流体电荷随格点变化的条件下仍有效；分析单比特翻转在集居数寄存器的综合征分区及Knill-Laflamme条件；在D2Q9的18个数据比特上做态矢量演示；对D3Q19用精确MRT流动分析，按模式回归密度或动量的阶数对守恒零空间排序，并在中等雷诺数经典衰减流中以每个实现约1.75×10^4次单集居数位移进行验证。
AI.result: D2Q9态矢量演示可将单比特故障族恢复到双精度舍入误差；D3Q19仍存在15维动理学零空间，MRT分析给出守恒模式的排序；经典D3Q19模拟中该故障字母表的恢复使轨迹回到浮点舍入误差。
AI.conclusion: 该工作给出了针对特定电荷改变字母表的内部恢复映射，并给出了未解决零空间扇区的动理学分类；结论依赖理想守恒碰撞与可靠参考寄存器的假设。

title: Feasibility Correction in Linear Programs
summary: We study feasibility correction for linear programs. Suppose an initial point satisfies most of the constraints. Can it be moved into the feasible region without changing the objective value? Our main deterministic result says that this is possible if the constraint matrix satisfies a restricted isometry property (RIP). We apply the correction theorem to obtain lower bounds for random linear programs with finite-moment or sub-Weibull entries. We complement these with matching-order upper bounds under a uniform $p$th-moment bound for some $p>2$ and a delocalization condition on the objective direction. As an application of our techniques, we also derive lower bounds for the Gaussian width of feasible regions under RIP assumptions.

AI.tldr: 该文研究线性规划的可行性修正问题：若初始点满足大多数约束，能否在不改变目标值的前提下将其移入可行域。作者证明，当约束矩阵满足限制等距性质（RIP）时可行，并据此给出随机线性规划的下界，同时给出在p阶矩一致界与目标方向离域条件下的匹配阶上界，并应用于Gaussian宽度下界。
AI.motivation: 该研究关注线性规划中"近似可行点能否低成本修正为可行点且不改变目标值"这一基本问题，并希望将可行性修正工具用于刻画随机线性规划最优值的行为，弥补现有对随机LP下界与上界分析的工具不足。
AI.method: 核心方法是证明一个确定性可行性修正定理：在约束矩阵满足限制等距性质（RIP）的条件下，可修正初始点至可行域而不改变目标值。随后将该定理应用于有限矩或次Weibull型随机项的随机线性规划以得到下界，并在p>2的一致p阶矩界与目标方向离域条件下推导匹配阶上界；此外将技术用于RIP假设下可行域Gaussian宽度的下界分析。
AI.result: 在RIP条件下建立了可行性修正定理；由此获得随机线性规划（有限矩或次Weibull项）的下界；在一致p阶矩界（p>2）与目标方向离域条件下给出匹配阶上界；并导出了RIP假设下可行域Gaussian宽度的下界。
AI.conclusion: 可行性修正可在RIP下无损（保持目标值）实现，这为随机线性规划的最优值提供了紧致的下界与（在相应假设下的）匹配上界，并可作为分析可行域Gaussian宽度等几何量的通用工具。

title: Crossover of Scaling Behaviors of Work Cumulants in a Driven Gaussian Field Theory
summary: We derive the finite-temperature characteristic function of work (CFW) for a driven $O(N)$ Gaussian field theory and obtain closed-form expressions for all zero-temperature excess-work cumulants. For gapped protocols, we use adiabatic perturbation theory (APT) to derive the $τ_Q^{-2}$ scaling for protocols with a nonzero first derivative at either boundary, where $τ_Q$ is the protocol duration; smoother boundaries lead to faster decay. For power-law protocols approaching the critical point with exponent $p$, we determine the competition between critical excitations and the regular contribution. The $n$th cumulant's critical contribution follows Kibble--Zurek (KZ) scaling $τ_Q^{-p(d+n)/(p+2)}$ for $d+n<2p+4$, acquires a logarithmic correction $τ_Q^{-2p}\logτ_Q$ at $d+n=2p+4$, and scales as $τ_Q^{-2p}$ above this condition, where $d$ is the spatial dimension. This analytical study of the APT--KZ crossover in a solvable model provides a basis for studying their competition in interacting field theories.

AI.tldr: 该文推导了驱动O(N)高斯场论在有限温度下的功特征函数(CFW)及零温超额功累积量的闭式表达式，并刻画了缓慢驱动协议中绝热微扰论(APT)与Kibble-Zurek(KZ)机制之间的竞争。
AI.motivation: 非平衡驱动量子/统计场论中，有限速率协议下的功分布与缺陷激发的标度规律是核心问题。此前对可解模型中APT机制与KZ机制如何竞争(APT–KZ crossover)缺乏系统解析刻画，该工作旨在利用O(N)高斯场论这一可解模型填补此空白，为相互作用场论中的类似竞争研究提供基础。
AI.method: 以驱动O(N)高斯场论为对象，解析推导有限温度下功特征函数(CFW)，得到零温超额功所有累积量的闭式结果；对存在能隙的协议，采用绝热微扰论(APT)分析边界一阶导数非零时的τ_Q^{-2}标度；对以幂指数p趋于临界点的幂律协议，分析临界激发与正则贡献的竞争，并给出第n累积量临界贡献的标度律。
AI.result: 有能隙协议：边界一阶导数非零时趋向τ_Q^{-2}，更光滑的边界衰减更快。幂律协议：第n累积量的临界贡献在d+n<2p+4时服从KZ标度τ_Q^{-p(d+n)/(p+2)}；在d+n=2p+4处出现对数修正τ_Q^{-2p}log τ_Q；超过该条件时按τ_Q^{-2p}标度，其中d为空间维度。
AI.conclusion: 该工作对可解模型中APT–KZ交叉给出了完整解析刻画，明确了不同参数区间下主导标度律及对数修正，为在相互作用场论中研究APT与KZ机制的竞争提供了基准与理论依据。

title: Motivic classes of Fano schemes of lines on intersections of two quadrics
comment: 69 pages. With an appendix by Pieter Belmans
summary: Let $X\subset\mathbb P^N$ be a smooth complete intersection of two quadrics. We find formulas in the Grothendieck ring of varieties for the class of $X$ and for the class of its Fano scheme of lines, thereby proving the first two cases of a conjecture of Belmans et al. We also find a formula for the class of the relative Fano schemes of linear subspaces (of any dimension) in the fibers of quadric fibrations over curves, under a simple degeneration assumption. As consequences, we compute the rational Chow motive of the relative Fano scheme, and we provide evidence for a conjecture of Shah on a residual category in a semiorthogonal decomposition of the relative Fano scheme of lines.

AI.tldr: 研究光滑双二次完全交及其Fano线簇在Grothendieck环中的类，并给出曲线上一族二次超曲面的相对Fano簇的公式，验证Belmans等人的猜想（前两情形）及Shah猜想的相关证据。
AI.motivation: Belmans等人提出关于双二次完全交及其Fano线簇在Grothendieck环中类的猜想，前两情形尚待证明；同时，曲线上的二次纤维化中线性子空间的相对Fano簇缺乏统一的类公式，且Shah关于相对Fano线簇半正交分解中剩余范畴的猜想缺乏验证。
AI.method: 在Grothendieck环中计算光滑双二次完全交$X$及其Fano线簇的类，证明Belmans等人猜想的前两情形；在简单退化假设下，推导曲线上一族二次超曲面的任意维线性子空间的相对Fano簇的类公式；据此计算相对Fano簇的有理Chow motive。
AI.result: 获得了$X$及其Fano线簇在Grothendieck环中的显式类公式，证明了Belmans等人猜想的两个情形；得到了曲线二次纤维化中任意维线性子空间的相对Fano簇的类公式；计算了相对Fano簇的有理Chow motive；为Shah关于相对Fano线簇半正交分解中剩余范畴的猜想提供了证据。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将双二次完全交及相对Fano簇的类计算系统化，验证并支持了Belmans等人与Shah的猜想，为相关几何对象的motive与半正交分解研究提供了新工具与证据。

title: Compressed Sensing with Quantized Tensor Trains (QTTs)
summary: The storage and recovery of a vector of length \(2^d\) can become prohibitively expensive as \(d\) grows, a manifestation of the curse of dimensionality. For certain structured functions and multiscale quantities, the resulting discretized vectors admit compact quantized tensor train (QTT) representations after binary tensorization: a length-\(2^d\) vector is reshaped into a \(d\)-way binary tensor with low tensor-train (TT) rank. Motivated by this construction, we study compressed sensing of tensorized signals that combine bounded TT rank with sparse low-order interaction structure, using randomly sampled Walsh--Hadamard measurements. For this structured model class, we establish a uniform restricted isometry property and derive a measurement condition guaranteeing uniqueness of noiseless recovery. We also propose a structure-aware initializer for the alternating linear scheme (ALS), obtained by projecting the adjoint backprojection onto the low-order interaction space before applying TT-SVD. We prove a uniform initialization error bound whose measurement requirement, for fixed structural parameters, grows polynomially with the tensor order \(d\) rather than with the ambient dimension \(2^d\). Numerical experiments support the predicted RIP and initialization scaling and demonstrate more reliable ALS recovery.

AI.tldr: 研究张量化信号的压缩感知，该信号同时具有有界TT秩和稀疏低阶交互结构，采用随机Walsh-Hadamard测量，建立了均匀RIP与无噪恢复唯一性条件，并提出结构感知ALS初始化方法及其误差界。
AI.motivation: 长度2^d向量的存储与恢复随d增长代价极高，是维数灾难的体现。对于特定结构化函数与多尺度量，经二元张量化后所得离散向量具有紧凑的QTT表示（低TT秩）。现有研究多单独处理低TT秩或稀疏结构，缺乏对二者结合模型的压缩感知理论分析。
AI.method: 针对TT秩有界与稀疏低阶交互结构相结合的张量化信号，使用随机Walsh-Hadamard测量进行压缩感知；建立均匀受限等距性质（RIP）；推导保证无噪恢复唯一性的测量条件；提出结构感知初始化器——先将伴随反投影投影到低阶交互空间，再应用TT-SVD，用于交替线性方案（ALS）。
AI.result: 在所提结构化模型类上建立了均匀RIP和测量条件以保证无噪恢复唯一性；证明了均匀初始化误差界，其测量需求在固定结构参数下随张量阶数d多项式增长，而非随环境维度2^d增长；数值实验验证了预测的RIP与初始化尺度，并展示了更可靠的ALS恢复。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为结合低TT秩与稀疏低阶交互结构的张量化信号压缩感知提供了理论保证，将测量复杂度从随环境维度2^d依赖降低为随阶数d多项式依赖，并通过结构感知初始化提升了ALS恢复的可靠性。

title: Post-Anomaly Detection Inference for Deep SVDD
summary: Deep Support Vector Data Description (Deep SVDD) has become a prominent framework for unsupervised anomaly detection by learning latent representations that compactly characterize normal data around a center. Despite its empirical success, anomaly decisions produced by Deep SVDD are typically made solely based on anomaly scores without rigorous statistical guarantees, thereby limiting their reliability in safety-critical and high-stakes applications where false positives must be strictly controlled. In this paper, we propose PADI (Post-Anomaly Detection Inference), a novel framework that equips a trained and frozen Deep SVDD detector with statistically valid inference by leveraging the Selective Inference framework. Specifically, PADI performs inference conditional on the event that a test instance is identified as anomalous by Deep SVDD, thereby enabling rigorous statistical assessment of anomaly decisions. Based on this formulation, we derive valid selective p-values that quantify the statistical significance of the detected anomaly. Using these p-values, we theoretically establish control of the false positive rate (FPR) at a user-specified significance level $α$ (e.g., $α=0.05$). Furthermore, we extend the proposed framework to Deep Semi-Supervised Anomaly Detection (Deep SAD), providing a principled approach for statistically reliable inference in semi-supervised anomaly detection settings. Extensive experiments on both synthetic and real-world benchmark datasets robustly support the theoretical findings. The results demonstrate that PADI consistently achieves proper FPR control while attaining superior true positive rates compared with existing approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PADI框架，将选择性推断（Selective Inference）引入已训练并冻结的Deep SVDD检测器，在"测试样本被判为异常"的条件下进行推断，导出有效的选择性p值，从而在用户指定显著性水平α下理论保证假阳性率（FPR）控制，并扩展至Deep SAD，实验验证其FPR控制与更优的真阳性率。
AI.motivation: Deep SVDD虽在无监督异常检测中表现优异，但其异常判定仅依赖异常分数，缺乏严格的统计保证，导致在安全攸关、高代价场景中假阳性难以严格控制，可靠性不足。
AI.method: 提出PADI框架：对训练后冻结的Deep SVDD检测器，利用选择性推断框架，在"测试实例被Deep SVDD判定为异常"这一事件条件下进行条件推断；据此推导有效的选择性p值以量化所检测异常的统计显著性，并由这些p值在理论上确立用户指定显著性水平α下的FPR控制；进一步将框架扩展至Deep SAD，用于半监督异常检测的统计可靠推断。
AI.result: 在合成数据集与真实基准数据集上的大量实验支持了理论结论：PADI在持续实现合理FPR控制的同时，取得了优于现有方法的真阳性率。
AI.conclusion: PADI为Deep SVDD及Deep SAD提供了具有统计有效性的异常判定推断机制，在保证FPR受控的前提下提升了检测性能，增强了异常检测在安全关键应用中的可靠性。

title: Learned Compression of SAR Phase-History Data: A Rate-Honest Feasibility Study on GOTCHA
summary: On-board compression of synthetic aperture radar (SAR) phase history is bandwidth-critical, and block-adaptive quantization (BAQ) remains the operational standard. We test whether a small convolutional autoencoder, with its encoder on the sensor, can compete with BAQ on complex phase-history patches from the AFRL GOTCHA collection. Every method is charged for all transmitted bits, rates are reported in bits per complex sample (b/cs), and detection is scored by one-to-one matching of CA-CFAR detections. The autoencoder (28,656 encoder parameters) loses at every rate. At 16 b/cs it reaches -2.87 dB NMSE, against -35.5 dB for 8-bit BAQ with $\pm 3σ$ clipping and -41.0 dB with a tuned clipping range. It also loses to a $16 \times 16$ block Karhunen-Loève transform (KLT), a local linear coder with a tenth of its encoder cost (-5.39 dB). Running the network in a companded Fourier domain helps, but its detection F1 remains bounded at 33%. The evidence points to this model, its normalization, and its objective, not to a fundamental limit of learned coding. Per patch, the data have modest lag-1 coherence ($|ρ| \approx 0.3$) and patch-specific spectral concentration. Two findings concern evaluation itself. First, 97% of CFAR crossings on raw $64 \times 64$ patches are border artifacts of the zero-padded detector. Second, on interior cells BAQ's clipping range decides detection: 8-bit BAQ keeps 69% F1 with tuned clipping but 17% at $\pm 3σ$, and at 8 b/cs or less adaptive FFT thresholding preserves more detections than BAQ. We close with an evaluation protocol for learned radar compression.

AI.tldr: 小卷积自编码器在SAR相位历史有载压缩中全面劣于BAQ及KLT基线，且研究揭示CFAR检测评估存在严重边界伪影与clipping敏感性，提出学习型雷达压缩评估协议。
AI.motivation: SAR相位历史有载压缩对带宽极为敏感，块自适应量化（BAQ）仍是现役标准。作者欲检验具备传感器端编码器的小型卷积自编码器能否在AFRL GOTCHA复数相位历史块上超越BAQ，并反思现有评估方式的可靠性。
AI.method: 在GOTCHA数据集复数相位历史patch上，将卷积自编码器（编码器28,656参数）与8位BAQ（±3σ与调优clipping）、16×16块KL变换（编码器成本仅前者1/10）对比；所有方法按全部传输比特计费，速率以b/cs表示；检测采用CA-CFAR一对一匹配评分，并尝试在压扩Fourier域运行网络。
AI.result: 自编码器在各速率下均落败：16 b/cs时NMSE为-2.87 dB，而8位BAQ（±3σ）为-35.5 dB、调优clipping为-41.0 dB，16×16 KLT为-5.39 dB。压扩Fourier域可改善，但检测F1仍限于33%。数据lag-1相干性仅约0.3且有块特定谱集中。评估层面：原始64×64 patch上97%的CFAR越限为零填充检测器的边界伪影；内部单元BAQ性能依赖clipping范围（调优69% F1 vs ±3σ 17%），8 b/cs及以下自适应FFT阈值保留检测多于BAQ。
AI.conclusion: 失败源于该模型、其归一化与目标函数，而非学习型编码的根本极限。BAQ的检测表现高度依赖clipping选择，现有CFAR评估受边界伪影严重干扰，作者据此提出面向学习型雷达压缩的评估协议。

title: Sequences of generalized moments and their applications to some moment partial differential equations
summary: We introduce sequences of generalized moments that are a generalization of sequences preserving summability and sequences of moments from Balser's theory of moment summability. We construct extensions of Laplace and Borel integral operators for these new sequences. We find integral representations of moment derivatives for generalized moments. We show the characterization of summable solutions of moment-PDEs with generalized moments. We describe singular directions for summable solutions of moment-PDEs with generalized moments and we express jumps across these singular directions in terms of hyperfunctions and in terms of kernel functions associated with sequences preserving summability, which are connected with given sequences of generalized moments.

AI.tldr: 本文引入广义矩序列，构造相应的Laplace与Borel积分算子推广，给出矩导数的积分表示，刻画广义矩矩-PDE的可和解析解的奇性方向及跳跃。
AI.motivation: Balser的矩可和性理论中的保可和性序列与矩序列已有较好结果，但缺乏更一般的矩框架；为研究求解矩-PDE（moment-PDE）的可和解析解的奇性结构，需将Laplace/Borel积分算子与矩导数推广到更一般的广义矩序列。
AI.method: 引入广义矩序列，作为保可和性序列与Balser矩序列的一般化；构造与之对应的Laplace与Borel积分算子的推广；求广义矩的矩导数的积分表示；将可和解析解理论推广至带广义矩的矩-PDE，分析其奇性方向（奇异方向）。
AI.result: 建立了广义矩序列框架下Laplace与Borel积分算子的推广形式；得到广义矩矩导数的积分表示；给出带广义矩的矩-PDE可和解析解的刻画；描述其奇异方向，并以超函数（hyperfunctions）及与保可和性序列关联的核函数两种方式表示跨越这些奇异方向的跳跃。
AI.conclusion: 广义矩序列为矩可和性与矩-PDE可和解析解理论提供了统一的推广框架，其跳跃可用超函数和核函数表达，深化了对可和解奇性（Stokes现象类）结构的理解。

title: Vortex rings as hydrodynamic dispersants for mitigating underwater oil spills
summary: The usage of chemical dispersant to promote the breakup of oil droplets remains one of the crucial response strategy towards controlling the rapidly rising droplets during an underwater oil spillage disaster like the Deepwater horizon. However, the detrimental effects of dispersant on the marine life are now well recognized. Here, we demonstrate that vortex ring presents an environmental friendly alternative to the debatable usage of chemical dispersant that primarily aids droplet break-up. We propose two mitigating strategies through the application of vortex rings: (i) atomization of large oil droplets into smaller droplets, which enhances natural dispersion and biodegradation (ii) targeted relocation of spilled oil droplets from ecologically sensitive regions to safer remote locations during minor spill events. This proof-of-concept study demonstrates that vortex rings can efficiently atomize underwater oil droplets while simultaneously transporting them over long distances. The efficiency strongly depends on the droplet size distribution and the strength of the vortex ring. Using time scale analysis and force balances arguments, we propose droplet response and atomization criteria by a traversing vortex ring. Beyond atomization and droplet transport which are center to many engineering processes, the work finds high relevance in the area of bubble turbulence, agricultural industry, multiphase reactors, combustion process, atmospheric fluid dynamics and oil extraction from rocks, to name a few.

AI.tldr: 本文提出以涡环作为化学分散剂的环保替代方案，通过涡环实现水下油滴的雾化破碎与长距离定向输运，缓解水下溢油灾害。
AI.motivation: 化学分散剂虽能促进油滴破碎、抑制快速上升的油羽，但其对海洋生物的毒性已获公认，亟需环境友好的替代响应策略。
AI.method: 概念验证研究：利用涡环作用于水下油滴，提出两种缓解策略——(i) 将大油滴雾化为小油滴以增强自然分散与生物降解；(ii) 在小型溢油事件中将油滴从生态敏感区定向转移至偏远安全区域。并采用时间尺度分析与力平衡论证，建立油滴在穿越涡环时的响应与雾化判据。
AI.result: 涡环可高效雾化水下油滴并同时将其输运至远距离；其效率强烈依赖于油滴尺寸分布与涡环强度，并给出了相应的雾化与响应判据。
AI.conclusion: 涡环是一种可行的环保型油滴破碎与输运手段，除溢油治理外，还可推广至气泡湍流、农业、多相反应器、燃烧、大气流体动力学及岩石采油等领域。

title: PDE-OBS: Controlled Evaluation Across Observation Patterns
comment: 57 pages, including supplementary material. Code: https://github.com/ru1ch3n/PDE-OBS
summary: Physical-field reconstruction and forecasting depend on both measurement density and spatial layout, yet evaluation under a single observation pattern does not characterize performance when that pattern changes. We introduce PDE-OBS, an integrated benchmarking platform spanning numerical data generation, model training, and inference and evaluation under varying observation conditions. It combines 560,000 fields and trajectories from seven partial differential equation families with configurable observation operators and seven adapted baseline methods for stationary reconstruction and short-horizon forecasting. Separating observation construction from physical records allows users to specify parameterized patterns and deterministic mixtures for training and testing while preserving prediction targets and data splits. The evaluation protocol uses references trained for each test pattern to compare models on identical test observations and targets, alongside equal-count groups for spatial-layout comparisons. On a 14,000-record subset, we evaluate 441 trained models under nine test patterns, yielding 3,969 evaluations. Mean cross-pattern error exceeds mean matched-pattern error in all 49 PDE-method pairs, and this finding persists in a configuration-matched subset of 117 models. Denser test observations do not consistently reduce error for a fixed model. Mixed-pattern training on five completed pairs reduces large single-pattern transfer errors, although destination-trained references usually remain more accurate. Together, the benchmark and findings support systematic evaluation of observation-pattern sensitivity and provide a reusable workflow for developing methods under changing measurement conditions. Code: https://github.com/ru1ch3n/PDE-OBS.

AI.tldr: 论文提出PDE-OBS基准平台，用于在不同观测条件下系统评估物理场重建与预测模型，揭示跨观测模式误差普遍高于匹配模式误差。
AI.motivation: 物理场重建与预测的性能同时取决于观测密度和空间布局，但单一观测模式下的评估无法刻画观测模式变化时的模型表现，缺乏统一的基准与协议。
AI.method: 构建PDE-OBS集成基准平台，涵盖数值数据生成、模型训练、推理与评估；整合7类偏微分方程的56万条场与轨迹，配备可配置观测算子与7种适配基线方法，支持稳态重建与短期预测；将观测构造与物理记录解耦，允许用户指定参数化模式及确定性混合用于训练和测试；评估协议采用针对每种测试模式训练的参考模型进行同观测同目标比较，并设置等数量分组用于空间布局对比。
AI.result: 在14,000条记录子集上，对9种测试模式下的441个训练模型进行评估，共获得3,969次评估结果；49个PDE-方法配对的跨模式平均误差均高于匹配模式平均误差，该结论在117个配置匹配模型子集中依然成立；更密集的测试观测并未稳定降低固定模型的误差；在5个完成的配对上，混合模式训练可降低单模式迁移的大误差，但目标模式训练的参考模型通常仍更准确。
AI.conclusion: 该基准与发现支持对观测模式敏感性进行系统评估，并为在变化测量条件下开发新方法提供了可复用工作流，代码已开源。

title: Inverse Optimal Feedback Stabilization of 3D Nonholonomic Vehicles in Spherical Coordinates
comment: Submitted to the 2027 American Control Conference (ACC)
summary: Inverse optimal control provides optimality and robustness guarantees without solving the Hamilton--Jacobi--Bellman (HJB) equation, but its application to 3D nonholonomic vehicles has been precluded by the absence of strict control Lyapunov functions (CLFs). Recently, such strict CLFs were constructed for the 3D nonholonomic vehicle in spherical coordinates, which circumvent Brockett's obstruction, on the largest possible domain. Building on this construction, this paper develops a general inverse optimal stabilizing controller for the 3D nonholonomic vehicle actuated by surge velocity, pitch rate, and yaw rate. The design is a damping $L_gV$ feedback that minimizes a meaningful cost and inherits stability margins. Its flexibility is demonstrated through two choices of penalty function: a quadratic running cost on the state, recovering a near-classical optimal control formulation, and stabilization under user-defined input constraints. Numerical simulations illustrate stabilization performance, control-effort tradeoffs, and the effect of input constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文基于球坐标下构造的严格控制Lyapunov函数（CLF），为欠驱动3D非完整车辆设计了逆最优镇定控制器，通过阻尼型L_gV反馈最小化有意义代价并获得稳定裕度，仿真验证了镇定性能与输入约束效果。
AI.motivation: 逆最优控制无需解Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman（HJB）方程即可提供最优性与鲁棒性保证，但3D非完整车辆因缺乏严格控制Lyapunov函数（CLF）、受Brockett障碍限制而难以应用。近期在球坐标下于最大可能域上构造了规避该障碍的严格CLF，本文在此基础上推进其控制器设计。
AI.method: 针对由纵荡速度、俯仰角速度和偏航角速度驱动的3D非完整车辆，设计一般性的逆最优镇定控制器。该设计采用阻尼型L_gV反馈，使某个有意义的代价函数最小化并继承稳定裕度。通过在惩罚函数上选取两种形式体现灵活性：一是关于状态的二次运行代价（近经典最优控制形式），二是在用户自定义输入约束下的镇定。
AI.result: 给出了可最小化有意义代价、兼具稳定裕度的逆最优镇定控制律；通过二次运行代价恢复近经典最优控制表述，并实现用户自定义输入约束下的镇定。数值仿真展示了镇定性能、控制代价权衡以及输入约束的影响。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将逆最优控制成功扩展至3D非完整车辆，借助球坐标严格CLF绕开Brockett障碍，在最大可行域上实现了具有最优性与鲁棒性保证的镇定控制，且具备处理输入约束的灵活性。

title: Static versus dynamic universality in the site-diluted kagome Ising model
summary: We study the site-diluted Ising model on the kagome lattice using the Wolff single-cluster algorithm, focusing on both equilibrium and dynamic critical properties. The equilibrium critical exponents $ν= 1$ and $γ/ν= 7/4$ retain their exact pure Ising values for all spin concentrations $p$ considered, consistent with the marginal irrelevance of disorder at $α= 0$, with the specific heat crossing over from logarithmic to double-logarithmic growth upon dilution. These static results are shared between the kagome and square lattices. On the dynamic side, $z$ decreases upon dilution on both lattice, opposite to what is observed under local dynamics, with evidence of saturation to a $p$-independent value at strong dilution, suggesting a diluted dynamic fixed point. While $z$ is consistent between the two lattices in the pure case, it differs in the diluted regime, an effect we attribute to the two lattices sitting at different positions along the renormalization-group flow between the Ising and percolation fixed points, rather than to a true asymptotic breakdown of dynamic universality.

AI.tldr: 研究kagome晶格上site-diluted Ising模型的平衡与动态临界性质，发现静态临界指数保持纯Ising精确值，动态指数z随稀释减小并趋于饱和，两晶格在稀释区动态指数不同，归因于RG流中位置差异而非动态普适性破缺。
AI.motivation: 探究稀释无序对Ising模型临界行为的影响，特别是kagome与square晶格在平衡和动态临界性质上的异同，检验无序在α=0时的边缘无关性以及动态普适性问题。
AI.method: 采用Wolff单簇算法对kagome晶格上的site-diluted Ising模型进行数值模拟，计算平衡与动态临界指数（ν、γ/ν、z），并与square晶格结果对比。
AI.result: 静态临界指数ν=1、γ/ν=7/4在所有自旋浓度p下保持纯Ising精确值，比热从对数发散跨渡到双对数增长；动态指数z随稀释减小（与局域动力学相反），强稀释下趋于p无关的饱和值，暗示稀释动态不动点；纯情形下两晶格z一致，稀释区则不一致。
AI.conclusion: 静态结果符合无序在α=0处的边缘无关性；稀释区两晶格z的差异源于它们处于Ising与percolation不动点之间RG流的不同位置，而非动态普适性的真正渐近破缺。

title: The $F$-signature Function on the Big Cone
summary: We define and study the $F$-signature of big divisors on projective varieties in positive characteristics. For a normal projective variety $X$, we show that the $F$-signature function defines a continuous function on the big cone of $X$, extending our previous results on the ample cone. By studying the the Frobenius-alpha invariant on the big cone, we prove that the positivity of the $F$-signature of any big $\mathbb{R}$-divisor on $X$ is equivalent to the global $F$-regularity of $X$. As applications, we prove a birational transformation rule for the $F$-signature in terms of the $F$-signature of certain graded ideal sequences. We also prove that in a reduction modulo $p$ situation, a characteristic independent lower bound for the $F$-signature of $X$ with respect to any ample divisor $L$ spreads out to a similar bound for arbitrary big divisors on $X$.

AI.tldr: 本文定义并研究正特征射影簇上大除子的F-符号，证明其在大锥上连续，并揭示F-符号正性与整体F-正则性的等价关系，推广了先前关于丰沛锥的结果。
AI.motivation: 先前工作仅在丰沛锥上研究F-符号函数，而大锥是更自然且更广泛的研究对象。将F-符号的定义与性质从丰沛除子推广到大除子，有助于更深入理解正特征代数几何中整体F-正则性等奇点性质。
AI.method: 在正特征下对正规射影簇X的大除子定义F-符号；通过研究大锥上的Frobenius-alpha不变量，分析F-符号函数的连续性及正性；并结合约化模p的技术手段进行研究。
AI.result: 证明F-符号函数在大锥上连续；证明大R-除子的F-符号正性与X的整体F-正则性等价；得到F-符号的双有理变换规则（以某些分次理想序列的F-符号表示）；在约化模p情形下，证明关于丰沛除子的特征无关下界可推广到任意大除子。
AI.conclusion: F-符号可自然推广至大锥并保持良好性质，其正性刻画了整体F-正则性，且具有良好的双有理变换行为与约化模p扩展性，为正特征代数几何中奇点与除子理论提供了新工具。

title: CI-PINN: Causal Integral Physics-Informed Neural Network for Solving Evolution Equations
summary: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) solve partial differential equations (PDEs) by incorporating governing physical laws into the training loss. For evolution equations, however, their conventional pointwise space--time representation does not explicitly encode temporal dependence, which can hinder accurate prediction. To mitigate this limitation, this work proposes a novel neural architecture termed a causal integral neural network (CinNet). The core module of CinNet is a Volterra-type causal integral term, which aggregates historical features to encode temporal dependence, thereby incorporating temporal causality at the architectural level rather than through training-level modifications as in many existing methods. Building on CinNet, we further develop a causal integral physics-informed neural network (CI-PINN) for solving evolution equations. Extensive numerical experiments on benchmark evolution equations demonstrate that the presented method outperforms various baseline PINN variants in terms of solution accuracy, with pronounced superiority under sparse-collocation scenarios. Additional empirical analyses show that CI-PINN exhibits low sensitivity to hyperparameter choices, while ablation studies confirm the effectiveness of the proposed network components.

AI.tldr: 提出因果积分神经网络(CinNet)及CI-PINN，用Volterra型因果积分项在架构层面编码时间依赖，提升演化方程求解精度。
AI.motivation: 传统PINN对演化方程采用逐点时空表示，不显式编码时间依赖，限制预测精度；现有方法多通过训练层面的修改引入时间因果性，而非架构层面。
AI.method: 提出CinNet，其核心模块为Volterra型因果积分项，通过聚合历史特征编码时间依赖；在此基础上构建因果积分物理信息神经网络(CI-PINN)用于求解演化方程。
AI.result: 在基准演化方程上的大量数值实验中，该方法在求解精度上优于多种基线PINN变体，在稀疏配点情形下优势尤为明显；对超参数选择敏感性低，消融实验验证了各网络组件的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 在架构层面引入因果积分机制可有效编码时间依赖，CI-PINN在精度、稀疏配点鲁棒性和超参数稳健性方面均具优势。

title: Identifiability Guarantees for Drivers and Dynamics of Delayed Physical Systems
summary: A wide range of methods have been proposed, including physics-informed neural networks, which are powerful but do not guarantee identifiability of the dynamics, symbolic regression, which requires a set of precomputed operations, and causal discovery, which is more principled but usually relies on strong assumptions that physical systems may violate. In this work, we develop a theory-grounded method and prove that under a set of permissive assumptions, the structural drivers and drift of stochastic delayed differential equations are identifiable. Our method outperforms others on a benchmark for driver identifiability, and on a second benchmark to evaluate physical consistency of the learned dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于理论的方法，在较为宽松的假设下证明了随机延迟微分方程的结构驱动项与漂移项具有可辨识性，并在驱动项可辨识性与所学动力系统物理一致性两个基准上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有动力系统辨识方法各有局限：物理信息神经网络虽强大但无法保证动力学的可辨识性；符号回归需要预先给定算子集合；因果发现更严谨但依赖强假设，而物理系统往往不满足这些假设。因此需要一个既有理论保证又适应物理系统的辨识方法。
AI.method: 作者提出一种有理论支撑的方法，针对随机延迟微分方程，在一组较为宽松的假设下证明其结构驱动项（structural drivers）与漂移项（drift）是可辨识的（identifiable）。
AI.result: 在驱动项可辨识性基准测试上，该方法优于其他方法；在评估所学动力学物理一致性的第二个基准上同样表现更优。
AI.conclusion: 通过在宽松假设下证明随机延迟微分方程结构驱动项与漂移项的可辨识性，并将方法在两类基准上验证，本文为物理系统的动力学辨识提供了兼具理论保证与实证优势的途径。

title: A Mesoscopic View of Transformer Weights Through Row and Column Scale Fields
comment: 37 pages, 14 figures, 5 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/tiexinding/NPM-Weibull-public (directory scale_field, tag p5-scale-field-v1)
summary: Pooled statistics of Transformer weights obscure how magnitude is distributed across functional channels, while individual weights are too numerous to compare directly. We study the mesoscopic level between them: row and column scale fields, the median-centred log-RMS profiles of a weight matrix over its channels, which together with a global scale and a full balanced core represent the matrix exactly. Across public Pythia checkpoints at four sizes and controlled runs from three initialization families, balancing reveals similar measured core magnitude profiles. A mixture bridge, with its form fixed before the analysis and its coefficients fitted, predicts the pooled-shape departure from field width on held-out runs and data arms of the controlled grid. The indexed fields retain further structure: they align across projections that share a functional channel, and query/key profiles follow reassigned RoPE frequencies rather than fixed matrix coordinates. Training trajectories show early field formation followed by component-dependent broadening or recession. Extending the channel-based analysis to AdamW's second moment reveals related functional organization in its log-space row and column factors. Finally, edits of a frozen checkpoint separate reciprocal scale balance, which preserves the forward computation, from relative channel gain: flattening the gain increases in-distribution loss while preserving matrix norms and the balanced core. Row and column scale fields thus connect pooled magnitude statistics to channel organization and provide coordinates for tracking and testing trained weight structure.

AI.tldr: 论文研究Transformer权重的"介观"尺度场（行/列对数RMS轮廓），发现其能揭示通道级功能组织，并可用于追踪与测试训练后的权重结构。
AI.motivation: 汇总统计量掩盖了权重幅度在功能通道上的分布，而逐个权重又数量过多难以直接比较，因此需要一个介于两者之间的介观分析视角。
AI.method: 将权重矩阵精确分解为全局尺度、行/列尺度场（中位数中心化的对数RMS轮廓）与平衡核心；在Pythia多尺寸checkpoint及三类初始化的受控实验上分析，并用预先设定形式、拟合系数的混合桥模型预测形状偏离，同时扩展到AdamW二阶矩。
AI.result: 不同初始化与规模下测得相似的平衡核心幅度轮廓；混合桥能在留出运行与数据分支上预测偏离；尺度场随共享功能通道跨投影对齐，query/key轮廓遵循重分配的RoPE频率；训练轨迹呈现早期场形成后分化的展宽或收缩；扁平化相对通道增益会提高分布内损失而保持矩阵范数与平衡核心。
AI.conclusion: 行/列尺度场将汇总幅度统计与通道组织相连接，为追踪和检验训练后权重结构提供了新的坐标框架。

title: Dynamical stability for the periodic modified Mullins-Sekerka flow
summary: We prove dynamical stability in arbitrary dimension for the modified Mullins--Sekerka flow, the gradient flow of the sharp-interface Ohta--Kawasaki energy on the flat torus. Specifically, we show that if an initial set has the same volume as a strictly stable critical set for the energy and is sufficiently close to it in $C^{3,α}$, then the flow exists for all times and converges exponentially fast, in every $C^k$ norm, to a translate of that critical set. The proof relies on a quantitative Alexandrov-type estimate for strictly stable critical sets of the energy.

AI.tldr: 证明任意维数下修正 Mullins–Sekerka 流（平坦环面上 sharp-interface Ohta–Kawasaki 能量的梯度流）的动力学稳定性：初值与严格稳定临界集同体积且在 $C^{3,\alpha}$ 下充分接近时，流整体存在并以指数速率在任意 $C^k$ 范数下收敛到该临界集的平移。
AI.motivation: 研究修正 Mullins–Sekerka 流的动力学稳定性，即严格稳定临界集在小扰动下是否长期保持并吸引附近演化。
AI.method: 基于对能量严格稳定临界集的定量 Alexandrov 型估计，结合 $C^{3,\alpha}$ 接近性与等体积约束进行分析。
AI.result: 流对所有时间存在，并在每个 $C^k$ 范数下指数快速收敛到原临界集的一个平移。
AI.conclusion: 严格稳定临界集在任意维数下具有动力学稳定性，且收敛为指数速率、光滑范数意义下成立。

title: Assessment of subgrid scale mixing models used in LES at high pressures
summary: Molecular mixing models for the conditional scalar diffusion (CSD) term in the filtered mass density function (FMDF) transport equation used in Large Eddy Simulation (LES-FMDF) approach are evaluated against direct numerical simulation (DNS) of spatially evolving jets. A database of DNS of turbulent mixing slot jets of $C_{7}H_{16} / O_2$ and $C_{7}H_{16} / Air$ is developed. The formulation includes the compressible form of the governing equations, a generalized multicomponent diffusion model, a cubic real gas equation of state and realistic property models. Simulations are conducted over a wide range of initial pressures ($1 atm < P_0 < 100 atm$) and jet width based Reynolds numbers of 850 and 1300. FMDF of mixture fraction at various filter widths are obtained from the simulation at several spatial locations within the flow. The CSD term in the exact transport equation of FMDF is calculated from the DNS. An \textit{a priori} analysis of Interaction by Exchange of Mean (IEM), Modified Curl (MC) and Mapping Closure (MAPPING) mixing models for CSD is conducted. At high pressures, significant deviations are observed between the CSD measured from the DNS and those predicted by the models. The source of the deviations is determined to be the mixing frequency used in the models. The significance of the mixing frequency and its variation with change in pressure and diffusion models is studied. The primary objective of this work is to assess the applicability of aforementioned mixing models to flows at large pressures and determine the causes for deviation in prediction.

AI.tldr: 本文通过空间发展湍流射流的DNS数据库，对LES-FMDF方法中条件标量扩散（CSD）项的IEM、MC与Mapping混合模型进行了先验评估，发现高压下模型预测与DNS存在显著偏差，根源在于混合频率。
AI.motivation: LES-FMDF方法中CSD项需要混合模型封闭，而现有混合模型（IEM、MC、MAPPING）在高压条件下的适用性尚不明确，因此需要评估其准确性并查明偏差来源。
AI.method: 建立C7H16/O2与C7H16/Air湍流混合槽射流的DNS数据库，采用可压缩控制方程、广义多组分扩散模型、立方型真实气体状态方程及真实物性模型；在1–100 atm初始压力、Re=850和1300条件下模拟，从DNS获取不同滤波宽度和空间位置的混合物分数FMDF，计算精确输运方程中的CSD项，并对IEM、MC、MAPPING模型开展先验分析。
AI.result: 高压条件下，DNS测得的CSD项与三种模型预测值出现显著偏差；偏差来源被确定为模型中使用的混合频率，且混合频率随压力及扩散模型的变化具有重要影响。
AI.conclusion: 研究评估了上述混合模型在高压流动中的适用性，指出混合频率是导致预测偏差的关键因素，为高压LES-FMDF建模中混合模型的改进提供了依据。

title: SCOPE: Observation-Conditioned Full-Target Prediction for Sparse PDE Inference
comment: 34 pages, including supplementary material. Code: https://github.com/ru1ch3n/SCOPE
summary: Recovering complete physical fields from sparse observations is challenging because the measurements may not uniquely determine the underlying state. Diffusion-based PDE solvers address this problem through iterative sampling whereas neural operators provide deterministic one-pass predictions. We propose SCOPE (Sparse-Context Observability-aware Predictive Embeddings) to recover complete PDE fields from sparse observations by coupling full-field latent prediction with physical reconstruction. A shared decoder reconstructs fields from both predicted and complete-view representations so that representation learning is guided by both physical recovery and latent matching. We derive a quadratic risk decomposition at fixed teacher-decoder pairs showing why optimal latent prediction need not yield optimal field reconstruction. We also establish sufficient conditions for decoder improvements on complete inputs to transfer to recovery from partial observations. Experiments across five PDE settings show that SCOPE outperforms mask-aware neural operators on all ten forward and inverse tasks and achieves lower errors than those reported for diffusion-based solvers including DiffusionPDE and FunDPS. Decoder-only adaptation further improves recovery without retraining the backbone while retaining deterministic single-pass inference.

AI.tldr: 提出SCOPE框架，通过耦合全场隐空间预测与物理重建，从稀疏观测中恢复完整PDE场，在十个正/逆任务上优于掩码感知神经算子和扩散类求解器，且保持确定性单次推理。
AI.motivation: 从稀疏观测恢复完整物理场困难，因为测量可能无法唯一确定潜在状态；扩散类PDE求解器依赖迭代采样，而神经算子虽为确定性单次预测但精度有限。需要一种兼顾确定性推理与高精度恢复的方法。
AI.method: SCOPE（稀疏上下文可观测性感知预测嵌入）：耦合全场隐空间预测与物理重建；共享解码器同时从预测表征和完整视图表征重建场，使表征学习同时受物理恢复与隐匹配引导；推导固定教师-解码器对下的二次风险分解，说明最优隐预测不必导致最优场重建；给出解码器在完整输入上的改进可迁移至部分观测恢复的充分条件。
AI.result: 在五类PDE设置中，SCOPE在全部十个正向与逆向任务上优于掩码感知神经算子，误差低于DiffusionPDE、FunDPS等扩散类求解器；仅解码器适配即可在不重训主干的情况下进一步改善恢复，并保持确定性单次推理。
AI.conclusion: SCOPE通过耦合隐预测与物理重建，实现了稀疏观测下高精度的确定性PDE场恢复，并提供理论解释与高效适配能力。

title: Algebraic Vector Fields on $S^2$ are $2$-generated
summary: We exhibit two vector fields on $S^2$, which generate the entire Lie algebra of algebraic vector fields. Compositions of the flows associated with these two vector fields enable us to approximate every diffeomorphism of $S^2$ isotopic to the identity in the $\mathrm{C}^r$-sense for any $r\geq 0$.

AI.tldr: 在$S^2$上构造两个代数向量场，其李代数生成整个代数向量场李代数，且对应流的复合可逼近任意与恒等映射同痕的微分同胚。
AI.motivation: 研究球面$S^2$上微分同胚的可控性与逼近问题，探寻能否用有限个向量场的流复合生成足够丰富的变换群。
AI.method: 构造$S^2$上的两个代数向量场，证明它们生成整个代数向量场李代数；利用这两个向量场对应流的复合来逼近微分同胚。
AI.result: 两个向量场的流之复合可在$\mathrm{C}^r$意义下（任意$r\geq 0$）逼近$S^2$上所有与恒等映射同痕的微分同胚。
AI.conclusion: 有限个向量场的流复合足以在光滑范畴内逼近$S^2$的恒等同痕微分同胚，揭示了代数向量场在李代数生成与逼近能力上的有效性。

title: Thermodynamics of the space of trajectories governed by a combination of two additive boundary functionals
comment: 23 pages, 3 figures. This work extends and generalizes the trajectory functional approach introduced in preprints arXiv:2607.24078 and arXiv:2609.08477 by incorporating relative path-space invariants and establishing a modified strong-drift fluctuation theorem
summary: This paper extends the formalism of stochastic path-space thermodynamics by systematically expanding the space of thermodynamic variables with a spectrum of boundary and relative functionals of random processes. Generalizing the approaches introduced in preprints arXiv:2607.24078 and arXiv:2609.08477, we investigate the fluctuation statistics of a one-dimensional Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process with an asymmetric linear drift and a step penalty potential at the origin, which models the waiting phase of a molecular Brownian motor. Utilizing the Feynman-Kac formalism and the parabolic cylinder theory, a numerical scheme based on matching logarithmic derivatives via the secant method is constructed. A high-precision eigenvalues of the effective Hamiltonian is obtained, which define the cumulant generating function. We formulate a modified path-space fluctuation theorem of the Gallavotti-Cohen type for the conjugate drift current at a fixed integral occupation time of the system in the dissipative half-plane. The physical and thermodynamic significance of the new variables is elucidated. A combination of "residence time" and "integral current" functionals is applied to describe an ion channel sensitive to mechanical or electrical stimuli.

AI.tldr: 本文将随机路径空间热力学形式化推广到更广的热力学变量空间，研究带非对称线性漂移与原点阶跃惩罚势的一维Ornstein-Uhlenbeck过程，借助Feynman-Kac形式与抛物柱函数理论，通过割线法匹配对数导数构造数值格式，求得有效哈密顿量的高精度本征值并定义累积量生成函数，进而建立Gallavotti-Cohen型修正路径空间涨落定理，并应用于离子通道描述。
AI.motivation: 在前期预印本（arXiv:2607.24078、arXiv:2609.08477）引入的随机路径空间热力学框架基础上，作者希望系统性地扩展热力学变量空间，引入随机过程的边界泛函与相对泛函谱，以刻画分子布朗马达等待阶段等非平衡涨落问题，并寻求新的路径空间涨落关系。
AI.method: 以带非对称线性漂移和原点阶跃惩罚势的一维Ornstein-Uhlenbeck过程为模型；采用Feynman-Kac形式描述路径权重演化；利用抛物柱函数理论求解相关本征问题；构造基于割线法匹配对数导数的数值格式以获取有效哈密顿量的高精度本征值，该本征值定义累积量生成函数。
AI.result: 获得了有效哈密顿量的高精度本征值，并据此确定累积量生成函数；在系统于耗散半平面内固定积分占据时间的条件下，针对共轭漂移流建立了Gallavotti-Cohen型的修正路径空间涨落定理；同时阐明了新引入热力学变量的物理与热力学意义，并将"停留时间"与"积分电流"泛函的组合用于描述对机械或电刺激敏感的离子通道。
AI.conclusion: 通过扩展随机路径空间热力学的变量空间并引入边界与相对泛函，可在非对称漂移与阶跃势条件下得到可控的高精度涨落统计，并导出修正的Gallavotti-Cohen型涨落关系；所引入变量具有明确的物理与热力学含义，可用于离子通道等受刺激系统的刻画。

title: Failure of semipositive metric extension in a smooth projective family
summary: We construct a smooth projective family of rational surfaces, an effective line bundle on its total space, and a prescribed semipositively curved singular Hermitian metric on the central fibre that has no semipositive extension to any neighbourhood of that fibre. It has analytic singularities and is of minimal singularity type. The failure persists even when the restriction is only required to have the same singularity type as the prescribed metric. The family is obtained by blowing up four disjoint sections of a product, with three points becoming collinear on the central fibre. An integrable adjoint section on that fibre cannot extend because the corresponding adjoint systems vanish on every nearby fibre. This gives a negative answer to Păun's metric-extension question, listed as Question 38 by Dinew, Guedj, and Zeriahi.

AI.tldr: 该文构造了一个光滑射影有理曲面族及中心纤维上的半正曲率奇异Hermitian度量，证明其无法半正延拓，从而否定了Păun的度量延拓问题。
AI.motivation: Păun提出的度量延拓问题（Dinew–Guedj–Zeriahi列为问题38）长期开放：给定族中心纤维上的半正曲率奇异Hermitian度量，是否存在到邻近纤维的半正延拓？本文旨在给出反例。
AI.method: 构造四段不相交截面的乘积吹胀族，使中心纤维上三点共线；在中心纤维上指定具有解析奇点、极小奇点型的半正曲率奇异Hermitian度量；利用伴随系统在邻近纤维上消失来分析延拓障碍。
AI.result: 所得度量无任何到中心纤维某邻域的半正延拓；即使仅要求在延拓后与给定度量具有相同奇点型，延拓仍失败；中心纤维上可积伴随截面无法延拓，因相应伴随系统在每个邻近纤维上消失。
AI.conclusion: 该反例否定地回答了Păun的度量延拓问题（问题38），表明半正曲率奇异Hermitian度量在族中的延拓性一般不成立。

title: Into the danger zone: stable extrapolation in high-dimensional function and operator learning
summary: Out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization is a central challenge in scientific machine learning. We study regression problems in which the test distribution differs from the training distribution and ask: under what assumptions on the target function or operator is stable extrapolation possible, and how far beyond the training domain can one extrapolate? Existing theory controls the test error through additive penalties measuring the discrepancy between the training and test distributions. Such guarantees show robustness to small distribution shifts, but can very pessimistic in comparison to OOD performance observed empirically. We identify classes of holomorphic functions and operators for which the OOD generalization error converges at algebraic rates even in the presence of large distribution shifts. This phenomenon stems from the increasing smoothness of higher-index coordinates, leading to what we term a `blessing of high dimensionality'. For learning with either polynomials, deep neural networks or deep neural operators, we derive explicit rates for arbitrary test measures supported on suitable domains and quantify how the admissible domain depends on the underlying regularity of the function or operator. Our extrapolation guarantees are independent of the test distribution, depending only on its support. We also present a series of numerical experiments across a range of functions and operators that support the main theoretical findings.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究科学机器学习中的分布外(OOD)泛化：证明对全纯函数/算子，即使分布偏移很大，OOD泛化误差仍以代数速率收敛，称之为"高维祝福"，并给出多项式、深度神经网络/算子学习的显式速率与可外推域刻画。
AI.motivation: OOD泛化是科学机器学习的核心难题。现有理论通过度量训练与测试分布差异的加性惩罚来控制测试误差，只能保证小偏移下的稳健性，且往往比经验观测到的OOD表现悲观得多。作者希望回答：在何种对目标函数或算子的假设下可以实现稳定外推，以及能外推到训练域之外多远。
AI.method: 识别出一类全纯函数和算子，其高阶坐标光滑性递增（"高维祝福"），从而在分布大幅偏移下仍可稳定外推；针对多项式、深度神经网络、深度神经算子三类学习范式，对支撑在合适域上的任意测试测度推导显式收敛速率，并量化可允许域与函数/算子内在正则性的关系；辅以多组数值实验验证。
AI.result: 证明该类全纯函数/算子的OOD泛化误差即使在大分布偏移下也以代数速率收敛；得到对多项式、深度神经网络和深度神经算子的显式速率，并刻画可允许外推域随底层正则性的变化；外推保证与测试分布无关，仅依赖其支撑；数值实验支持理论结论。
AI.conclusion: OOD泛化并非必然悲观：对具有递增光滑性的全纯函数/算子可实现分布无关的稳定外推，且随维度升高"高维祝福"使可外推域扩大；该结果为超越加性分布差异惩罚的传统理论提供了新视角。

title: Latent Inference-Time Guidance of Time Series Foundation Models
summary: Time Series Foundation Models (TSFMs) currently provide state-of-the-art results in forecasting tasks. They are available out-of-the-box and rely on in-context learning to make their predictions, which makes the quality of their performance highly sensitive to the user-selected lookback, covariates, horizon and training data distributions. In practise, the quality of the forecasts are variable but complementary, which highlights the need for a principled ensembling approach, rather than selecting the best context. This paper introduces Latent Inference-Time Guidance for TSFMs, which adaptively combines a pool of TSFM forecasts through a time-dependent latent space with independent components. The framework comes equipped with identifiability and reconstruction guarantees, whilst maintaining the off-the-shelf aspect of foundation models. We provide experiments on datasets at various frequencies and from multiple domains: these show that the approach is competitive with traditional ensembling approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向时间序列基础模型（TSFM）的潜在推理时引导（Latent Inference-Time Guidance）方法，通过在时间相关的潜在空间中自适应组合多个TSFM预测，在保持基础模型即开即用特性的同时提供可识别性与重构保证。
AI.motivation: TSFM 依赖上下文学习进行预测，其性能对用户选择的回看窗口、协变量、预测视野和训练数据分布高度敏感。实际中不同配置下产生的预测质量参差不齐但具有互补性，因此需要一个有原则的集成方法，而非简单挑选最佳上下文。
AI.method: 提出针对 TSFM 的潜在推理时引导框架：通过一个具有独立分量的时间相关潜在空间，自适应地组合一组 TSFM 预测结果。该框架附带可识别性与重构保证，并且保持基础模型即开即用（off-the-shelf）的特性，无需重新训练。
AI.result: 在来自多个领域、不同采样频率的数据集上进行实验，结果表明该方法与传统集成方法相比具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 通过在时间相关潜在空间中对多个 TSFM 预测进行自适应组合，可在不改动基础模型的前提下获得与现有集成方法相当的性能，为 TSFM 集成提供了一种有理论保证的原则性方案。

title: Position: Let's Strengthen Verifiability If We Can't Enforce Reproducibility
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 Position Paper Track
summary: In the field of Machine Learning, many papers contain empirical results supporting claimed statements or illustrating the performance of a proposed method. However, most practitioners know that (1) results are generally hard to reproduce, and increasingly so, (2) code is not often available to do so, and (3) it hinders the development of research. In this position paper, we analyze and quantify these issues, and make concrete proposals to improve result checkability, if not reproducibility. Code and supporting materials are available at https://github.com/giddyyupp/position-enforce-verifiability.

AI.tldr: 这是一篇立场论文，针对机器学习论文中经验结果难以复现、代码常不可得、阻碍研究发展三大问题进行分析与量化，并提出改进"结果可核查性"（而非严格复现性）的具体建议。
AI.motivation: 机器学习领域大量论文依赖经验结果支撑论点或展示方法性能，但实践者普遍认识到：结果难以复现且趋势加剧、代码往往不可得、这阻碍了研究发展。作者希望系统分析并量化这些问题，推动改进。
AI.method: 采用立场论文（position paper）形式，对上述三类问题进行定性与定量分析，并据此提出具体提案，聚焦于提升结果的"可核查性"（checkability），并公开代码与支撑材料。
AI.result: 对结果可复现性差、代码可得性低及其对研究发展的阻碍进行了分析与量化，并给出提升结果可核查性的具体建议。
AI.conclusion: 呼吁社区重视并改善机器学习论文结果的可核查性，即使无法完全复现，也应先保证可核查；相关代码与材料已开源。
