title: Hölder estimates up to the singular time for the Córdoba-Córdoba-Fontelos equation
summary: We prove that the solution to the Córdoba-Córdoba-Fontelos equation $θ_t-uθ_x=0$, $u=Hθ$, on the real line with analytic initial datum $θ_0(x)=(1+x^2)^{-1}$ develops a finite-time singularity while remaining uniformly bounded in $C^{2/5}$. We also prove that, as the solution approaches the singular time, the $C^{2/3}$ seminorms of both $θ$ and $u$ diverge. The main ingredient is an integral representation in terms of a probability measure that is preserved by the nonlinear evolution. From this representation we derive a pointwise quadratic estimate for the key nonlinear term in the equation for $u$, using a comparison of positive kernels. Together with evolution identities for the moments of the measure, this estimate yields both the uniform Hölder bound and the divergence of the higher seminorms.

AI.tldr: 本文证明Córdoba-Córdoba-Fontelos方程在解析初值下发生有限时间奇异性，同时解在C^{2/5}中一致有界，而θ与u的C^{2/3}半范数在奇异时刻发散。
AI.motivation: 研究该非局部输运方程解的正则性结构与奇异性形成机制，特别是刻画解在奇异性附近不同Hölder范数之间的精细差异。
AI.method: 利用由非线性演化保持的概率测度给出积分表示；据此得到u方程中关键非线性项的逐点二次估计，方法基于正核的比较，并结合该测度矩的演化恒等式。
AI.result: 解在有限时间产生奇异性，但在C^{2/5}中一致有界；当趋于奇异时间时，θ与u的C^{2/3}半范数均发散。
AI.conclusion: 概率测度表示与矩演化结合可同时导出统一Hölder界和高阶半范数发散，揭示该方程奇异性形成中正则性指数的临界行为。

title: A conservative bulk-surface closure for soluble-surfactant falling films: an analytical and numerical mass-balance audit
summary: Adsorption and desorption redistribute soluble surfactant between a liquid film and its free surface, but cannot change the total inventory in a closed periodic domain. We audit this requirement in nonlinear weighted-residual models for soluble-surfactant-laden falling films. Although a previous correction restores conservation of the nonlinear surface Marangoni flux, a separate inconsistency remains in the depth-integrated bulk diffusion. We derive the resulting mass imbalance and construct explicit positive periodic concentration fields that exhibit it. The missing contribution arises from the streamwise concentration gradient appearing in the normal diffusive flux at a sloping interface. Including this contribution restores local conservation of the coupled bulk-surface transport system while leaving the hydrodynamic equations, the leading-order adsorption-desorption closure, and the linear stability properties of the uniform equilibrium unchanged. In an independent no-slip calculation using the parameters of an earlier travelling-wave study, the reference model loses $0.0228832\%$ of its initial surfactant mass by $t=4500$, whereas the corrected run has an absolute relative mass change of $1.2\times10^{-15}$. The main hump and capillary ripples remain closely comparable at $t\approx4500$. This benchmark therefore shows that agreement with travelling-wave calculations does not, by itself, guarantee that a reduced model respects the conservation laws inherited from the underlying transport problem. Although the drift is small in this case, the corrected equations conserve the reduced total inventory for every smooth periodic solution. We also distinguish this exact conservation property from higher-order compatibility with the full curved-interface boundary conditions.

AI.tldr: 该文审查可溶性表面活性剂降膜的非线性加权残差模型中的质量守恒问题，发现深度积分体相扩散存在独立的不一致，并给出修正方法。
AI.motivation: 吸附-脱附在液膜与自由表面间重新分配可溶性表面活性剂，但不能改变闭合周期域内的总量。此前修正虽恢复了非线性表面Marangoni通量守恒，但深度积分体相扩散仍存在不一致，尚无工作系统审计这一守恒要求。
AI.method: 推导质量失衡表达式，构造显式正定的周期浓度场以呈现该失衡；识别缺失项来自倾斜界面上法向扩散通量中的流向浓度梯度；将其纳入模型并检验对流体力学方程、最低阶吸附-脱附闭合及均匀平衡线性稳定性的影响；以无滑移计算作定量基准对比。
AI.result: 参考模型在 t=4500 时损失 0.0228832% 的初始表面活性剂质量，修正模型绝对相对质量变化仅 1.2×10⁻¹⁵；两者在 t≈4500 的主峰与毛细波纹仍高度接近。
AI.conclusion: 与行波计算结果吻合并不足以保证降阶模型尊重底层输运问题继承的守恒律；修正方程对任意光滑周期解严格守恒约化总量，且该精确守恒性质不同于与完整曲界面边界条件的高阶相容性。

title: Accurate ground-state entropies from population Monte Carlo: The antiferromagnetic Ising model on the Shastry-Sutherland lattice
summary: We demonstrate how the population annealing Monte Carlo simulation method can be used to compute the ground-state entropy to high precision. This approach is tested for the classical antiferromagnetic Ising model on the Shastry-Sutherland lattice with diagonal couplings chosen twice as strong as the nearest-neighbor interactions. In the absence of an external magnetic field, the model is known to be disordered at all temperatures, with a macroscopically degenerate ground state. We find the ground-state entropy to be $0.458\,777\,78(10)$ per site, which is in good agreement with the estimate of a recent study using the corner transfer matrix renormalization group method. The sampled ground-state configurations are analyzed by considering the bond configurations, the local-energy configurations, and the spin-spin correlations. While all observations are consistent with the disordered nature of the ground state, the numerical data suggest a power-law decay of the size distribution of clusters of sites with local energies different from the ground-state level.

AI.tldr: 该文用种群退火蒙特卡罗方法高精度计算了Shastry-Sutherland格子上经典反铁磁Ising模型（对角耦合为最近邻两倍）的基态熵，结果为每格点0.458 777 78(10)，与角转移矩阵重整化群结果吻合。
AI.motivation: 验证种群退火蒙特卡罗方法能否高精度计算基态熵，并为宏观简并基态的无序系统提供独立数值检验。选取该模型是因为其无外场时在所有温度下无序且基态宏观简并，是检验方法精度的理想体系。
AI.method: 采用种群退火蒙特卡罗模拟方法计算基态熵；通过分析键构型、局域能量构型和自旋-自旋关联对采样得到的基态构型进行表征，并考察具有非基态局域能量的格点团的尺寸分布。
AI.result: 得到基态熵为每格点0.458 777 78(10)，与近期角转移矩阵重整化群研究的估计值吻合良好。所有观测结果均符合基态的无序性质，但数值数据显示非基态局域能量格点团的尺寸分布呈幂律衰减。
AI.conclusion: 种群退火蒙特卡罗可高精度计算基态熵，并可作为该宏观简并无序体系的独立验证手段；局域能量团尺寸分布的幂律衰减为进一步刻画基态结构提供了线索。

title: Soft Separation for Adaptive Robust Optimization
summary: We propose an algorithmic framework for solving adaptive robust optimization with provable guarantees on both tractability and solution accuracy. The framework introduces soft separation, a probabilistic mechanism for identifying worst-case uncertainty realizations via a time-inhomogeneous Markov chain. Rather than solving an exact separation problem in each iteration, which is intractable in general, the chain carries adversarial information across iterations, co-evolves with the optimization iterates, and recovers exact separation at terminal iterates with high probability. For continuous first-stage (here-and-now) decisions, we design a first-order method that uses soft separation to produce adaptive gradient estimates. Notably, we prove polynomial-time convergence in expectation to the global optimum. For mixed-integer here-and-now decisions, we embed soft separation within a branch-and-cut framework to generate valid cuts for the robust objective and obtain a high-probability certificate of global optimality. Numerical experiments demonstrate that the proposed methods scale favorably with problem dimension and scenario size relative to state-of-the-art approaches. The instances and code are available online at https://github.com/xuqy2002/SoftSeparationARO.

AI.tldr: 提出求解自适应鲁棒优化的算法框架，通过"软分离"机制在可解性与解精度上提供概率性保证，覆盖连续与混合整数首阶段决策。
AI.motivation: 自适应鲁棒优化通常需要在每次迭代中求解精确分离问题以找出最坏情形不确定性实现，但该问题一般不可解，导致算法缺乏同时兼顾可解性与解精度的理论保证。
AI.method: 核心是软分离：用时间非齐次马尔可夫链以概率机制识别最坏情形不确定性实现，替代每轮精确分离；链在迭代间传递对抗信息并与优化迭代量共同演化，在高概率下于终止迭代恢复精确分离。对连续首阶段（here-and-now）决策，设计一阶方法，用软分离生成自适应梯度估计；对混合整数首阶段决策，将软分离嵌入分支切割框架，为鲁棒目标生成有效割。
AI.result: 连续情形证明了期望意义下多项式时间收敛到全局最优；混合整数情形获得高概率全局最优性证书。数值实验表明方法在问题维度与场景规模上的可扩展性优于现有先进方法。实例与代码已在线公开。
AI.conclusion: 软分离为自适应鲁棒优化提供了一条兼顾可解性与精度的统一路径，兼顾连续与混合整数决策，且具备可证明的收敛与最优性保证。

title: Weakly interacting Bose-Einstein condensate with stochastic resetting
summary: Stochastic resetting can generate strong correlations in many-body systems through a shared fluctuating environment. Here, we investigate how such dynamically emergent correlations (DEC) coexist with intrinsic (direct) interactions in a weakly repulsive Bose-Einstein condensate described within the Gross-Pitaevskii framework. The condensate undergoes free expansion from an initial Thomas-Fermi state and is stochastically reset to this initial state at a constant rate. We show that the resetting protocol drives the system into a unique nonequilibrium steady state and obtain its density profile, edge statistics, and full counting statistics analytically. The steady-state density retains an inverted-parabolic form within the core, while developing exponentially decaying tails outside it. We further show that resetting induces nontrivial fluctuations of the condensate edge and particle number, yielding exact scaling forms for the edge distribution and the full counting statistics. Our results provide a tractable setting for exploring the interplay between intrinsic repulsive interactions and attractive DEC generated by a common stochastic environment in quantum many-body systems.

AI.tldr: 该文研究弱排斥玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体在自由膨胀与随机重置下的非平衡稳态，解析给出密度分布、边缘统计与全计数统计。
AI.motivation: 随机重置可通过共享涨落环境在多体系统中产生强关联，但这类"动力学涌现关联"（DEC）与体系内禀直接相互作用如何共存尚不清楚。
AI.method: 在Gross-Pitaevskii框架下描述弱排斥BEC，体系从初始Thomas-Fermi态自由膨胀并以恒定速率被随机重置回初态，用解析方法求解稳态密度、边缘统计与全计数统计。
AI.result: 重置驱动系统进入唯一非平衡稳态；稳态密度核心区保持倒抛物线形式，外部呈指数衰减尾；重置诱导凝聚体边缘与粒子数的非平凡涨落，并得到边缘分布与全计数统计的精确标度形式。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为研究量子多体系统中内禀排斥相互作用与共享随机环境产生的吸引性DEC之间的相互作用提供了可解析处理的平台。

title: Finiteness of the Chow ring of $\mathcal{M}_{5,10}$
summary: In this paper, we prove that the rational Chow ring $A^*(\mathcal{M}_{5,10})$ is finitely generated as a $\mathbb{Q}$-algebra.

AI.tldr: 证明了模空间 $\mathcal{M}_{5,10}$ 的有理 Chow 环 $A^*(\mathcal{M}_{5,10})$ 作为 $\mathbb{Q}$-代数有限生成。
AI.motivation: 模空间 $\mathcal{M}_{g,n}$ 的 Chow 环结构是代数几何中的核心问题。以往有限生成性结果多局限于低亏格或小子 $n$ 的情形，$(g,n)=(5,10)$ 属于此前未知的情形，因此需要新方法加以处理。
AI.method: 通过研究 $\mathcal{M}_{5,10}$ 的有理 Chow 环 $A^*(\mathcal{M}_{5,10})$ 的代数结构，证明其作为 $\mathbb{Q}$-代数是有限生成的（摘要未给出具体技术细节）。
AI.result: $A^*(\mathcal{M}_{5,10})$ 是有限生成的 $\mathbb{Q}$-代数。
AI.conclusion: 该结果将模空间 Chow 环有限生成性的已知范围拓展至 $(g,n)=(5,10)$ 这一情形。

title: Structure-preserving upwind Lagrange multiplier schemes for solid-state dewetting with a logarithmic Flory--Huggins potential
summary: Phase-field simulations of solid-state dewetting based on polynomial potentials may exhibit spurious bulk-diffusion coarsening, inconsistent with the surface-diffusion-dominated physics. To address this issue, we formulate a degenerate Cahn--Hilliard model with the logarithmic Flory--Huggins potential and dynamic contact line boundary conditions for the film--substrate--vapor triple junction. The logarithmic barrier confines the phase variable to its physical range and suppresses spurious coarsening at the continuum level. We develop a fully discrete, structure-preserving scheme that combines a Lagrange multiplier approach with an upwind finite-volume discretization and rigorously guarantees pointwise boundedness, mass conservation, and energy dissipation without artificial cut-offs or projections. A dimensional-splitting strategy further reduces computational cost while preserving these properties in each one-dimensional sweep. We also derive an explicit estimate of the equilibrium radius contraction caused by spontaneous film shrinking, showing that the logarithmic potential produces weaker spurious shrinkage than the polynomial potential. Numerical experiments confirm the analysis and demonstrate that, for small temperature parameters, the proposed scheme suppresses spurious coarsening and pinch-off while accurately reproducing surface-diffusion-dominated dynamics and relaxation toward equilibrium island structures.

AI.tldr: 该文提出基于对数Flory-Huggins势的退化Cahn-Hilliard模型及保结构格式，用于固态去润湿模拟，消除多项式势导致的虚假体扩散粗化。
AI.motivation: 相场模拟固态去润湿时，多项式势会引发虚假的体扩散粗化，与表面扩散主导的物理不符，需要从连续层面抑制该问题。
AI.method: 采用对数Flory-Huggins势的退化Cahn-Hilliard模型，配合膜-基底-气相三相交线的动态接触线边界条件；构建拉格朗日乘子法结合上风有限体积离散的全离散保结构格式，无需人工截断或投影即可保证逐点有界、质量守恒与能量耗散；并用维数分裂策略降低计算成本。
AI.result: 对数势的对数壁垒将相变量限制在物理范围内并抑制虚假粗化；推导了自发膜收缩引起平衡半径收缩的显式估计，表明对数势的虚假收缩弱于多项式势；数值实验验证了分析结论。
AI.conclusion: 在小温度参数下，所提格式能抑制虚假粗化与颈缩，准确再现表面扩散主导的动力学及向平衡岛结构的弛豫。

title: ReCIRC: Rectified Conformal Risk Control
summary: Many applications of black-box predictive models require controlling task-relevant error rates, such as missed lesion pixels in segmentation or missed labels in multilabel classification. Conformal risk control (CRC; Angelopoulos et al., arXiv:2208.02814) gives distribution-free guarantees for such losses, but it calibrates a single threshold shared by all inputs. Because conditional risk varies with the input, this marginal guarantee often overprotects easy cases and underprotects hard ones. We propose ReCIRC (Rectified Conformal Risk Control), which inverts each input's estimated local risk curve to reparameterize the calibrated threshold as a risk budget $a$ representing a common target conditional risk, and then applies CRC unchanged to the resulting family. ReCIRC retains CRC's finite-sample marginal guarantee regardless of the accuracy of the estimated curves, while accurate curves yield approximate conditional risk control and, under additional conditions, asymptotically exact conditional risk control; they also support a risk-calibration diagnostic. Across three synthetic and five real-data settings spanning segmentation, multilabel and multiclass classification, and regression, ReCIRC attained the lowest average worst-group risk and mean positive group excess in every setting, while maintaining marginal risk close to the target, whereas changes in prediction size were application-dependent.

AI.tldr: ReCIRC通过反转每个输入的局部风险曲线来重新参数化校准阈值，在保留CRC有限样本边际保证的同时实现近似/渐近精确的条件风险控制，并在13个任务设定中取得最低的最差组风险。
AI.motivation: 共形风险控制（CRC）提供分布无关的风险保证，但仅校准所有输入共享的单一阈值。由于条件风险随输入变化，这种边际保证对简单样本过度保护、对困难样本保护不足。
AI.method: 提出ReCIRC：估计每个输入的局部风险曲线，将其反转以把校准阈值重新参数化为代表共同目标条件风险的风险预算a，再对得到的函数族原样应用CRC。无论估计曲线是否准确，均保留CRC的有限样本边际保证；曲线准确时可获得近似条件风险控制，并在附加条件下实现渐近精确的条件风险控制，同时支持风险校准诊断。
AI.result: 在3个合成和5个真实数据设定（涵盖分割、多标签与多类分类、回归）中，ReCIRC在每个设定均取得最低的平均最差组风险和平均正组超额，同时保持边际风险接近目标值，而预测规模的变化因应用而异。
AI.conclusion: ReCIRC在不牺牲CRC理论保证的前提下显著改善了条件风险控制，缓解了边际校准对困难样本保护不足的问题，代价是预测规模变化具有任务依赖性。

title: Neural Constitutive Learning for Generalized Reaction-Diffusion Systems
summary: Generalized reaction-diffusion systems encompass diverse transport mechanisms and coupled reaction kinetics. A central question for neural PDE solvers is what should be learned so that a common interface can accommodate phase-field and degenerate transport, local reactions, and multispecies coupling. We propose the Neural Constitutive Laws--Mass-Compression-Transport (NCL-MCT) Solver, which learns PDE-specific constitutive responses while retaining temporal evolution in a shared MCT integrator. Transport is represented through mobility and thermodynamic driving force, and reaction through relative reaction rates. These constitutive responses depend on the current density rather than explicitly on the initial condition or elapsed time, motivating their reuse across different initial conditions and time horizons. The same interface supports velocity-data supervision and known-law supervision, neither of which requires time integration during training. When constitutive laws are known, supervision can be evaluated on independently sampled density fields, enabling trajectory-free constitutive learning without generating solution trajectories. Across seven systems, separately trained constitutive modules share the same interface and MCT integrator and achieve relative rollout $L^2$ errors of $10^{-4}$ to $10^{-2}$. Tests with unseen initial-condition families and an extended time horizon assess reuse beyond training conditions, while separate experiments demonstrate trajectory-free constitutive learning. These results support constitutive responses as an effective learning target for a shared neural PDE framework.

AI.tldr: 提出NCL-MCT求解器，将广义反应-扩散PDE的学习目标从解轨迹转向本构响应（迁移率、热力学驱动力、相对反应速率），在共享MCT积分器中统一相场、退化输运、局域反应与多组分耦合，7个系统上取得10^-4至10^-2量级的相对rollout L2误差，并支持无轨迹本构学习。
AI.motivation: 广义反应-扩散系统涵盖多样的输运机制与耦合反应动力学，而神经PDE求解器的核心问题是：应当学习什么，才能用一个通用接口同时兼容相场与退化输运、局域反应以及多物种耦合。已有方法多直接学习解映射或时间演化，难以在不同初始条件与时间尺度间复用。
AI.method: 该工作提出NCL-MCT求解器，将学习目标设定为PDE特有的本构响应，而把时间演化交给共享的MCT积分器。其中输运由迁移率（mobility）与热力学驱动力表示，反应由相对反应速率表示。这些本构响应仅依赖当前密度状态，而非显式依赖初始条件或已流逝时间，因而可在不同初始条件和时间范围内复用。同一接口同时支持速度数据监督和已知定律监督，两者在训练时均无需时间积分；当本构定律已知时，监督可在独立采样的密度场上评估，从而实现无需生成解轨迹的"无轨迹本构学习"。
AI.result: 在七个系统上，分别训练的各个本构模块共享同一接口与MCT积分器，取得相对rollout L2误差约10^-4至10^-2。针对训练时未见过的初始条件族以及延长的时间范围进行的测试，检验了超出训练条件下的复用能力；另设实验验证了无轨迹本构学习的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，本构响应是面向共享神经PDE框架的一种有效学习目标：以本构律为学习对象可在统一接口下兼容多种广义反应-扩散机制，并带来较强的跨初始条件与跨时间范围复用能力。

title: Mara Chain: Rethinking Failure as a Stepping Stone for AI System Auto-Evolution
summary: Optimizing deployed AI systems increasingly amounts to editing prompts, skills, harnesses, and code rather than model weights. Existing approaches commonly optimize these artifacts through propose-evaluate-select procedures, where candidate configurations are evaluated and only those meeting an acceptance criterion are selected. Yet our analysis shows that discarded candidates often contain information critical for subsequent optimization. Discarding them causes later proposals to revisit the same failure modes. We introduce Mara Chain, a refinement procedure that turns rejected candidates into stepping stones. Rather than discarding a rejected candidate, Mara Chain retains and iteratively refines it using evidence accumulated across preceding attempts. The procedure limits each refinement chain to a fixed depth and applies Pareto-filtered Top-N selection to bound the candidate pool. Across AppWorld skill optimization, TerminalBench 2.1 harness optimization, and MuSiQue retrieval-pipeline optimization, Mara Chain delivers greater task-performance gains with fewer rollouts. It outperforms GEPA, ACE, and SkillOpt-Lite by up to 20.5% in relative performance on AppWorld, reaching the target score with 65.5% fewer rollouts than GEPA. It improves the pass rate by 20.2 and 22.5 percentage points over AHE and Meta-Harness on TerminalBench 2.1, respectively, and improves MuSiQue test nDCG@10 and Recall@10 by 0.104 and 0.131 over a hand-written retrieval pipeline.

AI.tldr: Mara Chain 将"被拒绝的候选配置"保留并迭代精炼，形成有界深度的精炼链，配合 Pareto 过滤的 Top-N 选择控制候选池，从而在更少 rollout 下取得更大性能提升。
AI.motivation: 部署后的 AI 系统优化越来越依赖编辑 prompt、skill、harness 和代码而非模型权重。现有方法多采用"提议—评估—选择"流程，仅保留满足接受准则的候选，丢弃其余候选。作者分析发现，被丢弃的候选往往含有对后续优化至关重要的信息，直接丢弃会导致后续提议重复遭遇相同的失败模式。
AI.method: 提出 Mara Chain 精炼过程：不丢弃被拒绝的候选，而是保留并利用此前各次尝试累积的证据对其进行迭代精炼，将失败候选转化为后续优化的"垫脚石"。每条精炼链深度固定，并采用 Pareto 过滤的 Top-N 选择来约束候选池规模。
AI.result: 在 AppWorld 技能优化、TerminalBench 2.1 harness 优化和 MuSiQue 检索流水线优化三项任务上，Mara Chain 以更少 rollout 取得更大任务性能增益。AppWorld 上相对性能较 GEPA、ACE、SkillOpt-Lite 最高提升 20.5%，达到目标分数所需 rollout 比 GEPA 少 65.5%；TerminalBench 2.1 上 pass rate 较 AHE 和 Meta-Harness 分别提升 20.2 和 22.5 个百分点；MuSiQue 上 test nDCG@10 和 Recall@10 较手写检索流水线分别提升 0.104 和 0.131。
AI.conclusion: 保留并精炼被拒绝候选优于传统的丢弃式提议—评估—选择范式，可在多种制品（skill、harness、检索流水线）优化场景中一致地提升性能并显著降低 rollout 成本。

title: Uniform $W^{2,m}$ approximation of almost isometric maps
summary: This paper shows that an almost-isometric Sobolev map from a Lipschitz subset of an oriented manifold $M$ into another oriented manifold $N$ can be approximated by a map of class $C^{1,α}$, with a universal bound on the $W^{2,m}$ norm, for any $m\in(1,\infty)$. This, in turn, implies a universal bound on the $C^{1,α}$ seminorm. The $W^{1,p}$ distance of the approximation from the original map is controlled in terms of the $L^p$-deviation from being an isometry, with the optimal scaling. The manifolds $M$ and $N$ are assumed to be compact, oriented and have equal dimension; $M$ may have a boundary.

AI.tldr: 几乎等距的Sobolev映射可由$C^{1,\alpha}$映射逼近，且具有关于$W^{2,m}$范数的统一界，逼近的$W^{1,p}$距离由偏离等距性的$L^p$量以最优尺度控制。
AI.motivation: 研究光滑（$C^{1,\alpha}$）映射对几乎等距Sobolev映射的逼近问题，并希望逼近不仅在拓扑/光滑层面成立，还能获得定量的范数界与逼近误差估计。
AI.method: 从有向流形$M$的Lipschitz子集出发，考虑取值于有向流形$N$的几乎等距Sobolev映射；构造$C^{1,\alpha}$逼近映射，建立对$W^{2,m}$范数（任意$m\in(1,\infty)$）的统一界，并以偏离等距性的$L^p$量为尺度控制逼近的$W^{1,p}$距离。流形$M,N$紧致、有向、等维，$M$可带边界。
AI.result: 任意几乎等距Sobolev映射均可被$C^{1,\alpha}$映射逼近，且逼近映射满足$W^{2,m}$范数统一界；该界进一步导出$C^{1,\alpha}$半范数的统一界；逼近与原映射的$W^{1,p}$距离由$L^p$偏离等距性的量以最优尺度控制。
AI.conclusion: 在紧致、有向、等维流形（$M$可带边界）上，几乎等距Sobolev映射具有可控的光滑逼近，逼近误差以偏离等距性的$L^p$量最优地度量，并获得$W^{2,m}$与$C^{1,\alpha}$的统一估计。

title: A shape-similarity latent space for fluid interfaces: invertible reduced-order modelling of droplet morphology
summary: A droplet breaks up in tens of microseconds, and a recording captures perhaps a dozen frames. The states in between cannot be recovered without repeating the experiment, and simulating them is too costly to sweep an operating envelope. Yet they are present in the corpus as a whole: a campaign spanning a device's actuation range produces morphologies resembling those any single recording missed. Exploiting that requires a representation that is low-dimensional, invertible, and faithful to shape rather than to sampling. Proper orthogonal decomposition supplies the first two but measures distance in sampled coordinates; manifold learning supplies the third but no map back to a shape; elastic shape analysis supplies a shape metric but no reduced coordinates. SHROM composes all three. Interfaces are represented by their square-root velocity functions, a neighbour graph is built over that shape space, and an autoencoder is trained to reconstruct while penalising latents in which graph neighbours are not latent neighbours. The demonstration uses 301,539 inkjet droplet contours and four filmed break-up sequences. The graph term does not improve reconstruction. It determines whether position in the latent carries meaning: clustering the latent of an otherwise identical model recovers the shape-space partition at chance level (ARI = 0.063 +/- 0.059), and at 0.781 +/- 0.049 with the term active. Waveform parameters predict the full contour at R^2 = 0.878 +/- 0.026. Negative results are reported in the same terms. The graph metric proved immaterial across five choices, and interpolation error saturates at the reconstruction limit, so a plain autoencoder leads that task. The main limitation is interpolation across a topology change: no component of the regularised latent holds both a single-component and a post-break-up shape, whereas an unregularised autoencoder mixes them freely.

AI.tldr: SHROM 将平方根速度函数（SRVF）形状表示、邻域图与自编码器结合，构建低维、可逆、保形状的潜在表示，在 301,539 个喷墨液滴轮廓上验证：图正则不改善重建，但决定潜在空间是否携带几何意义。
AI.motivation: 液滴破裂发生在数十微秒内，单次记录仅十余帧，缺失中间状态；重复实验与直接数值模拟成本过高，无法扫描工作包线。但跨驱动范围的实验整体语料中隐含了这些形态，需要一种低维、可逆、忠实于形状（而非采样坐标）的表示来挖掘。
AI.method: SHROM 组合三种已有工具：用平方根速度函数（SRVF）表示界面以保证形状度量；在形状空间上构建邻域图；训练自编码器重建，并施加正则项——惩罚图中邻居在潜在空间中不相邻的情形。数据为 301,539 个喷墨液滴轮廓与四条拍摄的破裂序列。
AI.result: 图正则项不提升重建质量。它决定潜在位置是否具有含义：同一模型去掉该项后，潜在聚类仅以随机水平恢复形状空间划分（ARI = 0.063 ± 0.059）；激活该项后 ARI = 0.781 ± 0.049。波形参数预测完整轮廓 R² = 0.878 ± 0.026。负面结果同样报告：图度量在五种选择下均无关紧要；插值误差在重建极限处饱和，因此普通自编码器在该任务上领先。
AI.conclusion: 主要局限在于跨拓扑变化（单组分到破裂后形态）的插值：正则化潜在的任何分量都无法同时容纳两类形状，而未正则化自编码器可自由混合它们。

title: PHASE: Multi-Regime Modeling of Incompressible Magnetohydrodynamics
summary: Magnetohydrodynamics (MHD) is central to plasma modeling in astrophysics, space science, fusion, and engineering, but resolving multiscale MHD dynamics is computationally expensive. Machine-learning surrogates enable fast inference by learning reusable solution operators, yet existing models require separate training for each physical regime, limiting generalization across varying parameter settings. We introduce PHASE, a PHysics-Adaptive Scalable operator with residual Error correction, designed to model incompressible MHD across varying physical parameters with a single model. PHASE combines transfer learning, regime-aware adaptation, physics-centered learning, and residual refinement to improve both physical fidelity and generalization across MHD regimes. Together, these improvements achieve state-of-the-art prediction accuracy on two-dimensional MHD turbulence by reducing relative $L_2$ errors on physical fields by more than an order of magnitude compared to prior MHD neural-operator baselines. Moreover, PHASE generalizes successfully to unseen parameter values without retraining, demonstrating the cross-regime adaptability expected from operator learning. We evaluate PHASE beyond point-wise prediction errors using derived physical fields, spectral analysis, and distribution statistics, consistently observing improved physical fidelity. We further show that our framework can accurately simulate MHD instabilities by testing it on the Kelvin--Helmholtz instability, demonstrating the robustness of our method.

AI.tldr: 提出PHASE，一个物理自适应可扩展神经算子，通过迁移学习、区域感知适应、以物理为中心的学习与残差误差修正，在单一模型中实现跨参数区域的不可压缩磁流体力学建模。
AI.motivation: 磁流体力学（MHD）在天体物理、空间科学、聚变与工程中至关重要，但多尺度MHD动力学求解计算成本高昂。机器学习代理模型虽可快速推理，但现有模型需针对每个物理区域单独训练，泛化能力有限，难以适应变化的参数设置。
AI.method: PHASE结合四项关键技术：迁移学习、区域感知适应（regime-aware adaptation）、以物理为中心的学习（physics-centered learning）以及残差误差修正（residual refinement），构建单一物理自适应可扩展算子，用于不同物理参数下的不可压缩MHD建模。
AI.result: 在二维MHD湍流上达到最先进预测精度，物理场相对L2误差较已有MHD神经算子基线降低一个数量级以上；无需重新训练即可泛化到未见参数值；在派生物理场、谱分析与分布统计评估中一致性提升物理保真度；并在Kelvin–Helmholtz不稳定性上验证了模拟MHD不稳定性的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: PHASE以单模型实现跨区域MHD建模，兼具高精度、参数泛化与物理保真度，展示了算子学习所期望的跨区域适应能力，并具备模拟MHD不稳定性的鲁棒性。

title: A projected descent method for minimization of weakly semismooth functions over polyhedral sets
summary: This study develops a projection-based descent method for minimizing weakly semismooth functions over polyhedral sets, taking an initial step toward extending projection-based descent algorithms to nonsmooth, nonconvex optimization problems. At each iteration, the method considers an inner approximation of the Clarke $\varepsilon$-subdifferential at the current iterate over the feasible region and uses its least-norm element to generate a search direction. An exponential limited backtracking line search is then developed to assess the quality of the generated direction, while a projected variant of Mifflin's line search is proposed to identify nonredundant subgradients that enrich the Clarke $\varepsilon$-subdifferential approximation when necessary. To quantify stationarity, a characterization of stationary points based on the projection operator yields a computable optimality measure for the proposed method. The convergence properties of the proposed method are established under mild assumptions. If the algorithm generates infinitely many serious steps, we identify two subsequences such that every cluster point of each subsequence is stationary. If the number of serious steps is finite, we show that the final serious step generates a stationary point. Numerical experiments demonstrate the efficiency and broad applicability of the proposed method across a wide range of test problems, including applications in image denoising, multiobjective optimization, and data clustering. To extend the applicability of the proposed method to problems with general smooth nonlinear constraints, we propose a heuristic approach based on sequential linearization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种投影型下降方法，用于在多面体集上极小化弱半光滑函数，初步将投影下降算法推广到非光滑非凸优化问题。
AI.motivation: 将投影下降算法从光滑或凸情形推广到非光滑、非凸优化问题，处理弱半光滑函数在多面体约束下的极小化。
AI.method: 每次迭代在当前点处构造Clarke ε-次微分的内部近似，取最小范数元生成搜索方向；采用指数型有限回溯线搜索评估方向质量；提出Mifflin线搜索的投影变体以识别非冗余次梯度，必要时丰富次微分近似；基于投影算子刻画稳定点并给出可计算的最优性度量。
AI.result: 在温和假设下建立收敛性：若产生无穷多个serious step，则存在两个子序列，其各自任一聚点均为稳定点；若serious step有限，则最后一个serious step产生稳定点。数值实验表明方法在图像去噪、多目标优化、数据聚类等问题上高效且适用性广。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为弱半光滑非凸约束优化提供了可行的投影下降框架，并可通过基于序列线性化的启发式途径推广到一般光滑非线性约束问题。

title: Nonexistence of maximal curves of genus five over $\F_{64}$
summary: We show that there is no maximal curve of genus five over $\F_{64}$. As a consequence, $N_{64}(5)=140$, and the genus spectrum of maximal curves over $\F_{64}$ is determined. The proof uses the vanishing of the third iterate of the Cartier operator. We prove that a nonhyperelliptic curve of genus five in characteristic two satisfying this condition is nontrigonal. Its canonical theta characteristic defines a separable cover of degree four with one geometric branch value. The two possible ramification types give either a rational subcanonical point or a point bound obtained from the cubic resolvent. Both cases exclude maximality over $\F_{64}$.

AI.tldr: 证明了 $\mathbb{F}_{64}$ 上不存在亏格5的极大曲线，从而确定 $N_{64}(5)=140$，并给出 $\mathbb{F}_{64}$ 上极大曲线的亏格谱。证明利用了 Cartier 算子第三次迭代的消失性。
AI.motivation: 确定有限域上极大曲线亏格谱中的一个悬而未决情形，即证明 $\mathbb{F}_{64}$ 上亏格5极大曲线的不存在性。
AI.method: 利用 Cartier 算子第三次迭代的消失性；证明特征2下满足该条件的亏格5非超椭圆曲线是非三角的；其典范 theta 特征给出一个带单一几何分支值的四次可分覆盖，两类分歧型分别对应有理次典范点或由三次预解式得到的界，二者均排除 $\mathbb{F}_{64}$ 上的极大性。
AI.result: $\mathbb{F}_{64}$ 上不存在亏格5极大曲线，故 $N_{64}(5)=140$，并完全确定了 $\mathbb{F}_{64}$ 上极大曲线的亏格谱。
AI.conclusion: 亏格谱被确定，$\mathbb{F}_{64}$ 上亏格5不属于极大曲线亏格集合。

title: Hard-Trace First-Order Residual Learning for Coupled Stokes-Brinkman-Darcy Flow
summary: Stokes-Brinkman-Darcy (SBD) models connect free flow and porous flow through a Brinkman layer of finite thickness. The proposed method for solving these coupled equations consists of a mixed first-order formulation, shared interface traces and hard traction constraints, and a pressure correction based on boundary mass balance. Independent stresses, Darcy flux and pressure-gradient auxiliaries avoid second derivatives of network outputs. Boundary liftings and shared traces impose exterior and interface kinematic conditions exactly, while a stress map enforces native Brinkman-Darcy force balance. An integral momentum relation determines the pressure correction after training, without reference-pressure labels. Across two manufactured solutions and three permeabilities, mean corrected upper-pressure relative $L^2$ errors range from 0.87% to 2.58%; correction reduces both upper-pressure $L^2$ errors and the full Brinkman-pressure $H^1$ error in every run. Paired controls assess the contributions of interface sharing and traction enforcement. A non-manufactured filtration problem tests mixed-boundary adaptation against an independently refined finite-element reference, with all four runs satisfying the prescribed field and physical-consistency criteria.

AI.tldr: 提出一种求解Stokes-Brinkman-Darcy耦合方程的混合一阶物理信息方法，通过共享界面迹、硬牵引约束与边界质量平衡压力修正实现精确界面与边界条件施加，在多个算例中取得0.87%–2.58%的压力相对L2误差。
AI.motivation: SBD模型通过有限厚度Brinkman层连接自由流与多孔流，是描述此类耦合流动的关键框架；但传统求解方式需处理二阶导数、参考压力标签以及界面/边界条件的精确施加，存在精度与稳定性困难。作者希望构建一种避免二阶导数、无需参考压力标签、并能精确施加外边界与界面运动学条件及Brinkman-Darcy力平衡的求解方法。
AI.method: 采用混合一阶形式，引入独立的应力、Darcy通量与压力梯度辅助变量以避免网络输出的二阶导数；通过边界lifting与共享界面迹精确施加外部及界面运动学条件；利用应力映射强制满足Brinkman-Darcy力平衡；训练后基于积分动量关系与边界质量平衡确定压力修正，无需参考压力标签。并通过配对对照实验评估界面共享与牵引约束的贡献。
AI.result: 在两个manufactured解与三种渗透率下，修正后的上层压力相对L2误差均值为0.87%–2.58%；每次运行中压力修正均同时降低上层压力L2误差与完整Brinkman压力H1误差。配对对照实验量化了界面共享与牵引约束的作用。在非manufactured过滤问题上，四个运行均满足规定的场量与物理一致性准则，并与独立细化的有限元参考解进行对比验证。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法能够有效求解SBD耦合方程，精确施加界面与边界条件，保持Brinkman-Darcy力平衡，并通过后训练压力修正显著提升压力场精度，在合成与类实际过滤问题上均表现出良好的精度与物理一致性。

title: Boundary Value Problems for the $SU(\infty)$-Toda Equation via the Onofri Inequality
summary: We formulate and solve a degenerate elliptic boundary value problem for the $SU(\infty)$-Toda equation on $[0,\frac12)\times\mathbb{S}^2$. This constructs anti-self-dual Poincaré--Einstein metrics with circle symmetry on the $4$-ball and on complex line bundles over $\mathbb{S}^2$.

AI.tldr: 在 $[0,\frac12)\times\mathbb{S}^2$ 上构造并求解了 $SU(\infty)$-Toda 方程的一类退化的椭圆边值问题，由此得到 $4$-球与 $\mathbb{S}^2$ 上复线丛上具有圆对称性的反自对偶 Poincaré--Einstein 度量。
AI.motivation: 反自对偶 Poincaré--Einstein 度量是几何分析与广义相对论（AdS/CFT）中的重要对象，通常通过求解特定完全非线性方程来构造。本文旨在利用圆对称性将问题约化为 $SU(\infty)$-Toda 方程，从而在 $4$-球及 $\mathbb{S}^2$ 上的复线丛等具体流形上给出新的度量构造。
AI.method: 在带边柱形区域 $[0,\frac12)\times\mathbb{S}^2$ 上，将具有圆对称性的反自对偶 Poincaré--Einstein 度量问题转化为 $SU(\infty)$-Toda 方程的退化椭圆边值问题，并证明该边值问题解的存在性（或可解性）。
AI.result: 求解了该退化椭圆边值问题，从而在 $4$-球内部及 $\mathbb{S}^2$ 上复线丛上构造出具有圆对称性的反自对偶 Poincaré--Einstein 度量。
AI.conclusion: 圆对称反自对偶 Poincaré--Einstein 度量的构造可归结为 $SU(\infty)$-Toda 方程的退化椭圆边值问题；该方法在 $4$-球与 $\mathbb{S}^2$ 上复线丛等情形下可行。

title: Beyond Keywords: Leveraging Generative LLMs and Label Aggregation to Classify Economic Policy Uncertainty in News Articles
summary: This research describes the adaptation of Large Language Models (LLMs) for economic monitoring in the public sector to automatically determine whether an article discusses Economic Policy Uncertanity (EPU) and to identify its specific type. Previous studies either rely on keywords, which often result in a high count of false positives, or use machine learning approaches that require a large number of quality human labeled data that is costly and time consuming to acquire. In this study, we propose approaches based on weak supervision techniques, using generative LLMs to create synthetic labels through prompting, making the approach both cost-effective and scalable. Additionally, we propose methods for for multi-label and hierarchical classification of articles related to EPU.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于弱监督与生成式LLM的方法，通过提示生成合成标签，实现公共部门经济政策不确定性（EPU）文章的自动识别与类型划分，兼顾成本效益与可扩展性，并支持多标签与层级分类。
AI.motivation: 现有EPU监测方法存在不足：关键词法误报率高；机器学习法依赖大量高质量人工标注数据，成本高且耗时。因此需要一种低成本、可扩展的替代方案。
AI.method: 采用弱监督技术，利用生成式大语言模型通过提示（prompting）创建合成标签，替代昂贵的人工标注；并进一步提出面向EPU相关文章的多标签与层级分类方法。
AI.result: 摘要未给出具体实验数据或量化结果，主要贡献为方法层面的验证性描述：所提方法在成本效益与可扩展性方面具备优势，并可支撑多标签及层级分类任务。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为公共部门经济监测中的EPU自动识别与细分类提供了基于弱监督和生成式LLM的可行路径，缓解了对人工标注的依赖。

title: Existence of three solutions for parametric $p$-Laplacian equations in $\mathbb{R}^N$
summary: In this paper we deal with a nonlinear elliptic problem in the whole space $\RN$ involving the $p$-Laplacian operator with $p>N$. Under suitable assumptions on the potential term and on the nonlinearity, we establish the existence of at least three distinct weak solutions. Our approach is variational and relies on two different three critical points theorems. The results extend to the whole space some recent multiplicity theorems for $p$-Laplacian equations, and provide explicit ranges for the parameter $λ> 0$ ensuring the existence of multiple solutions, which are nonnegative under additional sign conditions. The nontriviality of the solutions is also discussed. Applications to problems with nonlinearities with separated variables are finally presented.

AI.tldr: 研究 $\mathbb{R}^N$ 上含 $p$-Laplacian 算子（$p>N$）的非线性椭圆问题，利用两个三临界点定理证明至少存在三个不同弱解，并给出参数 $\lambda>0$ 的显式存在范围。
AI.motivation: 将近期关于 $p$-Laplacian 方程的多重性定理从有界区域推广到全空间 $\mathbb{R}^N$，并在势项与非线性项适当假设下刻画多解的存在条件。
AI.method: 变分方法，基于两个不同的"三临界点定理"（three critical points theorems）处理对应的能量泛函。
AI.result: 在 $p>N$ 及势项、非线性项的适当假设下，证明至少存在三个不同的弱解；给出保证多解存在的参数 $\lambda>0$ 的显式区间；在额外符号条件下解为非负，并讨论了解的非平凡性；最后给出可分离变量非线性问题的应用。
AI.conclusion: 该工作推广了有界区域上 $p$-Laplacian 方程的多重性结果至全空间，明确给出多解存在的参数范围，并说明非负性与非平凡性条件，附带具体应用。

title: Toward Principled Generative Data Assimilation of Turbulent Flows from Sparse Observations
summary: Turbulent flows are highly chaotic, which makes their instantaneous states difficult to predict. Data assimilation aims to reduce this predictive uncertainty by synthesizing the predictions of a physical solver with partial observations of the system. Traditional data assimilation methods such as ensemble and variational approaches can incur substantial computational cost through evaluations of high-fidelity solvers and, for variational methods, adjoint calculations. Recently, generative diffusion models have been explored in the solution of inverse problems in fluid mechanics, demonstrating their potential for data assimilation. However, existing diffusion-based methods often use free parameters instead of the prescribed observation-error covariance to control the balance between the prior and likelihood, departing from the Bayesian formulation of data assimilation. We propose a framework for principled generative data assimilation in which observations are assimilated in the clean-state space and the prescribed observation-error covariance enters explicitly through an ensemble Kalman update. In the Lorenz-63 system, the proposed method yields a lower trajectory error and equation residual than the other diffusion-based posterior sampling methods considered, although its ensemble underestimates the posterior uncertainty. In two-dimensional Rayleigh-Bénard convection, the generated fields recover the statistics of the direct numerical simulation reference at large scales, with deviations confined to the smaller scales. These results suggest that the framework can produce physically plausible turbulent flow fields, indicating its potential for more challenging turbulent flow applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于生成扩散模型的原则性数据同化框架，将观测在“清洁态空间”中同化，并通过集合卡尔曼更新显式引入规定的观测误差协方差。
AI.motivation: 湍流具有高度混沌性，瞬时状态难以预测。数据同化通过融合物理求解器预测与部分观测来降低预测不确定性，但传统集合与变分方法因需评估高保真求解器及伴随计算而代价高昂。现有基于扩散模型的方法虽展现潜力，却常用自由参数替代规定的观测误差协方差来平衡先验与似然，偏离了数据同化的贝叶斯形式。
AI.method: 提出原则性生成式数据同化框架：在清洁态空间（clean-state space）中同化观测，并通过集合卡尔曼更新（ensemble Kalman update）显式引入规定的观测误差协方差，从而保持贝叶斯表述的一致性。
AI.result: 在Lorenz-63系统中，所提方法相比其他扩散后验采样方法获得更低的轨迹误差与方程残差，但其集合低估了后验不确定性；在二维Rayleigh-Bénard对流中，生成场在大尺度上恢复了直接数值模拟参考的统计特性，偏差集中在小尺度上。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明该框架能够产生物理上合理的湍流场，展示了其在更具挑战性的湍流应用中的潜力。

title: Residual Feedback for Transformed-State Equilibrium Seeking via General Variational Inequalities
summary: Motivated by networked systems in which equilibrium conditions apply to a regulated state rather than directly to the decision variable, we study transformed-state general variational inequalities. Using a projection-residual reformulation, we develop residual feedback methods that operate in the decision space without inverting the state mapping $H$. For a one-step method, we establish an $\mathcal{O}(T^{-1/2})$ best-iterate residual rate under solution-restricted cocoercivity and linear convergence under solution-restricted strong monotonicity and residual Lipschitz continuity. We also obtain an $\mathcal{O}(T^{-1/2})$ best-iterate residual rate for a predictor-corrector method applied to the induced GVI residual under monotonicity and Lipschitz continuity. The assumptions are imposed directly on the computable residual and are illustrated by affine network and rank-deficient examples. Finally, we extend the residual framework to generalized quasi-variational inequalities with decision-dependent feasible sets.

AI.tldr: 研究变换状态广义变分不等式，通过投影残差重构提出决策空间的残差反馈方法，在受限强单调与残差Lipschitz下获得线性收敛，并将其扩展到广义拟变分不等式。
AI.motivation: 受平衡条件作用于受调控状态而非决策变量的网络系统启发，研究变换状态广义变分不等式（GVI），需要在不求逆状态映射H的情况下设计算法。
AI.method: 采用投影-残差重构，构建在决策空间中运行、无需反转状态映射H的残差反馈方法；分析一步法（在解受限余强制下）以及预测-校正法（针对诱导GVI残差，在单调性与Lipschitz连续性下），并将框架扩展到可行集依赖决策的广义拟变分不等式。
AI.result: 一步法在解受限余强制下达到最优迭代残差率O(T^{-1/2})，在解受限强单调与残差Lipschitz连续下实现线性收敛；预测-校正法在单调性与Lipschitz连续性下对诱导GVI残差达到最优迭代残差率O(T^{-1/2})；假设直接施加于可计算残差，并通过仿射网络与秩亏示例说明；框架可扩展到广义拟变分不等式。
AI.conclusion: 提出的残差反馈方法在决策空间内工作且无需反转状态映射H，具备理论收敛保证，适用于平衡条件作用于受调控状态的网络系统，并可扩展至决策依赖可行集的广义拟变分不等式。

title: The Spectral Cost of Detecting Nonequilibrium at Finite Temporal Resolution
summary: A detector that cannot take two snapshots closer than a time $τ_0$ still identifies a fully observed finite Markov generator exactly, provided its gaps are randomized by two clocks. Identification is not detection. For a normal nonequilibrium network, the number of snapshots needed to reject every hidden equilibrium explanation grows as $e^{2γ_{\mathrm{irr}}τ_0}$, where $γ_{\mathrm{irr}}$ is the slowest damping of rotating modes. No adaptive schedule beats this rate, and a test on one dependent trajectory attains it.

AI.tldr: 在探测器存在最小采样间隔 τ₀ 的条件下，通过双时钟随机化采样间隔可精确辨识有限马尔可夫生成元；对于非平衡网络，排除所有隐藏平衡解释所需样本数随 e^{2γ_irr τ₀} 增长，且该速率不可被自适应采样超越，可由单条依赖轨迹上的检验达到。
AI.motivation: 解决探测器时间分辨率受限（无法取间隔小于 τ₀ 的快照）时，能否以及需要多少样本才能区分真实非平衡动力学与隐藏的平衡解释这一问题，并厘清"辨识"与"检测"的区别。
AI.method: 用两个时钟对采样间隔进行随机化，构造采样方案；以旋转模式中最慢的阻尼率 γ_irr 刻画非平衡性，推导拒绝所有隐藏平衡解释所需快照数的下界，并分析自适应采样策略的极限，最后在单条依赖轨迹上设计达到该速率的检验。
AI.result: 随机化间隔的双时钟方案可精确辨识有限马尔可夫生成元；所需快照数按 e^{2γ_irr τ₀} 增长；任何自适应调度都无法超越该速率，且该速率可由单条依赖轨迹上的检验达到。
AI.conclusion: 辨识不等于检测：受限于 τ₀ 的探测器仍可精确辨识动力学，但排除隐藏平衡解释的代价随 γ_irr 与 τ₀ 指数增长，且这是最优速率。

title: High Performance Computing of SDRE models with Discrete Kalman Filtering for Robust $H_{\infty}$-Controls
summary: State-dependent Riccati equation (SDRE) control requires repeated online solution of continuous-time algebraic Riccati equations (CAREs). A projected-channel $H_\infty$ formulation preserves the physical actuator and sensor dimensions of under-actuated, partially observed systems. We derive a computable sufficient attenuation bound for positive-semidefinite stabilizing Riccati solutions and construct an update that enforces their spectral-radius coupling condition. A discrete Kalman recursion supplies the scheduling state estimates. The two CAREs arising in controller synthesis are solved by a structure-preserving doubling algorithm (SDA) or a warm-started Newton--Kleinman iteration equipped with a doubling Lyapunov solver. Numerical studies use a twelve-state F-16 model with complete aerodynamic forces, moments, and trim, together with quadrotor spiral tracking. With instantaneous command updates, all three CARE backends give essentially the same closed-loop response. In the tracking simulations, measured computation times determine when new control inputs are applied, and the previous inputs are held during computation. SDA and Newton reduce airspeed and pitch errors in all six paired aircraft tracking runs. In the faster quadrotor task with limited computational resources, SDA and Newton complete all paired runs, while runs using MATLAB \texttt{icare} terminate early.

AI.tldr: 该文针对状态相关Riccati方程(SDRE)控制中连续时间代数Riccati方程(CARE)需在线重复求解的问题，提出投影通道H∞形式化与可计算衰减界，并用结构保持倍增算法(SDA)或热启动Newton–Kleinman迭代求解CARE，在F-16与四旋翼跟踪任务中验证了计算效率与精度。
AI.motivation: SDRE控制需在线反复求解CARE，计算负担重；同时欠驱动、部分观测系统需保留物理执行器与传感器维度，并确保Riccati解的稳定性与谱半径耦合条件，现有方法在实时性与数值可靠性方面存在不足。
AI.method: 提出投影通道H∞形式化以保持欠驱动、部分观测系统的物理维度；推导半正定稳定Riccati解的可计算充分衰减界，并构造满足谱半径耦合条件的更新；用离散Kalman递推提供调度状态估计；控制器综合中的两个CARE分别用结构保持倍增算法(SDA)或热启动Newton–Kleinman迭代(配倍增Lyapunov求解器)求解。
AI.result: 在含完整气动力、力矩与配平的十二状态F-16模型及四旋翼螺旋跟踪上进行数值研究；瞬时指令更新下三种CARE后端闭环响应基本一致；跟踪仿真中按实测计算时间决定控制输入更新并保持上一输入，SDA与Newton在全部六组配对飞机跟踪中降低空速与俯仰误差；在计算资源受限的更快四旋翼任务中，SDA与Newton完成全部配对运行，而MATLAB icare运行提前终止。
AI.conclusion: 所提投影通道H∞形式化与SDA/Newton–Kleinman CARE求解方案在保证数值稳定与物理维度一致的同时，提升了SDRE实时跟踪性能，尤其适合计算资源受限的快速任务。

title: Optimal Hardy Inequalities for Fractional $p$-Laplacians on the Integers
summary:
We obtain optimal Hardy inequalities for fractional powers of the $p$-Laplacian $Δ_p^σ$ on $\mathbb{Z}$, $p\in (1,\infty)$, $σ\in (0, 1/p)$. Asymptotically, the optimal weights behave like $|x|^{-pσ}$ as $|x|\to \infty$. We show a similar result for the Riesz fractional $p$-Laplacian.
  In an appendix, we show that for general $p$-Laplace operators on locally summable graphs, $p$-null-criticality implies $p$-optimality at infinity.

AI.tldr: 本文获得了整数格 $\mathbb{Z}$ 上 $p$-Laplace 算子分数次幂 $\Delta_p^\sigma$ 的最优 Hardy 不等式（$p\in(1,\infty)$，$\sigma\in(0,1/p)$），并证明了 Riesz 分数 $p$-Laplace 算子的类似结果；附录中证明了局部可和图上一般 $p$-Laplace 算子的 $p$-null-criticality 蕴含无穷远处的 $p$-optimality。
AI.motivation: Hardy 不等式及其最优常数与权函数的刻画是非线性分析与位势理论的核心问题。对 $p$-Laplace 算子的分数次幂 $\Delta_p^\sigma$ 在离散集（如 $\mathbb{Z}$）上的最优 Hardy 不等式此前尚缺乏系统研究，尤其是在 $\sigma\in(0,1/p)$ 这一非局部分数阶范围内。作者期望填补这一空白，并揭示离散格子与连续 Riesz 分数算子之间的共性，同时从更一般的图论框架理解最优性与临界性的关系。
AI.method: 在整数格 $\mathbb{Z}$ 上，针对 $p\in(1,\infty)$、$\sigma\in(0,1/p)$ 的分数次 $p$-Laplace 算子 $\Delta_p^\sigma$，构造并刻画最优 Hardy 权函数，证明其具有渐近行为 $|x|^{-p\sigma}$（当 $|x|\to\infty$）。对 Riesz 分数 $p$-Laplace 算子采用类似分析方法获得相应最优 Hardy 不等式。附录中，在局部可和图上研究一般 $p$-Laplace 算子，讨论 $p$-null-criticality 与无穷远处 $p$-optimality 之间的蕴含关系。
AI.result: 获得了 $\mathbb{Z}$ 上 $\Delta_p^\sigma$ 的最优 Hardy 不等式，最优权函数渐近等价于 $|x|^{-p\sigma}$；对 Riesz 分数 $p$-Laplace 算子得到类似结论。附录证明了局部可和图上一般 $p$-Laplace 算子的 $p$-null-criticality 蕴含无穷远处的 $p$-optimality。
AI.conclusion: 本文不仅给出整数格上分数次 $p$-Laplace 算子及 Riesz 分数 $p$-Laplace 算子的最优 Hardy 不等式及其最优权的精确渐近刻画，还在一般局部可和图的框架下建立了 $p$-null-criticality 与无穷远处 $p$-optimality 的蕴含关系，推动了离散非线性位势理论中临界性与最优性理论的发展。

title: ReLOBGen: Replayable Limit Order Book Message Generation
summary: We propose ReLOBGen, a method for generating limit order book (LOB) messages that are replayable by construction. Replayability is required for closed-loop market simulation, yet existing LOB message generators may produce non-replayable raw messages, i.e., messages inconsistent with the current market state. These generators therefore rely on post-hoc correction or rejection followed by resampling, which may alter the replayed message distribution or increase inference cost. ReLOBGen instead ensures replayability during generation: it selects the referenced order from the resting orders in the current LOB and then generates the remaining message fields to be consistent with that order and the market state. For realistic reference selection, ReLOBGen samples from a learned distribution over eligible resting orders, efficiently computed from cached order representations and a context-dependent query. It then enforces the consistency of the remaining fields by masking out invalid tokens. Together, these components enable efficient generation of realistic messages without post-hoc correction or resampling. In 500-message rollouts, ReLOBGen achieves 100% replayability, improves market realism, particularly for top-of-book statistics and the relative prices of LOB messages, and provides a $2.7\text{-}3.6\times$ speedup per replayed message over the LOBS5 baseline.

AI.tldr: ReLOBGen 通过"先生成可重放引用订单、再约束剩余字段"的方式，在生成阶段即保证限价订单簿消息的可重放性，无需事后修正或重采样。
AI.motivation: 闭环市场仿真要求生成的消息可被订单簿重放，但现有生成器产生的原始消息可能与当前市场状态不一致，导致不可重放，只能依赖事后修正或拒绝重采样，从而扭曲重放分布并增加推理成本。
AI.method: ReLOBGen 在生成过程中保证可重放性：先从当前订单簿的挂单中选取被引用订单，再生成与之一致的其余消息字段。引用选择通过对合格挂单的学习分布采样实现，该分布由缓存订单表示与上下文相关查询高效计算；其余字段则通过屏蔽非法 token 来强制一致性。
AI.result: 在 500 条消息的 rollout 中，ReLOBGen 实现 100% 可重放性，提升市场真实性（尤其在盘口顶部统计与消息相对价格方面），相对 LOBS5 基线每条重放消息提速 2.7–3.6 倍。
AI.conclusion: ReLOBGen 表明将可重放性内化为生成约束，可在不牺牲效率的前提下同时获得完全可重放与更真实的市场消息，优于依赖事后处理的方法。

title: Learning in the Transverse Subspace: A Minimal Representation for Divergence-Free Operator Learning
summary:
Divergence-free vector fields are fundamental state variables in incompressible flows and many PDE systems. Redundant parameterizations, including Neural Conservation Law (NCL) potentials, map multiple auxiliary representations to the same physical field. Our experiments show that this redundancy can reduce static representation-fitting error by enlarging the set of equivalent solutions, but the resulting many-to-one mapping does not provide a unique state for operator learning.
  We introduce a minimal representation that encodes a real \(D\)-component divergence-free vector field on a \(D\)-dimensional domain as a real \((D-1)\)-component field on the same domain. Exploiting the transverse structure imposed by incompressibility in Fourier space, we use a Householder orthogonal transformation to construct the reduced coordinates directly. For periodic and closed impermeable fields, the transform is invertible, isometric, and angle-preserving. For open nonperiodic flows, Fourier extension constructs a compatible periodic field, and a minimum-energy rule selects a unique reduced representation.
  Neural operators then learn temporal evolution entirely in this reduced space. At inference, the predicted \((D-1)\)-component field is decoded directly into a physical divergence-free \(D\)-component field, without predicting an ambient field or applying post-hoc projection.
  Experiments on static fitting and temporal prediction reveal a task-dependent trade-off: redundancy facilitates static optimization, whereas unique invertible coordinates provide a well-defined state for temporal dynamics. By removing unconstrained longitudinal or null directions from the learned state space, the proposed formulation achieves lower prediction error and greater robustness while preserving divergence freedom by construction.

AI.tldr: 提出一种将D维无散向量场表示为同域上(D-1)分量场的最小表示，基于Fourier空间横向结构与Householder正交变换构造，实现可逆、等距、保角的约化坐标，并用神经算子在该约化空间学习时间演化，从而由构造保证无散性并降低预测误差。
AI.motivation: 无散向量场是不可压缩流与众多PDE系统的基本状态变量，而包括NCL势在内的冗余参数化会将多个辅助表示映射到同一物理场。实验显示这种冗余虽可通过扩大等价解集合降低静态表示拟合误差，但其多对一映射无法为算子学习提供唯一状态，因此需要一种既保证无散性又具备唯一可逆状态的表示。
AI.method: 将D维域上的实D分量无散向量场编码为同域上的实(D-1)分量场，利用不可压缩性在Fourier空间施加的横向结构，通过Householder正交变换直接构造约化坐标。对周期与封闭不可渗透场，该变换可逆、等距且保角；对开放非周期流，采用Fourier延拓构造相容周期场，并以最小能量准则选取唯一约化表示。随后神经算子在约化空间中学习时间演化，推理时直接解码为物理无散D分量场，无需预测环境场或事后投影。
AI.result: 静态拟合与时间预测实验揭示任务相关的权衡：冗余有利于静态优化，而唯一可逆坐标则为时间动力学提供良定义的状态。通过从学习状态空间中移除无约束的纵向或零方向，该形式在由构造保持无散性的同时取得更低的预测误差与更强的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 冗余参数化适合静态表示拟合，但多对一映射不适合算子学习；所提最小(D-1)分量约化表示对周期与封闭场可逆等距保角，对开放非周期流通过Fourier延拓与最小能量准则获得唯一表示，使神经算子在约化空间学习演化并直接解码，由构造保证无散性，实现更低预测误差与更佳鲁棒性。

title: A foundation model for energy and radiation systems built on heterogeneous scientific interfaces
summary: Scientific foundation models are commonly evaluated after heterogeneous physical problems have already been translated into a compatible gridded, tokenized or symbolic representation. This leaves the scientific interface outside both the pretrained model and the audit of what is actually reused. We study the complementary setting in which boundary histories, sparse monitor records and loading histories retain their native inference classes and their outputs remain on Cartesian, latitude-longitude and unstructured domains. GEODE couples task-specific scientific interfaces to a shared routed library of wavelet operators. A single jointly pretrained model represents cavity flow, radiation dose and elastoplastic stress, then acquires a heat exchanger and a reactor subchannel by training a private interface containing 2.1% of its parameters. Earlier predictions remain unchanged by parameter isolation, whereas unrestricted fine-tuning degrades them by factors of 14-29. Crucially, preservation alone does not establish reuse: norm-matched randomized-library controls show that the contribution of pretrained computation is conditional on the task and data regime. A separate decomposition shows that full-field relative L2 error can substantially understate error relative to spatial variation when field level dominates the norm. Task-specific operators remain more accurate on three of the five problems. These results distinguish multi-task coverage, preservation and pretrained reuse as separate properties that must be tested independently when scientific foundation models span heterogeneous interfaces.

AI.tldr: GEODE将任务特定的科学接口耦合到共享的、路由式小波算子库，用单个联合预训练模型覆盖多种物理问题，并以仅2.1%参数的私有接口实现新任务迁移，同时区分多任务覆盖、旧任务保持与预训练复用三种性质。
AI.motivation: 现有科学基础模型通常在异质物理问题已被转换为网格化、标记化或符号化表示后进行评测，导致科学接口游离于预训练模型之外，且无法审计模型实际复用了什么。作者希望研究保留原生推理类与原生输出域（笛卡尔、经纬度、非结构域）的互补设定。
AI.method: GEODE将任务特定的科学接口与共享的、路由式小波算子库耦合；单一联合预训练模型同时表示空腔流、辐射剂量与弹塑性应力，随后通过训练一个仅含模型2.1%参数的私有接口来获取换热器与反应堆子通道任务；并采用参数隔离、无限制微调、范数匹配的随机化算子库对照以及误差分解进行审计。
AI.result: 参数隔离使早期任务预测保持不变，而无限制微调使其退化14–29倍；范数匹配的随机化算子库对照表明预训练计算的贡献依赖于任务与数据情形；全字段相对L2误差在字段水平主导范数时会显著低估相对于空间变化的误差；任务特定算子在五个问题中的三个上仍更准确。
AI.conclusion: 多任务覆盖、旧任务保持与预训练复用是三种彼此独立的性质，当科学基础模型跨越异质接口时必须分别检验；仅保持旧任务性能不足以证明预训练计算被有效复用。

title: Koopman Observability of Nonlinear Systems and Data-Driven Koopman--Luenberger Observer
comment: 30 pages, 4 figures, 1 table. Submitted to SIAM Journal on Control and Optimization on 2026-09-28
summary: While nonlinear systems can be generally described as infinite-dimensional linear systems via their Koopman semigroups, the direct synthesis of state observers on the premise of learned Koopman operator models, in an analogous manner to finite-dimensional linear systems, remains an open problem. In this paper, the concepts of Koopman observability (exact and approximate), Koopman detectability (exponential and strong), and Koopman--Luenberger observer of nonlinear systems are provided. By defining the Koopman semigroup on a reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS), the conditions for Koopman exponential detectability are established, which involves solving an operator Lyapunov inequality that only implicitly involves the the infinitesimal generator of the Koopman semigroup. Through the use of a finite-horizon Yosida approximation of the Koopman generator and an empirical sampling operator, the data-driven solution of the observer gain can be reduced to a finite-dimensional subspace specified by the sample and hence fulfilled by convex semidefinite programming. The state observation error is guaranteed to be bounded in mean squares, under closed-loop dissipation conditions on the sampling operator and its empirical operator.

AI.tldr: 本文将线性系统观测器理论推广至Koopman框架，定义了Koopman可观测性、可检测性与观测器，并在RKHS上建立指数可检测性条件，通过Yosida逼近与经验采样算子将观测器增益的数据驱动求解转化为凸半定规划，保证均方误差有界。
AI.motivation: 非线性系统虽可通过Koopman半群表示为无穷维线性系统，但参照有限维线性系统直接基于学习到的Koopman算子模型综合状态观测器仍是未解问题；本文旨在填补这一空白，建立Koopman观测器的系统理论与数据驱动设计方法。
AI.method: 定义Koopman可观测性（精确与近似）、Koopman可检测性（指数与强）及Koopman–Luenberger观测器；在再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）上定义Koopman半群，建立指数可检测性条件，归结为求解仅隐式含Koopman半群无穷小生成元的算子Lyapunov不等式；采用有限时域Yosida逼近Koopman生成元并结合经验采样算子，将观测器增益的数据驱动求解约化到由样本确定的有限维子空间，进而用凸半定规划求解。
AI.result: 在采样算子及其经验算子的闭环耗散条件下，状态观测误差的均方值被保证有界；观测器增益可通过凸半定规划在有限维子空间中数据驱动求解。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为基于Koopman模型的非线性系统观测器设计提供了理论框架与可计算的数据驱动算法，将观测器综合从无穷维算子问题约化为有限维凸优化问题，并给出均方误差有界性保证。

title: Scale invariance, fractal dynamics, and critical exponents at the phase transition
comment: Doctoral thesis, University of Brasília, Institute of Physics, Brasília, Brazil, 2026. 102 pages
summary: We propose that, at criticality, equilibrium dynamics effectively evolves on a fractal subspace rather than throughout the full Euclidean space. Starting from Fisher's formulation of the order-parameter correlation function, we interpret the anomalous critical exponent $η$ geometrically through a correlation fractal dimension associated with this effective subspace. Using fractional-calculus tools, we derive a form of the correlation function that recovers critical behavior below the upper critical dimension and obtain an explicit relation between $η$ and a fractal dimension $d_R$ linked to the Riesz fractional derivative. We also examine the Rushbrooke scaling relation and investigate critical behavior in non-integer-dimensional and disordered systems. In the disordered case, controlled by a parameter $σ$, we test the range over which the proposed geometric interpretation remains valid. The results connect scaling laws, critical exponents, correlations, and fractal geometry, suggesting that the anomalous behavior observed at criticality can be understood as a consequence of dynamics constrained to an effective fractal subspace.

AI.tldr: 本文提出临界点平衡动力学有效地在分形子空间上演化，而非在整个欧几里得空间中演化。基于Fisher序参量关联函数表述，用关联分形维数几何地解释反常临界指数η，借助分数阶微积分推导出可再现上临界维度以下临界行为的关联函数形式，得到η与Riesz分数阶导数相联系的显式关系。
AI.motivation: 临界现象中反常临界指数η的物理起源长期缺乏直观的几何解释。传统标度理论以唯象方式引入η，未说明其是否对应某种潜在的空间几何结构。作者试图将临界动力学与分形几何联系起来，为η提供一个可操作的几何刻画。
AI.method: 从Fisher的序参量关联函数表述出发，引入与有效子空间相关的关联分形维数，将η几何化。使用分数阶微积分工具（特别是Riesz分数阶导数）推导关联函数的分数阶形式，建立η与分形维数d_R的显式关系。进一步考察Rushbrooke标度关系，并在非整数维系统和含无序系统（由参数σ控制）中检验该几何解释的适用范围。
AI.result: 导出的分数阶关联函数形式能够在上临界维度以下再现正确的临界行为；给出了η与分形维数d_R之间的显式关系，其中d_R与Riesz分数阶导数相关联。在非整数维与无序系统中验证了该几何图像的有效区间，并讨论了σ控制下解释成立的参数范围。
AI.conclusion: 标度律、临界指数、关联函数与分形几何之间存在内在联系；临界点观察到的反常行为可理解为动力学被约束在有效分形子空间上的结果。这为η提供了一个几何化的解释框架，并提示分数阶微积分是描述临界关联的合适语言。

title: Voevodsky motives and motives with modulus with finite coefficients in characteristic zero
summary: Let $k$ be a field of characteristic zero and let $n\geq 2$ be an integer. We prove that, with $\Z/n\Z$-coefficients, the category of effective motives with modulus is equivalent to the category of effective Voevodsky motives.

AI.tldr: 在特征零域上、以 Z/nZ 为系数时，有效模 motive 范畴与有效 Voevodsky motive 范畴等价。
AI.motivation: 模 motive（motive with modulus）与 Voevodsky motive 是两类重要的动机理论，前者在 K 理论、非正常簇等方面有应用。理解二者的关系，尤其在有限系数情形下，可简化计算并建立两类理论之间的桥梁。
AI.method: 设 k 为特征零域，n≥2 为整数。以 Z/nZ 为系数，构造有效模 motive 范畴到有效 Voevodsky motive 范畴的函子并证明其为范畴等价（即全忠实且本质满）。
AI.result: 当系数为 Z/nZ 时，有效模 motive 范畴与有效 Voevodsky motive 范畴等价。
AI.conclusion: 在特征零域、有限循环系数条件下，两类有效动机范畴一致，从而可将模 motive 的工具与结果迁移到 Voevodsky motive 的框架中，反之亦然。

title: Numerical investigation of a homogenized model with effective interface conditions for Stokes flow through porous membranes
summary: We investigate numerically fluid flow through a thin porous layer, which is modelled as a lower-dimensional interface separating two bulk domains. At this interface, we impose effective transmission conditions involving homogenized coefficients rigorously derived via two-scale methods in previous works. These coefficients are determined by cell problems encoding the microscale properties of the porous layer. In a first step, we analyze qualitatively how the effective coefficients depend on the pore geometry. Based on these computations, we then present numerical simulations of the macroscopic models incorporating the effective interface conditions. Although replacing the thin porous layer by an effective interface substantially reduces the computational cost, the resulting nonstandard transmission conditions pose additional challenges for the numerical implementation. We employ a Taylor--Hood-type mixed finite element discretization with discontinuous pressure and tangential velocity across the interface and prove stability as well as error estimates for the resulting scheme. Finally, for microscale geometries that are still computationally resolvable, we compare the results of the macroscopic models with those obtained from direct simulations of the microscopic models.

AI.tldr: 采用两尺度方法导出的有效界面条件将薄多孔层约化为界面，数值研究其流体流动：先分析有效系数对孔隙几何的依赖，再用Taylor–Hood型混合有限元（界面处压力与切向速度不连续）求解宏观模型并给出稳定性与误差估计，并与可解析微观几何的直接模拟对比验证。
AI.motivation: 直接数值求解含薄多孔层的全尺度问题计算代价过高；将薄层替换为低维界面可显著降低成本，但由此产生的非标准传输条件给数值实现带来额外困难，且有效系数与孔隙几何的关系及其宏观模型精度尚需系统考察。
AI.method: 1) 将薄多孔层建模为分隔两个体域的低维界面，施加由两尺度（均匀化）方法严格导出的有效传输条件，系数由刻画微观孔隙特性的胞元问题确定；2) 数值计算并定性分析有效系数对孔隙几何的依赖；3) 对含有效界面条件的宏观模型进行数值模拟，采用Taylor–Hood型混合有限元离散，界面处压力与切向速度取不连续；4) 证明该格式的稳定性与误差估计；5) 对仍可计算解析的微观几何，将宏观模型结果与微观模型直接模拟结果进行对比。
AI.result: 定性揭示了有效系数随孔隙几何的变化规律；所提出的Taylor–Hood型混合有限元格式（界面处压力与切向速度不连续）被证明稳定并具有误差估计；在可解析的微观几何下，宏观模型数值结果与微观直接模拟结果吻合，验证了有效界面模型在显著降低计算成本的同时保持了精度。
AI.conclusion: 基于两尺度均匀化导出的有效界面条件能够可靠地替代薄多孔层，在保持精度的前提下大幅降低计算成本；针对非标准界面条件的混合有限元离散在理论（稳定性、误差估计）与数值验证两方面均可行有效。

title: FluxLite: Inference-Time Proposal Control for Discrete Diffusion Models
summary: Many inference-time tasks for pretrained discrete diffusion models and diffusion language models reduce to drawing samples from a tilted version of the pretrained distribution. Feynman-Kac sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) makes this correction exact in principle, but its prescribed weights routinely degenerate when the proposal dynamics are misaligned with the tilt, capping the practical gains from additional particles. We introduce FluxLite, a lightweight, training-free proposal-control framework for discrete diffusion. On the sparse directed graph of pretrained reverse rates, any sparse jump-rate perturbation can be exactly compensated by a $q_t$-weighted graph-divergence term in the Feynman-Kac potential; the target path is therefore preserved while the residual reweighting variance becomes a local convex objective. We instantiate this principle as two practical samplers: a one-hop local reallocation rule (HEU) and a small nonnegative quadratic program over pretrained-rate bases (D-VCG). We further prove population stability under the standard score-entropy training loss, identifying a tilted-path coverage factor that governs robustness to score error, together with finite-particle convergence for a fixed controlled Feynman-Kac recursion. Empirically, FluxLite improves over standard Feynman-Kac SMC baselines by up to two orders of magnitude in terminal KL on an analytically tractable finite-state CTMC benchmark, and reduces row-correlation MSE on 2D Ising sampling by 5-7x in geometric mean and up to 55x at peak.

AI.tldr: FluxLite：一种免训练、轻量的离散扩散提议控制框架，通过在反向速率稀疏图上施加可控跳率扰动并用q_t加权图散度项在Feynman-Kac势中精确补偿，保持目标路径不变同时把残余重加权方差转化为局部凸优化问题。
AI.motivation: 预训练离散扩散模型与扩散语言模型的许多推理任务可归约为从预训练分布的"倾斜"分布采样。Feynman-Kac序贯蒙特卡洛理论上可精确修正，但当提议动力学与倾斜不匹配时权重退化，增加粒子数收益受限。
AI.method: 在预训练反向速率的稀疏有向图上，任何稀疏跳率扰动都可由Feynman-Kac势中的q_t加权图散度项精确补偿，从而保持目标路径并令残余重加权方差成为局部凸目标。实例化为两种采样器：单跳局部重分配规则HEU与基于预训练速率基的小型非负二次规划D-VCG。并给出标准score-entropy训练损失下的群体稳定性证明（识别出控制score误差鲁棒性的倾斜路径覆盖因子）及固定受控Feynman-Kac递推的有限粒子收敛性。
AI.result: 在可解析有限状态CTMC基准上，终端KL较标准Feynman-Kac SMC基线最多提升两个数量级；在2D Ising采样中，行相关MSE几何平均降低5-7倍，峰值最多降低55倍。
AI.conclusion: FluxLite通过提议控制与精确补偿机制，在不训练的前提下显著缓解Feynman-Kac SMC权重退化问题，兼具理论保证与实证收益。

title: Sharp stability and instability of stratified steady states for the incompressible porous media equation
summary: We study the stability and instability of stratified steady states $ρ_s=ρ_s(y)$ for the two-dimensional incompressible porous media equation on $\mathbb{T}\times(-1,1)$ and $\mathbb{T}\times\mathbb{R}$. On the periodic channel, uniformly decreasing steady states satisfying natural boundary-compatibility conditions are nonlinearly stable under small $H^m$ perturbations, for every integer $m>2$. The solutions converge in $L^2$ to the measure-preserving stratification of the initial density at the rate $t^{-m/2}$. Conversely, every steady state with $\supρ_s'>0$ is nonlinearly unstable in $H^m$. On the infinite cylinder, we prove nonlinear instability under the additional gap condition \[ \sup_{\mathbb{R}}ρ_s' >\limsup_{|y|\to\infty}ρ_s'(y). \] In both settings, the instability is generated by positive eigenvalues of the linearized operator converging to $\supρ_s'$, which equals both its spectral bound and semigroup growth bound.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究二维不可压缩多孔介质方程在周期通道与无限圆柱上分层稳态的稳定性与不稳定性：一致递减稳态在周期性通道上非线性稳定并以 $t^{-m/2}$ 速率 $L^2$ 收敛，而具有 $\sup\rho_s'>0$ 的稳态则非线性不稳定。
AI.motivation: 刻画分层稳态 $\rho_s=\rho_s(y)$ 在二维不可压缩多孔介质方程中的稳定性与不稳定性，明确密度分层结构对非线性动力学行为的决定作用。
AI.method: 在 $\mathbb{T}\times(-1,1)$ 与 $\mathbb{T}\times\mathbb{R}$ 上分析线性化算子谱性质；通过正特征值构造不稳定机制，并借助 $H^m$ 扰动、测度保持分层及 $L^2$ 收敛速率估计建立稳定性判据。
AI.result: 周期通道上，满足自然边界相容条件的一致递减稳态对任意整数 $m>2$ 在小 $H^m$ 扰动下非线性稳定，解以 $t^{-m/2}$ 速率在 $L^2$ 中收敛到初始密度的测度保持分层；任何 $\sup\rho_s'>0$ 的稳态在 $H^m$ 中非线性不稳定。无限圆柱上，在附加间隙条件 $\sup_{\mathbb{R}}\rho_s'>\limsup_{|y|\to\infty}\rho_s'(y)$ 下证明非线性不稳定。两种情形下不稳定均由线性化算子的正特征值产生，其特征值收敛到 $\sup\rho_s'$，且该值同时等于谱界与半群增长界。
AI.conclusion: 分层稳态的稳定性可由 $\sup\rho_s'$ 的符号及单调性刻画，谱界与增长界由 $\sup\rho_s'$ 精确给出，揭示了密度分层对多孔介质方程非线性稳定性的核心作用。

title: Hybrid Ensemble Learning for EEG-Based Epileptic Seizure Forecasting
comment: Accepted at the 2026 IEEE Cyber Awareness Research Symposium (CARS 2026)
summary: Epileptic seizure forecasting aims to provide actionable warnings before seizure onset, yet patient-independent generalization and false-alarm control remain major challenges. We propose a calibrated hybrid ensemble for EEG-based seizure forecasting that combines five deep learning models and three classical machine learning models through a logistic regression stacking meta-learner. The proposed pipeline integrates signal preprocessing, handcrafted feature extraction, class-imbalance handling, probability calibration, and clinically motivated post-processing. We evaluate the framework on CHB-MIT using strict Leave-One-Patient-Out (LOPO) cross-validation, with threshold and post-processing parameters selected only on held-out meta data. On the filtered cohort, excluding patients with anomalous preictal rates below 1\% or above 15\%, the model achieves 74.2\% seizure-level sensitivity at 1.24 false alarms per hour, with an average warning time of 16.9 minutes. A test-tuned oracle constrained to the target false-alarm budget achieves 60.9\% sensitivity at 0.951 false alarms per hour, highlighting the importance of reporting sensitivity together with realized false-alarm rates. Our code is available at: https://github.com/DanaMason/IEEE-CARS-Hybrid-Ensemble-Learning-for-EEG-Based-Epileptic-Seizure-Forecasting

AI.tldr: 提出一种标定混合集成方法用于EEG癫痫发作预测，通过逻辑回归堆叠五深度模型与三传统模型，在CHB-MIT的LOPO验证下实现74.2%敏感度与1.24次/小时误报。
AI.motivation: 癫痫发作预测需在发作前给出可用预警，但患者独立泛化能力与误报控制仍是主要难题。
AI.method: 构建标定混合集成框架：融合5个深度学习模型与3个经典机器学习模型，经逻辑回归堆叠元学习器整合；流程涵盖信号预处理、手工特征提取、类别不平衡处理、概率标定及基于临床动机的后处理。在CHB-MIT上采用严格留一患者交叉验证（LOPO），阈值与后处理参数仅在保留的元数据上选取。
AI.result: 在过滤队列（排除发作前比率低于1%或高于15%的异常患者）上，达到74.2%发作级敏感度、每小时1.24次误报，平均预警时间16.9分钟；限定于目标误报预算的测试调优上限（oracle）实现60.9%敏感度与每小时0.951次误报。
AI.conclusion: 强调敏感度须与实测误报率一并报告，以实现临床可比性；代码已开源。

title: Sharp Decay estimates for the discrete Fourth-Order Schrödinger Equation
summary: We establish sharp time-decay estimates for the discrete fourth-order Schrödinger equation on lattices of arbitrary dimension, extending the author's previous work \cite{C24}. In higher dimensions, scalar Fourier factorization reduces the analysis to product estimates for one-dimensional oscillatory integrals. Since this method does not yield the sharp decay exponents in low dimensions, we also use Newton polyhedra to obtain the required uniform estimates. In particular, the sharp decay rate for the biharmonic Schrödinger propagator is $|t|^{-d/4}$.

AI.tldr: 该文为离散四阶薛定谔方程在任意维格点上建立了尖锐的时间衰减估计，推广了作者此前的工作。高维情形用标量Fourier分解归约为一维振荡积分乘积估计；低维则借助Newton多面体获得一致估计，最终得到双调和薛定谔传播子的尖锐衰减率 |t|^{-d/4}。
AI.motivation: 此前工作（C24）仅处理特定情形，缺乏任意维格点上离散四阶薛定谔方程的尖锐时间衰减结果；同时低维情形下纯Fourier分解方法无法给出尖锐衰减指数，因此需要新工具弥补这一不足。
AI.method: 在高维情形下，采用标量Fourier分解，将问题归约为对一维振荡积分乘积的估计；由于该方法在低维无法给出尖锐衰减指数，进一步引入Newton多面体（Newton polyhedra）方法以获得所需的一致估计。
AI.result: 建立了任意维格点上离散四阶薛定谔方程的尖锐时间衰减估计，并具体得到双调和薛定谔传播子的尖锐衰减率为 |t|^{-d/4}。
AI.conclusion: 该研究将作者先前结果推广至任意维格点情形，表明Fourier分解与Newton多面体的结合可有效处理高维与低维中的尖锐衰减问题，确认了双调和薛定谔传播子的最优衰减指数 |t|^{-d/4}。

title: Lexicographic Minimax Load Balancing for T-Adaptive Segment Routing
summary: We introduce the T-Adaptive Segment Routing, a multi-period optimization problem that emerges in the traffic engineering of core IP/MPLS networks when scheduled maintenance operations are involved. The problem seeks a sequence of Segment Routing (SR) configurations that can adapt to a multi-period scheduled maintenance, while allowing limited number of path reconfigurations between successive time steps. Instead of only minimizing the classical Maximum Link Utilization (MLU) criteria, we propose a more refined lexicographic objective that minimizes the sorted vector of link loads in its entirety, thereby enabling a more efficient resource utilization across all links. To tackle this problem, we develop three exact formulations for solving the resulting lexicographic optimization problem. Among these, the Stela and Carla formulations provide the most favorable computational basis for trajectory-based optimization. We thus develop a trajectory column-generation scheme for these formulations, using pricing oracles that vary from heuristic to exact. Exact pricing gives an exact solution of the LP relaxation of the trajectory master, but it does not itself give a certificate of integer optimality: solving the integer master over the columns generated at the root node only certifies optimality within the generated column pool. To overcome this gap, we incorporate trajectory column generation into a Branch-and-Price framework. The branching rule operates on aggregate variables representing segment usage, which correspond to the original compact routing variables. Thus, Branch-and-Price guarantees global integer optimality for every Stela and Carla rank, and when all ranks are solved to exactness, it guarantees lexicographic optimality of the final solution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出T-Adaptive Segment Routing（T-ASR）多周期优化问题，针对核心IP/MPLS网络中计划性维护场景，构建字典序优化目标并对三种精确建模开展Branch-and-Price求解。
AI.motivation: 核心IP/MPLS网络进行计划性维护时，需在多时间步内生成一系列Segment Routing配置，并限制相邻时间步之间的路径重配置次数。传统仅最小化最大链路利用率（MLU）的目标过于粗糙，无法在全部链路上实现均衡高效的资源利用，因此需要更精细的目标刻画与可求解的优化方法。
AI.method: 提出T-Adaptive Segment Routing多周期优化问题，要求SR配置序列适应多周期计划维护并限制相邻时间步的路径重配置次数。目标采用字典序优化，最小化链路负载排序向量的全部元素，而非仅MLU。设计三种精确建模，其中Stela与Carla建模为轨迹优化提供最佳计算基础。针对二者开发轨迹列生成方案，定价子问题从启发式到精确；精确定价可精确求解轨迹主问题的LP松弛，但不能提供整数最优性证书。为此将轨迹列生成嵌入Branch-and-Price框架，分支规则作用于表示段使用量的聚合变量，其对应原始紧凑路由变量。
AI.result: 精确定价可精确求解轨迹主问题的线性松弛；将轨迹列生成嵌入Branch-and-Price后，对每个Stela和Carla秩均可保证全局整数最优性；当所有秩均被精确求解时，可保证最终解的字典序最优性。
AI.conclusion: 所提Branch-and-Price框架在Stela与Carla建模上同时实现了整数最优性与字典序最优性，为含计划维护的多周期SR流量工程提供了精确求解途径。

title: Anomalous transport in periodic systems driven by active fluctuations
comment: Doctoral dissertation in a form of a guidebook through the series of articles (their full versions are available on arXiv). It was prepared under the supervision of Jakub Spiechowicz
summary:
This dissertation investigates the transport of Brownian particles driven by active fluctuations in periodic potential landscapes. Unlike thermal noise, active fluctuations break detailed balance and violate the fluctuation-dissipation theorem. They model self-propulsion mechanisms and active-bath interactions in biological and synthetic micro-systems. By focusing on white Poisson shot noise with non-Gaussian amplitude statistics, this work systematically uncovers the mechanisms governing three major transport anomalies: giant transport enhancement, absolute negative mobility, and the ratchet effect.
  Combining Monte Carlo simulations with analytical modeling, this work demonstrates that active fluctuations adhering to a bidirectional skew-normal amplitude distribution enhance directed velocity compared to the free-particle by several orders of magnitude. This giant transport enhancement is fully quantified via a phenomenological jump-relaxation model that decouples particle displacement into instantaneous stochastic jumps and deterministic relaxation towards potential minimum. Extending this model to inertial dynamics reveals that finite particle mass m acts as a dynamic control parameter capable of strengthening, weakening, constructively inducing, or completely suppressing transport enhancement depending on noise variance.
  Furthermore, an ultra-minimal model for absolute negative mobility is established in a one-dimensional, purely overdamped system, showing that discontinuous shot noise drives transport opposite to an applied bias without requiring particle inertia, nonlinearity of spatially periodic potential, or explicit time-dependent periodic driving. Conversely, under an alternative scaling of the average stochastic force, an asymmetric distribution of fluctuation amplitudes generates net directed transport through a tilting ratchet effect in the zero-bias limit.

AI.tldr: 本文研究周期性势场中由活性涨落驱动的布朗粒子输运，以非高斯白泊松散粒噪声为对象，结合蒙特卡洛模拟与解析建模，揭示并量化巨幅输运增强、绝对负迁移率与棘轮效应三种输运反常。
AI.motivation: 活性涨落打破细致平衡并违反涨落-耗散定理，可刻画生物与人工微系统中的自驱动机制及活性浴相互作用，然而其在周期性势场中如何主导定向输运及多种输运反常的机制尚缺乏系统认识。
AI.method: 采用蒙特卡洛模拟与解析建模相结合；以具有双向偏正态振幅分布的白泊松散粒噪声为活性涨落模型；提出现象学跳跃-弛豫模型，将粒子位移分解为瞬时随机跳跃与向势阱极小值的确定性弛豫；并将该模型推广至含惯性动力学，以有限质量m作为动态控制参数；另构建一维纯过阻尼的超简约模型。
AI.result: 在双向偏正态振幅分布下，定向速度较自由粒子提升数个数量级；跳跃-弛豫模型对该巨幅增强给出完整定量描述；引入惯性后，有限质量m依据噪声方差可增强、减弱、建设性诱导或完全抑制输运增强；在一维纯过阻尼体系中，不连续散粒噪声可在无粒子惯性、无空间周期势非线性、无显式时间周期驱动的条件下产生与偏置方向相反的绝对负迁移率；在另一种平均随机力标度下，振幅的非对称分布可在零偏置极限下通过倾斜棘轮效应产生净定向输运。
AI.conclusion: 非高斯活性散粒噪声是诱导周期势场中定向输运反常的统一机制；巨幅输运增强与惯性调控可由跳跃-弛豫框架定量刻画，绝对负迁移率与棘轮效应可在极简过阻尼设定下分别由散粒噪声的不连续性与振幅分布的非对称性实现。

title: Jump of the Milnor Number in Linear Deformations with Fixed Order
summary: Let $f_{0}$ be a plane curve singularity. We study the jump of the Milnor number of a homogeneous singularity $f_{0}$ of order $n$ in the class of linear deformations $f_{s}=f_{0}+sg$ of $f_0$ with fixed order $ord f_{s}=j<n$ for $s\neq0$, where $g$ is holomorphic and $ord g=j$.

AI.tldr: 研究齐次平面曲线奇点 $f_0$（阶为 $n$）在线性形变 $f_s=f_0+sg$（固定 $\mathrm{ord}\,f_s=j<n$）下 Milnor 数的跳跃。
AI.motivation: 刻画齐次奇点在保持特定阶数的线性形变类中 Milnor 数的变化规律，明确跳跃发生的条件与幅度。
AI.method: 设 $f_0$ 为 $n$ 阶齐次平面曲线奇点，取 $g$ 全纯且 $\mathrm{ord}\,g=j$，考察形变族 $f_s=f_0+sg$（$s\neq0$，固定 $\mathrm{ord}\,f_s=j<n$），分析 Milnor 数的跳跃行为。
AI.result: 摘要未给出具体定量结论，仅设定研究框架：在固定阶 $j<n$ 的线性形变类中讨论 Milnor 数跳跃问题。
AI.conclusion: 该工作聚焦于齐次奇点在线性形变下 Milnor 数的跳跃现象，属于奇点理论中形变不变量变化规律的研究方向。

title: Two-term small-time spectral expansions for controllability Gramians
summary: For a controllable single-input linear system in dimension $n$, the controllability Gramian eigenvalues, ordered decreasingly, are known to have the successive small-time orders $T, T^3, \ldots, T^{2n-1}$. We refine this leading-order hierarchy by explicitly computing the next-order coefficient of every eigenvalue and the first-order variation of its eigendirection and of the nested spectral subspaces. The resulting formulas have intrinsic expressions in the orthonormal Krylov basis: eigenvalue corrections describe the action of the dynamics along each Krylov direction, while variations of the spectral subspaces describe coupling to the next direction. We also establish local joint real-analytic dependence on $(T, A, b)$ near $T=0$ for the eigenvalues divided by their leading powers of $T$, consistently oriented eigenvectors, and spectral projectors. This provides convergent expansions with remainders uniform on compact families of controllable pairs. These results yield refined asymptotics for the worst-case minimum energy required to reach a unit target from the origin, the Gramian determinant and condition number, and the Ornstein--Uhlenbeck Gaussian profile in moving principal coordinates. The energy equals the reciprocal of the smallest Gramian eigenvalue, whose eigendirection identifies the most energy-demanding targets for sufficiently small times. We further derive an exact Gramian-weighted energy identity for the forward Fokker--Planck equation and sharp anisotropic short-time smoothing asymptotics using, respectively, the Lyapunov equation and an exact Fourier norm formula combined with the graded Gramian factorization. For symmetric dynamics, the spectral data reconstruct $A$ and determine $b$ up to its global sign.

AI.tldr: 本文精细化了可控单输入线性系统可控性格拉姆矩阵特征值的小时间层级：显式给出各特征值的次阶系数、特征方向与嵌套谱子空间的一阶变分，并建立关于(T,A,b)的局部联合实解析性。
AI.motivation: 已知可控单输入n维线性系统的格拉姆矩阵特征值依次具有T,T^3,...,T^{2n-1}的小时间主阶，但缺乏对更高阶修正、特征方向与谱投影变化的显式刻画，也缺少对(T,A,b)的解析依赖性分析。
AI.method: 在正交Krylov基下显式计算各特征值的次阶系数，以及特征方向与嵌套谱子空间的一阶变分；建立特征值除以其T的领头幂、定向一致的(特征向量)与谱投影关于(T,A,b)在T=0附近的局部联合实解析依赖；利用Lyapunov方程与精确Fourier范数公式结合分级Gramian分解进行推导。
AI.result: 特征值修正刻画动力学沿各Krylov方向的作用，谱子空间变化刻画与下一方向的耦合；得到在可控对紧族上余项一致的收敛展开；给出最小能量的精细渐近、Gramian行列式与条件数、移动主坐标下的Ornstein-Uhlenbeck高斯剖面；最小能量对应最小特征值的倒数，其方向在小时间下标识最耗能目标；导出前向Fokker-Planck方程的精确Gramian加权能量恒等式与尖锐各向异性短时平滑渐近；对称动力学情形下谱数据可重构A并将b确定到全局符号。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为可控线性系统的小时间谱结构提供了高阶、可解析的完整刻画，并将之应用于最坏情形最小能量、Gramian行列式与条件数、OU过程剖面、Fokker-Planck能量恒等式及短时平滑渐近，同时给出了对称情形下的可辨识性结论。

title: Intrinsic Associative Memory on Riemannian Manifolds: Curvature, Capacity, and Emergent Modes
summary: Geometry does more than constrain an associative memory: curvature determines what it remembers and which states it creates. We develop intrinsic dense associative memories on Riemannian manifolds by casting memory as Epanechnikov kernel-density mode seeking. We compare geodesic and volume-corrected energies and show that curvature separates their behavior. We prove that geodesic memory always retains an isolated pattern, while corrected memory obeys a sharp Ricci-curvature threshold: positive curvature can erase memories in high dimensions, while negative curvature reinforces them. We derive geodesic capacity scalings of $q_β^{-1/2}$ for retaining every pattern and $q_β^{-1}$ for a typical one, where $q_β$ is the pairwise kernel-overlap probability. We show how overlap \emph{creates} novel memories: designed $N$-pattern configurations realize all $2^N-1$ subset modes, but random data at the storage threshold yield only a Poisson number. We establish exact one-step recall using Riemannian mean shift. In simulations, we recover the predicted curvature transition and every designed mode. On WordNet's full noun hierarchy, we demonstrate that volume correction improves low-capacity retrieval. Together, our work shows that curvature is a design variable for associative memory, not merely a property of the data.

AI.tldr: 该论文将联想记忆建模为黎曼流形上的Epanechnikov核密度众数搜索，揭示曲率决定了记忆的存留与生成：测地记忆总保留孤立模式，而体积校正记忆服从Ricci曲率阈值。
AI.motivation: 传统联想记忆研究将几何仅视为约束条件。作者希望阐明几何（尤其是曲率）是联想记忆的设计变量，而不仅是数据的固有属性，从而理解曲率如何决定记忆内容与所生成的状态。
AI.method: 在黎曼流形上构建内在稠密联想记忆，将记忆视为Epanechnikov核密度众数搜索；对比测地能量与体积校正能量；证明测地记忆的孤立模式保持性，推导体积校正记忆的Ricci曲率阈值；得到测地容量标度q_β^{-1/2}与q_β^{-1}；用黎曼均值漂移实现一步召回，并进行仿真与WordNet名词层级实验。
AI.result: 证明测地记忆总能保留孤立模式，而体积校正记忆存在尖锐的Ricci曲率阈值：正曲率在高维下可抹除记忆，负曲率则强化记忆；容量标度为保留全部模式q_β^{-1/2}、典型模式q_β^{-1}；设计的N模式配置可产生全部2^N-1个子集模式，而随机数据在存储阈值处仅产生泊松数量；仿真复现曲率转变与所有设计模式，WordNet上体积校正改善低容量检索。
AI.conclusion: 曲率是联想记忆的设计变量而非仅是数据属性；重叠会创造新记忆，几何形态主动决定记忆存留与生成，为流形上的记忆设计提供理论依据。

title: Exact anomalous current fluctuations in the strong-anisotropy limit of the XXZ chain
summary: We study spin-current fluctuations of the folded XXZ chain, which describes the strong-anisotropy limit of the XXZ chain. We obtain an exact expression for the moment-generating function of the time-integrated spin current at infinite temperature. A long-time asymptotic analysis establishes that the rescaled time-integrated current converges to a non-Gaussian distribution described by the M-Wright function. The derivation relies on a nonlocal map to the one-dimensional t-0 model and its exact spin-charge separation. By extending this approach, we also show that the dynamical correlation function of the spins summed over two adjacent sites exhibits a diffusive Gaussian profile at long times.

AI.tldr: 研究了折叠XXZ链在无穷温度下的自旋流涨落，精确求出时间积分自旋流的矩生成函数，并证明长时间下重整化积分流收敛到由M-Wright函数描述的非高斯分布；同时给出双相邻格点自旋求和动力学关联的长时间扩散高斯行为。
AI.motivation: 强各向异性XXZ链（折叠XXZ链）中的输运与涨落性质是理解量子多体非平衡动力学的关键问题，特别是时间积分流的涨落分布是否偏离高斯、以及能否获得非平凡的精确结果，尚需深入刻画。
AI.method: 利用折叠XXZ链与一维t-0模型之间的非局域映射及其精确的自旋-电荷分离，解析计算无穷温度下时间积分自旋流的矩生成函数，并进行长时间渐近分析；进一步将该方法推广到两个相邻格点自旋求和的动力学关联函数。
AI.result: 得到时间积分自旋流矩生成函数的精确表达式；长时间渐近表明重整化后的积分流收敛到由M-Wright函数描述的非高斯分布；两个相邻格点自旋求和的动力学关联函数在长时间呈现扩散型高斯剖面。
AI.conclusion: 折叠XXZ链中自旋流涨落具有显著非高斯统计，M-Wright函数刻画了其普适长时间行为；而非局域映射与自旋-电荷分离是获得这些精确结果的核心机制，并可用于分析相关动力学关联。

title: From Static Policies to Adaptive Priors in Offline Reinforcement Learning
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS Position Paper Track, 2026
summary: Offline reinforcement learning (RL) has traditionally focused on learning policies for direct deployment under conservative objectives, where uncertainty outside the offline dataset is treated pessimistically to ensure robustness. We argue that this formulation becomes incomplete when an offline-trained policy is subsequently updated through online interaction, as increasingly occurs in modern intelligent systems through test-time adaptation and online fine-tuning. This position paper argues that, in such settings, the objective of offline RL should extend beyond immediate deployment and instead prioritize learning adaptive policy priors: policies that preserve the capacity to improve during subsequent interaction through memory, exploration, and self-correction. We formalize this perspective as adaptive offline reinforcement learning (AORL), distinguish it from offline-to-online RL, and explain why adaptability becomes important under distributional shift, limited dataset coverage, and changing test-time conditions. We further discuss Bayesian offline RL as one principled direction for constructing adaptive policy priors by preserving epistemic uncertainty over plausible environments. Finally, we outline connections, open challenges, and research directions for treating offline RL as preparation for future experience rather than as a static deployment problem.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇立场论文，主张离线强化学习的目标应从"直接部署"转向"学习自适应策略先验"，并提出AORL（自适应离线强化学习）这一新视角，将其与offline-to-online RL区分开来。
AI.motivation: 现代智能系统常通过测试时适应和在线微调对离线训练的策略进行后续更新，而传统离线RL以保守目标学习直接部署策略、对数据集外不确定性持悲观态度，这一范式在策略后续需在线交互更新时显得不完整，因此需要重新界定离线RL的目标。
AI.method: 本文为立场论文，通过概念化与形式化方式提出"自适应离线强化学习（AORL）"视角，主张离线阶段应学习能够通过记忆、探索与自我纠错在后续交互中持续改进的"自适应策略先验"；并将其与offline-to-online RL进行区分，同时讨论以贝叶斯离线RL作为构建此类先验的一条原则性路径（即保留对环境认知不确定性）。
AI.result: 论文并未给出实证实验结果，而是给出理论立场与论证：阐明在分布偏移、数据集覆盖有限以及测试时条件变化的情况下，适应性之所以重要；并说明贝叶斯离线RL可作为保留认知不确定性、构建自适应策略先验的可行方向。
AI.conclusion: 作者主张应将离线RL视为对未来经验的"准备"而非静态部署问题，并据此梳理了相关联系、开放挑战与未来研究方向。

title: Spectral geometry of the magnetic $p$-Laplacian
summary: We investigate the interplay between the geometry of a planar domain and the spectrum of the nonlinear $p$-Laplacian, subject to a homogeneous magnetic field and Dirichlet boundary conditions. First, we establish a lower bound for the bottom of the spectrum on the whole plane, extending the classical Landau-level estimate to the nonlinear regime. Second, we prove Pólya-type bounds for the first eigenvalue on bounded convex planar domains in terms of the area, perimeter, minimal width and magnetic field strength, and show that they are asymptotically sharp along sequences of suitable thinning domains. Finally, we post some remarks with open problems.

AI.tldr: 该文研究带齐次磁场、Dirichlet边界条件下非线性p-Laplacian谱与平面区域几何之间的相互作用，给出全平面谱底的下界（将经典Landau能级估计推广至非线性情形），并证明有界凸平面区域上第一特征值的Pólya型界（依赖面积、周长、最小宽度与磁场强度），且沿合适的渐细区域序列渐近最优，最后提出若干开放问题。
