Within such sets, individual signals may be characterized by distinct sampling parameters. This paper investigates organized signal sets neural network encoders. In the context of this work, the purpose of such encoders is to project heterogeneously sampled signal sets into an arbitrary fixed-size vectors space. This new representation space is designed so that signal sets can be processed as vectors rid of sampling differences to allow for arbitrary topology-aware processing with no signal processing constraints. Within this representation space designed to reduce the influence of heterogeneous sampling parameters, the relevance of signal sets representations is evaluated by considering signal sets discrimination potential with a focus on waveforms separation. The encoding and embeddings discrimination experiments conducted rely exclusively on synthetic complex-valued radiofrequency signals.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究“组织化信号集”的神经网络编码器，将异构采样的信号集投影到固定尺寸的向量空间，使信号集可脱离采样差异、以向量形式进行任意拓扑感知处理，并以波形分离为核心评估其判别能力，实验均基于合成复值射频信号。
AI.motivation: 传感器网络与雷达可产生组织化信号集（有序信号、网格距离单元信号或图节点信号），但集合内各信号的采样参数可能不同，形成异构采样问题，阻碍统一处理与拓扑感知分析，因此需要一种能消除采样差异的表示方法。
AI.method: 设计面向组织化信号集的神经网络编码器，将异构采样的信号集映射到任意固定尺寸的向量空间；在该表示空间中进行编码与嵌入判别实验，重点考察信号集判别潜力，尤其是波形分离，实验仅采用合成复值射频信号。
AI.result: 论文通过编码和嵌入判别实验评估表示的相关性，聚焦波形分离任务；实验结果表明所设计表示空间可用于评估信号集判别潜力，且实验完全基于合成复值射频信号，未涉及真实数据。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提出以固定尺寸向量空间表示异构采样组织化信号集的编码思路，使信号集可作为向量进行任意拓扑感知处理而不受信号处理约束，并通过合成复值射频信号上的波形分离实验验证了表示的判别评估价值。

title: Formation of shear bands through discrete localized plastic increments
summary: We study rate-independent systems in which the evolution is obtained by incremental minimization of elastic energy and one-homogeneous dissipation under constraints on the admissible inelastic increments. Such constraints arise naturally in several models of inelastic materials, including shear-transformation-zone models, intermittent plasticity, and quantized plasticity, where evolution proceeds through prescribed elementary activation events rather than arbitrary plastic increments. We establish the existence of a continuous-time limit for the corresponding constrained incremental scheme under suitable assumptions. As an application, we formulate a simplified shear-transformation-zone model consisting of localized activation events on a lattice embedded in a two-dimensional elastic medium. We prove that this model generates shear-band formation through the successive activation of neighboring transformation zones. More precisely, we show that every admissible evolution remains localized on a growing line segment in the infinite-domain setting and that the same mechanism persists on sufficiently large bounded domains. These results provide a rigorous mathematical framework for constrained activation models and show that restrictions on admissible elementary events alone constitute a mechanism for localization in rate-independent systems.

AI.tldr: 研究带约束增量的率无关系统，证明约束增量格式的连续时间极限存在，并以简化剪切转变区模型证明剪切带通过相邻激活事件的逐次触发而形成。
AI.motivation: 若干非弹性材料模型（剪切转变区模型、间歇塑性、量子化塑性）中，塑性演化由规定的基元激活事件构成，而非任意塑性增量，因此允许的非弹性增量受到约束。作者希望为这类约束激活模型建立严格的数学框架，并探究仅对基元事件的限制本身是否足以导致局部化。
AI.method: 考虑率无关系统，其演化由弹性应变能与一阶齐次耗散在允许非弹性增量约束下的增量最小化给出。在适当假设下证明相应约束增量格式的连续时间极限存在。作为应用，构造一个简化剪切转变区模型：在嵌入二维弹性介质的格点上进行局部化激活事件，并分析其演化行为。
AI.result: 证明了约束增量格式在适当假设下存在连续时间极限；对简化剪切转变区模型，证明其通过相邻转变区的逐次激活形成剪切带，即每条允许演化在无限域情形下保持局限于一条增长线段上，且该机制在足够大的有界域上依然保持。
AI.conclusion: 为约束激活模型提供了严格的数学框架，并表明仅对允许基元事件的限制本身即可构成率无关系统中的局部化机制。

title: Controller Identifiability: The Boundary Between Logarithmic and Square-Root Local Minimax Regret in Structured Adaptive LQR
summary: We study when logarithmic regret is attainable in structured adaptive linear-quadratic regulation. The state and input matrices depend affinely on a common unknown parameter. We consider neighborhoods of a known nominal model that is stabilizable and observable through the output associated with the state cost, with radii proportional to the inverse fourth root of the horizon. The key condition is controller identifiability, which requires the optimal gain derivative to vanish in every parameter direction that leaves the closed-loop dynamics unchanged under nominal optimal feedback. Under suitable regularity conditions on the noise density, this condition at the nominal parameter yields logarithmic local minimax regret when the gain derivative there is nonzero. Failure of the condition yields square-root local minimax regret. If the nominal gain derivative vanishes, local minimax regret remains bounded. We prove that controller identifiability is equivalent to the optimal gain remaining unchanged under sufficiently small invisible perturbations of the nominal model. Motivated by this invariance, we construct a certainty-equivalent policy that estimates only the visible parameter component and attains the logarithmic upper bound under controller identifiability. The policy requires neither the horizon nor the noise law, and its guarantee holds for independent, identically distributed noise with zero mean and finite positive definite covariance.

AI.tldr: 本文研究结构化自适应线性二次调节（LQR）中对数遗憾的可实现性，提出“控制器可辨识性”作为关键充要条件，并给出达到对数上界的确定性等价策略。
AI.motivation: 在自适应LQR中，对数遗憾并非总能实现，其可达成性依赖于未知参数如何影响最优控制器。已有工作缺乏对“何时能实现对数遗憾”这一结构性问题的精确刻画。
AI.method: 设定状态与输入矩阵仿射依赖于共同未知参数，考虑已知标称模型（可镇定、经状态代价对应输出可观）的邻域，半径与视界的四次方根倒数成比例。核心条件为控制器可辨识性：要求最优增益导数在一切“在标称最优反馈下不改变闭环动态”的参数方向上消失。在噪声密度的适当正则条件下分析局部极小极大遗憾，并证明控制器可辨识性等价于最优增益在足够小的“不可见”扰动下保持不变。基于该不变性构造仅估计可见参数分量的确定性等价策略。
AI.result: 在标称参数处若增益导数非零且满足控制器可辨识性，则获得对数局部极小极大遗憾；该条件失效时为平方根局部极小极大遗憾；若标称增益导数消失，则局部极小极大遗憾保持有界。所构造的确定性等价策略在控制器可辨识性下达到对数上界，且不需要视界与噪声分布，其保证对零均值、有限正定协方差的独立同分布噪声成立。
AI.conclusion: 控制器可辨识性是结构化自适应LQR中对数遗憾可实现性的精确判据，并可通过仅辨识可见参数分量的确定性等价策略实现该最优上界。

title: Breakdown of Local Denoising as Semantic Speciation
comment: 9 pages main, 13 pages appendix, 4 figures. Comments very welcome
summary: The dynamics of generative models exhibit two apparently distinct temporal windows: a speciation window, in which a sample commits to a semantic class, and a nonlocality window, in which local context windows become insufficient for generation. Motivated by evidence of their near-concurrence in a variety of frontier models, we investigate their relationship through the spatial distribution of semantic information. Under a "common cause" hypothesis, we prove that the nonlocality window must lie in the speciation window. This hypothesis postulates that semantic labels explain a fraction of the correlations between distant tokens, a condition that is natural for many real datasets. We further give conditions under which both windows shrink to a single limiting time as system size grows, defining a "phase transition", and verify this behavior analytically in Gaussian mixtures. Together, these results identify conditions under which semantic information explains the concurrence of speciation and nonlocality, connecting two complementary perspectives on the emergence of semantic structure in generative modeling.

AI.tldr: 本文研究生成模型中“语义分化窗口”与“非局域性窗口”两个时间窗口的关系，在“共同原因”假设下证明非局域性窗口必包含于语义分化窗口内，并给出两窗口随系统规模收缩为单一极限时刻（相变）的条件，在高斯混合模型中进行了验证。
AI.motivation: 生成模型动力学呈现两个看似独立的时间窗口：样本确定其语义类别的“语义分化窗口”，以及局部上下文窗口不足以支撑生成的“非局域性窗口”。多种前沿模型中二者近乎同时出现，这一现象暗示二者存在内在关联，作者希望从语义信息的空间分布角度揭示其关系。
AI.method: 作者基于语义信息的空间分布，提出“共同原因”假设——语义标签解释远距离token之间相关性的一个比例，该假设对许多真实数据集自然成立。在此假设下，通过理论推导证明非局域性窗口必位于语义分化窗口之内；进一步给出两窗口随系统规模增大而收缩为单一极限时刻（即相变）的条件，并在高斯混合模型中作解析验证。
AI.result: 在“共同原因”假设下，非局域性窗口被证明必然落在语义分化窗口内；同时给出了两窗口在系统规模增长时收缩为单一极限时刻的充分条件，并在高斯混合模型上解析验证了该相变行为的存在。
AI.conclusion: 研究识别出语义信息能够解释语义分化与非局域性近乎同时出现的条件，从而将生成建模中语义结构涌现的两个互补视角联系起来。

title: On the Hilbert polynomial of the linked projective space
summary: Linked projective spaces are quiver Grassmannians of subspaces of dimension 1 of certain quiver representations. Degenerations of linear series produce these representations, with the limit divisors parameterized by the associated linked projective spaces. It is not known whether all linked projective spaces arise this way. If they do, they are degenerations of the (small) diagonal in a product of projective spaces. In any case, we prove here that they have the (multivariate) Hilbert polynomial of the diagonal. To achieve this, we give first a formula for the Hilbert polynomial of (simple) normal-crossings schemes with multiplicity-free strata in a product of projective spaces, more general and simpler than that found by Castillo et al. Then we prove that a linked projective space is normal-crossings, by describing it locally in terms of Mustafin varieties. Finally, we use a relation between intersections of components of the linked projective space and certain polytopes in the tiling of a simplex associated to the linked net to prove that we may apply our formula for the Hilbert polynomial.

AI.tldr: 本文研究 linked projective spaces，证明其具有（多变量）Hilbert 多项式且等于对角线的 Hilbert 多项式。
AI.motivation: linked projective spaces 作为特定 quiver 表示中一维子空间的 quiver Grassmannians 出现，并由线性系的退化产生，但其是否全部由该方式产生尚不清楚；若成立，则它们是射影空间乘积中对角线的退化。本文旨在确定其 Hilbert 多项式性质。
AI.method: 首先给出射影空间乘积中具有无重数分层的（简单）normal-crossings 概型的 Hilbert 多项式公式，较 Castillo 等人的结果更一般且更简单；随后利用 Mustafin 簇局部描述 linked projective space，证明其为 normal-crossings；最后借助 linked projective space 各分支交集与 linked net 相关单形剖分中多面体之间的关系，应用所得公式。
AI.result: 证明了 linked projective spaces 具有与对角线相同的（多变量）Hilbert 多项式；并建立了更一般的 normal-crossings 概型 Hilbert 多项式公式，同时证明 linked projective space 是 normal-crossings 的。
AI.conclusion: linked projective spaces 在 Hilbert 多项式意义下与射影空间乘积中的对角线一致，从而支持其作为对角线退化的理解。

title: Finite element approximation for the Bessel $(p,s)$-Laplacian
summary:
We study the finite element approximation of the Dirichlet problem for the Bessel $(p,s)$-Laplacian, $\operatorname{div}^{s} \left(|
abla^{s} u|^{p-2}
abla^{s} uight)$, built from the Riesz fractional gradient $
abla^s$ and posed on the Bessel potential space $X^{s,p}$, obtained by complex interpolation between $L^p$ and $W^{1,p}$. For $p = 2$ this operator reduces to the fractional Laplacian, while for $p 
eq 2$ it differs from the fractional $p$-Laplacian arising from real interpolation. Since a direct Galerkin discretization requires reassembling a dense stiffness matrix at every nonlinear iteration, we propose an augmented Lagrangian formulation based on the projected fractional gradient $B_h = \mathbfΠ_h 
abla^s$, in which the only dense matrix is assembled once and the nonlinearity decouples elementwise. We analyze the resulting consistency error, establish a priori convergence rates in $X^{s,p}$, conditional on a discrete inf-sup condition for the augmented Lagrangian scheme, and present numerical experiments that illustrate the convergence of the method and its ability to deal with degenerate and strongly nonlinear problems.

AI.tldr: 本文研究 Bessel (p,s)-Laplacian 的 Dirichlet 问题有限元逼近，提出基于投影分数阶梯度的增广拉格朗日格式以规避每次非线性迭代重装稠密刚度矩阵，建立一致性误差与先验收敛率，并用数值实验验证。
AI.motivation: Bessel (p,s)-Laplacian 由 Riesz 分数阶梯度构建、定义在复插值空间 X^{s,p} 上，p=2 时退化为分数阶 Laplacian，p≠2 时有别于实插值得到的分数阶 p-Laplacian。直接 Galerkin 离散需在每个非线性迭代步重新组装稠密刚度矩阵，计算代价高昂，因此需要更高效的离散格式。
AI.method: 提出基于投影分数阶梯度 B_h = Π_h ∇^s 的增广拉格朗日格式：唯一的稠密矩阵只需组装一次，非线性项可逐单元解耦；对由此产生的一致性误差进行分析，并在增广拉格朗日格式的离散 inf-sup 条件下建立 X^{s,p} 中的先验收敛率。
AI.result: 给出了该格式的一致性误差分析；在离散 inf-sup 条件下证明了 X^{s,p} 空间中的先验收敛率；数值实验展示了方法的收敛性及其处理退化与强非线性问题的能力。
AI.conclusion: 所提增广拉格朗日有限元格式在保持稠密矩阵单次组装、非线性逐单元解耦的同时具备可证收敛性，适用于退化及强非线性情形，为 Bessel (p,s)-Laplacian 问题提供了高效可行的数值途径。

title: Optimal Multi-Reward Reinforcement Learning
summary: We study an unknown-transition finite-horizon Markov decision process (MDP) with a finite collection of known reward functions $\{r^1, r^2, \ldots, r^M\}$. The goal is to output an $ε$-optimal policy for every reward using online episodic interaction only. Performance is measured by the policy error $V_{0}^{*, m} - V_{0}^{\widehatπ^{m}, m}$ where $m\in [M]$ represents the reward function and $V_{0}^{*, m}=\mathbb{E}_{s_1\sim μ}[V_{1}^{*, m}(s_1)]$. Under this setting, we design a provably efficient algorithm to establish a minimax sample complexity bound of $$ O\left(\frac{SAH^3}{ε^2}\log M \mathrm{polylog}\left(\frac{SAH\log M}{\min\left\{ε, 1\right\}δ}\right)\right)$$ episodes, with no additional burn-in cost. This matches the information-theoretic lower bound up to a factor of $ \mathrm{polylog}(SAH\log M/(\min\left\{ε, 1\right\}δ))$. Our method combines three technical ingredients. First, we adapt MVP to reward-switching learning to construct optimistic value estimates. Second, we use fresh replay samples to conservatively evaluate the candidate policies. Third, gap-based multiplicative weights updates adjust the reward-sampling distribution using the differences between these estimates, converting weighted learning progress into simultaneous guarantees for all rewards.

AI.tldr: 研究未知转移、有限时域MDP下同时学习M个已知奖励函数的多目标强化学习，提出样本复杂度为O(SAH³/ε²·log M·polylog(...))的算法，达到信息论下界（忽略polylog因子）。
AI.motivation: 目标是仅通过在线回合式交互，为多个已知奖励函数同时输出ε-最优策略，衡量指标为各奖励下的策略误差。需要在不增加burn-in成本的前提下达到高效样本复杂度。
AI.method: 方法融合三部分技术：1）将MVP适配到奖励切换学习以构造乐观价值估计；2）使用新鲜回放样本保守评估候选策略；3）基于gap的乘法权重更新，利用估计差值调整奖励采样分布，将加权学习进展转化为对所有奖励的同时保证。
AI.result: 实现了O(SAH³/ε²·log M·polylog(...))回合的极小极大样本复杂度，无额外burn-in成本，且与信息论下界仅差polylog因子。
AI.conclusion: 该算法在未知转移多奖励MDP中具有可证明的高效性，样本复杂度接近最优，实现了对所有奖励的同时ε-最优策略保证。

title: KernelOnet: An Interpretable Neural Operator Based on Kernel Functions
summary: This paper proposes an interpretable neural operator framework, the Kernel Operator Network (KernelOnet), which incorporates kernel functions explicitly into the neural operator architecture, so that the operator structure matches the kernel-expansion form used in boundary-type kernel-expansion methods. Unlike traditional neural operators such as DeepONet, which learn basis functions implicitly through deep networks, KernelOnet replaces the trunk network with explicit kernels and offers three complementary kernels: a data-driven learnable kernel, in which a neural network parameterizes a radial basis function learned from data, and which for constant-coefficient linear problems can be regarded as a non-singular fundamental solution; a physics-informed kernel, which embeds physical information such as analytic fundamental solutions into the network structure, so that the expansion satisfies the governing equation automatically and can be trained without supervision on boundary conditions alone, with no interior solution data; and a hybrid kernel, which splits the solution, according to the linear principal part of the governing equation, into a homogeneous part spanned by analytic fundamental solutions and a source part carried by low-rank learned correction kernels, thereby balancing physical priors against data fitting on nonlinear problems lacking an analytic fundamental solution. On three benchmarks and one engineering problem in a shallow-water waveguide, KernelOnet attains high accuracy; where comparable with DeepONet, it is more accurate with fewer learnable parameters. Its unsupervised configuration needs no interior solution labels, and its per-query inference cost is far below that of per-instance solvers, offering an effective route to acoustic propagation in unbounded exterior domains that general-purpose neural operators struggle to handle.

AI.tldr: 本文提出可解释神经算子框架 KernelOnet，将核函数显式融入神经算子结构，使其算子形式匹配边界型核展开法。KernelOnet 用显式核替代 DeepONet 的 branch/trunk 中的 trunk 网络，提供数据驱动可学习核、物理信息核与混合核三种形式。在三个基准与浅海波导工程问题上精度高，参数量少于 DeepONet 且更准确，无监督配置无需内部解标签，单查询推理成本远低于逐实例求解器。
AI.motivation: 传统神经算子（如 DeepONet）通过深度网络隐式学习基函数，缺乏可解释性，且通用神经算子在无界外域声传播等问题上表现不佳。作者希望将核展开的显式结构引入神经算子，使物理先验与数据拟合得以平衡。
AI.method: KernelOnet 将核函数显式嵌入神经算子结构，以显式核替换 trunk 网络，提供三种互补核：(1) 数据驱动可学习核，由神经网络参数化径向基函数，对常系数线性问题可视为非奇异基本解；(2) 物理信息核，将解析基本解等物理信息嵌入网络结构，使展开自动满足控制方程，可仅凭边界条件无监督训练，无需内部解数据；(3) 混合核，按控制方程线性主部将解分为由解析基本解张成的齐次部分和由低秩学习校正核承载的源项部分，在缺乏解析基本解的非线性问题上平衡物理先验与数据拟合。
AI.result: 在三个基准测试和一个浅水波导工程问题上，KernelOnet 均达到高精度；在与 DeepONet 可比较的场景下，其精度更高且可学习参数更少。无监督配置无需内部解标签，单次查询推理成本远低于逐实例求解器。
AI.conclusion: KernelOnet 通过显式核结构提升了神经算子的可解释性与精度，在参数量、监督需求和推理效率上均具优势，为通用神经算子难以处理的无界外域声传播问题提供了有效途径。

title: Long time strong Sobolev instability for quasilinear NLS
summary: We prove long-time strong Sobolev instability for a class of quasilinear Schrödinger equations on $\mathbb T^2$ arising, via the Madelung transform, in the description of Euler-Korteweg capillary fluids. More precisely, for every $s\ge 7$, arbitrarily small $μ>0$, and arbitrarily large $\mathcal K>0$, we construct a solution such that $$ \|u(0)\|_{H^s}<μ, \qquad \|u(T)\|_{H^s}>\mathcal K $$ at some finite time $T$, for which we provide an explicit exponential upper bound. The instability mechanism is generated by a finite-dimensional resonant Toy Model associated with the cubic semilinear part of the equation, in the spirit of Colliander-Keel-Staffilani-Takaoka-Tao. The main technical difficulty is to justify this dynamics over the long time scale of the energy transfer in the presence of quasilinear derivative losses. We achieve this by combining a weak Birkhoff normal form with paradifferential calculus, microlocal symmetrization, and modified energy estimates. Our result provides a rigorous quasilinear realization of a resonant energy-transfer mechanism, and suggests a connection with weakly turbulent dynamics in capillary fluids.

AI.tldr: 该论文证明了 $\mathbb T^2$ 上由 Euler-Korteweg 毛细流体经 Madelung 变换得到的一类拟线性薛定谔方程的长时间强 Sobolev 不稳定性；对任意 $s\ge 7$、任意小 $\mu>0$ 和任意大 $\mathcal K>0$，构造出初值 $H^s$ 范数小于 $\mu$ 的解，其在有限时刻 $T$ 的 $H^s$ 范数大于 $\mathcal K$，并给出 $T$ 的指数上界。
AI.motivation: 研究动机在于理解毛细流体中弱湍流动力学的严格数学机制：以往关于能量级联与不稳定性的结果多针对半线性方程，而拟线性色散方程在导数损失下能否实现共振能量转移长期缺乏严格刻画。
AI.method: 方法上，作者将方程三次半线性部分对应的有限维共振 Toy Model 与 Colliander-Keel-Staffilani-Takaoka-Tao 的框架结合，用以驱动不稳定性；核心技术难点是在拟线性导数损失存在下，将该动力学维持到能量转移所需的长时间尺度，为此综合使用弱 Birkhoff 正规形、仿微分（paradifferential）演算、微局域对称化以及修正能量估计。
AI.result: 结果是：对每个 $s\ge 7$，可构造满足 $\|u(0)\|_{H^s}<\mu$ 而 $\|u(T)\|_{H^s}>\mathcal K$ 的解，并给出有限时间 $T$ 的显式指数型上界，从而证明长时间强 Sobolev 不稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 结论表明该工作为共振能量转移机制提供了一个严格的拟线性实现，并提示其与毛细流体中弱湍流动力学之间存在联系。

title: Optimal Actuator Design across Ranks and Control Horizons
summary: We study how actuator rank and control horizon jointly determine worst-case control performance for finite-dimensional linear systems under a fixed total actuator-gain budget. The design variable is the input covariance $X=BB^\top$. Scalar actuators give rank-one matrices $X=bb^\top$; dropping the rank constraint yields their convex hull and a semidefinite benchmark. We identify regimes in which low-rank designs necessarily fall short and others in which they attain the benchmark. At small time, the relaxed maximizer is unique and full rank. If $A$ is cyclic, then, for every $k

AI.tldr: 本文研究在固定总执行器增益预算下，执行器秩与控制时域如何共同决定有限维线性系统的最坏情况控制性能，揭示低秩（标量执行器）设计与半正定松弛基准之间的差距与一致情形。
AI.motivation: 标量执行器对应于秩一输入协方差矩阵 X=bb^⊤，其可行集是非凸的；而放弃秩约束后的半正定松弛提供了性能上界基准。理解低秩约束何时必然带来性能损失、何时又能达到松弛基准，对执行器配置设计至关重要。
AI.method: 以输入协方差 X=BB^⊤ 为设计变量，比较秩一约束下的标量执行器设计与去掉秩约束后的凸包（半正定基准）。通过分析松弛最优解的秩结构与系统矩阵 A 的性质（如循环性、时间尺度）来刻画两种设计的关系。
AI.result: 在小时间尺度下，松弛最优解唯一且为满秩。若 A 为循环矩阵，则对每个 k（具体结论在摘要中未完整给出）表现出特定的秩—时域依赖关系。
AI.conclusion: 执行器秩与控制时域共同影响最坏情况控制性能：存在低秩设计必然次优的区间，也存在低秩设计能够达到半正定基准的区间，二者由系统动态结构（如 A 的循环性）和时间尺度决定。

title: Exceptional Loci and Hyperbolicity of Complements of Plane Curves with $\bar{c}_1^2 - \bar{c}_2 > 0$
summary:
Let B be a plane curve which has simple normal crossings. We prove that, if B = B_1 \cup B_2 has two irreducible components with deg B_1, deg B_2 \geq 5 or deg B_1 = 4, deg B_2 \geq 7, and if B is general, then the associated algebraic exceptional set is empty.
  Based on this, we show that for a general plane curve B satisfying \bar{c}_1^2 - \bar{c}_2 > 0, the open surface \mathbb{P}^2 \setminus B is Kobayashi hyperbolic.

AI.tldr: 设 B 为简单正规交叉平面曲线。当 B=B₁∪B₂ 满足 deg B₁,deg B₂≥5，或 deg B₁=4,deg B₂≥7，且 B 一般时，对应的代数例外集为空；由此证明满足 \bar{c}_1²-\bar{c}_2>0 的一般平面曲线的补曲面 P²∖B 是 Kobayashi 双曲的。
AI.motivation: 研究平面曲线补曲面的双曲性问题，特别是用代数例外集的空性来判定 Kobayashi 双曲性。
AI.method: 对具有简单正规交叉的两不可约分支平面曲线 B=B₁∪B₂，在给定次数条件下证明其关联代数例外集为空。
AI.result: 在所述次数条件下，一般曲线 B 的代数例外集为空；进而对满足 \bar{c}_1²-\bar{c}_2>0 的一般平面曲线 B，P²∖B 是 Kobayashi 双曲的。
AI.conclusion: 给出了一般平面曲线补曲面 Kobayashi 双曲性的充分条件。

title: Computing Spectral Properties of Differential Operators on Surfaces
summary: Computing spectra of differential operators on surfaces is crucial in many applications, ranging from medical image analysis to nanoscale quantum structures. However, discretization of the infinite-dimensional operator and the underlying surface can lead to inaccurate and misleading results. This paper introduces the SurfSpec suite of algorithms to compute eigenvalues and spectral measures of operators on surfaces with error control and convergence guarantees. We combine methods based on complex contour integration and residuals to compute discrete spectra and high-frequency eigenmodes, including of nonlinear eigenvalue problems. We then compute convolutions of spectral measures with rational kernels to deal with continuous spectra. In both cases, the key tool is the operator resolvent applied to functions, which is computed using high-order methods that solve surface PDEs. We illustrate our algorithms on a variety of differential operators and surfaces, including a triceratops.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SurfSpec算法套件，用于在曲面上计算微分算子的特征值与谱测度，并带误差控制与收敛保证。
AI.motivation: 曲面微分算子谱计算在医学图像分析、纳米量子结构等领域应用广泛，但无穷维算子与底层曲面的离散化易导致结果不准确甚至误导。
AI.method: 结合复围道积分与残差方法计算离散谱及高频本征模（含非线性特征值问题）；用有理核卷积谱测度以处理连续谱。核心工具是将算子预解式作用于函数，并通过求解曲面PDE的高阶方法计算该预解式。
AI.result: 在多种微分算子与曲面上验证了算法，包括三角龙（triceratops）曲面。
AI.conclusion: SurfSpec可在曲面上实现带误差控制和收敛保证的谱计算，兼顾离散谱与连续谱问题。

title: EnJoi: Ensemble Joint Score Filter for Generative Data Assimilation
summary: Data Assimilation (DA) aims to recover the full state of a dynamical system that is only partially observed. A solution is to use Score-based models to generate physically consistent trajectories that agree with the observations. These Autoregressive Diffusion models are trained by conditioning on the previous state; however, they do not take into account the uncertainty of their past predictions. We propose a new diffusion-based assimilation algorithm that dynamically balances the confidence in the current state and the new observations. Crucially, we choose to learn the distribution of the joint state containing both the past and future. This allows us to use a modified version of En4DVar, a classical DA algorithm that relies on the covariance of an ensemble of particles. Experiments on fluid and traffic flow simulations show improved reconstruction performance, especially in situations where observations are sparse and non-homogeneous.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于扩散模型的资料同化算法，通过联合学习过去与未来状态的分布，动态平衡当前状态与新观测的置信度，在流体与交通流实验中改善了稀疏、非均匀观测下的重建性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于分数的自回归扩散同化模型虽能生成与观测一致的物理轨迹，但仅以先前状态为条件，未考虑其历史预测的不确定性，因而无法合理权衡历史预测与当前观测的可信度。
AI.method: 提出新的扩散同化算法，学习包含过去与未来状态的联合状态分布；在此基础上采用经典同化算法 En4DVar 的改进版本，利用粒子集合的协方差动态平衡当前状态与新观测的置信度。
AI.result: 在流体与交通流模拟实验中重建性能提升，尤其在观测稀疏且非均匀的情形下表现更优。
AI.conclusion: 联合建模过去与未来状态分布并结合集成协方差的自适应加权，是提升稀疏、非均匀观测下资料同化效果的有效途径。

title: Asymptotic spreading speeds of a road-field reaction-diffusion predator-prey model
summary: This paper is devoted to studying asymptotic spreading speeds of a road-field reaction-diffusion predator-prey system, in which predators diffuse faster on the straight line $\R\times \{0\}$ than in the half plane $\R\times (0,+\infty)$. We give a sharp characterization of the spreading properties of solutions of the system with compactly supported initial values by appealing to the invasion speed of the prey when predators are absent, and the invasion speed of predators when the prey is saturated. Notably, since the line may accelerate the expansion of predators in a cone of directions, the invasion speed of predators varies with the direction. To overcome the difficulty arising from the coupling between the predator-prey interaction and the road-field interaction, we first derive pointwise comparisons between predators and the prey and then reduce the components of predators in the system to a truncated field-road system depending on the invasion speed of the prey. By using known results for the single-species field-road model, we further show the propagation properties of the truncated system. This step is very crucial. Once the propagation properties of the truncated system are established, we can obtain the expected spreading properties of solutions to the original system by applying the comparison principle and contradiction arguments, and constructing appropriate Lyapunov functionals.

AI.tldr: 本文研究道路-场（road-field）反应扩散捕食者-食饵系统的渐近传播速度，捕食者在直线上的扩散快于半平面。通过将捕食者分量约化为截断的场-道路系统，结合单物种场-道路模型结果、比较原理与Lyapunov泛函，给出了紧支初始值解传播性质的精确刻画。
AI.motivation: 道路-场结构中，直线加速了捕食者沿锥形方向的扩张，使捕食者入侵速度随方向变化，捕食者-食饵相互作用与道路-场相互作用耦合，导致传播速度难以刻画，故需研究其渐近传播性质。
AI.method: 先建立捕食者与食饵的逐点比较估计；将捕食者分量约化为依赖食饵入侵速度的截断场-道路系统；利用已知单物种场-道路模型结果得到截断系统的传播性质；再通过比较原理、反证论证并构造合适的Lyapunov泛函，导出原系统的传播性质。
AI.result: 对紧支初始值，给出了解传播性质的精确刻画：食饵缺失时对应食饵入侵速度，食饵饱和时对应捕食者入侵速度；由于直线在锥形方向上加速捕食者扩张，捕食者入侵速度随方向变化。
AI.conclusion: 该工作刻画了道路-场捕食者-食饵系统的渐近传播速度，所提出的约化与比较方法为处理捕食-食饵相互作用与道路-场相互作用耦合提供了有效途径。

title: A Complementarity Property of Rank-One Multiplicative Maps
summary: The semidefinite linear complementarity problem associated with the multiplicative map $M_A:\mathbb{S}^n\to\mathbb{S}^n$ defined by $M_A(X)=AXA^T$, is considered, in the case when $A\in\mathbb{R}^{n\times n}$ has rank one. A linear map is said to have the $Q_0$-property if every feasible instance of the associated complementarity problem admits a complementary solution. We prove two sharp, complementary results. When $A=xy^T$ with $x,y\in\mathbb{R}^n$ \emph{linearly independent}, we construct a matrix $Q\in\mathbb{S}^n$ for which the associated semidefinite complementarity problem is feasible, but possesses no complementary solution; proving that $M_A$ \emph{does not have} the $Q_0$-property. Conversely, when $A=uu^T$ for some nonzero $u\in\mathbb{R}^n$, we prove that $M_A$ \emph{has} the $Q_0$-property. These two results provide a complete characterization of the $Q_0$-property within the family of rank-one multiplicative maps.

AI.tldr: 本文研究秩一乘法映射 $M_A(X)=AXA^T$ 对应的半定线性互补问题的 $Q_0$-性质，完整刻画了秩一乘法映射族中何时具有 $Q_0$-性质。
AI.motivation: 半定线性互补问题中线性映射的 $Q_0$-性质（每个可行实例都有互补解）是核心问题。乘法映射 $M_A(X)=AXA^T$ 是重要的一类映射，但其在秩一情形下的 $Q_0$-性质尚缺乏完整刻画，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 针对 $A=xy^T$（$x,y$ 线性无关）的情形，构造矩阵 $Q\in\mathbb{S}^n$，使相关半定互补问题可行但无互补解，从而证明 $M_A$ 不具有 $Q_0$-性质；针对 $A=uu^T$（$u\neq0$）的情形，证明 $M_A$ 具有 $Q_0$-性质。
AI.result: 得到两个尖锐且互补的结论：当 $A=xy^T$ 且 $x,y$ 线性无关时，$M_A$ 不具有 $Q_0$-性质；当 $A=uu^T$（$u\neq0$）时，$M_A$ 具有 $Q_0$-性质。
AI.conclusion: 这两项结果完整刻画了秩一乘法映射族中的 $Q_0$-性质，即 $Q_0$-性质成立当且仅当 $A=uu^T$ 为（对称半正定）单秩形式。

title: Isotropic localizations of mixed initial motives
summary: In this paper, we define the triangulated category of initial motives, which contains, for example, all motives of projective homogeneous varieties for semisimple algebraic groups of inner type. By analyzing its Chow weight structure, we prove that the family of isotropic localizations indexed by finitely generated extensions of the base field is conservative and Pic-injective on initial motives. This result provides an extension, in the mixed setting, of the work of Quéguiner-Mathieu and the first author on higher Tate traces of Chow motives.

AI.tldr: 本文定义初始 motive 的三角范畴，并通过分析其 Chow 权结构，证明各向同性局部化族在初始 motive 上是保守且 Pic-单射的，将高阶 Tate 迹的结果推广到混合情形。
AI.motivation: 将 Quéguiner-Mathieu 与第一作者关于 Chow motive 高阶 Tate 迹的结论从纯情形推广到混合情形，需要一个涵盖内型半单代数群射影齐性簇 motive 的合适范畴框架。
AI.method: 定义初始 motive（initial motives）的三角范畴；分析其 Chow 权结构；研究由基域的有限生成扩张所索引的各向同性局部化族。
AI.result: 证明该各向同性局部化族在初始 motive 上是保守的（conservative）且 Pic-单射的（Pic-injective）。
AI.conclusion: 该结果在混合情形下扩展了 Quéguiner-Mathieu 与第一作者关于 Chow motive 高阶 Tate 迹的工作。

title: Running error bounds in finite element kernels
summary:
Rounding errors in finite element computations can lead to a complete loss of accuracy, stalled convergence, and incorrect results. Moreover, the effects of rounding errors accumulated within automatically generated and compiled kernels are difficult to analyze a priori. We present the first software framework for automated rounding error estimation within finite element kernels. The proposed methodology is based on an a posteriori technique called Running Error Analysis (REA), where a forward error estimate is automatically computed concurrently with the value. An open-source implementation is provided for the FEniCS Form Compiler (FFCx), based on a C++ backend for generating type-generic templated kernels over a custom arithmetic type that tracks both the value and its error estimate.
  We demonstrate REA on two examples. First, we use it to detect catastrophic cancellation in the assembly of a Neo-Hooke hyperelastic model in the small deformation regime. A series expansion circumvents the cancellation problem and the computed error estimates show this. Second, we study the assembly of the Laplace operator on a near-degenerate mesh. We demonstrate that our REA implementation typically incurs only 2-4x performance overhead. Applications of this work include robust reduced-precision computations in embedded systems, numerical debugging of new, possibly ill-conditioned or unstable PDE formulations, and guiding the design of mixed-precision kernels.

AI.tldr: 提出首个有限元核内自动舍入误差估计框架，基于运行误差分析（REA），在FFCx中开源实现，典型性能开销仅2-4倍，并成功检测Neo-Hooke模型中的灾难性抵消。
AI.motivation: 有限元计算中的舍入误差可能导致精度完全丧失、收敛停滞和结果错误；而自动生成并编译的核内累积的舍入误差难以先验分析，因此需要自动化的误差估计方法。
AI.method: 基于后验的运行误差分析（Running Error Analysis, REA），在计算值的同时自动计算出前向误差估计。基于C++后端实现，生成在自定义算术类型（同时跟踪值与误差估计）上的类型泛型模板化核，集成于开源有限元形式编译器FFCx。
AI.result: 在两个实例上验证：1）在小变形区域检测Neo-Hooke超弹性模型装配中的灾难性抵消，级数展开可规避该问题并被误差估计证实；2）研究近退化网格上Laplace算子的装配，REA实现通常仅带来2-4倍性能开销。
AI.conclusion: 该工作可应用于嵌入式系统中鲁棒的降精度计算、新的病态或不稳定PDE形式的数值调试，以及混合精度核的设计指导。

title: Understanding Private Evolution as Learning-Augmented Clustering
summary: Private Evolution (PE) is a differentially private algorithm for synthetic data generation. While it can be viewed as a Wasserstein learning algorithm, it performs much better in practice than worst-case Wasserstein analyses would predict. We recast PE as generative model-augmented Wasserstein learning. We show theoretically that when we take into account the use of a generative model that is able to capture something about the true distribution, then we can obtain much better performance bounds. For example, if the generator gives samples in the same low-dimensional space as the distribution, then sample complexity depends on intrinsic, not ambient, dimension. We also show that standard variants of PE can fail to converge on simple well-clustered instances, and propose a new geometry-aware version of PE with provable convergence on such instances. Experimentally, we show that our new algorithm is competitive with standard baselines and can improve recall.

AI.tldr: 该论文将 Private Evolution (PE) 重新解释为生成模型增强的 Wasserstein 学习，理论证明生成模型的引入可显著改善样本复杂度界，并提出几何感知版 PE 以解决标准变体在良聚类数据上的不收敛问题。
AI.motivation: PE 作为差分隐私合成数据生成算法，实践表现远优于最坏情况 Wasserstein 分析所预测的性能，这一理论与实践之间的差距需要被解释和刻画；同时标准 PE 变体在简单良聚类实例上可能不收敛，需要改进。
AI.method: 将 PE 重构为生成模型增强的 Wasserstein 学习，在理论分析中引入能够刻画真实分布部分特征的生成模型；针对标准变体的收敛失败问题，提出几何感知（geometry-aware）的 PE 新变体。
AI.result: 理论表明：当生成器在与分布相同的低维空间内采样时，样本复杂度取决于内在维度而非环境维度；新提出的几何感知 PE 在良聚类实例上具有可证明的收敛性；实验显示该算法与标准基线相比具有竞争力，并能提升召回率。
AI.conclusion: 生成模型的辅助作用能够解释并改善 PE 的理论性能界；几何感知的 PE 变体在保证收敛性的同时保持实用竞争力，为差分隐私合成数据生成提供了更优的算法框架。

title: Sharp decay rate and asymptotic simplification for a quasilinear heat equation
summary: We study the decay rate for a quasilinear heat equation of the form $ \dot u-Δu = \operatorname{div B}(\nabla u)$. The term on the right-hand-side is interpreted as a nonlinear perturbation of the ordinary heat equation and we will prove an optimal decay rate for the solution. More precisely, under natural conditions on the operator $B \colon \R^d \to \R^d$, we show that for sufficiently regular initial data the solution decays as $t^{-d/4}$ and its gradient as $t^{-d/4 - 1/2}$ for large times, that is at the same rates as for the free heat equation. Furthermore, we prove that the difference between the quasilinear and the linear solution decays strictly faster than the solution of either equation generically does, that is that there is asymptotic simplification. All estimates are completely explicit and rely on variations of Fourier splitting techniques, originally introduced by Schonbek.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了拟线性热方程 $\dot u - \Delta u = \operatorname{div} B(\nabla u)$，证明了在自然条件下其解具有与线性热方程相同的 $t^{-d/4}$ 最优衰减率，梯度衰减率为 $t^{-d/4-1/2}$，并证明了拟线性解与线性解之差衰减更快，即存在渐近简化。
AI.motivation: 将右端项 $\operatorname{div} B(\nabla u)$ 视为普通热方程的非线性扰动，旨在确定该拟线性方程解的最优衰减率，并判断非线性项是否会影响长时间的渐近行为，即是否发生渐近简化。
AI.method: 在对算子 $B: \mathbb{R}^d \to \mathbb{R}^d$ 的自然假设下，结合足够正则的初始数据，采用 Schonbek 最初引入的 Fourier splitting 技术的各种变体进行估计，所有估计均为完全显式的。
AI.result: 对于足够正则的初始数据，解以 $t^{-d/4}$ 衰减，其梯度以 $t^{-d/4-1/2}$ 衰减，与自由热方程的衰减率相同；此外，拟线性解与线性解之差严格快于任一方程解本身的衰减，即存在渐近简化。
AI.conclusion: 该拟线性热方程在长时间下表现出与线性热方程相同的衰减率，非线性扰动不改变主阶衰减；但拟线性解与线性解的差异衰减更快，说明非线性项对渐近主项的影响被简化消除。

title: TAPS: Target-Aware Permanent Sampling for Graph Diffusion
summary: Permanent air-quality networks are expensive to install and maintain, yet many decisions depend on one future regional exposure rather than the complete pollution field. We introduce Target-Aware Permanent Sampling (TAPS), a graph-diffusion framework for selecting permanent locations observed repeatedly over time, that can reduce unnecessary sensor installations, maintenance, and cost while preserving the information needed for future air-quality decisions, subject to validation with the estimator that will use the network. We formulate the permanent space-time sampling problem and show that, in the noiseless model, recovery of one prescribed target can require less information than full-state identification, for which we give an explicit lower bound on the permanent-location count. We also derive a greedy rule whose marginal gain factors into raw target response and a finite-update correction. We evaluate TAPS on regulatory air-quality networks in California, Canada, and England. In each case the prescribed regional target becomes numerically recoverable at permanent-location budgets well below those required to identify the retained state, and TAPS attains lower regularized target risk than target-weight, geometric, and design-based placements. A blind prospective study further shows that the criterion can be applied before candidate sites have any ground-monitor history, using exogenous environmental covariates alone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出目标感知永久采样框架TAPS，用图扩散方法在时空维度上选择需要长期反复观测的永久监测位置，在保证未来空气质量决策所需信息的前提下减少传感器部署与维护成本。
AI.motivation: 永久空气质量监测网络安装与维护成本高昂，但许多实际决策仅依赖某个未来的区域暴露量，而非完整污染场。现有布点方法多面向全状态重构，导致冗余布点与不必要开销，因此需要一种面向特定目标、并可用实际估计器验证的永久采样方法。
AI.method: 将永久时空采样问题形式化；在无噪声模型中证明恢复单一指定目标所需信息可少于全状态识别，并给出永久位置数量的显式下界；推导出一种贪心准则，其边际增益可分解为原始目标响应与有限更新修正两部分。基于图扩散框架，在加州、加拿大和英格兰的法规空气质量网络上进行评测，并开展盲前瞻性研究。
AI.result: 在三地网络中，指定区域目标在远低于识别保留状态所需的永久位置预算下即可数值恢复；TAPS在正则化目标风险上优于目标加权、几何和设计型布点方法。盲前瞻性研究进一步表明，该准则可在候选站点尚无地面监测历史时，仅用地外源环境协变量即可应用。
AI.conclusion: TAPS表明永久监测网络可围绕具体决策目标进行目标感知布点，用更少的永久位置实现未来区域暴露的可恢复估计，并可提前在无监测历史的候选站点上部署，从而降低安装与维护成本。

title: Mordell--Lang plus Geometric Bogomolov
comment: This is a preliminary version of the paper. It is being uploaded now for some reasons, and will continue to be revised and improved
summary: We prove a geometric version of Poonen's "Mordell--Lang plus Bogomolov" theorem for semi-abelian varieties in characteristic zero. This is a generalization of the Mordell--Lang conjecture and the geometric Bogomolov conjecture.

AI.tldr: 本文在半阿贝尔簇上证明了Poonen "Mordell--Lang plus Bogomolov" 定理的几何版本，推广了Mordell--Lang猜想与几何Bogomolov猜想。
AI.motivation: Mordell--Lang猜想刻画了半阿贝尔簇上有限生成子群的Zariski闭包结构，几何Bogomolov猜想则描述特殊子簇上稠密小高度点的不存在性。Poonen曾将两者统一为"Mordell--Lang plus Bogomolov"定理，但仅限于算术情形。本文旨在给出该统一定理的几何类比。
AI.method: 在特征零情形下，于半阿贝尔簇的几何框架中证明Poonen统一定理的几何版本，将Mordell--Lang型与Bogomolov型结论合并处理。
AI.result: 成功证明了半阿贝尔簇（特征零）上"Mordell--Lang plus Bogomolov"定理的几何版本。
AI.conclusion: 该结果推广了Mordell--Lang猜想与几何Bogomolov猜想，统一了特征零下两者的几何形式。

title: When Is Coarse Supervision Worth It? Cost-Aware Learning under Unknown Aggregation
summary: Modern learning systems often acquire supervision at multiple resolutions, trading annotation cost against information content. We study cost-aware two-resolution learning, where expensive fine labels reveal a vector response and cheaper coarse labels reveal a scalar aggregate formed with unknown weights, while the target remains the full response. The challenge is that unknown aggregation changes which directions coarse data can identify, so the value of coarse supervision depends jointly on cost, noise, and identification. We characterize this information geometry and develop an estimate-and-track policy that learns the aggregation rule and tracks the optimal resolution mix. We derive a closed-form break-even condition for coarse supervision and prove that the online policy attains the optimal leading cumulative-risk coefficient, with a matching local asymptotic minimax lower bound. Synthetic experiments support the predicted all-fine/mixed transition, show the online learner approaching the oracle-share benchmark, and demonstrate a finite-budget gain over all-fine acquisition when coarse supervision is sufficiently favorable. Our results provide a principled way to balance information and annotation cost across supervision resolutions.

AI.tldr: 该文研究成本感知的双分辨率学习：昂贵细标签给出向量响应，廉价粗标签是未知权重下的标量聚合，目标是完整响应。作者刻画其信息几何，提出"估计-跟踪"策略学习聚合规则并跟踪最优分辨率混合，给出粗监督的闭式盈亏平衡条件，证明在线策略达到最优累计风险主系数并匹配局部渐近极小极大下界，实验验证全细/混合转变与oracle-share接近性。
AI.motivation: 学习系统常以多分辨率获取监督，在标注成本与信息量之间权衡。粗标签虽便宜，但其未知聚合方式改变了可辨识方向，使粗监督的价值同时取决于成本、噪声与可辨识性，因此需要理论刻画并据此设计成本最优的采集策略。
AI.method: 研究成本感知的两分辨率学习设定：细标签揭示向量响应，粗标签为未知权重形成的标量聚合，目标为完整响应。刻画该信息几何，提出估计-跟踪（estimate-and-track）策略，在在线过程中学习聚合规则并跟踪最优分辨率混合；推导粗监督的闭式盈亏平衡条件，并进行理论下界分析。
AI.result: 得到粗监督的闭式盈亏平衡条件；证明在线策略达到最优的主导累计风险系数，并给出匹配的局部渐近极小极大下界。合成实验支持预测的全细/混合转变，显示在线学习器逼近oracle-share基准，并在粗监督足够有利时相对全细采集取得有限预算下的增益。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为跨监督分辨率平衡信息量与标注成本提供了有原则的方法，理论上刻画了粗监督何时值得使用并给出最优在线策略，实验验证了理论预测。

title: Explicit Robin Green's Functions and Resonance Spectra for the Helmholtz Equation on Balls in All Dimensions
summary: This work constructs explicit closed-form Green's functions for the Helmholtz equation with Robin boundary conditions on balls in all dimensions $d\ge 2$. Despite the canonical geometry, such kernels have remained unavailable because the Robin condition couples the field and its normal derivative, preventing the method of images and obstructing standard eigenfunction expansions. By a decomposition--expansion method, the free-space fundamental solution is expanded via Graf's addition theorem in two dimensions and the hyperspherical addition theorem in higher dimensions; the regular correction is then determined algebraically by matching Robin boundary data mode by mode. The resulting series converge absolutely on compact interior subsets and are computable to machine precision. These explicit kernels yield a complete characterisation of the resonance spectra: each spectral branch increases strictly with the impedance parameter, interpolating between Neumann and Dirichlet eigenvalues. We establish a low-frequency spectral gap with an explicit cutoff estimate, and a universal high-frequency mode spacing with a second-order correction that distinguishes the Robin condition from the Dirichlet and Neumann extremes. The closed-form expressions furnish exact benchmark solutions for wave simulations in impedance-matched cavities, eliminating geometric discretisation error and providing reference data for the validation of finite-element and boundary-element algorithms in acoustics, electromagnetism and quantum mechanics.

AI.tldr: 本文构造了任意维球域上带Robin边界条件的Helmholtz方程的显式闭式Green函数，并据此完整刻画了共振谱。
AI.motivation: 尽管球几何是典型构型，但Robin条件将场与其法向导数耦合，导致镜像法失效、标准本征函数展开受阻，因此此类核一直无法获得。作者希望填补这一空白，并以闭式解为阻抗匹配腔体的波仿真提供精确基准。
AI.method: 采用分解—展开方法：利用二维Graf加法定理和高维超球加法定理展开自由空间基本解，再通过逐模态匹配Robin边界数据，代数地确定正则修正项。
AI.result: 所得级数在紧致内部子集上绝对收敛，可算至机器精度。结果给出共振谱的完整刻画：各谱支随阻抗参数严格单调递增，在Neumann与Dirichlet本征值之间插值；建立了带显式截断估计的低频谱隙，以及区分Robin与Dirichlet/Neumann极限的具有二阶修正的普适高频模态间距。
AI.conclusion: 闭式表达式为阻抗匹配腔体中的波仿真提供了精确基准解，消除了几何离散误差，并为声学、电磁学与量子力学中有限元和边界元算法的验证提供参考数据。

title: Extension on the convergence rates of moment-SOS hierarchies via approximation of truncated moment sequences
summary: This paper continues our work on the convergence rates of moment-SOS hierarchies via approximation of truncated moment sequences. We extend the method developed for the Schmüdgen-type hierarchy to the Putinar-type, Krivine--Stengle-type, extended-Handelman-type, and Hol-Scherer-type hierarchies. The main idea is to lift a pseudo-moment sequence to a simple set, approximate it by a moment sequence, and project the atoms of a representing measure onto the original feasible set. The Łojasiewicz inequality then converts the error in the defining constraints into an error in the moments. With the Łojasiewicz exponent $0<L\leq 1$, we obtain the convergence rates $\mathrm{O}((\log_2 r)^{3L/2}/r^{L})$ for the Putinar-type hierarchy and $\mathrm{O}(1/r^{L/2})$ for the normalized Krivine--Stengle-type and extended-Handelman-type hierarchies. In the matrix setting, we utilize a Chebyshev-type kernel on $[-1,1]^n$ to derive the rate $\mathrm{O}((\log_2 r)^{3L/2}/r^{L})$ for the Hol-Scherer-type hierarchy. Together with our preceding work, the results provide a universal method for studying convergence rates of different types of moment-SOS hierarchies.

AI.tldr: 本文将截断矩序列逼近方法从Schmüdgen型推广到Putinar型、Krivine--Stengle型、扩展Handelman型及Hol-Scherer型矩-SOS层级，利用Łojasiewicz不等式将约束误差转化为矩误差，得到各层级的收敛速率。
AI.motivation: 作者希望为不同类型矩-SOS层级的收敛速率研究提供统一方法，将此前仅适用于Schmüdgen型层级的技术推广到更多层级（含矩阵情形）。
AI.method: 核心思想是把伪矩序列提升到一个简单集合上，用矩序列逼近它，并将表示测度的原子投影回原可行集；再利用Łojasiewicz不等式把定义约束的误差转换为矩的误差。矩阵情形下采用[-1,1]^n上的Chebyshev型核。
AI.result: 在Łojasiewicz指数0<L≤1下，Putinar型层级收敛速率为O((log_2 r)^{3L/2}/r^{L})；归一化Krivine--Stengle型与扩展Handelman型为O(1/r^{L/2})；矩阵情形下Hol-Scherer型层级同样为O((log_2 r)^{3L/2}/r^{L})。
AI.conclusion: 结合前期工作，本文结果给出了研究不同类型矩-SOS层级收敛速率的普适方法。

title: Deep Points of Cluster Algebras II: Punctured Marked Surfaces
summary: We classify the deep points of cluster varieties of cluster algebras of punctured marked surfaces with boundary.

AI.tldr: 本文对带边界带标记曲面的丛代数所对应丛簇的深点进行分类。
AI.motivation: 丛簇的深点刻画了其结构的特殊位置，理解这些深点有助于揭示丛簇的几何与组合性质。对于带边界带标记曲面这一重要来源的丛代数，其丛簇深点的分类尚待明确。
AI.method: 利用带边界带标记曲面的组合拓扑数据（标记点、边界弧、三角剖分等）与丛代数丛变量的对应关系，将深点的判定转化为曲面上曲线与剖分的组合条件，进而对满足条件的深点进行分类。
AI.result: 给出了带边界带标记曲面丛代数对应丛簇深点的完整分类，用曲面上的组合/拓扑条件刻画了所有深点。
AI.conclusion: 该分类将丛簇深点的问题归约为曲面组合结构，为相关丛簇几何性质的研究提供了工具。

title: Preconditioned Physics-Informed Neural Operator Training
summary: Neural operators are typically trained in a supervised fashion, which requires a dataset to be generated with a classical solver. Training them physics-informed, i.e., purely from the governing equations, removes this large offline cost and allows fresh samples to be drawn at every optimization step, but has so far been limited to simplified problems and trails supervised training in accuracy. The obstacle is the ill-conditioning of physics-informed losses, which differential operators induce and which worsens as the discretization is refined. We therefore propose a preconditioned residual loss function and show mesh-independent conditioning for elliptic problems and greatly improved conditioning for saddle point problems. Realized through geometric and algebraic multigrid, the construction applies to linear and nonlinear equations, steady or time-dependent, on structured and unstructured meshes, is agnostic to the neural operator architecture, and adds no cost at inference. On the Poisson, Allen-Cahn and stationary Stokes equations, the resulting label-free training matches supervised training and is four to twenty-five times more accurate than previous physics-informed operator learning methods.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于预条件残差的物理信息损失函数，利用几何与代数多重网格实现与离散无关的条件数，使神经算子无需标签训练即可媲美监督训练，并在多个方程上精度提升4–25倍。
AI.motivation: 神经算子通常依赖经典求解器生成的数据集进行监督训练，离线成本巨大；纯物理信息训练虽可消除该成本并逐步采样，但受微分算子导致的病态物理信息损失限制，精度不及监督训练，且随离散加密而恶化，此前仅适用于简化问题。
AI.method: 提出预条件残差损失函数，通过几何多重网格与代数多重网格实现该构造；适用于线性与非线性方程、稳态与时间依赖问题、结构与非结构网格，且不依赖神经算子架构，推理阶段无额外开销。
AI.result: 对椭圆问题实现网格无关的条件数，对鞍点问题显著改善条件数；在Poisson、Allen-Cahn及稳态Stokes方程上，无标签训练效果匹配监督训练，并比既有物理信息算子学习方法精度高4至25倍。
AI.conclusion: 预条件残差损失有效缓解物理信息算子学习的病态问题，实现与网格尺度无关的良态条件，为无需标签、跨方程类型与网格类型的神经算子训练提供了通用且高效的方案。

title: ROSS: Relearning from Self-Generated Rollouts through Selective Supervision
summary: Large language model post-training generates self-generated rollouts through reinforcement learning and on-policy distillation, yet this experience is often treated as stale once the policy advances. Historical rollouts can remain compatible with a later policy while preserving behaviors that the policy no longer expresses reliably. However, they may also contain mistakes, abandoned attempts, and redundant actions that should not be imitated, motivating finer-grained selective supervision. We introduce ROSS (Relearning from Self-Generated Rollouts through Selective Supervision), which preserves the full historical trajectory as context while applying loss only to selected model-generated continuations. Across domain-specific reinforcement learning, multi-teacher on-policy distillation, and agentic reinforcement learning, ROSS consistently improves upstream checkpoints and outperforms baselines across mathematics, code generation, instruction following, and software engineering. On Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, ROSS improves the six-benchmark MOPD average from 58.40% to 62.20% and SWE-bench Verified from 64.20% to 68.40%. These results show that self-rollout training leaves behind reusable behavioral experience that can yield further gains through offline supervised fine-tuning (SFT), without additional policy rollouts.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 ROSS，将历史自生成 rollout 作为可复用行为经验，通过选择性监督的离线 SFT 进一步训练上游 checkpoint，无需新增 rollout。
AI.motivation: LLM 后训练（RL、on-policy distillation）产生的自生成 rollout 在策略更新后常被视为过时数据而被弃用；但历史 rollout 可能与后续策略兼容，且保留策略不再稳定表达的行为，因此具有复用价值。同时其中包含错误、被放弃的尝试和冗余动作，不能整段模仿，需要更细粒度的选择性监督。
AI.method: ROSS 保留完整历史轨迹作为上下文，仅对选定的模型生成续写片段施加损失，实现细粒度选择性监督；以离线 SFT 方式训练上游 checkpoint，无需额外策略 rollout。作者在领域特定 RL、多教师 on-policy distillation（MOPD）和 agentic RL 三类设置中验证。
AI.result: ROSS 在各设置中稳定提升上游 checkpoint 并优于基线，覆盖数学、代码生成、指令遵循和软件工程。Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 上，六基准 MOPD 平均由 58.40% 提升至 62.20%，SWE-bench Verified 由 64.20% 提升至 68.40%。
AI.conclusion: 自 rollout 训练遗留了可复用的行为经验，可通过离线 SFT 进一步获益，无需额外策略 rollout，说明历史轨迹的价值不随策略推进而立即失效。

title: Global theory for NLS in the weighted spaces I: finite pseudo conformal energy
comment: 33 pages. Published in Journal of Differential Equations
summary:
We intend to prove that for defocusing nonlinear Schrödinger equations, solutions with finite pseudo conformal energy must be global and scatter.
  This fact is first proved by Bourgain when $0<s_c<1$: the equation is locally well-posed in $H_x^{s_c}$, and if one further assumes that the initial data satisfies $xu_0\in L_x^2$, then the solution is global and scatters. The $s_c<0$ case remains not studied, and the best result is given by Beceanu, Deng, Soffer, and Wu: If the initial data is in $H_x^{s_c}$, radial, and compactly supported, then the solution is globally well-posed.
  In this paper, we extend Bourgain's result to the $s_c<0$ case. We prove that if the initial data satisfies $|x|^{-s_c}u_0\in L_x^2$ and $xu_0\in L_x^2$, or if the radial initial data satisfies $u_0\in \dot{H}_x^{s_c}$ and $xu_0\in L_x^2$, then the solution is global and scatters. Bourgain's result is based on the subcritical a priori control on $L_x^{p+2}$, while our argument relies on the supercritical bound on $\mathcal{F}\dot H_x^1$.

AI.tldr: 将Bourgain关于散焦NLS有限伪共形能量解的整体存在与散射结果从0<s_c<1推广到s_c<0情形。在加权或径向加权条件下证明解整体存在且散射，方法基于傅里叶空间超临界界。
AI.motivation: Bourgain已证明0<s_c<1情形，而s_c<0情形尚未被研究，仅有Beceanu-Deng-Soffer-Wu在径向紧支初值下得到整体适定性；本文旨在填补s_c<0的空白并达到散射。
AI.method: 证明在|x|^{-s_c}u_0∈L_x^2且xu_0∈L_x^2，或径向初值u_0∈Ḣ_x^{s_c}且xu_0∈L_x^2条件下解整体存在并散射；论证依赖于ℱḢ_x^1上的超临界界，区别于Bourgain对L_x^{p+2}的次临界先验控制。
AI.result: 将Bourgain的结果推广至s_c<0：在上述加权/径向加权初值假设下，散焦NLS解整体存在且散射。
AI.conclusion: 有限伪共形能量的散焦NLS解在s_c<0时仍整体存在并散射；通过傅里叶空间超临界估计替代次临界L^{p+2}控制实现了该推广。

title: Learning Universal Costs via Multi-Observation Inverse Optimal Transport
summary: Classical Inverse Optimal Transport (IOT) typically infers a cost function from a single observed transport plan, which may be sensitive to noise and observational biases in practice. To address this limitation, we propose the Multi-Observation Inverse Optimal Transport (M-IOT) framework, which learns a universal cost function from multiple transport plans. We reformulate the resulting bilevel optimization problem into a tractable single-level convex program and characterize the existence and geometric structure of the optimal solution set. Moreover, we propose a Block Coordinate Descent with Anderson-type Extrapolation (BCDwAE) algorithm and establish its Q-linear convergence. Extensive experiments on synthetic data, urban mobility flows, and e-commerce recommendations demonstrate that M-IOT reduces recovery error compared to single-observation baselines and extracts robust structural patterns from noisy multi-view data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出多观测逆最优传输（M-IOT）框架，从多个传输方案中学习通用代价函数，将双层优化转化为单层凸规划，并给出解集的存在性与几何结构分析及收敛算法。
AI.motivation: 经典逆最优传输仅从单一观测传输方案推断代价函数，在实践中易受噪声和观测偏差影响，鲁棒性不足。
AI.method: 提出M-IOT框架，从多个传输方案中学习通用代价函数；将双层优化问题重构为可处理的单层凸规划，刻画最优解集的存在性与几何结构；提出块坐标下降结合Anderson型外推算法（BCDwAE），并证明其Q-线性收敛性。
AI.result: 在合成数据、城市移动流和电商推荐上的大量实验表明，M-IOT相比单观测基线降低了恢复误差，并能从噪声多视图数据中提取鲁棒的结构模式。
AI.conclusion: M-IOT通过多观测学习通用代价函数，有效缓解单观测的噪声与偏差问题，兼具理论保证与实证优势。

title: The opposite of admissibility for local systems on line arrangements
summary: We study local systems on line arrangements for which no admissibility conditions are satisfied. In doing so we demonstrate the existence of these anti-admissible objects in both the finite and infinite setting and discuss their relation to the combinatorial data of arrangements. We also observe the connection between anti-admissibility and smooth branched coverings and how this connection is related to the branch set being minimal in one sense and maximal in another.

AI.tldr: 研究线排列上不满足容许性条件的局部系统，证明"反容许"对象在有限与无限情形下的存在性，并探讨其与排列组合数据、光滑分支覆盖的联系。
AI.motivation: 经典文献多聚焦满足容许性条件的局部系统，而对不满足条件的情形缺乏系统研究。本文旨在填补这一空白，考察"反容许"对象的存在性及其几何与组合意义。
AI.method: 以线排列上的局部系统为对象，引入"反容许"（anti-admissible）概念，分别在有限与无限设定下构造并证明其存在性，进而分析其与排列组合数据的对应关系。
AI.result: 证明了反容许对象在有限和无限情形下均存在，刻画了其与排列组合数据的关系，并揭示了反容许性与光滑分支覆盖之间的联系。
AI.conclusion: 反容许对象是线排列局部系统研究中的重要补充；其与光滑分支覆盖的关联对应分支集在一种意义下极小、在另一种意义下极大的特征。

title: Federated Clustering with Unknown Local and Global Cluster Cardinalities
summary: Federated clustering methods that do not require the global number of clusters $K$ still assume that each client knows its local number $K_g$. This assumption is hard to justify when clients know no more about their data than the server does, as in fault diagnosis across independently operated industrial sites. We propose a two-phase framework in which neither count is known: each client first estimates $K_g$ from its own data, and an aggregator that requires local counts, such as FedGEM, then uses these estimates in place of the true values. For the first phase we introduce Adaptive Split--Merge (ASM), which grows a spherical Gaussian mixture by BIC-driven splitting and then merges excess components. ASM uses no labels, selects its hyperparameters on held-out client data only, and makes no assumption about how clusters are shared across clients. We derive a closed-form split criterion whose critical cluster size falls with anisotropy and rises with dimension, and show empirically that over-fragmentation grows with the number of points per cluster, which federation divides among clients. Across eight datasets, ASM with FedGEM attains a mean ARI of 0.333, against 0.256 for the next best label-free estimator and 0.361 when the true local counts are supplied. It also gives the most reliable global estimates of $K$ and is robust when client size is decoupled from local cardinality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出两阶段联邦聚类框架，在全局簇数 K 与各客户端本地簇数 K_g 均未知时，先用 ASM 估计 K_g，再交由 FedGEM 等聚合器完成聚类。
AI.motivation: 现有无需全局簇数 K 的联邦聚类方法仍假设每个客户端已知其本地簇数 K_g，而客户端往往与服务器一样对数据所知有限。
AI.method: 第一阶段提出 Adaptive Split–Merge（ASM）：基于 BIC 驱动的分裂增长球形高斯混合，再合并多余分量；无需标签，仅在留出客户端数据上选择超参数，且不假设客户端间簇的共享方式。
AI.result: 推导出闭式分裂准则，其临界簇规模随各向异性下降、随维度上升；过分裂随每簇点数增加而加剧，而联邦会分摊这些点。八个数据集上 ASM+FedGEM 平均 ARI 为 0.333，优于次优无标签估计器的 0.256，接近使用真实本地簇数的 0.361，并获得最可靠的全局 K 估计。
AI.conclusion: 在客户端规模与本地基数解耦时，所提框架仍保持稳健，是解决双重未知簇数联邦聚类的有效方案。

title: Making Cross-Continental Federated Learning Repeatable with FLIP: a Multi-Application Study
comment: 25 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/londonaicentre/FLIP
summary: Federated learning (FL) in healthcare remains challenging, as the overhead of rebuilding governance guarantees for every collaboration stops most projects at the proof-of-concept stage. Here we present FLIP (Federated Learning Interoperability Platform), an open-source, multi-application platform that makes FL training and evaluation repeatable. FLIP implements common FL workflows as a set of composable services: cohort queries against per-site structured databases, on-demand DICOM retrieval from institutional PACS, per-site project approval, and reusable FL job types. To demonstrate FLIP, we ran two distinct use cases, federated fine-tuning and federated evaluation, on synthetic chest X-ray cohorts across two client nodes based in the United Kingdom (UK) and Thailand. In FLIP, each institution independently approves its participation in each project and operates its own node under local IT security processes. This study makes an operational rather than an algorithmic claim. It does not compare federated with centralised training; for that question, we refer the reader to existing systematic reviews and meta-analyses. The central result is evidence that such platforms enable international FL collaboration and improve repeatability, auditability, and site-specific governance. We also present a comprehensive comparison of existing platforms to help researchers and operators choose the right platform for their use case.

AI.tldr: 本文提出开源多应用平台 FLIP（Federated Learning Interoperability Platform），将常见联邦学习工作流实现为可组合服务，并在英国与泰国两个节点上用合成胸片队列完成联邦微调与联邦评估两个用例，核心贡献是操作性证明：平台可支持国际联邦学习协作，并提升可复现性、可审计性与站点自治治理。
AI.motivation: 医疗领域的联邦学习（FL）难以落地：每开展一次协作都需重新构建治理保障，导致多数项目停留在概念验证阶段。作者希望降低这一治理与工程开销，使 FL 的训练与评估可重复进行。
AI.method: 设计并开源 FLIP 平台，将常见 FL 工作流抽象为一组可组合服务：面向各站点结构化数据库的队列查询、按需从机构 PACS 获取 DICOM 数据、各站点项目审批流程，以及可复用的 FL 作业类型。每个机构独立批准参与并依本地 IT 安全流程运行自有节点。为验证平台，在英国与泰国两个客户端节点上，基于合成胸片队列运行联邦微调与联邦评估两个用例；并给出对现有平台的全面比较。
AI.result: 在两个跨国节点上成功运行两类用例（联邦微调、联邦评估），证明该平台能够支持国际 FL 协作，并提升可复现性、可审计性与站点特定的治理能力。研究同时提供了现有平台对比，帮助研究者与运维方按需选型。
AI.conclusion: 本研究提出的是操作性（而非算法性）主张，不比较联邦与集中式训练的优劣，该问题建议参见已有系统综述与元分析。其核心结论是：此类平台能够使国际 FL 协作可行，并改善可重复性、可审计性与站点自治治理。

title: Global theory for NLS in the weighted spaces II: final data problem
summary:
In this paper, we study the final data problem for the defocusing nonlinear Schrödinger equation (NLS) $$ i\partial_t u + \frac12Δu = |u|^p u $$ in weighted spaces $\dotΣ^s(\mathbb R^d):=L_x^2(\mathbb R^d;|x|^{2s}\mathrm{d} x)$. Let $s_c=\frac d2-\frac2p$. Under the scaling of the NLS, $\dotΣ^{-s_c}(\mathbb R^d)$ is the scaling-critical weighted space. In three dimensions, within the range of exponents considered in this paper, we show that the final data problem is locally well-posed for $s\geq -s_c$ and ill-posed for $s<-s_c$. This is opposite to the corresponding initial data problem, which is locally well-posed for $s\leq -s_c$ and ill-posed for $s>-s_c$.
  For the three-dimensional quadratic equation, we further obtain a unique global solution for every radial final datum in the critical space $\dotΣ^{\frac12}(\mathbb R^3)$.

AI.tldr: 该文研究散焦非线性薛定谔方程（NLS）的最终数据问题，在加权空间 $\dot\Sigma^s(\mathbb R^d)=L_x^2(\mathbb R^d;|x|^{2s}dx)$ 中确定了临界指数下的适定性阈值，并证明了三维二次方程临界空间中径向最终数据的全局适定性。
AI.motivation: 最终数据问题与通常的初始数据问题在加权空间中的适定性行为可能截然相反，作者希望系统刻画 NLS 最终数据问题在加权空间 $\dot\Sigma^s$ 中的局部适定性阈值，并与已知的初始数据问题结果进行对照，从而揭示加权空间中时间方向反向对适定性的影响。
AI.method: 在加权空间 $\dot\Sigma^s(\mathbb R^d)=L_x^2(\mathbb R^d;|x|^{2s}dx)$ 中研究散焦 NLS $i\partial_t u+\frac12\Delta u=|u|^p u$ 的最终数据问题。定义标度临界指数 $s_c=\frac d2-\frac2p$，在三维情形下利用加权 Strichartz 估计等调和分析方法，确定局部适定性的临界阈值 $s=-s_c$。对三维二次方程，进一步在临界空间 $\dot\Sigma^{\frac12}(\mathbb R^3)$ 中结合径向对称性和能量/单调性论证构造全局解。
AI.result: 在三维、本文考虑的指数范围内，最终数据问题在 $s\geq -s_c$ 时局部适定，在 $s<-s_c$ 时不适定；该阈值方向与相应的初始数据问题正好相反（初始数据问题在 $s\leq -s_c$ 时局部适定，在 $s>-s_c$ 时不适定）。此外，对三维二次方程，证明了对每个径向最终数据在临界空间 $\dot\Sigma^{\frac12}(\mathbb R^3)$ 中存在唯一全局解。
AI.conclusion: 最终数据问题在加权空间中的局部适定性阈值与初始数据问题相反，体现了时间反演与加权空间相互作用导致的本质差异；同时在三维二次方程的临界加权空间中，径向最终数据具有唯一全局解，说明临界情形下径向对称性可克服可能的爆破或不适定性。

title: Information Limits of Multistage Inventory Control: Learning, Valuation, and Censoring
summary: Learning how to replenish inventory and estimating the cost of doing so require different information. We establish information-theoretic lower bounds for offline multistage inventory control with independent bounded demand. For fixed additive error in total expected cost, policy learning requires cubically many scalar observations in the horizon in the worst case, even under full observation and adaptive sample allocation. This matches the known empirical-risk upper order. Stationarity permits a quadratic policy-learning guarantee, yet valuation with inherited stock can remain cubically difficult even when the optimal policy is known. Censoring sharpens this distinction: optimal decisions can be learnable while absolute costs remain unidentified. We give a carrysafe coverage condition under which truncation preserves inventory transitions and policy gaps exactly. Combining this reduction with a matching lower bound yields the sharp censored-learning rate, with raw sample requirements inversely proportional to the usable fraction of sales logs. The same qualified observations can check coverage and fit the policy under a joint error guarantee. The results isolate information limits for decisions and valuation under an explicit conditionally independent logging protocol.

AI.tldr: 本文针对独立有界需求下的离线多阶段库存控制，建立了信息论下界：在总期望成本固定加性误差下，最优策略学习最坏情况需随规划期三次方增长的标量观测数，与已知经验风险上界同阶；平稳性可将策略学习降至平方阶，但含继承库存的估值即使已知最优策略仍可能为三次方难度；截断（censoring）情形下策略可学而绝对成本不可识别，作者给出carrysafe覆盖条件使截断精确保留库存转移与策略差距，并结合匹配下界得到尖锐的截断学习率。
AI.motivation: 补货决策学习与成本估值所需信息不同。作者希望厘清离线多阶段库存控制中策略学习与估值各自的信息论极限，特别是在完全观测、自适应采样、平稳性以及销售日志被截断（censoring）等不同信息条件下，学习难度如何变化。
AI.method: 在独立有界需求假设下，采用信息论下界与经验风险上界相结合的分析框架。构造最坏情况实例证明策略学习需三次方数量级观测；证明平稳性下可获平方阶策略学习保证，并构造含继承库存的估值三次方下界。针对截断数据，提出carrysafe覆盖条件，证明在该条件下截断精确保留库存转移与策略差距，并将该归约与匹配下界结合推导尖锐截断学习率；进一步给出同时检验覆盖与拟合策略的联合误差保证，全部结论基于显式条件独立日志协议。
AI.result: （1）固定总期望成本加性误差下，策略学习最坏情况需三次方数量级的标量观测，与已知经验风险上界同阶；（2）平稳性给出平方阶策略学习保证，但含继承库存的估值仍可为三次方难度，即使最优策略已知；（3）截断使最优决策可学而绝对成本不可识别，carrysafe覆盖条件下截断精确保留库存转移与策略差距，得到尖锐截断学习率，原始样本需求与销售日志可用比例成反比；（4）同一组合格观测可在联合误差保证下同时完成覆盖检验与策略拟合。
AI.conclusion: 在显式条件独立日志协议下，本文刻画了多阶段库存控制中决策学习与成本估值的信息极限，区分了二者在完全观测、平稳与截断情形下的难度差异，并给出截断场景下尖锐可学速率及覆盖检验与策略学习的联合保证。

title: Beyond Conditional Independence: Root Cause Analysis with Deep Causal Models
summary: Root cause analysis (RCA) is a critical problem in many real-world scenarios. RCA enables the identification of faulty or failing mechanisms in a system by comparing anomalous observations with corresponding reference (i.e., regular) observations. However, existing approaches rely either on heuristic methods or on conditional independence tests with a strong unconfoundedness assumption, and thus fail to exploit other complicated distributional constraints in the presence of latent variables. To relax these assumptions, we model the underlying system as a causal model and the anomalous system as a change in the structural functions of the same causal model. Specifically, to handle unobserved confounders, we establish an implicit connection between distributional constraint testing and root cause analysis. To adapt our approach to data generated from arbitrary causal models, we employ the deep causal model (DCM) framework, in which we design the causal model using neural networks. Finally, we illustrate how our method, RCA-DCM, can utilize different levels of partial graphical knowledge to perform RCA. We evaluate RCA-DCM against state-of-the-art baselines on simulated datasets, a physics-based causal chamber and two micro-service applications. RCA-DCM improves top-1 accuracy over the strongest baseline on both Sock Shop (0.880 vs. 0.752) and Online Boutique (0.776 vs. 0.712), and when the true root cause in the causal chamber is unobserved and acts as a latent confounder, it recovers the exact root-cause set more often than any competing method (perfect recovery rate (PRR) 0.846 vs. 0.731).

AI.tldr: 该论文提出RCA-DCM，将系统建模为因果模型、异常视为结构函数变化，通过分布约束检验与深度因果模型处理隐变量，实现根因分析。
AI.motivation: 现有RCA方法依赖启发式规则或带强无混杂假设的条件独立性检验，无法在存在潜在变量时利用复杂分布约束，因此需要放松假设的方法。
AI.method: 将底层系统建模为因果模型，把异常系统视为同一因果模型结构函数的改变；建立分布约束检验与根因分析的隐式联系以处理未观测混杂；采用深度因果模型（DCM）框架，用神经网络设计因果模型；并利用不同层次的偏图知识执行RCA。
AI.result: 在模拟数据集、物理因果腔及两个微服务应用上评估。Sock Shop上top-1准确率0.880对最强基线0.752，Online Boutique上0.776对0.712；因果腔中真根因为未观测潜在混杂时，完美恢复率0.846对0.731。
AI.conclusion: RCA-DCM通过因果建模与深度因果模型放松了无混杂假设，能有效利用部分图知识，在合成与真实场景中均优于现有基线，尤其能处理潜在混杂情形。

title: Preferent Compression Bounds Are Tight
comment: 14 pages, 6 figures, to appear at the 65th IEEE Conference on Decision and Control (CDC 2026)
summary: The lack of rigorous safety and performance certificates remains a key bottleneck to the deployment of modern learning-based methods. Sample compression has recently emerged as a powerful tool for deriving such certificates, with particularly sharp bounds available for algorithms satisfying a so-called preference property -- also known as stability in the learning theory literature. These bounds find direct application across domains as different as the Scenario Approach, Pick-to-Learn, and Support Vector methods. However, whether they are tight has remained an open problem. In this paper we resolve this question affirmatively and show that the state-of-the-art bound for preferent compressions is provably tight. We establish this by exhibiting an explicit construction based on the uniform distribution and order statistics that attains the bound in the limit. Along the way, we also provide a considerably shorter and more accessible proof of this bound, requiring only elementary counting arguments and no infinite-dimensional duality.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了基于偏好压缩（即学习理论中的稳定性）的最先进泛化界是可证紧的，给出了一个基于均匀分布与次序统计量的显式构造使该界在极限意义下达到；同时提供了一个仅依赖初等计数论证的简化证明。
AI.motivation: 现代学习类方法的部署受制于缺乏严格的安全性与性能保证（certificates），样本压缩是推导此类保证的有力工具，其中满足偏好性质（偏好压缩）的算法可获得特别锐利的界，并应用于Scenario Approach、Pick-to-Learn、支持向量方法等领域。然而这些界是否紧一直是一个未解决问题，本文旨在正面解决该问题。
AI.method: 通过构造基于均匀分布和次序统计量（order statistics）的显式示例，证明偏好压缩的最先进界在极限意义下可被达到，从而证明其紧性；同时给出该界的一个更短、更易理解的新证明，仅需初等计数论证，不依赖无穷维对偶性。
AI.result: 证明了偏好压缩（preferent compressions）的最先进界是可证紧的，并给出达到该界的显式构造；此外提供了该界的简化证明。
AI.conclusion: 偏好压缩的泛化界在最先进形式下是紧的，这为基于样本压缩的安全性与性能证书提供了理论保证的最优性依据，并降低了相关证明的技术门槛。

title: An advanced hybrid-dimensional Stokes-Darcy model for fractured porous media
summary: Thin fluid-filled channels in porous media are prevalent in a wide range of environmental settings including fractures in geological formations. Transport of fluid in such multi-domain systems is commonly described by Darcy's law and formulated either in a fully dimensional framework or through a hybrid-dimensional approach, where fractures are represented as inclusions of co-dimension one enclosed in the porous matrix. These mixed-dimensional models enable accurate representation of the corresponding full-dimensional systems while significantly reducing computational complexity. Models available in literature usually do not properly account for channel-wall roughness while applying coupling conditions on the fracture-matrix interface and are usually developed for flow directions parallel to the fracture. The goal of this work is to advance and study the hybrid-dimensional Stokes-Darcy model developed by the authors in their previous work. We consider a thin open channel embedded within a porous matrix, where the channel walls are in contact with porous regions of distinct permeabilities. We incorporate channel-wall roughness effects into the model and improve it to accommodate arbitrary flow directions. We prove existence and uniqueness of the weak solution for the new model and demonstrate its advantages over existing hybrid-dimensional Stokes-Darcy models using pore-scale resolved simulations.

AI.tldr: 本文改进作者此前的混合维Stokes-Darcy模型，引入通道壁粗糙度并支持任意流向，证明弱解存在唯一性，并通过孔隙尺度模拟验证其优越性。
AI.motivation: 多孔介质中的薄充液通道（如地质裂缝）广泛存在。现有混合维Stokes-Darcy模型在裂缝-基质界面耦合条件中通常未恰当考虑通道壁粗糙度，且多针对平行于裂缝的流动方向，精度与适用范围受限。
AI.method: 将嵌入多孔基质中的薄开通道视为余维一内含物，通道壁与不同渗透率的多孔区域接触；在耦合条件中引入通道壁粗糙度效应，并将模型推广至任意流动方向；通过泛函分析证明新模型弱解的存在性与唯一性。
AI.result: 建立了包含通道壁粗糙度、适用于任意流向的改进混合维Stokes-Darcy模型，并证明了该模型弱解的存在性与唯一性；孔隙尺度全维解析模拟表明其在精度上优于现有混合维模型。
AI.conclusion: 该工作完善了混合维Stokes-Darcy建模框架，兼顾计算效率与物理准确性，为含粗糙壁面、任意流向的裂缝-基质流动问题提供了可靠且高效的工具。

title: A stochastic subgradient method with optimal failure exponent
summary: Fix a target accuracy $\varepsilon$, a gradient-noise level $s$, and a horizon $N$. We wish to design algorithms which minimize the probability of observing a suboptimality gap which exceeds the target accuracy, i.e., $\mathcal{E}_N = -\log \sup_{f,P} \mathbb{P}_P(f(x_A) - f_\star \ge \varepsilon)$, with the noise law $P$ known only to be sub-Gaussian. We single out a uniformly averaged schedule which is harmonic (of the form $h_k = R^2/(\varepsilon (N+m-k))$) and prove, via an optimized exponential supermartingale argument, that it attains the optimal exponent $\mathcal{E}_N^\star = \varepsilon^2 N (1+o(1))/(2R^2 s^2)$. Optimality is certified by a matching impossibility result: under Gaussian noise, a gradient-masking change of measure caps the exponent of every algorithm at the same leading order. In a small-noise limit, our setting degenerates into the adversarial-error model of Gösgens and van Parys (2025) for subgradient methods.

AI.tldr: 该文研究在仅有次高斯噪声假设下，通过设计步长调度来最小化观测到超过目标精度 ε 的次优性缺口的概率，给出调和型平均步长并证明其达到最优指数，且用匹配的不可能性结果认证最优性。
AI.motivation: 在许多随机优化场景中，噪声分布的真实规律未知，仅能假定为次高斯。相较于期望意义上的收敛速率，更关心的是“出现超过目标精度 ε 的次优性缺口”这一大偏差事件的发生概率。因此需要设计算法（尤其是步长调度）使该概率的指数衰减速率最大。
AI.method: 固定目标精度 ε、梯度噪声水平 s 与时间步 N，以 \mathcal{E}_N = -\log \sup_{f,P} \mathbb{P}_P(f(x_A) - f_\star \ge ε) 为优化目标，在噪声规律 P 仅知为次高斯的前提下，给出一种均匀平均的调和型调度（h_k = R^2/(ε(N+m-k))）。通过优化的指数上鞅论证证明其达到最优指数 \mathcal{E}_N^\star = ε^2 N (1+o(1))/(2R^2 s^2)。并用高斯噪声下的梯度掩蔽测度变换给出匹配的不可能性结果。
AI.result: 所提出的调和型平均调度达到最优指数 \mathcal{E}_N^\star = ε^2 N (1+o(1))/(2R^2 s^2)。匹配的不可能性结果证明：在高斯噪声下，通过梯度掩蔽的测度变换可将任意算法的指数上界限制在同一主阶，从而认证该调度的最优性。在小噪声极限下，该问题退化为 Gösgens 与 van Parys（2025）针对次梯度方法的对抗误差模型。
AI.conclusion: 该工作刻画了次高斯噪声下最小化超出目标精度的次优性缺口概率的最优指数，并给出实现该最优指数的调和型均匀平均调度，同时通过匹配下界证明其最优性；在小噪声极限下与已有对抗误差模型相衔接。

title: Scalable Diffusion SBI for Compositional Inference under Simulator Misspecification
summary: Simulation-based inference is challenging when many heterogeneous observations must be composed, hierarchical latent structure must be preserved, and the simulator is misspecified relative to observed data. We develop sampling and fine-tuning methods for diffusion-based inference in design-conditional settings, where the same simulator is queried across different experimental conditions $ξ$. We extend compositional score-based inference with a continuous-time diffusion coefficient that accounts for the number of observations, avoiding Jacobian and auxiliary-covariance corrections. We introduce Hierarchical Blockwise Diffusion Sampling (HBDS), which infers shared parameters and group-specific latent states using a single pretrained model, with the hierarchy specified only at sampling time. Together, these methods support variable observation sets and groupings without retraining. To address misspecification, we introduce path-regularized fine-tuning that adapts the learned likelihood to observations and transfers corrections to posterior inference. Using Girsanov's theorem, we quantify path divergence between pretrained and fine-tuned models across experimental designs and interpret it alongside predictive errors to distinguish candidate misspecification correction from unnecessary adaptation. We evaluate compositional sampling on exact-score Gaussian and Simple Likelihood, Complex Posterior benchmarks, HBDS with analytic and learned scores on a controlled hierarchical model, and fine-tuning and localization on a separate analytic model with known design-dependent discrepancy. Finally, we apply the framework to 940 measurements across four cell lines in a mechanistic Bone Morphogenetic Protein signaling model, where fine-tuning improves posterior-predictive accuracy relative to the pretrained model and shifts posterior marginals toward the least-squares reference while retaining spread.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出基于扩散模型的采样与微调方法，用于设计条件、含层次潜变量且存在模型误设的仿真推断问题。
AI.motivation: 仿真推断面临三大挑战：需组合大量异质观测、需保留层次潜变量结构、以及仿真器相对于真实观测存在误设。现有方法难以在无需重训练的情况下支持可变观测集与分组，也缺乏对误设的量化与修正手段。
AI.method: 1) 扩展组合式得分推断，引入考虑观测数量的连续时间扩散系数，避免Jacobian与辅助协方差修正；2) 提出层次块状扩散采样（HBDS），用单一预训练模型推断共享参数与组特定隐状态，层次仅在采样时指定；3) 提出路径正则化微调，使学习到的似然适配观测并将修正迁移至后验推断；4) 利用Girsanov定理量化预训练与微调模型在不同实验设计下的路径散度，并结合预测误差区分有效误设修正与不必要适配。
AI.result: 在精确得分高斯、Simple Likelihood与Complex Posterior基准上验证组合采样；在受控层次模型上用解析与学习得分验证HBDS；在具有已知设计依赖差异的解析模型上验证微调与定位；并应用于骨形态发生蛋白信号机制模型中的940个测量、四个细胞系，微调提升了后验预测精度，并使后验边缘向最小二乘参考偏移但保留离散度。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法可在不重训练的情况下支持可变观测集与分组，并能有效诊断与修正仿真器误设，在真实机制模型中提升了后验预测准确性与后验校准性。

title: TORQUE: Optimizing What (not) to Quantize Before and After Rotation
summary:
Uniform random rotations are an effective preprocessing step for quantization: they make normalized coordinate distributions approximately Gaussian, enabling the use of codebooks optimized offline. We introduce TORQUE, a framework that improves on previous quantization works that use random rotations by jointly optimizing how many and which coordinates to preserve at high precision both before and after rotation, under a fixed overall expected bit budget.
  Intuitively, before rotation, preserving large input coordinates at high precision can reduce overall error by preventing the rotation from spreading their values across many coordinates. Likewise, after rotation, preserving a small fraction of the largest-magnitude coordinates at high precision allows the remaining values to be quantized more accurately using codebooks optimized offline for the resulting truncated Gaussian distribution.
  We derive a quantization error upper bound and prove that top-$k$ pre-rotation retention minimizes it for each $k$. This reduces the search over coordinate subsets to an optimization over $k$, enabling a fast optimizer that uses offline codebooks and parallel parameter selection for practical implementation. We demonstrate an improved tradeoff between reconstruction accuracy and storage cost through numerical evaluation under the Gaussian model and experiments on nearest-neighbor retrieval, KV-cache compression, and activation compression.

AI.tldr: 提出TORQUE框架：在固定比特预算下，联合优化旋转前后保留哪些高精度坐标，提升均匀随机旋转量化的精度-存储折中。
AI.motivation: 均匀随机旋转虽能使归一化坐标分布近似高斯，从而使用离线优化码本，但现有工作未在固定比特预算下同时优化旋转前后高精度保留的坐标数量与具体坐标，导致旋转会扩散大值、增加量化误差。
AI.method: 推导量化误差上界，证明对每个k，旋转前top-k保留可最小化该上界，从而将坐标子集搜索降为对k的一维优化；据此设计快速优化器，采用离线码本与并行参数选择实现，联合优化旋转前与旋转后的高精度坐标保留策略。
AI.result: 在高斯模型下的数值评估以及最近邻检索、KV缓存压缩、激活压缩实验中，重建精度与存储成本之间的折中优于先前方法。
AI.conclusion: 在固定期望比特预算下联合优化旋转前后的高精度坐标保留，可有效降低量化误差，并在多种实际压缩与检索任务中实现更优的精度-存储权衡。

title: Optimal regularity of optimal transport and degenerations of convex cones
summary: If $T$ is an optimal transport map between bounded convex domains $Ω$ and $Ω'$, we characterize the regularity/singularity dichotomy for $DT$ at $(x,T(x)) \in \partial Ω\times \partial Ω'$. This is obtained through a new approach to the regularity theory based on affine degenerations of the tangent cones to $(Ω, Ω')$ at $(x,T(x))$. We formulate a general principle relating the optimal boundary regularity to a stability criterion and an $\mathrm{SL}(n)$ moduli space of pairs of convex cones. Among other results, we establish geometric criteria for existence and non-existence of homogeneous optimal transport maps between convex cones.

AI.tldr: 本文研究有界凸域间最优传输映射在边界点的正则性/奇异性二分，提出基于切锥仿射退化的新方法，并将边界正则性与稳定性判据及凸锥对的SL(n)模空间相联系。
AI.motivation: 刻画最优传输映射在边界处的正则与奇异行为是传输理论的核心问题，已有方法难以统一处理边界奇异性，本文旨在建立新的理论框架。
AI.method: 通过研究(Ω,Ω')在(x,T(x))处切锥的仿射退化，提出将最优边界正则性归约为稳定性判据与凸锥对的SL(n)模空间的总体原则。
AI.result: 建立了DT在边界点处正则性/奇异性的二分刻画，并给出凸锥间齐次最优传输映射存在与非存在的几何判据。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为最优传输边界正则性提供了统一视角，将正则性问题与模空间几何联系起来。

title: Greedy sign-based box splitting: exact solvable classes, sharp thresholds and order-oracle complexity
summary: Greedy box splitting reads gradient signs at the centre and retains one smaller box. Its summable travel budget makes an incorrect exclusion irreversible. We determine when this geometry is safe. Halving is minimax optimal in the sign-vector oracle model on a coordinatewise sign-consistent class that need not be convex. A dimensionless sign defect yields a sharp scalar envelope, attained by one smooth convex potential; a three-dimensional trajectory ends farther from the target than its initial radius. For quadratics, universal convergence with aspect $w$ and contraction beta holds exactly when the weighted absolute row defect is at most $(2 β- 1)$. Perron weights minimise this defect. Adaptive half-sizes avoid initial enlargement and, under persistent error, converge to an exact capped fixed-point limit. For binary comparisons, an independent probe fraction $q$ permits universal localisation on common-target monotone sections exactly when $(q \leq 2 β- 1)$; coupled probes give the sharp threshold $2/3$. Matching information bounds distinguish comparisons from sign-vector queries. Error bands give finite-time guarantees and sharp residual floors. Extensions and reproducible experiments identify the assumptions and costs of freezing, smoothing, voting, multistart and random-matrix certificates.

AI.tldr: 本文研究"贪心盒分割"（通过在中心读取梯度符号并保留一个更小的盒）这一几何过程的安全性条件，给出其极小极大最优性与精确阈值。
AI.motivation: 贪心盒分割的累计行程预算有限，导致一次错误的排除不可逆，因此需要确定该几何方法在何种条件下是安全的。
AI.method: 在符号向量预言机模型下，针对无需凸性的逐坐标符号一致类证明折半为极小极大最优；引入无量纲符号缺陷，导出精确标量包络（由单一光滑凸势取得）；对二次函数给出普适收敛与收缩系数 β 的充要条件，并给出 Perron 权重最优性；分析自适应半尺寸、独立/耦合探测比例的定位阈值；给出匹配的信息界与误差带有限时间保证。
AI.result: 存在三维轨迹其终点到目标的距离大于初始半径；二次函数普适收敛与收缩 β 当且仅当加权绝对行缺陷不超过 (2β−1)；独立探测比例 q 的普适定位条件为 q ≤ 2β−1，耦合探测的精确阈值为 2/3；误差带给出有限时间保证与精确的残差下界。
AI.conclusion: 研究刻画了贪心盒分割的安全性边界，并通过扩展与可复现实验识别了冻结、平滑、投票、多起点与随机矩阵证书等方法的假设与代价。

title: Iterative Exact Discrete Guidance for Energy-Based Sampling
summary: Sampling from unnormalized distributions over large discrete state spaces becomes difficult when a multimodal target is far from a tractable reference. We introduce Iterative Exact Discrete Guidance (IEDG), a population-exact, trajectory-wise guidance framework for unnormalized discrete targets. Rather than learn the full reference-to-target correction in one step, IEDG introduces a global Boltzmann tilt along an annealing trajectory. Each stage learns a stage-local posterior correction for an incremental Boltzmann tilt of the current source, while the resulting corrections are accumulated relative to a fixed analytic posterior. At the population optimum, exact stage posteriors recover the correct reverse dynamics, whose exact simulation reproduces the target distribution. IEDG chooses stage increments by relative effective sample size (rESS), which controls Rényi-2 displacement and locally adapts the step size to the thermodynamic geometry of the annealing path. Our stagewise total-variation analysis shows that limited overlap amplifies Bregman fitting error by $1/\sqrt{\mathrm{rESS}}$, while posterior, simulation, and truncation errors enter additively. IEDG improves all distribution-level errors over the neural baselines on ordered, exactly enumerated Ising $4\times4$, while substantially reducing one-shot errors on Ising/Potts $16\times16$ across thermodynamic regimes and attaining the best neural-sampler result on several reported local-statistic and phase-coverage metrics. On Max-Cut, its best-of-512 and average-sample ratios exceed all the baselines. Code and artifacts are available at https://github.com/StillFantasy123/iterative-exact-discrete-guidance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出沿退火轨迹引入全局玻尔兹曼倾斜的种群精确、逐轨迹引导框架，实现未归一化离散分布的采样。
AI.motivation: 当多模态目标分布远离易处理的参考分布时，从大离散状态空间上的未归一化分布采样十分困难。
AI.method: IEDG 不一步学习完整的参考到目标校正，而是沿退火轨迹引入全局玻尔兹曼倾斜，每阶段学习当前源分布增量倾斜的局部后验校正，并将校正相对固定解析后验累积；阶段增量由相对有效样本量 (rESS) 选择，控制 Rényi-2 位移并局部自适应步长。
AI.result: 在4×4 Ising 上优于神经基线；在16×16 Ising/Potts 上显著降低单步误差；在 Max-Cut 上 best-of-512 与平均样本比均超过所有基线。
AI.conclusion: IEDG 在种群最优处可精确恢复逆向动力学并重现目标分布，阶段增量由 rESS 控制可自适应热力学几何。

title: Neural networks for spectral optimization
summary: Given a functional dependent on the spectrum of a differential operator, we address the problem of finding a domain which optimizes this functional. PDE solvers might be used to tackle this optimization. It is however computationally expensive. We propose two neural network models which learn the spectrum directly from the geometry of the domain and can be used to optimize the domain from one or more eigenvalues. We investigate two representations. The first encodes the domain through Fourier coefficients and a light MLP, which is efficient on star-shaped geometries, achieving a precision of 0.2\%. Through a rescaling of the coefficients the designed models satisfy the scaling law of the eigenvalues. Additionally, averaging the outputs of the trained surrogates over rotations and reflections induces invariance for these transformations. The second is a model that takes the landscape function, the indicator function and the gradient of the landscape function. A Gram-Schmidt process produces orthogonal eigenfunctions as output of the model along with the associated eigenvalues. The landscape model reaches 1\% mean relative error on the first ten eigenvalues, compared with 4\% for an FNO model. Replacing the landscape by an SDF worsened both prediction and optimization errors. The trained model also generalizes from synthetic shapes to domains given as classical image dataset. The resulting surrogates of both approaches recover classical spectral optima such as the disk for the first eigenvalue or the conjectured minima of higher eigenvalues. This confirms that our models produce accurate differentiable estimates of eigenvalues, which can be used in shape optimization problems involving spectral quantities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出两种从区域几何直接预测拉普拉斯特征值的神经网络代理模型（傅里叶系数+MLP、landscape function模型），实现可微、高精度的谱估计并用于形状优化。
AI.motivation: 求解依赖微分算子谱的泛函优化问题需反复调用PDE求解器，计算代价高昂；因此需要能从区域几何直接、快速、可微地估计特征值的代理模型，以支撑谱形状优化。
AI.method: 提出两种神经网络模型：(1) 以傅里叶系数编码区域，配合轻量MLP；通过对系数重缩放满足特征值缩放律，并对输出在旋转与反射上平均以获得不变性；(2) 输入为landscape function、指示函数及其梯度，经Gram-Schmidt正交化输出正交特征函数及对应特征值。与FNO模型对比，并测试以SDF替换landscape的效果。
AI.result: 傅里叶+MLP模型在星形几何上精度达0.2%；landscape模型对前十个特征值的平均相对误差为1%，优于FNO的4%；用SDF替换landscape会同时恶化预测与优化误差；模型可从合成形状泛化到经典图像数据集区域。
AI.conclusion: 两种代理模型均能恢复经典谱最优解（第一特征值对应圆盘、更高特征值的猜想极小值），表明其可提供准确且可微的特征值估计，适用于涉及谱量的形状优化问题。

title: Finite-Time Vanishing of Vacuum and Large-Time Behavior of the Multi-Dimensional Degenerate Compressible Navier-Stokes Equations with Large Spherically Symmetric Initial Data
summary: In this paper, we study the two- and three-dimensional barotropic compressible Navier-Stokes equations with degenerate density-dependent viscosity coefficients in the whole space or in a ball for arbitrarily large spherically symmetric initial data. For initial data allowing vacuum, we establish the global existence of weak solutions and derive uniform-in-time a priori estimates. As a consequence, we prove that the vacuum state of weak solutions will vanish in finite time. The key ingredients include a treatment of the pressure terms based on separate estimates in the low- and high-density regions, the Bresch-Desjardins entropy estimates, weighted radial estimates, and a coupled control of the velocity and effective velocity. In the three-dimensional case, this approach also allows us to treat the endpoint case of the adiabatic exponent. For sufficiently regular initial data with strictly positive density, we establish the global existence and large-time behavior of classical solutions.
