AI.tldr: 研究含退化密度依赖黏性系数的正压可压缩Navier-Stokes方程，在全空间或球域中针对大球对称初值，建立弱解的整体存在性、一致先验估计及真空消失，并在三维端点绝热指数情形下处理；对严格正密度的正则初值，给出经典解整体存在性与大时间行为。
AI.motivation: 可压缩Navier-Stokes方程在黏性系数依赖密度且允许真空退化时，弱解的整体适定性与真空演化（尤其大初值、球对称、三维端点绝热指数）尚缺乏统一处理；本文旨在填补这些情形下的整体存在性与大时间行为空白。
AI.method: 对压强项按低/高密度区域分别估计；采用Bresch-Desjardins熵估计、加权径向估计，以及对速度与有效速度的耦合控制；三维中进一步覆盖绝热指数端点情形。
AI.result: 证明弱解整体存在并得到时间一致先验估计；推出弱解真空状态在有限时间内消失；三维端点绝热指数可处理；对足够正则且密度严格正的初值，建立经典解整体存在性与大时间行为。
AI.conclusion: 该框架统一处理了退化密度依赖黏性系数下大球对称初值的可压缩Navier-Stokes方程，给出弱解整体存在、真空有限时间消失及经典解大时间行为，并覆盖三维端点绝热指数。

title: A Two-Stage Stochastic Facility Location Problem with Endogenous Demand Learning
summary: In facility location problems, planners can reduce demand uncertainty by collecting data, but these actions are costly. In this paper, we ask how a planner should jointly decide where to open facilities and invest in demand learning, which comes with a cost. The challenge is that learning changes how future random costs should be evaluated, creating a model that is both endogenous and nonlinear in location decisions. We model this problem within a two-stage stochastic framework, where both location and learning decisions have to be made here-and-now. Under some mild assumptions, we obtain a closed-form reformulation, which further enables a theoretical analysis of the sensitivity of learning decisions to model parameters and design of convergent solution algorithms that alternate between updating location and learning decisions. Numerical experiments on benchmark instances show that learning is most valuable when initial demand uncertainty is high, learning is effective, and learning costs are low. Moreover, the proposed solution algorithms find high-quality solutions much faster than exhaustive search and a standard commercial nonlinear solver. These findings show how information-acquisition decisions can be built directly into strategic facility planning. They help decision makers target limited learning resources where better demand information has the greatest value.

AI.tldr: 本文研究设施选址中选址与需求学习投资的联合决策问题，在二阶段随机规划框架下给出闭式重构，并设计收敛算法，验证学习的价值条件及算法高效性。
AI.motivation: 规划者可通过收集数据降低需求不确定性，但学习行为成本高昂，且学习会改变未来随机成本的评估方式，使模型在选址决策上具有内生性和非线性，因此需要明确如何联合决策选址与学习投资。
AI.method: 采用二阶段随机规划框架，将选址与学习决策均设为here-and-now决策；在温和假设下推导闭式重构，分析学习决策对模型参数的敏感性，并设计在选址与学习决策之间交替更新的收敛型求解算法。
AI.result: 基准算例数值实验表明：当初始需求不确定性高、学习有效且学习成本低时，学习最具价值；所提算法在解质量上优于穷举搜索和标准商业非线性求解器，且求解速度显著更快。
AI.conclusion: 研究展示了如何将信息获取决策直接纳入战略性设施规划，帮助决策者把有限的学习资源配置到需求信息价值最高的环节。

title: Identifying ODEs from Unstructured Data with Causal Representation Learning
summary: We study the problem of recovering the governing ODE of a dynamical system from unstructured, high-dimensional observations such as images. Existing methods for ODE discovery typically assume direct measurements of the variables, or do not provide theoretical guarantees on the learned variables and equations. While Causal Representation Learning (CRL) methods provide guarantees on identifying variables from high-dimensional observations up to component-wise diffeomorphisms, we show that in general these variables cannot be used directly as input to equation discovery methods, which typically assume that the variables will lead to sparse equations. So we introduce SParse Equivalent Equation Discovery AutoEncoder (SPEED-AE), a framework that combines a pretrained CRL method with a component-wise autoencoder that learns transformations of variables that are amenable to sparse ODE discovery. We show that for polynomial ODEs, this additional step allows us to restrict the identifiability of each variable from polynomial to monomial diffeomorphisms. Experiments on Lotka-Volterra, Lorenz, and a two-pendulum system show that SPEED-AE improves on the disentanglement of the CRL methods and that it recovers ODEs that are closest to the ground truth, while achieving state-of-the-art forecasting performance.

AI.tldr: 提出SPEED-AE框架，将预训练因果表示学习与逐分量自编码器结合，学习适合稀疏ODE发现的变量变换，可从高维图像观测中恢复动力学系统的控制ODE。
AI.motivation: 现有ODE发现方法通常假设可直测变量或无理论保证；CRL方法虽能识别变量，但仅到逐分量微分同胚，这些变量无法直接用于方程发现（后者假设变量能产生稀疏方程）。
AI.method: SPEED-AE：预训练CRL方法 + 逐分量自编码器，学习使变量变换适配稀疏ODE发现；对多项式ODE，可把每个变量的可识别性从多项式微分同胚收紧到单项式微分同胚。
AI.result: 在Lotka-Volterra、Lorenz和双摆系统上，SPEED-AE改善了CRL方法的解耦性，恢复的ODE最接近真值，并达到最优预测性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入额外变换学习步骤，SPEED-AE弥合了CRL识别变量与稀疏方程发现之间的差距，为高维观测下的ODE恢复提供了理论与实验支持。

title: Improving scalable oversight with co-trained monitors
summary: Worker-monitor setups are a promising approach to AI oversight, but training workers against fixed monitors can incentivize monitor evasion. We study whether this failure mode can be avoided by co-training the monitor alongside the worker, and explore both supervised and self-supervised approaches. In the supervised setting, we prove a characterization: monitoring is possible with vanishing error and query rates exactly when the class of possible monitor functions has finite Littlestone dimension. This connects worker monitoring with an established literature on adversarial online learning. For self-supervision, we propose a co-training procedure based on test-time distillation: the monitor uses additional test-time compute to generate training labels, then trains its standard-compute policy on those labels. For majority-vote labels, we give a finite-sample sharpening guarantee under adaptive worker distributions with action coverage, that shows that the monitor's verdicts converge to its initial modal verdicts. We stress-test the former in code-security settings where the worker is trained adversarially to fool the monitor. Our results suggest that adaptive monitors are better at keeping pace with evolving worker strategies, while fixed monitors are more vulnerable to evasion.

AI.tldr: 研究worker-monitor监督设置中固定监控器易被规避的问题，提出协同训练监控器，分别给出监督学习下的Littlestone维刻画与自监督下的测试时蒸馏方法及样本复杂度保证。
AI.motivation: worker-monitor设置是AI监督的有前景方案，但用固定监控器训练worker会产生规避监控的激励，需要研究协同训练监控器能否避免这一失效模式。
AI.method: 监督设置下证明：当且仅当可能监控函数类具有有限Littlestone维时，监控可实现误差与查询率趋于零；自监督设置下提出基于测试时蒸馏的协同训练流程——监控器利用额外测试时算力生成训练标签，再在其标准算力策略上训练这些标签；对多数投票标签，在自适应worker分布与动作覆盖条件下给出有限样本锐化保证。
AI.result: 监督设置建立了worker监控与对抗在线学习文献的联系；自监督下证明监控器的判定收敛于其初始模态判定；在代码安全场景中（worker被对抗训练以欺骗监控器）进行压力测试，结果表明自适应监控器更能跟上演化的worker策略，而固定监控器更易被规避。
AI.conclusion: 协同训练监控器可避免监控规避的失效模式，自适应监控优于固定监控，为AI监督提供理论与实践支持。

title: Boundary Layers and Initial-Boundary Corner Asymptotics for the 2D Navier-Stokes Equations with Vanishing Vertical Viscosity
summary: Motivated by anisotropic viscosity in geophysical fluid dynamics, where vertical momentum diffusion is often much weaker than horizontal diffusion and may be negligible in the interior yet remains essential near a solid wall, we study the vanishing vertical viscosity limit for the two-dimensional incompressible Navier--Stokes equations in the upper half-plane, with horizontal viscosity fixed at one and vertical viscosity \(\varepsilon^2\). For arbitrary divergence-free \(H^4\) no-slip initial data, with no time-differentiated compatibility conditions required, we construct the limiting horizontally viscous flow and the boundary-layer profiles on every prescribed finite interval \([0,T]\). The leading-order corrected approximation has \(O(\varepsilon)\) error in \(L^\infty\), and the full finite-order expansion reduces this error to \(O(\varepsilon^{3/2})\), uniformly down to \(t=0\). We further describe the development of the layer from data that vanish initially at the wall. At the initial--boundary corner, we determine the first two self-similar coefficients and characterize matching through exact profile tails, thereby separating the fixed-time scale \(\varepsilon\) from the short-time scale \(\varepsilon\sqrt t\). When the initial wall acceleration is nonzero, both the leading correction rate and the first normalized corner remainder are sharp. Finally, continuity estimates for fixed data yield joint small-time and small-viscosity limits for the exact solution, as well as finite-\(L^p\) asymptotics.

AI.tldr: 研究上半平面二维不可压缩Navier–Stokes方程在垂直粘性趋于零（\(\varepsilon^2\to0\)）、水平粘性固定为1时的消失垂直粘性极限。对任意的无散度\(H^4\)无滑移初值（无需时间求导的相容性条件），在任意有限时间区间\([0,T]\)上构造极限水平粘性流及边界层剖面：一阶修正逼近的\(L^\infty\)误差为\(O(\varepsilon)\)，完整有限阶展开将误差降至\(O(\varepsilon^{3/2})\)且一致到\(t=0\)。论文还刻画了初始在壁面消失的数据所诱导的层发展，在初始—边界角点确定前两个自相似系数，并用精确剖面尾部刻画匹配，从而区分固定时间尺度\(\varepsilon\)与短时间尺度\(\varepsilon\sqrt{t}\)；当初始壁面加速度非零时，一阶修正速率与首个归一化角点余项均为尖锐的。固定数据的连续性估计给出精确解在小时间与小微性下的联合极限及有限\(L^p\)渐近。
AI.motivation: 地球物理流体动力学中粘性常呈各向异性：垂直动量扩散远弱于水平扩散，在流体内部可忽略，但在固壁附近仍至关重要。这一物理背景促使研究水平粘性固定、垂直粘性趋于零的二维不可压缩Navier–Stokes方程的消失垂直粘性极限，以刻画内部水平粘性流与近壁边界层之间的相互作用。
AI.method: 在上半平面考察水平粘性为1、垂直粘性为\(\varepsilon^2\)的二维不可压缩Navier–Stokes方程。对任意无散度\(H^4\)无滑移初值（不要求含时间导数的相容性条件），构造极限水平粘性流及边界层剖面，给出有限阶渐近展开。在初始—边界角点利用自相似结构确定前两个自相似系数，并以精确剖面尾部刻画内外匹配，区分固定时间尺度\(\varepsilon\)与短时间尺度\(\varepsilon\sqrt{t}\)；对非零初始壁面加速度证明修正速率与角点余项的尖锐性，并用连续性估计导出联合极限与有限\(L^p\)渐近。
AI.result: 对任意有限区间\([0,T]\)及任意无散度\(H^4\)无滑移初值，构造出极限水平粘性流与边界层剖面：一阶修正逼近在\(L^\infty\)中误差为\(O(\varepsilon)\)，完整有限阶展开将误差降至\(O(\varepsilon^{3/2})\)，且一致到\(t=0\)。刻画了初始在壁面消失时层的发展，确定角点处前两个自相似系数并实现精确尾部匹配。当初始壁面加速度非零时，一阶修正速率与首个归一化角点余项均为尖锐。固定数据的连续性估计给出联合小时间与小微性极限及有限\(L^p\)渐近。
AI.conclusion: 该工作严格建立了各向异性粘性下二维Navier–Stokes方程消失垂直粘性极限的边界层理论，无需时间求导相容性条件即可在有限时间上构造高阶一致逼近，并揭示了初始—边界角点的自相似结构与尖锐误差速率，为理解地球物理流中内部水平粘性与近壁层耦合提供了数学基础。

title: A Spatial Benders Algorithm for Delay Constrained Routing
summary: We study the Delay Constrained Routing (DCR) problem arising in IP computer networks to support high bandwidth applications. The goal is to route IP packets, from source to destination, subject to quality of service constraints -- in particular, bounding the worst case delay -- while minimizing the total allocated bandwidth in the network. DCR can be formulated as a Mixed-Integer Second-Order Cone Program, and solved using standard solvers; while generally efficient, this hinges on off-the-shelf tools and does not scale to large instances. We devise a solver-free bespoke approach that uses nested Benders-Lagrange, namely, a double decomposition approach that exploits the special structure of the problem. In particular, we use a nonconvex nonlinear formulation of the problem, that results in a nonconvex Benders value function whose optimization we tackle with a bespoke Spatial Branch-and-Bound approach using custom piecewise-convex cuts. We show that our approach provides very tight upper and lower bounds in competitive running times w.r.t. previous state-of-the-art approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文研究IP网络中的时延约束路由(DCR)问题，提出一种无需通用求解器的嵌套Benders-Lagrange双层分解方法，通过定制空间分支定界与分段凸割处理非凸Benders值函数，在竞争性时间内获得紧的上下界。
AI.motivation: DCR问题旨在满足时延等QoS约束的同时最小化全网带宽分配，可建模为混合整数二阶锥规划并用标准求解器求解，但依赖现成工具且难以扩展到大规模实例，因此需要一种可扩展的定制化方法。
AI.method: 将DCR构建为非凸非线性形式，采用嵌套Benders-Lagrange的双重分解策略利用问题特殊结构；针对由此产生的非凸Benders值函数，设计定制化空间分支定界算法，并使用定制的分段凸割。
AI.result: 该方法能给出非常紧的上界与下界，且相较于此前最先进方法具有有竞争力的运行时间。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的无求解器定制分解算法有效求解DCR问题，在解质量与计算效率上均具备优势。

title: Interpretable intrinsic dimension estimation through componentwise calibration of distance and angle
summary: DANCo (Dimensionality from Angle and Norm Concentration) jointly calibrates nearest-neighbor distance and angular statistics and consistently reaches state-of-the-art accuracy on clean intrinsic-dimension (ID) benchmarks. Practical data, however, introduce neighborhood-relative noise and sample-amplitude heterogeneity that can distort these geometric signals. We reformulate DANCo componentwise, retaining separate distance and angular discrepancy curves so that the source of an estimate can be identified and interpreted. For the distance component, we derive a closed-form Kullback-Leibler divergence for the generic-order ratios of the generalized ratios ID estimator (Gride); when both angular parameters are matched (Full), Gride reduces mean percentage error from $27.7\%$ to $17.6\%$ at noise equal to $40\%$ of typical neighbor spacing on 24 manifolds. For the angular component, two sampling regimes motivate aligning mean direction while retaining concentration matching (Profiled). On a Gaussian scale mixture with generating dimension 70 embedded in 100 dimensions, profiling raises the Minimum Neighbor Distance (MiND) estimate from $22.8$ to $66.7$, while removing the known amplitudes restores MiND-Full to $71.9$; the control thus attributes the Full shortfall to amplitude heterogeneity. On CIFAR-10 and ImageNet, amplitude-reducing normalizations move angular location toward the references and narrow the Full-Profiled gap, an observational counterpart to the controlled mixture. Across four pretrained convolutional neural networks, Gride-Profiled, the two-nearest-neighbor estimator (TWO-NN), and the maximum-likelihood estimator (MLE) exhibit similar rise-and-fall profiles, while Full-Profiled differences identify the layers most sensitive to angular calibration.

AI.tldr: 该文将DANCo按分量重构，分别保留距离与角度差异曲线，以识别估计来源并提升噪声与幅度异质条件下的内在维度估计精度。
AI.motivation: DANCo虽在干净ID基准上达到最优，但实际数据存在邻域相对噪声与样本幅度异质性，会扭曲其几何信号，且原方法混合校准距离与角度统计，难以溯源误差来源。
AI.method: 对DANCo进行分量式重构：距离分量推导广义比值ID估计器Gride通用阶比值的闭式KL散度；角度分量针对两种采样情形，提出在匹配均值方向的同时保留浓度匹配的Profiled方案，并在高斯尺度混合、CIFAR-10/ImageNet及四个预训练CNN上验证。
AI.result: 在24个流形、噪声为典型邻居间距40%时，Full方案将Gride平均百分比误差从27.7%降至17.6%；70维嵌入100维高斯尺度混合中，Profiling将MiND从22.8提升至66.7，去除已知幅度后MiND-Full恢复至71.9；真实数据上幅度归一化缩小Full-Profiled差距；Gride-Profiled、TWO-NN与MLE呈相似升降曲线。
AI.conclusion: 分量式重构可定位并解释ID估计偏差来源，证实幅度异质性是Full估计不足的主因，Profiled角度校准在噪声与异质条件下更稳健，并可用于识别对角度校准敏感的层。

title: ABC: Advantage-Based Control Variates for Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards
summary: Recent progress in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has highlighted the effectiveness of simple critic-free policy-gradient methods such as Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). In contrast, actor-critic methods rely on learned value functions whose approximation error can introduce bias through commonly used advantage estimators such as temporal-difference error. Motivated by this observation, we revisit trajectory-level control variates through an advantage-value formulation, which we call Advantage-Based Control Variates (ABC). This formulation reveals that the covariance structure is closely related to the return decomposition used in Direct Advantage Estimation (DAE). Finally, we combine ABC with DAE into a single actor-critic algorithm and evaluate it in an offline-to-online RLVR setting, where the critic is first trained on previously collected trajectories and adapted during online learning. On mathematical reasoning tasks, ABC achieves performance competitive with GRPO using substantially fewer online optimization steps.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Advantage-Based Control Variates (ABC) 框架，通过 advantage-value 形式重新审视轨迹级控制变量，揭示其协方差结构与 Direct Advantage Estimation (DAE) 的回报分解密切相关，并将 ABC 与 DAE 结合为单一 actor-critic 算法。在 RLVR 离线到在线设置下，该方法在数学推理任务上以显著更少的在线优化步骤达到与 GRPO 相当的性能。
AI.motivation: RLVR 中无评论家的策略梯度方法（如 GRPO）表现高效，而 actor-critic 方法依赖学习价值函数，其近似误差会通过 TD 误差等优势估计器引入偏差。作者希望重新审视轨迹级控制变量，以缓解价值函数近似误差带来的偏差问题。
AI.method: 提出 Advantage-Based Control Variates (ABC) 的 advantage-value 形式，用于分析轨迹级控制变量；揭示其协方差结构与 DAE 中回报分解的关联；将 ABC 与 DAE 结合为单一 actor-critic 算法；在 offline-to-online RLVR 设置中先离线训练评论家、再在线适应。
AI.result: 在数学推理任务上，ABC 使用显著更少的在线优化步骤即达到与 GRPO 相当的性能。
AI.conclusion: 轨迹级控制变量可通过 advantage-value 形式统一理解，并与 DAE 的回报分解相衔接；ABC+DAE 的 actor-critic 算法在离线到在线 RLVR 场景中具有更高的样本/优化效率。

title: Weak solvability of a nonlinear Boussinesq groundwater flow model with mixed boundary conditions: the Moche CHAVIMOCHIC aquifer
summary: We prove weak solvability for a two dimensional nonlinear Boussinesq type groundwaterflow problem motivated by the Moche CHAVIMOCHIC aquifer in northern Peru. The model couples state dependent storage and transmissivity with a boundary decomposition into Dirichlet, Neumann, and nonlinear Robin parts dictated by the hydrogeological geometry. In contrast with much of the groundwater Boussinesq literature, which is devoted to exact, similarity, perturbative, semi-analytical, or linearized solutions for special geometries and boundary data, our objective is a variational existence result for a genuinely two-dimensional mixed-boundary problem. Because the physical transmissivity is proportional to the saturated thickness, the equation degenerates at local depletion. We therefore isolate a physically admissible saturated range and construct uniformly positive extensions of the constitutive laws. For the resulting uniformly parabolic problem, existence of a weak solution is obtained through an implicit Euler Rothe scheme, a nonlinear energy adapted to the storage law, uniform estimates for the discrete derivative of the storage potential, discrete compactness, and strong convergence of boundary traces. We then give a precise consistency statement showing when the abstract solution solves the original Moche model and identify the fully depleted regime as a distinct porous medium type problem.

AI.tldr: 该文为一类二维非线性 Boussinesq 型地下水流动问题建立了弱可解性，模型源于秘鲁北部 Moche CHAVIMOCHIC 含水层，采用变分方法处理退化与混合边界。
AI.motivation: 现有地下水 Boussinesq 文献多针对特殊几何与边界数据给出精确解、相似解、摄动解、半解析解或线性化解，缺少面向真实二维混合边界问题的变分存在性结果；且物理导水系数与饱和厚度成正比，方程在局部枯竭时退化，需在物理允许饱和范围内处理。
AI.method: 将状态依赖的储水与导水系数同 Dirichlet、Neumann 及非线性 Robin 边界分解相耦合；选取物理允许饱和区间并构造本构律的一致正延拓，得到一致抛物问题；采用隐式 Euler-Rothe 格式、适配储水律的非线性能量、储水势离散导数的均匀估计、离散紧性以及边界迹的强收敛来证明弱解存在性。
AI.result: 在一致抛物近似问题上获得弱解存在性，并给出精确的一致性陈述，说明抽象解在何种条件下求解原始 Moche 模型；同时识别出完全枯竭情形对应一类不同的多孔介质型问题。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为真实二维混合边界、退化 Boussinesq 型地下水流动问题提供了变分存在性框架，并厘清了抽象解与原模型及完全枯竭退化问题之间的关系。

title: Common Optimal Supports and Bottleneck Hierarchies in Truncated Cones
summary: {Let \(K\subseteq\mathbb R_+^E\) be a closed convex cone and \(P=K\cap[0,1]^E\). For a linear objective with positive optimum, we study the intersection of the coordinate supports of all optimal solutions.} We prove that this common support is a transversal of a natural clutter associated with the positive directions of the cone and introduce a decreasing hierarchy of bottleneck families that stabilizes after at most \(|E|-1\) levels. In the polyhedral setting, the first level consists exactly of the sets carrying feasible upper-bound dual multipliers, while every set carrying an optimal multiplier belongs to the stabilized family. {The breadth of the join-semilattice generated under union by the zero sets of the nonzero vertices gives an objective-independent upper bound on the universal stabilization depth;} this bound is exact for simplicial truncations. Every possible depth occurs, and the \(|E|-1\) bound is sharp. Membership in the second level is co-NP-complete and fixed-parameter tractable in the size of the candidate bottleneck. Under upper-box-integrality and the integer decomposition property, the hierarchy collapses at level two, and its stabilized members are exactly the carriers of optimal upper-bound multipliers. When \(P\) is integral, the common optimal support is the union of the supports of all optimal dual solutions. Applications include bipartite matchings, maximum-order cycle subdigraphs, binary circulations, balanced hypergraph matchings, interval hypergraphs, and maximum-weight closures.

AI.tldr: 该文研究线性目标下多面体最优解公共支撑的结构，证明其与锥正向clutter的横截关系，并引入在至多|E|-1层稳定的瓶颈族递降层级。
AI.motivation: 研究正最优线性目标下，所有最优解坐标支撑的交集（公共支撑）的结构刻画问题，揭示其与锥的正方向、对偶乘子之间的关系。
AI.method: 对闭凸锥K与P=K∩[0,1]^E，构造与锥正方向相关的自然clutter，引入递降的瓶颈族层级，证明至多|E|-1层稳定；利用多面体对偶的可行/最优上界乘子刻画层级成员；以非零顶点零集的并生成join-半格的宽度给出目标无关的稳定深度上界。
AI.result: 公共支撑是该clutter的横截；第一层恰为承载可行上界乘子的集合，最优乘子的集合落在稳定族中；稳定深度上界对单纯形截断精确；所有深度均可达且|E|-1界紧；第二层成员判定为co-NP完全且对候选瓶颈规模固定参数可解；在上盒整性与整数分解性质下层级在第二层塌缩，稳定成员恰为最优上界乘子的载体；P整时公共最优支撑等于所有最优对偶解支撑之并。
AI.conclusion: 该框架统一刻画了最优解公共支撑的瓶颈结构，给出目标无关的稳定深度上界与精确紧性，并推广至二分匹配、最大阶环子有向图、二元环流、平衡超图匹配、区间超图、最大权闭包等应用。

title: Pointwise or Pairwise: When Do Pairwise Losses Help Reward Learning, Provably?
comment: 58 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables; second through sixth authors contributed equally
summary: Pairwise losses are increasingly used for reward learning even when pointwise rewards are observed, with mixed empirical results. When and why do pairwise losses outperform pointwise losses? We study this question in a grouped offline contextual-bandit setting allowing multiple actions per context, capturing many reward learning scenarios. We compare Value Regression (VR), which regresses observed rewards pointwise, with Value Difference Regression (VDR), which regresses reward differences between a pair of actions sampled under the same context. We consider a semiparametric model where the mean reward is the sum of a learnable action-dependent component and an arbitrary context-dependent yet action-independent nuisance, capturing context-specific disturbances. Using a unified localized analysis, we prove finite-sample regression guarantees for finite and linear function classes and translate them into offline-regret bounds. For finite classes, VDR eliminates the misspecification term in the VR bound and improves a reward-scale-dependent error term by averaging over actions within each context, a benefit absent from the corresponding VR term. For linear classes, neither method uniformly dominates: within-context differencing removes nuisance-induced bias but may increase estimation variance relative to using absolute rewards when the misspecification is sufficiently low. This yields a feature geometry-dependent bias-variance tradeoff, which we corroborate with numerical experiments.

AI.tldr: 本文在分组离线上下文赌博机设置下，理论比较逐点损失（VR）与成对损失（VDR），证明两者优势取决于函数类与特征几何：有限类下VDR消除误设项并改善奖励尺度相关误差，线性类下二者不存在一致占优，呈偏置-方差权衡。
AI.motivation: 成对损失在奖励学习中应用渐广，但在可观测逐点奖励时其经验表现参差不齐，缺乏理论解释"何时、为何"成对损失优于逐点损失。作者试图在贴近现实的学习场景中厘清这一现象。
AI.method: 在允许每个上下文有多个动作的分组离线上下文赌博机设定下，比较值回归（VR，逐点回归观测奖励）与值差回归（VDR，回归同上下文下采样动作对的奖励差）。采用半参数模型：均值奖励 = 可学习的动作相关分量 + 任意的上下文相关但动作无关的干扰项。通过统一的局部化分析，为有限函数类与线性函数类证明有限样本回归保证，并转化为离线遗憾界。
AI.result: 对有限类：VDR消除VR界中的误设项，并通过对同一上下文内多动作求平均改善一个依赖奖励尺度的误差项，而VR无此收益。对线性类：两法均非一致占优——上下文内差分消除干扰引起的偏置，但当误设足够低时可能增大估计方差（相对使用绝对奖励），形成依赖特征几何的偏置-方差权衡；数值实验印证该结论。
AI.conclusion: 成对损失与逐点损失的优劣并无普适答案，取决于函数类结构与特征几何：有限类下VDR具明确理论优势，线性类下则表现为偏置-方差权衡。研究为奖励学习中选择损失形式提供了理论依据。

title: Introducing the CZAR Loss: A Tailored Objective Function for Financial Log-Return Predictions
comment: 22 pages, 12 figures, 2 tables; appeared in ADI (September 2026)
summary: In quantitative finance, standard regression losses are misaligned with the economics of return prediction. As the conditional mean of financial log-returns is close to zero, symmetric losses such as the mean squared and mean absolute errors make the constant zero forecast a near-optimal solution, penalizing models with genuine but noisy directional skill. This applies both during training, where predictions shrink toward zero, and during evaluation, where trivial forecasters can lead loss-based rankings. Under a Gaussian linear prediction model, we show that all symmetric monotonic losses share a universal breakeven directional accuracy against the zero predictor, which rises sharply and becomes unobtainable as the prediction noise approaches the standard deviation of the returns. We introduce the CZAR (Composite Zero-Agnostic Return) loss function, a piecewise quadratic loss built around five key requirements: convexity in the prediction, asymmetry with true return direction that vanishes at zero, near-linear penalization of undershoots and wrong-direction predictions, divergence for large errors, and an adaptive loss floor for evaluation. CZAR is provably convex in the prediction at fixed true value, has closed-form gradient and Hessian suitable for custom objectives in gradient-boosted libraries, and its four hyperparameters reduce to a single choice through correlated defaults. In idealized tests, the minimum directional accuracy required for a CZAR-evaluated forecaster to outperform the zero predictor under mean log loss remains near the 50% chance level, whereas the corresponding threshold for symmetric losses rises sharply with prediction noise. This advantage persists under heavy-tailed return distributions. In a LightGBM experiment on intraday BTC log-returns, CZAR-trained models reduce the `zero-returns bias' and improve directional accuracy on large-magnitude returns.

AI.tldr: 本文指出金融收益预测中对称损失函数（MSE、MAE）与经济学目标错位，因为对数收益条件均值近零，常数零预测近似最优；作者提出分段二次的CZAR损失，具备凸性、方向非对称、自适应损失下限等性质，在理想测试与LightGBM日内BTC实验中提升了方向准确率并降低零收益偏差。
AI.motivation: 量化金融中标准回归损失与收益预测的经济逻辑不一致：对数收益条件均值接近零，使MSE、MAE等对称损失把常数零预测推向近最优解，从而在训练中压缩预测、在评估中让平凡预测器占据排名优势，惩罚了具有真实但含噪方向预测能力的模型。
AI.method: 在高斯线性预测模型下，证明所有对称单调损失相对于零预测器具有统一的盈亏平衡方向准确率，且随预测噪声接近收益标准差而急剧上升、变得不可达。据此提出CZAR（Composite Zero-Agnostic Return）损失：围绕五项要求（预测凸性、随真实收益方向且在零点消失的非对称性、对低估与反向预测的近线性惩罚、大误差发散、评估用自适应损失下限）构造分段二次损失。CZAR对固定真值可证凸，具有闭式梯度与Hessian以便在梯度提升库中自定义目标，四个超参数通过相关默认值简化为单一选择。
AI.result: 理想化测试中，在平均对数损失下，CZAR评估的预测器要超过零预测器所需的最低方向准确率仍接近50%随机水平，而对称损失对应阈值随预测噪声急剧上升，且该优势在重尾收益分布下依然存在。LightGBM日内BTC对数收益实验中，CZAR训练的模型降低“零收益偏差”并提升大额收益的方向准确率。
AI.conclusion: 对称损失在收益预测中系统性偏向零预测，CZAR通过非对称分段二次设计与自适应下限缓解该错位，在理论与实验上均保持接近随机的盈亏平衡门槛并改善方向预测表现，为金融收益预测提供了更贴合经济目标的损失函数。

title: The finite-horizon five-expert prediction problem
summary: We give an explicit solution to the five expert prediction with expert advice partial differential equation (PDE) in the finite-time horizon setting. The solution formula establishes that the adversary's rank strategy $(1,0,1,0,0)$ is globally optimal, and the COMB strategy $(1,0,1,0,1)$ is optimal exactly on the set where $x_1=x_2$ and $x_3=x_4$. The formula is derived from the solution of the geometric-stopping problem given in our companion paper through the transform principle of Bayraktar, Ekren and Zhang, which links the two problems by a Laplace transform. Inverting the transform term by term expresses the solution through a series of Gaussian and complementary error function kernels. The optimality of $(1,0,1,0,0)$ is reduced to the signs of $41$ one-variable Gaussian series, which are certified with computer assistance by Poisson summation, first-mode domination and interval arithmetic on $1616$ rational cells. The proofs of our main theorems, certificates included, are also formalized in the Lean proof assistant.

AI.tldr: 该论文在有限时间horizon下显式求解专家预测与专家建议问题的五专家PDE，证明对手的rank策略(1,0,1,0,0)全局最优，COMB策略(1,0,1,0,1)仅在x1=x2且x3=x4处最优；解通过Laplace变换反转表示为Gaussian与互补误差函数核的级数，最优性归结为41个单变量Gaussian级数的符号，借助Poisson求和、首模支配与区间算术在1616个有理单元上计算机验证，并在Lean中形式化证明。
AI.motivation: 求解五专家预测与专家建议PDE，明确界定最优对手策略(rank策略与COMB策略)的适用范围。
AI.method: 利用伴随论文中geometric-stopping问题的解，经由Bayraktar、Ekren与Zhang的变换原理（以Laplace变换联系两问题）求出显式解；逐项反演变换，将解表示为Gaussian与互补误差函数核的级数；将(1,0,1,0,0)最优性归结为41个单变量Gaussian级数符号，并用Poisson求和、首模支配与区间算术在1616个有理单元上计算机验证；主定理及证书在Lean证明助手中形式化。
AI.result: 给出有限时间horizon下五专家预测PDE的显式解；rank策略(1,0,1,0,0)全局最优；COMB策略(1,0,1,0,1)恰在x1=x2且x3=x4的集合上最优；41个Gaussian级数符号被计算机辅助认证；证明在Lean中形式化。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式解与计算机辅助验证，刻画了五专家预测问题中最优对手策略的全局与局部最优性，并提供形式化证明。

title: Practical Stabilization of Switched Affine Systems under Dwell Time: From Polytopic to p-Norm Lyapunov Functions
summary: This paper addresses the stabilization of switched affine systems under dwell-time constraints around a desired operating point that is not a common equilibrium of the subsystems. Since asymptotic stabilization is generally unattainable in this setting, the objective is to ensure that trajectories converge to and remain within a prescribed region containing the desired operating point. The main contribution is the development of Lyapunov-based tools that accommodate target regions more general than those induced by quadratic Lyapunov functions. In particular, we establish a constructive Lyapunov characterization for a broad family of weighted $p$-norm functions, which generalizes the classical quadratic Lyapunov equivalence and underpins the proposed hybrid-control and dwell-time developments. Focusing on the case in which the desired region is a polytope, and building on existing Lyapunov-based methods, we develop a constructive two-step method that starts from a polytopic Lyapunov certificate for the average system and yields a smooth weighted $p$-norm Lyapunov function for all sufficiently large $p$. We prove that this extension guarantees practical asymptotic stability of the desired operating point and yields a Lyapunov-certified invariant region under minimum dwell-time switching. Numerical examples illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

AI.tldr: 针对切换仿射系统在驻留时间约束下、目标工作点非子系统公共平衡点的问题，提出基于加权 p-范数的Lyapunov工具，构建两步构造法，实现实用渐近稳定与不变区域。
AI.motivation: 切换仿射系统的目标工作点通常不是各子系统的公共平衡点，此时渐近稳定一般不可达，只能要求轨迹收敛并保持在包含目标点的指定区域内。传统基于二次Lyapunov函数的方法所刻画的靶区域过于受限，需要更一般的Lyapunov工具来支撑驻留时间约束下的混合控制设计。
AI.method: 建立针对一类加权 p-范数函数的构造性Lyapunov刻画，推广经典二次Lyapunov等价性；针对靶区域为多面体的情况，从平均系统的多面体Lyapunov证书出发，发展两步构造法，得到对充分大 p 成立的光滑加权 p-范数Lyapunov函数。
AI.result: 证明该扩展保证目标工作点的实用渐近稳定性，并在最小驻留时间切换下给出具有Lyapunov认证的不变区域；数值算例验证了方法有效性。
AI.conclusion: 所提加权 p-范数Lyapunov框架突破了二次型靶区域的限制，为切换仿射系统在驻留时间约束下的实用稳定与不变区域设计提供了可构造的理论工具。

title: Interacting particle guidance for sampling reward-tilted generative priors
comment: Code will be made available after publication
summary: Inference-time steering adapts pretrained diffusion and flow-based models to new tasks, e.g., to generate samples from a conditional distribution or samples with desired properties, without retraining. This can be formalized as sampling from a reward-tilted generative prior. As exact sampling from this distribution is intractable, guidance-based methods rely on approximations producing biased samples, and sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) methods correct for this bias using importance weights. However, while exact in the large particle limit, SMC suffers from weight degeneracy and particle collapse in practice. We propose interacting particle guidance (IPG), which replaces reweighting with transport. The particles interact through an additional drift, derived from the Feynman--Kac PDE to cancel the reweighting term, and remain unweighted. Choosing the drift in a reproducing kernel Hilbert space yields a closed-form solution that is cheap to compute, with negligible overhead compared to SMC. We demonstrate the method on Gaussian mixtures with known posteriors, and on high-dimensional image inpainting and protein structure inference tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出交互粒子引导（IPG），用粒子间"输运"替代序列蒙特卡洛（SMC）中的重加权，通过 Feynman-Kac PDE 推导附加漂移项以抵消权重更新，实现无需权重、低开销的推理期引导采样。
AI.motivation: 推理期引导需从"奖励倾斜的生成先验"采样，但精确采样不可解；引导类方法产生有偏样本，SMC 虽能以重要性权重纠偏，却在大规模粒子下仍遭遇权重退化与粒子崩塌的实践问题。
AI.method: 提出 IPG：取消重加权步骤，改以粒子间交互实现输运；交互由一项附加漂移承担，该漂移基于 Feynman-Kac PDE 推导，用于精确抵消重加权项，使粒子保持等权。将漂移选取于再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）中获得闭式解，计算成本低廉，相较 SMC 开销可忽略。
AI.result: 在具有已知后验的高斯混合模型上验证，并应用于高维图像修复与蛋白质结构推断任务。
AI.conclusion: 以交互输运取代重加权，可在保持粒子等权的同时规避权重退化与粒子崩塌，为推理期引导提供一种近似无偏、计算高效且可扩展至高维任务的新范式。

title: Understanding Decision-Making Mechanisms in Neural Routing Solvers
summary: Neural Combinatorial Optimization (NCO) has achieved strong empirical success, yet the internal mechanisms driving model decisions remain largely unexplored. In this paper, we investigate three representative autoregressive NCO models spanning two encoder-decoder configurations: AM and POMO (heavy-encoder, light-decoder), and LEHD (light-encoder, heavy-decoder). Through behavioral analyses, representation probing, and causal interventions, we examine how these models construct solutions and use internal representations during decoding. Our results suggest that AM and POMO predominantly follow a persistent geometric pattern throughout solution construction, whereas LEHD contains linearly accessible information about multiple future actions. Causal experiments further provide evidence for the role of future-node representations in LEHD's decision-making. We also observe that LEHD relies strongly on the current-node representation for immediate local decisions, while the start-node representation plays a broader navigational role over the subsequent route. Cross-instance alignment analyses additionally indicate that LEHD maps current-node representations into a relatively shared latent region, which may provide a stable reference for evaluating subsequent decisions. Across the Traveling Salesman Problem and the Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem, these results reveal distinct decision-making patterns across these architecturally distinct solvers and provide a foundation for more interpretable analyses of NCO solvers. Code and additional visualizations are provided in the https://github.com/NCO-Interpretability/NCO-Interpretability.

AI.tldr: 本文通过行为分析、表征探测与因果干预，揭示AM、POMO与LEHD三类自回归NCO模型的内部决策机制差异。
AI.motivation: NCO虽在经验上成功，但其驱动模型决策的内部机制尚未被充分探索，缺乏可解释性分析基础。
AI.method: 选取AM、POMO（重编码器-轻解码器）与LEHD（轻编码器-重解码器）三种代表性自回归模型，开展行为分析、表征探测、因果干预及跨实例对齐分析。
AI.result: AM与POMO在整个求解过程中主要遵循持续性的几何模式；LEHD则包含关于多个未来动作的线性可及信息。因果实验证明未来节点表征在LEHD决策中起作用；LEHD的即时局部决策强依赖当前节点表征，起始节点表征对后续路线起更广的导航作用；跨实例对齐显示LEHD将当前节点表征映射到较共享的潜在区域，为后续决策提供稳定参考。
AI.conclusion: 在TSP与CVRP上，架构不同的求解器呈现不同决策模式，为NCO求解器的可解释性分析奠定基础，并开源代码与可视化。

title: A true single-level reformulation for pessimistic bilevel optimization
summary: We propose a single-level reformulation (SLR) for the pessimistic bilevel optimization problem that does not rely on complementarity conditions or optimal value functions. For this reason, we refer to it as a true single-level reformulation (tSLR). A remarkable consequence is that this reformulation can satisfy the classical linear independence constraint qualification, despite the fact that even the weaker Mangasarian-Fromovitz constraint qualification is known to systematically fail for standard single-level reformulations of both optimistic and pessimistic bilevel programs. We leverage on these constraint qualifications to construct new necessary optimality conditions for pessimistic bilevel optimization. The reformulation also has a striking limitation: under the assumptions of our analysis, the classical second-order sufficient condition fails at every Karush-Kuhn-Tucker point of the problem. Nevertheless, preliminary numerical experiments demonstrate that algorithms based on the proposed tSLR can outperform existing approaches for pessimistic bilevel optimization. Overall, the proposed framework suggests that pessimistic bilevel programs may be considerably more tractable than previously believed and need not be inherently more difficult to solve than their optimistic counterparts.

AI.tldr: 提出悲观双层优化的真正单层重构(tSLR)，不依赖互补条件或最优值函数，可满足LICQ并导出新最优性条件，数值实验表现优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 标准单层重构即使对乐观问题也系统性违反MFCQ，悲观双层问题因此被认为更难处理；作者希望寻找不依赖互补条件与最优值函数的重构方式，以改善约束品性并提升可解性。
AI.method: 提出一种面向悲观双层优化的单层重构(tSLR)，其构建不依赖互补条件或最优值函数；基于该重构所满足的约束品性(可达LICQ)，构造新的悲观双层优化必要最优性条件，并进行初步数值实验比较。
AI.result: tSLR可满足LICQ，而标准重构连MFCQ都系统性失效；在给定分析假设下，经典二阶充分条件在每个KKT点处失效；初步数值实验显示基于tSLR的算法优于现有悲观双层优化方法。
AI.conclusion: 该框架表明悲观双层规划可能比以往认为的更易处理，并不必然比乐观问题更难求解。

title: A Sharp Transition in Data Reconstruction under Differential Privacy
summary: Data reconstruction attacks have empirically been successful in recovering training samples from learned models, raising privacy concerns and motivating defenses with guarantees that remain valid against future threats. While differential privacy (DP) provides formal protection, choosing the privacy budget remains a challenge: small budgets severely reduce utility, but it is hard to quantify how large the budget can be without allowing accurate reconstruction. In this work, we study informed attackers who aim to reconstruct a single $d$-dimensional training sample from a $ρ$-zero-concentrated DP model, knowing all other training data. Our main contribution is to establish a sharp transition at $ρ\asymp d$ for data reconstruction: on the one hand, we derive entropy-based lower bounds for any private mechanism and any attack, characterizing a set of target priors for which reconstruction is information-theoretically impossible for $ρ\ll d$; on the other hand, we analyze a simple attack on private linear regression with output perturbation, showing that reconstruction is practically feasible for $ρ\gg d$. Remarkably, the transition moves to $ρ\asymp s$ for data lying in an $s$-dimensional subspace, demonstrating that the privacy budget guaranteeing adequate protection must be assessed in terms of the effective dimension of the data. We validate our findings via experiments on synthetic data and natural images (CIFAR-10, ImageNet).

AI.tldr: 本文研究零集中差分隐私模型下的数据重构攻击，揭示了在 ρ≍d 处存在尖锐的相变：当 ρ≪d 时重构在信息论上不可行，而当 ρ≫d 时重构实际可行，且相变点随数据有效维度 s 移至 ρ≍s。
AI.motivation: 差分隐私虽提供形式化保护，但隐私预算的选择面临两难：预算过小严重损害效用，而预算过大又难以量化是否会容许精确的数据重构。现有工作缺乏对"多大规模预算才会导致重构成功"的精确刻画，因此需要厘清隐私预算与重构可行性之间的临界关系。
AI.method: 作者设定"知情攻击者"场景，即攻击者已知除目标外的全部训练数据，试图从 ρ-零集中差分隐私模型中重构单个 d 维训练样本。一方面，推导基于熵的下界，适用于任意隐私机制与任意攻击，刻画了 ρ≪d 时重构在信息论上不可行的目标先验集合；另一方面，针对输出扰动的私有线性回归设计并分析一种简单攻击，证明 ρ≫d 时重构实际可行。此外，将分析推广到位于 s 维子空间的数据，证明相变点移至 ρ≍s。
AI.result: 理论上建立了数据重构在 ρ≍d 处的尖锐相变：ρ≪d 时信息论下界保证重构不可能，ρ≫d 时简单攻击可实现重构；对 s 维子空间中的数据，相变阈值移至 ρ≍s。实验在合成数据和自然图像（CIFAR-10、ImageNet）上验证了上述发现。
AI.conclusion: 保证充分保护的隐私预算必须依据数据的有效维度而非名义维度来评估；该相变结果为差分隐私预算的设定提供了理论指导。

title: FLOORA: A Human-Aligned Domain-Specific Language Model for Architectural Design
summary: Foundation models are powerful generators, but many engineering domains require structured representations that general-purpose systems handle poorly. We introduce FLOORA (Floor Layout Optimization with RL Alignment), a family of small domain-specific language (DSL) models for architectural layout generation. With specialized data and alignment, our 0.6B model outperforms much larger frontier models, achieving VLM judge win rates up to 92.0% on out-of-distribution real-world buildings and 96.0% on synthetic buildings. Human evaluations further corroborate these results, with FLOORA selected as the best model in 89.3% of evaluations. FLOORA combines a token-efficient DSL, custom tokenization, domain-specific pretraining, supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and reinforcement learning (RL) with learned human-preference and verifiable rewards. This pipeline improves architectural and geometric validity, supported by extensive empirical evaluation and ablation studies. Although focused on architecture, our results suggest that similar domain-specific recipes may be useful in other engineering domains with structured, verifiable outputs. Datasets, models, and inference code are available at https://github.com/AutodeskAILab/floora.

AI.tldr: FLOORA 是一族面向建筑平面布局生成的小型领域专用语言（DSL）模型，通过数据与对齐专精，使 0.6B 模型在真实与合成建筑上显著超越大型前沿模型。
AI.motivation: 通用基础模型虽生成能力强，但在需要结构化表示的工程领域表现不佳，因此需要领域专用的小模型与配套数据/对齐方法。
AI.method: 提出 FLOORA（Floor Layout Optimization with RL Alignment），结合高 token 效率的 DSL、定制分词器、领域预训练、监督微调（SFT），以及使用人类偏好奖励与可验证奖励的强化学习（RL）。
AI.result: 0.6B 模型在 VLM 评判下取得最高 92.0%（分布外真实建筑）与 96.0%（合成建筑）的胜率；人类评估中 89.3% 被选为最佳模型；消融实验与大量实证验证了建筑与几何有效性的提升。
AI.conclusion: 领域专用配方（数据、DSL、对齐与 RL）能以小模型超越通用大模型，该思路可推广至其他具有结构化、可验证输出的工程领域。

title: Sharp lifespan results for plane-symmetric fluids on decelerated spacetimes
summary: In this article, we analyze plane-symmetric solutions to the relativistic Euler equations on spatially flat spacetimes with decelerated expansion. We consider a linear equation of state $p(ρ)=Kρ$ and power law inflation $a(t)=t^α$, where $0<K<\frac{1}{3}$ and $0\leqα<1$. Previous results imply nonlinear stability of the homogeneous and isotropic solution above an expansion threshold $α_\text{crit}=\frac{2}{3(1-K)}$. We prove that at and below this critical expansion rate there exist arbitrarily small data that exhibit finite-time singularity formation of the shock type, i.e., gradient blowup while the solution stays bounded. For this type of data, we establish lifespan estimates that are polynomial below and exponential at the critical threshold. In addition, we prove a theorem based on energy estimates that provides lower bounds on the lifespan of plane-symmetric solutions generated from small initial data and generalizes to solutions without symmetry in $3+1$-dimensions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究相对论欧拉方程在空间平坦、减速膨胀时空上的平面对称解，证明在临界及以下膨胀率存在激波型有限时间奇点，并给出寿命估计。
AI.motivation: 已有结果仅表明在膨胀阈值 α_crit=2/[3(1-K)] 之上均匀各向同性解具有非线性稳定性，但临界及以下膨胀率的行为未知，需要刻画小初值是否会产生奇点及其寿命。
AI.method: 取线状态方程 p(ρ)=Kρ（0<K<1/3）与幂律膨胀 a(t)=t^α（0≤α<1）；构造任意小初值并利用能量估计、梯度爆破分析与寿命估计方法研究平面对称解，并将结果推广到 3+1 维无对称情形。
AI.result: 证明在临界膨胀率及以下存在任意小初值导致激波型有限时间奇点（解保持有界但梯度爆破）；得到寿命估计：临界阈值以下为多项式型，临界处为指数型；并通过能量估计给出小初值平面对称解寿命的下界，且可推广至 3+1 维无对称解。
AI.conclusion: 临界膨胀率 α_crit=2/[3(1-K)] 是相对论欧拉方程解由稳定向奇点形成转变的临界阈值，减速膨胀不足以阻止激波型梯度爆破。

title: Non-Holonomic Gradient Play: Leafwise Nash Equilibria, Stability, and Deception
summary: We study generalized learning dynamics in multi-agent systems whose joint state evolves on a manifold and whose agents act through state-dependent, potentially nonholonomic vector fields. Under a bundle-splitting condition, we show that these dynamics admit an intrinsic representation as projected Riemannian gradients, giving rise to a class of \emph{nonholonomic gradient play} dynamics. We characterize the local stability of its equilibria through an intrinsic linearization that explicitly captures the effects of the Riemannian connection and the nonholonomy of the actuation frame. The framework recovers classical gradient play on Euclidean spaces and manifolds as special cases while accommodating nonholonomic actuation. We then develop a geometric theory of deception under asymmetric information, whereby an agent exploits privileged knowledge of other agents' learning rules to manipulate the emerging equilibrium. We show that deception effectively \emph{tilts the Riemannian geometry} perceived by the oblivious agents, distorting their projected gradient directions. We establish persistence of exponentially stable equilibria over an open set of deception parameters and derive an explicit first-order characterization of the resulting equilibrium displacement. Analytical and numerical examples illustrate the framework and its implications for equilibrium manipulation in games.

AI.tldr: 该文研究流形上、由状态依赖且可能非完整向量场驱动的多智能体广义学习动力学，在丛分裂条件下将其表示为投影黎曼梯度流（非完整梯度博弈），刻画平衡点局部稳定性，并建立非对称信息下的几何欺骗理论：欺骗会"扭曲"被欺者感知的黎曼几何，从而偏移平衡点。
AI.motivation: 经典梯度博弈与黎曼梯度流假设智能体沿完整方向更新，难以刻画实际系统中状态依赖、非完整的驱动结构；同时多智能体学习中一方可能利用对他方学习规则的先验知识操纵均衡，缺乏统一几何框架分析此类欺骗。
AI.method: 在联合状态位于流形、驱动为状态依赖（可能非完整）向量场的设定下，引入丛分裂条件，将动力学内蕴地表示为投影黎曼梯度，得到"非完整梯度博弈"类；通过显式包含黎曼联络与非完整驱动标架效应的内蕴线性化分析平衡点局部稳定性；进而构建非对称信息下的几何欺骗理论，证明欺骗等价于对不知情智能体所感知黎曼度规的"倾斜"。
AI.result: 框架可退化为欧氏空间与流形上的经典梯度博弈作为特例，同时兼容非完整驱动；证明指数稳定平衡点在欺骗参数的开放集上具有持久性，并给出平衡点位移的显式一阶刻画；解析与数值算例展示该框架及对博弈中均衡操纵的启示。
AI.conclusion: 统一的黎曼几何框架刻画了非完整多智能体学习动力学及其稳定性，并将欺骗重新诠释为几何层面的度规倾斜，为均衡操纵提供了可计算的一阶分析工具。

title: High-Dimensional Simulation-Based Inference in Latent Spaces
summary: Neural simulation-based inference (SBI) has been widely successful in inferring a relatively small number of interpretable parameters from potentially high-dimensional observations, such as images or time series. Accordingly, representation learning in SBI has focused almost exclusively on compressing the observations used to condition the posterior. More recently, however, SBI has begun to target increasingly high-dimensional parameter spaces, raising the complementary question of whether the inference target itself should be compressed. Our answer is a practical merger of SBI and latent generative modeling, which learns a low-dimensional representation of the simulator parameters, performs posterior inference directly in this latent space, and maps posterior samples back to the original parameter space. We characterize the conditions under which latent-space inference recovers the desired target posterior and systematically study its empirical trade-offs. Across four case studies and three generative families, we compare latent and standard estimators while controlling for network capacity, regularization, optimization, and training compute. At matched training compute, latent-space inference achieves accuracy and marginal calibration comparable to direct target-space inference while sampling up to more than an order of magnitude faster.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出将神经模拟推断(SBI)与潜在生成建模合并，学习模拟器参数的低维表示并在该潜在空间直接进行后验推断，再将样本映射回原参数空间，从而在保持精度与边际校准的同时显著加速采样。
AI.motivation: 神经模拟推断以往多用于从高维观测(图像、时间序列)推断数量较少、可解释的参数，因此表示学习几乎只关注压缩观测。然而SBI近期开始面向越来越高维的参数空间，这引出互补问题：推断目标本身是否也应被压缩。
AI.method: 在方法上作者将SBI与潜在生成建模实际融合：学习模拟器参数的低维表示，直接在该潜在空间执行后验推断，并把潜在空间的后验样本映射回原始参数空间。文中刻画了潜在空间推断能够恢复目标后验的条件，并系统研究其经验权衡。在四个案例研究与三个生成模型族上，比较潜在估计器与标准估计器，同时控制网络容量、正则化、优化与训练算力。
AI.result: 在匹配训练算力的条件下，潜在空间推断达到与直接目标空间推断相当的精度与边际校准，同时采样速度最高可提升一个数量级以上。
AI.conclusion: 结论是，面向高维参数空间的SBI可通过在参数的低维潜在表示上进行推断来实现，是一种实用且高效的方案，能够在可控算力下兼顾推断质量与采样效率。

title: GEM-KMeans: Memory-Efficient and Accurate Clustering on Massive Scale with GPU Optimization
summary: Memory-efficient scaling on clustering problems without sacrificing statistical accuracy is of central interest for large-scale data analysis and machine learning problems. Nonnegative low-rank (NLR) matrix factorization for $K$-means is a scalable clustering method, which connects to semidefinite relaxations with optimal average-case exact recovery guarantees. However, a direct GPU implementation of NLR requires multiple large factor-sized buffers and substantial data movements that are essentially memory-bound. In this paper, we introduce GEM-KMeans, a spectrally normalized yet mathematically equivalent NLR formulation that fuses the gradient update, nonnegative projection, and sufficient statistics for normalization and iterate movement into a matrix-multiplication epilogue. Instead of retaining three massive factor-sized arrays, our IO-aware GPU implementation materializes only one single factor with small tile-reduction arrays as additional storage in the High Bandwidth Memory (HBM). We derive explicit memory costs and spectrally normalized smoothness bounds for optimizing the clustering objective function. Accurate clustering is demonstrated at massive scales on synthetic and real datasets, where performance gains of GEM-KMeans over existing GPU-accelerated Lloyd's algorithms involve data-dependent runtime tradeoffs.

AI.tldr: 提出GEM-KMeans，一种谱归一化且数学等价的非负低秩矩阵分解K-means公式，通过将梯度更新、非负投影及归一化充分统计量融合进矩阵乘法尾函数，实现仅需单个因子矩阵的IO感知GPU实现，大幅降低显存占用并保持聚类精度。
AI.motivation: 大规模聚类问题中，内存高效扩展且不牺牲统计精度是核心需求。非负低秩矩阵分解（NLR）用于K-means虽可扩展并具备半定松弛的最优平均情况精确恢复保证，但其直接GPU实现需要多个大因子尺寸缓冲区与大量数据搬运，本质上是内存受限的。
AI.method: 提出GEM-KMeans：一种谱归一化但数学等价的NLR公式，将梯度更新、非负投影以及用于归一化和迭代移动的充分统计量融合为矩阵乘法尾函数（epilogue）。采用IO感知的GPU实现，在高带宽内存（HBM）中仅物化单个因子矩阵，外加小型分块归约数组作为额外存储。同时推导了聚类目标函数的显式内存开销与谱归一化平滑性界。
AI.result: 在合成与真实数据集上于大规模场景实现了准确聚类；相比现有GPU加速的Lloyd算法，GEM-KMeans的性能提升呈现数据相关的运行时权衡。
AI.conclusion: GEM-KMeans通过融合算子与IO感知设计，在保持统计精度的同时显著降低显存需求，为实现大规模内存高效聚类提供了可行方案，其相对Lloyd算法的性能增益取决于数据特性。

title: Stochastic Lie-Bracket Approximations for Zeroth-Order Optimization on Manifolds
summary: We propose a continuous-time algorithm for zeroth-order global optimization of smooth functions on compact manifolds that synthesizes Riemannian gradient dynamics using only objective measurements, without evaluating gradients. The algorithm is formulated as an ordinary differential equation driven by piecewise-smooth McShane-type approximations of the Wiener process, with a geometric compensation term that depends only on the actuation frame and not on the objective function. Our main result establishes infinite-horizon practical probabilistic guarantees for fixed approximation parameters. To this end, we show that the algorithm's trajectories approximate, in the mean-square sense, a Riemannian Langevin diffusion whose unique invariant Gibbs measure concentrates on the set of global minimizers. We exploit this approximation to establish finite-horizon probabilistic convergence guarantees and directly analyze the algorithm's long-time behavior to obtain the infinite-horizon result.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种连续时间零阶全局优化算法，在紧流形上仅用目标函数测量值（无需梯度）合成黎曼梯度动力学，通过分段光滑McShane型近似 Wiener 过程驱动ODE，并引入仅依赖驱动框架的几何补偿项，证明了无限时域下的实用概率保证。
AI.motivation: 现有零阶/无梯度优化多依赖梯度或强假设，且缺乏在流形上连续时间框架的长时间（无限时域）概率收敛保证。本文旨在设计一种仅用目标测量的连续时间算法，并给出严格的概率收敛性分析。
AI.method: 将算法建模为由分段光滑McShane型Wiener过程近似驱动的常微分方程，加入仅依赖驱动框架、与目标函数无关的几何补偿项；证明轨迹在均方意义下逼近唯一的黎曼Langevin扩散，其不变Gibbs测度集中于全局极小值集合。
AI.result: 对固定近似参数，建立了无限时域的实用概率保证；利用轨迹对黎曼Langevin扩散的均方逼近，先得到有限时域概率收敛保证，再直接分析长时间行为获得无限时域结果。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为紧流形上无梯度全局优化提供了连续时间理论框架，证明了算法在概率意义下的收敛性与长时间行为，几何补偿项与目标函数无关的特性增强了方法的通用性。

title: Early Learning Shapes Later Directions Of Representation Change In Continual Learning
summary: Representations continually change as a network learns new tasks. We ask whether early representational changes naturally form a geometric structure that continues to shape later learning. We identify a low-dimensional subspace of early representation drift, which we call a scaffold, and test whether it is reused across subsequent tasks. Across four pretrained visual encoders and two datasets, later representational changes consistently favor this early-defined subspace over matched random alternatives. This reuse is history-dependent: when networks experience different early tasks but identical later training inputs, each network preferentially reuses the scaffold induced by its own learning history. The same preference appears in individual optimizer updates, even though the network's dominant local response directions shift away from the original scaffold. Finally, constraining motion within the scaffold slows new-task acquisition more than matched random constraints, while effects on old-task retention are less consistent. In summary, these results suggest that early experience leaves a persistent geometric imprint on how neural networks adapt to future tasks.

AI.tldr: 早期表征漂移形成低维"脚手架"子空间，被后续任务持续复用，构成历史依赖的表征几何印记。
AI.motivation: 表征随网络学习新任务不断变化，作者追问：早期表征变化是否自然形成某种几何结构，并持续影响后续学习。
AI.method: 识别早期表征漂移的低维子空间（scaffold）；在4个预训练视觉编码器、2个数据集上检验后续表征变化是否偏向该子空间而非匹配的随机子空间；对比不同早期任务但相同后期训练输入的网络；分析单个优化器更新；并通过将运动约束在scaffold内进行干预实验。
AI.result: 后续表征变化一致偏向早期子空间而非随机替代；复用具历史依赖性，各网络偏向自身学习史诱导的scaffold；该偏好在单个优化器更新中同样出现，尽管网络主导局部响应方向已偏离原scaffold；约束运动于scaffold内比随机约束更显著地减慢新任务获取，对旧任务保持的影响较不一致。
AI.conclusion: 早期经验在神经网络如何适应未来任务上留下持久的几何印记。

title: Exponential Deterministic Query Complexity of Goldstein Stationarity
summary: We study the deterministic query complexity of finding approximate Goldstein stationary points of globally Lipschitz functions that may be nonsmooth and nonconvex. Under prescribed bounds on the Lipschitz constant and on the difference between the initial function value and the infimum, we prove a lower bound on the worst-case number of oracle calls that is exponential in the dimension at fixed sufficiently small accuracy parameters. The result holds for a local oracle and gives explicit dependence on the accuracy parameters. A complementary deterministic algorithm using only function values gives an exponential upper bound, establishing the exponential order in the dimension in this regime. For a coarser stationarity requirement, we also give a deterministic first-order algorithm with a dimension-free query bound. Thus, the dimension dependence differs between the two accuracy regimes.

AI.tldr: 研究全局Lipschitz（可能非光滑、非凸）函数上近似Goldstein稳定点的确定性查询复杂度：在精度充分小时，最坏情况oracle调用次数关于维数呈指数级；对更粗糙的平稳性要求，则存在维数无关的确定性一阶算法。
AI.motivation: 刻画非光滑非凸优化中寻找近似Goldstein稳定点的确定性查询复杂度，明确精度与维数依赖关系，区分不同精度机制下的复杂度本质。
AI.method: 在给定Lipschitz常数以及初始函数值与下确界之差的上界条件下，针对局部oracle构造并证明确定性查询复杂度下界；并给出仅使用函数值的确定性算法以得到匹配的指数上界；此外针对更粗糙的平稳性要求设计确定性一阶算法。
AI.result: 在足够小的精度参数下，最坏情况oracle调用次数关于维数呈指数级下界，且显式依赖精度参数；仅用函数值的确定性算法给出指数上界，确立该机制下的指数阶；对更粗糙平稳性要求，确定性一阶算法具有与维数无关的查询界。
AI.conclusion: 近似Goldstein稳定点的确定性查询复杂度在两类精度机制下表现不同：高精度时维数依赖为指数级，粗糙精度时可实现维数无关界。

title: Probability Contracts: Accuracy, Coherence, and Decisions Across LLM Interfaces
comment: Research preprint; includes proofs and supplementary analyses
summary: A probability used for a decision should refer to the same event across equivalent requests. We introduce probability contracts, a benchmark connecting exact finite-world posteriors, validated event transformations, and failure-aware decision evaluation. Four model-interface configurations are evaluated on 1,000 worlds. Their assessments differ across accuracy, coherence, and decision loss: Kev has lower aggregate canonical posterior error than Jev, but larger complement and coarsening residuals, with accuracy ordering varying by stratum. Jev's Event and Choice interfaces induce different binary actions on 32.8% of valid pairs at defer cost 0.10. A post-hoc analysis finds that disagreement certifies only 11-52% of mean binary pair error across configurations. An elementary action-region characterization explains when averaging changes decision loss relative to randomly selecting one interface. Although averaging cannot worsen that baseline's expected Brier score, its decision effect depends on the cost and crossed boundaries; the observed same-baseline penalties occur in configurations already worse than always deferring. The benchmark makes these distinctions measurable without treating consistency as accuracy or a score improvement as a decision guarantee.

AI.tldr: 提出"概率契约"基准，将精确有限世界后验、经验证的事件变换与失败感知的决策评估联系起来，在1000个世界上评测四种模型-接口配置，揭示准确率、一致性与决策损失之间的差异。
AI.motivation: 概率用于决策时，应针对同一事件在不同等价请求间保持一致。然而现有评估往往把一致性等同于准确性，或把分数提升当作决策保障，缺乏能将精确后验、事件变换与决策损失统一度量的基准。
AI.method: 引入概率契约(probability contracts)基准，包含精确有限世界后验、验证过的事件变换和失败感知的决策评估；在1000个世界上对四种模型-接口配置进行评测，比较规范后验误差、补集与粗化残差、分层准确率排序；对Event与Choice接口在延迟成本0.10下的二元动作差异做后验分析；通过动作区域刻画解释平均化对决策损失的影响。
AI.result: Kev的聚合规范后验误差低于Jev，但补集与粗化残差更大，且准确率排序随分层变化；Jev的Event与Choice接口在32.8%的有效对上诱导不同二元动作(延迟成本0.10)；分歧仅能认证11–52%的平均二元对误差；平均化不会恶化该基线的期望Brier分数，但决策效应取决于成本与跨界，观测到的同基线惩罚出现在本已劣于始终延迟的配置中。
AI.conclusion: 该基准使上述区分变得可测量，同时明确不应把一致性视为准确性，也不应把分数提升视为决策保障。

title: PHASE: A Physiology-Guided Hierarchical Foundation Model for Intracranial EEG
summary: Clinicians and neuroscientists have long analyzed intracranial electroencephalography (iEEG) through directly measurable physiological characteristics, which carry much of the information that downstream tasks depend on. Recent iEEG foundation models learn by reconstructing or predicting their inputs, which leaves the retention of these characteristics implicit. They are also evaluated mainly on cognitive decoding and a narrow clinical task, i.e., seizure detection. On a broad, clinically relevant benchmark such as Omni-iEEG, they remain below task-specific models when used frozen. We introduce PHASE, a physiology-guided foundation model that makes these characteristics explicit learning targets, pairing them with masked latent prediction in a temporal stage (PHASE-T) within each channel and a spatiotemporal stage (PHASE-ST) across synchronized channels. PHASE is pretrained on heterogeneous recordings from 222 participants at nine clinical sites. On all five Omni-iEEG clinical tasks, frozen PHASE-T outperforms every evaluated foundation model by up to 31\%, and fine-tuned PHASE-T surpasses the task-specific models, setting a new state of the art. PHASE-T benefits from physiological supervision, outperforming variants trained with latent prediction alone or auxiliary waveform reconstruction on every task in matched ablations. PHASE-T generalizes to unseen institutions, outperforming the compared models with few or no local labels. PHASE-ST further improves seizure-onset-zone identification over PHASE-T and, when frozen, decodes sound volume and pitch on BrainTreebank better than published models. Beyond task performance, PHASE learns to encapsulate the physiological characteristics clinicians recognize, from seizure onset and its propagation to anatomical region identity, even though its pretraining contains no ictal recordings or anatomical labels.

AI.tldr: PHASE是一个生理学引导的iEEG基础模型，通过将临床可识别的生理特征显式作为学习目标，结合掩码潜在预测，在临床基准Omni-iEEG上超越所有基础模型与任务专用模型，并具备跨机构泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有iEEG基础模型通过重建或预测输入进行学习，导致生理特征保留变得隐式；且评估局限于认知解码和癫痫检测这类狭窄任务，在Omni-iEEG等广泛临床基准上，冻结使用时仍不及任务专用模型。
AI.method: 提出PHASE，将生理特征作为显式学习目标，与掩码潜在预测配对，包含通道内的时间阶段PHASE-T和跨同步通道的时空阶段PHASE-ST；在九个临床站点、222名参与者的异质记录上预训练。
AI.result: 在Omni-iEEG全部五项临床任务上，冻结PHASE-T比所有被评估基础模型最高提升31%，微调后超越任务专用模型达到新SOTA；匹配消融中生理监督优于仅潜在预测或辅助波形重建；PHASE-T可泛化到未见机构，少标签或无标签下表现更好；PHASE-ST进一步提升癫痫发作起始区识别，冻结时在BrainTreebank上解码音量与音高优于已发表模型；并学到临床可识别的生理特征。
AI.conclusion: 将临床可识别的生理特征显式纳入预训练目标，能显著提升iEEG基础模型的任务性能、泛化性与生理可解释性，即便预训练数据不含发作记录或解剖标签。

title: Physical Muon: Orthogonalization as an Equilibrium Computation
comment: Accepted at 18th annual workshop on Optimization for Machine Learning
summary: Physical neural networks and analog in-memory computing could reduce the energy cost of neural network training. Realizing this potential, however, requires optimizers that combine effective learning with physical implementability. SGD fits local analog updates but struggles on transformers, while Adam family is unstable against analog bias. Muon offers strong training performance, but its Newton--Schulz orthogonalization relies on dense matrix-matrix products. To address this obstacle, we introduce Physical Muon, which computes the orthogonalization as the equilibrium of a continuous-time flow. Random probes approximate the flow using matrix-vector products, reciprocal reads, and local rank-1 writes. To test whether this replacement preserves training performance, we evaluate it on a 10.95M-parameter transformer. The dense flow's mean validation cross-entropy is 0.0085 above Newton--Schulz across nine seeds per method; the probe implementation is 0.0188 above the control across two seeds. Circuit simulations further reproduce the flow dynamics and yield comparable training behavior.

AI.tldr: 提出Physical Muon：将Muon的Newton–Schulz正交化改写为连续时间流的平衡态，用随机探针以矩阵-向量乘积、互易读取与局部rank-1写入近似，从而适配物理神经网络与模拟存内计算，并在10.95M参数Transformer上验证性能基本保持。
AI.motivation: 物理神经网络与模拟存内计算有望降低神经网络训练能耗，但需要兼具有效学习与物理可实现性的优化器：SGD适合局部模拟更新却难以胜任Transformer；Adam族在模拟偏置下不稳定；Muon训练性能强，但其Newton–Schulz正交化依赖稠密矩阵-矩阵乘积，难以在模拟硬件上实现。
AI.method: 提出Physical Muon，将正交化计算为连续时间流的平衡态；用随机探针近似该流，仅依赖矩阵-向量乘积、互易读取（reciprocal reads）与局部rank-1写入。
AI.result: 在10.95M参数Transformer上评估：稠密流相对Newton–Schulz的平均验证交叉熵在每种方法九个随机种子上高0.0085；探针实现在两个种子上相对对照高0.0188。电路仿真进一步复现了流动力学并给出可比的训练行为。
AI.conclusion: 将正交化重述为连续时间流平衡态并用随机探针与局部操作实现，可在保持Muon训练性能的同时满足模拟硬件的物理可实现性，为物理神经网络训练提供可行优化器方案。

title: Data Unlearning via Inverse Distillation
summary: Multi-step matching models, including flow and diffusion models, produce high-quality outputs but incur substantial inference costs and may reproduce unwanted components of their training datasets. We introduce Inverse Distillation Unlearning (IDU), a unified framework that simultaneously distills a teacher multi-step matching model into an efficient one-step student generator and suppresses outputs corresponding to a designated training subset. We first formulate distillation as a min-max objective over a data distribution and then represent this distribution as a mixture of the forget-set and the generated distributions. This allows us to compare this mixture with the teacher's training distribution and recover only the retained data at the optimum. Our method requires only a pretrained full-data teacher and data from the forget set, without access to retained training examples, extra feature extractors or classifiers. Extensive experiments on MNIST and CIFAR-10 datasets under flow-matching and score-based diffusion settings demonstrate that IDU substantially reduces the generation frequency of forgotten classes while preserving generation quality on the retained classes. To the best of our knowledge, IDU is the first unified framework for simultaneous unlearning and distillation in unconditional flow-matching and score-based models.

AI.tldr: 提出IDU统一框架，同时实现多步匹配模型的蒸馏与遗忘集去除，无需保留数据、额外特征提取器或分类器。
AI.motivation: 多步匹配模型（流模型、扩散模型）生成质量高，但推理成本大，且可能复现训练数据中不希望出现的成分。现有蒸馏与机器遗忘通常分开处理，缺乏同时兼顾效率与遗忘的统一方案。
AI.method: 将蒸馏建模为数据分布上的min-max目标，把该分布表示为遗忘集分布与生成分布的混合，并与教师训练分布比较，从而在最优解处仅恢复保留数据。方法仅需预训练的全数据教师模型与遗忘集数据。
AI.result: 在MNIST和CIFAR-10上，于flow-matching与score-based扩散两种设定下，IDU显著降低遗忘类别的生成频率，同时保持保留类别的生成质量。
AI.conclusion: IDU是首个在无条件flow-matching与score-based模型中同时实现遗忘与蒸馏的统一框架。

title: Why Adaptive Optimizers Underestimate Rare Tokens
summary: In the softmax output layer, a rare token receives a small positive logit gradient on most steps and a much larger negative gradient on the few steps when it is the target. SGD simply adds these contributions. Coordinate-wise adaptive methods such as Adam, RMSProp, and sign descent instead divide each update by a running estimate of its magnitude, and that estimate is largest immediately after the token appears. This imbalance has two effects. At the level of the whole output layer, we characterize which optimizers preserve the mean output embedding: every method whose update is linear in past gradients does, as do Kronecker-factored and orthogonalized methods such as Shampoo and Muon. Adam, Adafactor, Lion, and sign descent do not, and for these methods we obtain an exact step-by-step expression for the change. At the level of an individual rare token, the same normalization shifts the training fixed point. In the unigram model, sign descent lowers the logit of every token that occurs in fewer than half of the minibatches at a constant expected rate. For RMSProp with periodic arrivals, we can solve the fixed point in closed form: if a token is absent for at least two consecutive minibatches, its equilibrium probability is strictly below its data frequency for every learning rate, and the ratio tends to $κ/(2(e^{κ/2}-1))$. Here $κ$ is the mean number of steps between occurrences divided by the second-moment time constant $1/(1-β_2)$. In the same model, SGD and AMSGrad retain the unbiased fixed point. We test these predictions both in a unigram model and in a small language model trained from a known generating distribution. With random arrivals, the bias is larger than the periodic formula predicts; in the language model, the optimizers with the biased fixed point also fit the generating distribution less well.

AI.tldr: 论文分析稀有词元在softmax输出层的梯度不平衡：坐标自适应优化器（Adam、RMSProp、符号下降等）因按梯度幅值归一化，会压低稀有词元的logit与均衡概率，破坏无偏不动点；线性更新及Kronecker/正交化方法（Shampoo、Muon）保持均值输出嵌入不变。
AI.motivation: 稀有词元在多数步骤仅获得小的正logit梯度，仅在其作为目标时获得较大负梯度。SGD线性累加这些贡献，而Adam、RMSProp、符号下降等按运行幅值估计归一化更新，且该估计在词元出现后立即最大，造成系统性不平衡。作者希望刻画这种不平衡对输出层整体均值嵌入和各稀有词元训练不动点的影响。
AI.method: 从理论上区分哪类优化器保持均值输出嵌入：分析更新对历史梯度线性的方法、以及Kronecker分解与正交化方法（Shampoo、Muon）；对Adam、Adafactor、Lion、符号下降给出逐步变化的精确表达式。在unigram模型中对符号下降给出恒定期望速率的logit下降结论；对周期到达的RMSProp闭式求解不动点，并定义κ为平均到达间隔步数与二阶矩时间常数1/(1-β2)之比；同时与SGD、AMSGrad的无偏不动点对比。在unigram模型和已知生成分布的小型语言模型中进行验证。
AI.result: 线性更新方法、Shampoo与Muon保持均值输出嵌入不变；Adam、Adafactor、Lion、符号下降不保持并具精确变化表达式。符号下降使出现频率低于半数minibatch的每个词元logit以恒定期望速率下降。周期到达下RMSProp：若词元连续至少两个minibatch缺失，其均衡概率严格低于数据频率，比值趋于κ/(2(e^{κ/2}-1))。SGD与AMSGrad保持无偏不动点。随机到达时偏差大于周期公式预测；语言模型中带偏不动点的优化器对生成分布拟合更差。
AI.conclusion: 坐标自适应优化器的梯度幅值归一化会系统性偏置稀有词元的训练不动点，降低其概率并损害生成分布拟合；该偏差可由到达间隔与二阶矩时间常数之比κ量化。选择保持均值输出嵌入的优化器（如SGD、Shampoo、Muon）可避免此类偏差。

title: LoopICL: Looping a single transformer block to solve tabular tasks
summary: Tabular foundation models using in-context learning have recently surpassed gradient-boosted trees on predictive tabular tasks. However, recent mechanistic insights suggest that parameters in these models are largely redundant. We introduce LoopICL, a looped transformer whose core design decouples parameter count from computational depth. LoopICL consists of a single block, processing data through two coupled streams: a cell stream capturing per-cell feature representations and a row stream capturing in-context example representations, jointly refined through within-column and cross-column attention. During pre-training, we vary loop counts, allowing the block to be unrolled for a varying number of iterations at test-time and use a learned exit-gate to automatically exit. In its standard setting, LoopICL performs competitively with TabICLv2 on TabArena and TALENT at the same computational cost (FLOPs), while using nearly 90% fewer parameters. Furthermore, its recurrent design enables users to also trade off inference cost and performance, providing a resource-aware TFM.

AI.tldr: LoopICL 是一种循环式（looped）Transformer 表格基础模型，通过单模块、双流（cell 流与 row 流）与循环展开将参数量与计算深度解耦，在相同 FLOPs 下与 TabICLv2 性能相当而参数量减少近 90%，并支持推理成本与性能的可调权衡。
AI.motivation: 近期基于上下文学习（in-context learning）的表格基础模型已在表格预测任务上超越梯度提升树，但机制层面的分析表明这类模型的参数在很大程度上是冗余的。该工作旨在利用这一冗余性，在保持预测性能的同时压缩参数规模，并赋予模型可调节的推理预算。
AI.method: 提出 LoopICL：一个循环式 Transformer，其核心设计将参数量与计算深度解耦。模型仅含单个 block，通过两条耦合数据流处理输入：cell 流用于刻画逐单元格（per-cell）特征表示，row 流用于刻画上下文示例（in-context example）表示，二者通过列内（within-column）与跨列（cross-column）注意力联合精炼。预训练阶段变化循环次数（loop counts），使该 block 在测试时可展开为不同迭代步数，并借助学习得到的 exit-gate 自动决定退出时机。
AI.result: 在标准设定下，LoopICL 在 TabArena 与 TALENT 基准上、于相同计算成本（FLOPs）条件下与 TabICLv2 表现相当，同时参数量减少近 90%。此外，其循环（recurrent）设计允许用户在推理成本与性能之间进行权衡。
AI.conclusion: LoopICL 表明，借助单 block 循环与双流注意力结构，表格基础模型可以在大幅削减参数的同时保持竞争力，并作为资源感知型 TFM（resource-aware TFM）提供推理成本与性能的灵活调节能力。

title: RLTL;DR: Self-improvement by Internalizing Self-generated Feedback
summary: The common paradigm of reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is to let agents make multiple attempts at a task, and optimize towards the successful ones. This becomes problematic in the realms of self-improvement, where tasks are so difficult that the agent has a low or even no chance of success, and where there are no teacher models or example solutions to distill from. In this paper, we introduce RLTL;DR. After each failed attempt, we show the policy the verifier outputs and let it write its own feedback, in the form of a single TL;DR insight. The next rollout is conditioned on all previous insights, and we sequentially sample rollouts until a solution is found. Moreover, we enable backpropagation on the in-context insights to internalize a direct task to insight mapping. On challenging tool-calling and coding datasets (filtered to Pass@128=0), standard GRPO training of a Qwen 3.5 9B Thinking policy stays flat at a Pass@1 of 0% to 1%. RLTL;DR breaks through this learning barrier, achieving a Pass@1 of 14-31% with insights in context during training and, crucially, 12-13% when no insight is in context at eval time. We identify that the key is the task to insight internalization. To study this further, we reduce our approach to SFTL;DR, training only on (task, insight) tuples, without showing or backpropagating on any rollouts. Training on only 4k of these tuples recovers almost the full performance of RLTL;DR and classical SFT on full rollouts. This demonstrates a promising compacted training paradigm of the form "on this sort of task, keep this sort of thing in mind", which we hope to inspire future research on.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 RLTL;DR，让策略在每次失败后利用验证器输出自写一条 "TL;DR" 式洞察，并在上下文中条件化后续 rollout，同时对上下文洞察做反向传播以将"任务→洞察"映射内化，从而在 Pass@128=0 的困难任务上突破学习瓶颈。
AI.motivation: RLVR 的常规范式依赖多次尝试并优化成功轨迹，但在自我改进场景中任务极难，成功率接近或等于零，且没有教师模型或示例解答可蒸馏，导致标准方法（如 GRPO）训练停滞、无法学习。
AI.method: 提出 RLTL;DR：每次失败后向策略展示验证器输出，让其自行书写一条 TL;DR 形式的反馈洞察；下一次 rollout 以上前所有洞察为条件，顺序采样直到找到解。同时允许对上下文中的洞察进行反向传播，以将"任务→洞察"的直接映射内化。进一步简化为 SFTL;DR，仅用（任务，洞察）元组做监督训练，不展示也不反传任何 rollout。
AI.result: 在筛选为 Pass@128=0 的困难工具调用与代码数据集上，Qwen 3.5 9B Thinking 策略的标准 GRPO 训练 Pass@1 停留在 0%~1%；RLTL;DR 将学习瓶颈突破，训练时上下文中含洞察的 Pass@1 达 14%~31%，评测时不提供任何洞察仍达 12%~13%。仅用 4k（任务，洞察）元组训练的 SFTL;DR 即恢复 RLTL;DR 与基于完整 rollout 的经典 SFT 的几乎全部性能。
AI.conclusion: 关键在于"任务→洞察"的内化。结果支持一种紧凑的训练范式："在这类任务上，记住这类事情"，即以洞察作为可复用、可内化的知识载体，有望启发后续研究。

title: Koa-action: Fast and Consistent Structured Decision Making with Generative LLMs
summary: Industry applications often demand low-latency classification, yet current large language model (LLM) approaches remain poorly suited for latency-critical applications. Existing prompting and constrained decoding produce verbose, multi-token outputs that require expensive token-by-token generation, while encoder-based models achieve faster inference but sacrifice task flexibility. We propose Koa-action, a framework for low-latency atomic actions -- fast, single-step decisions such as classification, semantic endpointing, Boolean checks, and scoring -- formulated as constrained generation with single-token outputs. By introducing atomic label tokens and applying supervised fine-tuning, our method reduces classification to a deterministic one-step decoding problem. Across standard benchmarks, Koa-action delivers competitive accuracy with consistently low and stable latency. On a production intent-routing benchmark, Koa-action reaches 85.5% accuracy -- competitive with the strongest frontier models (Claude-4.8-Opus, Gemini-Pro-3.1) and ahead of GPT-5 and Gemini-2.5-Pro -- while answering in about half a second, several-fold faster than every frontier model (up to ~7.5x at the median) under identical serving conditions. Against the dedicated single-token system Jev/TypeSafe, Koa-action is competitive on accuracy and faster at the median, while also handling multimodal inputs and multi-label outputs that single-label text systems do not.

AI.tldr: Koa-action 将分类等原子动作建模为单 token 约束生成，通过原子标签 token 与监督微调实现一步解码，在保持竞争性精度的同时显著降低延迟。
AI.motivation: 工业应用需要低延迟分类，但现有 LLM 方法不适合延迟敏感场景：提示与约束解码产生冗长多 token 输出，需逐 token 昂贵生成；编码器模型推理更快却牺牲任务灵活性。因此需要兼顾精度、低延迟与任务灵活性的方案。
AI.method: 提出 Koa-action 框架，面向低延迟原子动作（分类、语义端点检测、布尔判断、打分等单步决策），将其形式化为单 token 输出的约束生成。核心是引入原子标签 token（atomic label tokens）并结合监督微调，把分类简化为确定性的单步解码问题。
AI.result: 在标准基准上取得竞争性精度且延迟低而稳定。在生产意图路由基准上达到 85.5% 精度，与最强前沿模型（Claude-4.8-Opus、Gemini-Pro-3.1）相当，优于 GPT-5 与 Gemini-2.5-Pro；约 0.5 秒响应，相同服务条件下比所有前沿模型快数倍（中位数最高约 7.5 倍）。相比专用单 token 系统 Jev/TypeSafe，精度具竞争力且中位延迟更快，并支持单标签文本系统不具备的多模态输入与多标签输出。
AI.conclusion: Koa-action 通过单 token 约束解码统一了低延迟与任务灵活性，在精度不逊前沿模型的前提下大幅提升推理速度，并扩展了多模态与多标签能力，适用于工业级延迟敏感分类任务。

title: Dyad: Extending Large Language Models with Native Typed Decision-Making
summary: We study how to build more capable general-purpose agents by extending large language models (LLMs) with native typed decision-making. We introduce Dyad, an architecture that augments a pretrained LLM with an environment-conditioned action encoder that embeds each candidate action description in parallel, then scores these embeddings against the LLM's internal state to yield a distribution over typed actions. By factorizing decision-making into representations of the evolving interaction state and environment-specific action semantics, Dyad introduces an inductive bias for learning reusable representations while keeping action scoring efficient even as the action space grows. We investigate two complementary reinforcement learning settings driven by environment interaction. With the LLM frozen, training the action encoder alone achieves consistent gains across four unseen environments, enabling modular adaptation without modifying any LLM parameters. Jointly optimizing both components outperforms conventional RL post-training across diverse interactive tasks and model scales, including a 3.80% average absolute gain on ALFWorld with a 9B model, while improving general knowledge, reasoning, and coding.

AI.tldr: Dyad通过在预训练LLM上增加环境条件化的动作编码器，将决策分解为交互状态表征与动作语义嵌入，实现类型化动作打分；冻结LLM仅训练编码器即可跨环境泛化，联合训练则优于传统RL后训练。
AI.motivation: 构建更强的通用智能体需要让LLM具备类型化决策能力。传统做法通常直接微调LLM，可能损害其通用知识与推理能力，且动作空间扩大时打分效率低、表征难以复用。
AI.method: 提出Dyad架构：为预训练LLM配备环境条件化的动作编码器，并行嵌入每个候选动作描述，并将其与LLM内部状态打分，得到类型化动作分布。通过将决策分解为"交互状态表征"与"环境相关动作语义"两部分，引入利于学习可复用表征的归纳偏置，并在动作空间增长时保持动作打分效率。研究两种由环境交互驱动的RL设置：冻结LLM仅训练动作编码器；以及联合优化两者。
AI.result: 冻结LLM仅训练动作编码器时，在四个未见环境中取得稳定提升，实现不修改LLM参数的模块化适配；联合优化在多种交互任务与模型规模上均优于传统RL后训练，例如9B模型在ALFWorld上取得3.80%的平均绝对提升，同时改善了通用知识、推理与编码能力。
AI.conclusion: 将类型化决策从LLM参数中解耦并交由环境条件化动作编码器处理，是一种可复用、可扩展且高效的智能体构建方式，兼具跨环境泛化与通用能力保持的优势。

title: Byzantine-Robust Federated Representation Learning
summary: We study federated learning (FL) with adversarial clients, where the goal is to minimize the average loss of the honest (non-adversarial) clients without knowing their identity. Under heterogeneity, a single shared model parameter is statistically inappropriate: it cannot capture the distinct data-generating processes across clients, incurring an irreducible model-heterogeneity bias and severely limiting robustness to adversarial clients (a.k.a. Byzantine-robustness). We address this problem through representation learning, where each client learns a personalized linear head, while collaboratively estimating a shared nonlinear representation through Byzantine-robust aggregation. We demonstrate that the heterogeneity among honest representation gradients is controlled by the representation error and statistical errors that decay either with the number of data samples per client ($τ$) or the number of iterations ($T$). In particular, our non-asymptotic parameter recovery error bound reveals three terms: (i) an initialization-dependent error that goes away with $T$, (ii) finite-sample noise terms that decreases with $τ$ and the number of honest clients, and (iii) a stochastic gradient variance term that also reduces with $T$. Importantly, with no irreducible model-heterogeneity bias in our bounds. We extend the regression analysis to multiclass classification, and empirically validate it on CIFAR-10, FEMNIST, and School Exam Score datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文研究含恶意客户端的联邦学习，通过表征学习让各客户端学习个性化线性分类头、协作估计共享非线性表征并采用拜占庭鲁棒聚合，消除模型异质性偏差。理论给出非渐近参数恢复误差界，分为初始化依赖项、有限样本噪声项与随机梯度方差项，均随T或τ衰减，无不可约异质性偏差。并将回归分析推广至多分类，在CIFAR-10、FEMNIST、School Exam Score上验证。
AI.motivation: 在客户端数据异质且存在恶意（拜占庭）客户端时，单一共享模型无法刻画各客户端不同的数据生成过程，产生不可约的模型异质性偏差，严重削弱对恶意客户端的鲁棒性。目标是在未知诚实客户端身份的前提下最小化其平均损失。
AI.method: 采用表征学习框架：每个客户端学习个性化线性分类头，同时通过拜占庭鲁棒聚合协作估计共享非线性表征；对诚实表征梯度间的异质性进行理论分析，推导非渐近参数恢复误差界，并将回归分析推广到多分类任务。
AI.result: 非渐近参数恢复误差界包含三项：(i) 初始化相关误差，随迭代数T消失；(ii) 有限样本噪声项，随每客户端样本数τ及诚实客户端数量增加而减小；(iii) 随机梯度方差项，亦随T降低。理论界中不存在不可约的模型异质性偏差。实验在CIFAR-10、FEMNIST、School Exam Score数据集上验证了理论。
AI.conclusion: 通过个性化分类头与共享鲁棒表征的结合，可在异质且含恶意客户端的联邦学习中消除模型异质性偏差，实现可随T和τ收敛的鲁棒参数恢复；回归结论可推广至多分类，并获得实验支持。

title: Counterfactual Probing for Parallel Unmasking with Hidden Forest Structure
summary: Masked generative models offer parallel token prediction, but accurate parallel sampling must account for dependencies among tokens. When dependencies are unknown, finding safe batches also costs model evaluations. We study whether total evaluations, including discovery, can be sublinear in sequence length $N$; sublinear sequential depth then follows. We consider discrete distributions with hidden forest structure, accessed through a fixed approximate conditional oracle. Under explicit regularity conditions and uniform Hellinger error bounds, for any fixed target accuracy $\varepsilon\in (0,1/8]$ and sufficiently large $N$, our sampler achieves seed-averaged total-variation error at most $\varepsilon$, with total masked-state submissions and sequential depth both bounded by $O(N^C \varepsilon^a)$ for constants $0 <C <1$ and $a > 0$. These guarantees use polynomial vocabulary size and an edge-response lower bound set by $N$ and $\varepsilon$. The sampler shares evaluations of hypothetical reveals across dependence tests to identify safe parallel batches without requiring full recovery of the hidden forest. A tunable parameter trades probing cost against irreversible commit rounds. In the same class, any admissible irreversible product-commit sampler attaining the same seed-averaged accuracy requires $Ω(N^c \varepsilon^b)$ counterfactual submissions or commit rounds in the worst case, for constants $c,b>0$.

AI.tldr: 在隐藏森林结构、固定近似条件预言机与显式正则条件下，本文提出一种共享反事实评估的并行掩码采样器，首次实现总评估量与序列深度对序列长度N的亚线性（O(N^C ε^a), 0<C<1）总变差误差保证，并证明同类不可逆乘积提交采样器存在Ω(N^c ε^b)下界，揭示探测成本与提交轮数的可调权衡。
AI.motivation: 掩码生成模型虽支持并行词元预测，但精确并行采样须处理词元间依赖；当依赖结构未知时，寻找安全批次本身也消耗模型评估。核心问题是：包含依赖发现在内的总评估量能否对序列长度N亚线性，从而带来亚线性串行深度。
AI.method: 针对具有隐藏森林结构的离散分布，通过固定近似条件预言机访问；在显式正则条件与一致Hellinger误差界下，设计采样器，将“假设性揭示”的评估在依赖检验间共享，以识别安全并行批次而无需完全恢复隐藏森林；引入可调参数在探测成本与不可逆提交轮数间权衡。
AI.result: 对任意固定目标精度ε∈(0,1/8]及充分大的N，采样器达到种子平均总变差误差≤ε，掩码状态提交总数与串行深度均为O(N^C ε^a)（0<C<1, a>0），在多项式词表规模及由N与ε设定的边响应下界下成立。下界方面：同类任何不可逆乘积提交采样器欲达相同种子平均精度，最坏情况下需Ω(N^c ε^b)次反事实提交或提交轮数（c,b>0）。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，在隐藏森林结构假设下，包含依赖发现的总评估量可对序列长度亚线性，并随之获得亚线性串行深度；共享反事实评估可在不恢复完整依赖结构的前提下识别安全并行批次；探测成本与不可逆提交轮数存在可调权衡，且不可逆乘积提交类采样器受Ω(N^c ε^b)下界限制，说明该权衡具有内在最优性意义。

title: Why Backdooring Neural Networks is so Easy?
summary: Securing modern AI systems against backdoor attacks remains an open challenge and requires fundamentally principled estimates of the adversary's budget -- the poison fraction $π$ and trigger strength $α$ needed to construct successful yet stealthy attacks. Motivated by recent empirical evidence that poisoning large language models can require a nearly constant number of malicious samples even as clean datasets grow, we derive an exact closed-form analysis of a quadratic neuron trained on a poisoned Gaussian mixture. We show, perhaps counterintuitively, that the same feature-learning dynamics that make neural networks powerful can also make them more vulnerable to backdoors. Specifically, with clean accuracy preserved to first order, $O(π)$, we demonstrate that lazy learning imposes the inverse-square-root scaling $α\propto π^{-1/2}$ for a successful attack, while feature learning induces a quadratic detector whose loss margin scales as $O(α^4)$, improving the attack budget to $α\propto π^{-1/4}$. Consequently, nonlinear feature learning substantially reduces the trigger strength required at small poison fractions, thereby in a sense making feature learners more backdoor vulnerable. These results provide a theoretical mechanism consistent with large-scale empirical observations and demonstrate that security audits based on linear heuristics can systematically underestimate backdoor vulnerability in the widely adopted feature-learning regimes.

AI.tldr: 该论文对受投毒高斯混合数据训练的二次神经元进行精确闭式分析，揭示了特征学习动态既提升网络能力，也使其更易受后门攻击：惰性学习要求触发强度按 α∝π^{-1/2} 缩放，而特征学习将损失边际改为 O(α^4)，使攻击预算改善至 α∝π^{-1/4}，从而在小投毒比例下显著降低所需触发强度。
AI.motivation: 保护现代AI系统免受后门攻击仍是开放挑战，需要从原理上估计成功且隐蔽攻击所需对手预算（投毒比例 π 与触发强度 α）。近期经验证据表明，投毒大语言模型所需的恶意样本数几乎恒定，即使干净数据规模增长，这一现象缺乏理论解释，且传统基于线性启发式的安全审计可能系统性低估后门脆弱性。
AI.method: 作者在一个受投毒的高斯混合分布上训练二次神经元，推导出精确的闭式解，并在保持干净精度至一阶 O(π) 的条件下，分别分析惰性学习与特征学习两种机制下的攻击可行条件与损失边际缩放关系。
AI.result: 结果显示：惰性学习强加逆平方根缩放 α∝π^{-1/2} 才能实现成功攻击；特征学习则诱导出损失边际按 O(α^4) 缩放的二次检测器，将攻击预算改善为 α∝π^{-1/4}。因此在小投毒比例下，非线性特征学习大幅降低所需触发强度。
AI.conclusion: 该研究给出了与大规模经验观察一致的理论机制，说明特征学习在某种意义上使模型更易受后门攻击，并表明基于线性启发式的安全审计会系统性低估广泛采用特征学习范式下的后门脆弱性。

title: Stochastic Heavy Ball with Polyak Step Size and Armijo Line Search: A General Convergence Analysis
summary: Polyak step size (PS) and Armijo line search (ALS) have received increasing attention in stochastic optimization, with encouraging empirical performance and theoretical guarantees. However, their convergence theory for stochastic heavy ball (SHB) methods remains limited. In this work, we develop a unified convergence analysis for SHB equipped with PS and ALS. To this end, we introduce a modified Armijo rule that closely parallels the Polyak step size, together with a decoupling analysis that isolates the historical dependence induced by momentum. For SHB with standard PS and ALS, we establish expected convergence for strongly convex, convex, and non-convex objectives without interpolation or restrictive conditions on the momentum parameter. Under interpolation or strong growth, we further strengthen the results to almost sure rates and last-iterate convergence. Moreover, for general settings beyond interpolation, we prove almost sure convergence to the exact optimum or to stationarity for SHB with diminishing variants of PS and ALS. These results provide a more comprehensive theoretical view of Polyak step size and Armijo line search for stochastic heavy ball methods.

AI.tldr: 本文为配备 Polyak 步长与 Armijo 线搜索的随机重球法建立了统一的收敛性分析，涵盖强凸、凸与非凸目标，并在插值或强增长条件下给出几乎必然速率与末次迭代收敛。
AI.motivation: Polyak 步长（PS）与 Armijo 线搜索（ALS）在随机优化中受到越来越多关注，兼具良好经验表现与理论保证，但针对随机重球法（SHB）的收敛理论仍十分有限，缺乏统一且不依赖插值或动量参数限制的分析框架。
AI.method: 作者提出改进的 Armijo 规则，使其与 Polyak 步长紧密对应，并设计解耦分析以分离动量引入的历史依赖性。基于此框架，对标准 PS 与 ALS 下的 SHB 建立期望收敛性，不依赖插值或对动量参数的苛刻限制；进一步在插值或强增长条件下强化结果；对超出插值的一般情形，采用递减型 PS 与 ALS 变体进行分析。
AI.result: 对标准 PS 与 ALS 的 SHB，在强凸、凸及非凸目标下均获得期望收敛；在插值或强增长条件下，进一步得到几乎必然速率与末次迭代收敛；在超出插值的一般设置中，对递减型 PS 与 ALS 变体证明了几乎必然收敛到精确最优解或稳定点。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为随机重球法中 Polyak 步长与 Armijo 线搜索提供了更完整的理论图景，统一了不同凸性设定下的收敛分析，并放宽了插值与动量参数限制，拓展了自适应步长方法在带动量随机优化中的理论适用性。

title: Search Dimension in Unlabeled Projection Pursuit: A Scaling Law for Subspace Restriction
summary: Projection pursuit searches for a direction along which the data look least Gaussian. When the observation space contains a large Gaussian complement, the empirical objective can be minimized by a direction that carries no signal, with empirical kurtosis as low as at the truth. Sample splitting exposes rather than repairs this failure. Appending coordinates independent of the latent regime degrades the search while leaving Bayes recoverability unchanged.
