AI.motivation: 多模态大模型（MLLMs）虽被寄予高效适配下游任务之期望，但在监督信号有限时适配依然困难。现有方案主要依赖两类路径：对MLLM参数进行微调，或训练基于神经网络的解码器。二者在标签稀缺时均表现不佳；此外，微调还需访问模型参数，而闭源模型通常不提供该权限。因此，需要一种不依赖底层模型参数、且能在有限监督下有效适配的解码方案。
AI.method: 提出AdaKerNet，一种可学习的任务自适应神经核解码器，完全对底层MLLM参数不可知（parameter-agnostic），仅作用于其冻结的、来自多种模态的丰富表征。其核心由三部分组成：(i) 一组可学习的、受Lipschitz约束控制的多模态特征，由MLLM表征导出；(ii) 一个参考核，为这些特征提供软结构先验；(iii) 一个轻量级非线性神经预测器，对该结构进行自适应形变。核表征与神经预测器在统一优化框架内联合学习，从而捕获与下游任务相关的特征及几何关系。
AI.result: 在四个MLLM（BLIP-2、LLaVA-1.5、Qwen2.5-VL、Gemini Embedding 2）以及涵盖文本、音频、图像和表格测量值的多模态输入上开展数值实验，结果显示：在多种稀缺标签预算下，AdaKerNet均较直接的MLP、注意力、自编码器及核方法解码器取得显著且一致的改进，相对基线平均误差降低最多达41%。额外的结构消融实验验证了各组成部分的互补贡献。
AI.conclusion: 实验表明，AdaKerNet是面向冻结多模态表征、在稀缺标签情形下进行预测的有效方法；其性能优势在不同MLLM、不同模态输入和不同标签预算下均保持一致，结构消融进一步证实了各模块的必要性与互补性。

title: Neural Succession: A Mesoscopic Theory of Invasion, Coexistence, and Stabilization in Continual Learning
comment: 20 pages, 10 figures, 7 tables. Code available at https://github.com/shoaibdipu/Neural_Succession/
summary: Continual learning is usually studied through mechanisms that preserve old knowledge. We develop Successional Learning Theory (SLT), a mesoscopic account in which the current representation is a resident community, the incoming task is an invader, forgetting is resident displacement, joint retention is coexistence, replay is resident reinforcement, and training moves from establishment toward stabilization. Its empirical coordinate is directional pre-invasion compatibility, measured on the resident model before the incoming task is learned. Across eight experiments, compatibility orders later forgetting on the 20 directed Split-CIFAR-10 transitions (three-repeat r=-0.789, incoming-task cluster 95% CI [-0.90,-0.72], every repeat alone r<=-0.67), forecasts held-out forgetting with 24% lower error than a no-information baseline, and reproduces under controlled MNIST permutations and CIFAR-10 rotations (r=-0.804, -0.718). On an 84-transition suite, compatibility separates coexistence from exclusion at every retention threshold (AUC 0.93-0.97). Replay repairs every transition with at most 325 stored examples and is most efficient where displacement is largest. Compatibility reaches |r|=0.720, while activation, representation, Jacobian, and fixed-coefficient Lotka-Volterra specializations do not. Plasticity and feature turnover fall reliably from early to late training (15/15 and 14/15 runs). We formalize a minimum habitat-modification bound, a displacement floor, a sufficient coexistence condition, an identifiability law with a range-restriction corollary, successional stabilization, and local reinforcement. The identifiability law also predicts where the coordinate loses leverage, and the prediction matches three CIFAR-100 partitions and five optimizer regimes. SLT is a pre-adaptation diagnostic that complements replay, regularization, and projection methods.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"演替学习理论"(SLT)，将连续学习中的表示视为"驻留群落"、新任务视为"入侵者"、遗忘视为"驻留置换"、联合保持视为"共存"、回放视为"驻留强化"，其经验坐标是任务入侵前的方向性兼容性，可在学习新任务前测量，并用于预测遗忘。
AI.motivation: 连续学习通常通过保留旧知识的机制来研究，但缺乏一个可学习的理论框架来统一解释遗忘、共存、回放等现象，也缺少能在新任务学习之前就预测遗忘的诊断指标。
AI.method: 将连续学习建模为群落生态学式的介观过程：当前表示为驻留群落，新任务为入侵者，遗忘为驻留置换，联合保持为共存，回放为驻留强化。核心是可测量的"入侵前方向性兼容性"坐标，在驻留模型上、学习新任务之前测得。通过8组实验在Split-CIFAR-10有向转移、受控MNIST置换和CIFAR-10旋转上进行验证，并在84转移套件上评估共存与排斥的区分能力，比较回放修复效果，并与激活、表示、Jacobian及固定系数Lotka-Volterra特化方法对比。同时形式化了最小生境修改界、置换下界、充分共存条件、可识别性定律及范围限制推论、演替稳定化和局部强化。
AI.result: 兼容性可排序后续遗忘：在20个有向Split-CIFAR-10转移上三重复r=-0.789（新任务聚类95% CI [-0.90,-0.72]，单次重复r≤-0.67），预测留出遗忘的误差比无信息基线低24%，并在MNIST置换和CIFAR-10旋转上复现（r=-0.804、-0.718）。在84转移套件上，兼容性在每个保持阈值下区分共存与排斥（AUC 0.93-0.97）。回放以最多325个存储样本修复每个转移，且在置换最大处效率最高。兼容性达到|r|=0.720，而激活、表示、Jacobian和固定系数Lotka-Volterra特化方法未达到。可塑性和特征周转从训练早期到晚期可靠下降（15/15和14/15次运行）。可识别性定律预测坐标在何处失去效力，预测与三个CIFAR-100划分和五种优化器机制相符。
AI.conclusion: SLT提供了一种预适应诊断工具，可在新任务学习前预测遗忘并指导回放资源配置，与回放、正则化和投影方法互补。

title: Reward-rate Policy Gradient for Efficient Machine Learning Engineering Agents
summary: Traditional reinforcement learning (RL) techniques focus on maximizing expected cumulative reward, where each action assumes to take a constant unit of time. However, this assumption does not hold for agentic RL tasks such as machine learning engineering (MLE) agents, where actions involve data loading, feature engineering, and model training that take variable durations. Efficiency matters in modern agentic RL where actions are costly. To address this limitation, we adapt from continuous-time RL and Semi-Markov Decision Process (SMDP) formulation and propose Reward-rate Policy Gradient (RPG), where we focus on optimizing the reward rate -- the long-term reward per unit of time. RPG estimates the reward rate from off-policy samples, then charges each action for the time it consumes at that rate. We first conduct theoretical analysis in the bandit setting to establish that RPG approximates the optimal reward rate and empirically demonstrate it outperforms baselines while avoiding enumeration over the policy space, a known issue for an existing method. We then further apply RPG on a small language model (Qwen3.5-4B) with self-improvement loops and empirically show it obtains higher rewards within a fixed time budget than vanilla RL on MLE-Bench and NanoGPT, with a 19.2% and 85.7% margin, respectively. Our method provides a practical solution for optimizing performance under wait time considerations in modern agentic RL tasks, where actions interact with external environments and cost time.

AI.tldr: 本文针对智能体强化学习中动作耗时可变的问题，提出奖励率策略梯度（RPG），通过优化单位时间长期奖励（奖励率）来提升时间预算内的性能。
AI.motivation: 传统强化学习最大化期望累积奖励，假设每个动作耗时恒定的单位时间。但在MLE智能体等任务中，动作（数据加载、特征工程、模型训练）耗时可变且代价高昂，效率至关重要，该假设不再成立。
AI.method: 借鉴连续时间强化学习与半马尔可夫决策过程（SMDP）建模，提出奖励率策略梯度（RPG），以单位时间长期奖励为目标进行优化。RPG从离策略样本估计奖励率，并按该速率对每个动作按其所耗时间进行"计费"。
AI.result: 在bandit设定下理论分析表明RPG可逼近最优奖励率，实验显示其优于基线且无需枚举策略空间（规避了现有方法的缺陷）。在小型语言模型（Qwen3.5-4B）结合自改进循环中，RPG在固定时间预算下于MLE-Bench和NanoGPT上获得的奖励分别高出普通RL 19.2%和85.7%。
AI.conclusion: RPG为现代智能体强化学习中需要在等待时间约束下优化性能的任务（动作与外部环境交互且耗时）提供了实用解决方案。

title: Longer Records, Broader Invariance: The Hidden Scaling Problem in Longitudinal Contrastive Learning
summary: Longitudinal data are valuable because people change. Yet the objectives used to learn from these data can inadvertently erase that change. In person-level contrastive learning, observations from the same person are treated as positives; as records grow, those positives can span increasingly distant---and increasingly different---behavioral states. More history can therefore produce not only more data, but broader invariance. We show that this distinction is fundamental. We separate \emph{record span}, how much history the learner sees, from \emph{supervision span}, how far across that history positive-pair supervision reaches. Across in-home sensing records spanning up to 2.7 years, broader supervision systematically suppresses recoverable changing-state information, even when the available history is held fixed. At the broadest span, less than 10\% of the information recoverable from an untrained encoder remains. Yet keeping positives local is not sufficient: as records grow, even distant states that are never paired become increasingly similar. Explicitly contrasting other observations from the same person reverses this loss without shortening the record, revealing a second route by which longitudinal scale can broaden invariance. Finally, we prospectively reproduce the supervision-span effect in 199 GLOBEM participants. Longitudinal scale therefore presents a choice: more history need not mean more invariance. By controlling what is held invariant as records grow, we can preserve the change that made the longitudinal data valuable in the first place.

AI.tldr: 该研究区分了记录跨度与监督跨度，发现纵向数据中更宽的监督范围会系统性抹除可恢复的状态变化信息，并揭示了保持局部正例之外的第二种不变性来源及可逆性。
AI.motivation: 纵向数据价值在于个体随时间变化，但个体级对比学习将同一人观测视为正例，随记录增长正例会跨越越来越远且差异越大的行为状态，从而可能产生过宽的不变性，抹除变化信息。作者欲厘清这一目标与数据价值之间的根本张力。
AI.method: 作者将"记录跨度"（学习器可见的历史量）与"监督跨度"（正例对监督在历史中延伸的范围）分离，在长达2.7年的居家传感记录上，在固定可用历史的前提下改变监督跨度，并检验显式对比同一人其他观测的效果，最后在199名GLOBEM参与者中进行前瞻性复现。
AI.result: 在固定历史条件下，更宽的监督系统性地抑制可恢复的变化状态信息，最宽跨度下从未训练编码器可恢复的信息中保留不足10%；仅保持正例局部并不足够，随记录增长未配对的不同状态也趋于相似；显式对比同一人其他观测可在不缩短记录的情况下逆转这种损失；监督跨度效应在199名GLOBEM参与者中前瞻性复现。
AI.conclusion: 纵向尺度是一种选择而非必然：更多历史不必意味着更强的不变性。通过控制随记录增长被保持不变的对象，可以保留使纵向数据有价值的个体变化，为纵向对比学习的目标设计提供依据。

title: Theory on Attention Dynamics for Out-of-Distribution In-Context Learning
summary: Transformers have demonstrated remarkable in-context learning (ICL) capabilities, enabling them to perform new tasks without additional fine-tuning. However, their performance often deteriorates when encountering out-of-distribution (OOD) inputs that deviate from the training distribution, and the underlying theory remains poorly understood. To fill this gap, we characterize the OOD error under the input distribution shift through the interplay between the dynamics of the so-called $α$-type and $β$-type attention weights, which represent the transformer's confidence in identifying the correct and incorrect features, respectively. Our results indicate that the OOD error for each feature depends on all pairwise interactions between the training features and OOD features, and under certain cases the transformer performs no better than random guessing. To improve the OOD generalization performance, we next investigate the impact of model finetuning with the OOD data, and particularly, characterize the model forgetting performance on the source domain. Interestingly, the performance on the source domain may not always degrade after finetuning, which highly depends on the nature of the feature shift: finetuning on OOD domain keeps enhancing the confidence of identifying correct features from the original distribution, while the interference from other incorrect features may either increase or decrease. Extensive experiments on both synthetic and real data are conducted to corroborate the theoretical insights.

AI.tldr: 本文通过α型与β型注意力权重的动态交互刻画分布偏移下Transformer的OOD误差，揭示其可能不优于随机猜测，并分析微调对源域遗忘的影响。
AI.motivation: Transformer虽具备强大的上下文学习（ICL）能力，但在遇到偏离训练分布的OOD输入时性能常显著下降，而这一现象的理论机制尚不清晰，本文旨在填补该理论空白。
AI.method: 从输入分布偏移出发，将OOD误差分解为α型注意力权重（识别正确特征的置信度）与β型注意力权重（识别错误特征的置信度）之间的动态交互；进一步分析在OOD数据上微调时源域遗忘的表现，考察特征偏移性质对源域性能的影响。
AI.result: 每个特征的OOD误差取决于训练特征与OOD特征之间所有成对交互，在特定情形下Transformer表现不优于随机猜测；微调对源域性能的影响并非总是负向，取决于特征偏移性质：微调持续增强对原分布正确特征的识别置信度，而其他错误特征的干扰可能增加或减少。合成与真实数据的实验均验证了理论结论。
AI.conclusion: 本文给出了OOD场景下Transformer ICL误差的理论刻画，阐明了注意力权重动态与特征交互的作用，并揭示了OOD微调中源域遗忘的条件性规律，为提升OOD泛化提供了理论依据。

title: Invariant Atoms: Sparse Coordinates of Local Semantic Geometry in Language Model Representations
summary: Large language models often preserve meaning despite substantial changes in wording, style, and syntax, while small semantic edits can systematically alter their hidden representations. This suggests that semantic variation may be organized along recurring local directions. We propose the Invariant Atom Hypothesis: local semantic motion admits preferred sparse coordinates along directions that remain stable under meaning-preserving transformations. We learn a shared semantic frame and sparse coordinates that reconstruct semantic displacements while suppressing nuisance variation, with anchor-dependent diagonal modulation adjusting atom strengths without sample-specific rotations. Empirically, the atoms exhibit strong semantic--nuisance separation, sparse reconstruction, reproducible directions, and causal effects on model predictions. The learned geometry generalizes to unseen semantic neighborhoods and nuisance families, while local reweighting improves semantic selectivity and preserves a consistent global-to-local structure. Atom signatures also remain stable under model modification. These findings support reusable invariant directions as a sparse coordinate system for local semantic geometry in language models.

AI.tldr: 该文提出"不变原子假说"：语义变化沿一组可复用的稀疏局部方向组织。作者学习共享语义框与稀疏坐标，在抑制干扰变量的同时重构语义位移，并验证了原子的语义-干扰分离性、稀疏性、可复现性、因果性与泛化性。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在措辞、风格、句法大幅变化时仍能保持语义，而微小的语义编辑却会系统性地改变隐藏表示。这表明语义变异可能沿可复现的局部方向组织，但缺乏对这类局部语义几何结构的显式刻画与验证。
AI.method: 提出不变原子假说，假设局部语义运动存在优先的稀疏坐标，其方向在保义变换下保持稳定。具体地，学习一个共享语义框与稀疏坐标以重构语义位移，同时抑制干扰变量；采用依赖于锚点的对角调制来调整原子强度，而不引入样本特定的旋转。
AI.result: 原子表现出显著的语义-干扰分离、稀疏重构、方向可复现以及对模型预测的因果效应；所学几何可泛化到未见语义邻域与干扰族；局部重加权提升语义选择性并保持一致的全局-局部结构；原子签名在模型改动下依然稳定。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果支持将可复用不变方向视为语言模型中局部语义几何的稀疏坐标系统。

title: Channel-Dependent State Space Model for Multivariate Time Series Forecasting
summary: Multivariate time series forecasting (MTSF) is critical across many real-world domains. Existing deep learning approaches fall into two paradigms with distinct limitations: channel-independent (CI) methods unconditionally ignore cross-variable dependencies and model only temporal dynamics, while channel-dependent (CD) methods consider both but typically rely on architectural compromises to mitigate overfitting and computational overhead. We therefore propose Chameleon, a specialized CD state space model (SSM) that enables data-dependent, fine-grained interactions across variables while scaling linearly with their number. By connecting selective SSMs with the Kalman filter, we leverage the missing measurement update in the former for cross-variable modeling while preserving the SSM backbone for robust temporal modeling. We further identify favorable inductive biases of GatedDeltaNet for time series, adapt it as our backbone, and improve generalization through additional techniques, including a previously unexplored stochastic perturbation of reversible instance normalization. On strongly dependent ODE and PEMS datasets, Chameleon achieves the best MSE and MAE across all settings, while its CI ablation and prior CD methods incur 61-178% higher MSE on average. Across 28 standard benchmark settings, Chameleon also achieves better MSE and MAE than each baseline in at least 27 and 22 cases, respectively. Training-time and peak-memory analyses on Traffic and ETT further demonstrate competitive efficiency and favorable memory scalability across different variable counts.

AI.tldr: 提出 Chameleon——一种专用的通道依赖状态空间模型，通过将选择性 SSM 与 Kalman 滤波联系起来实现细粒度变量交互，同时保持线性复杂度，在多个 MTSF 基准上取得最优或近最优的 MSE/MAE。
AI.motivation: 多变量时间序列预测中，通道独立（CI）方法无条件忽略跨变量依赖，仅建模时间动态；通道依赖（CD）方法虽同时考虑两者，但通常依赖架构折衷来缓解过拟合与计算开销。因此需要一种既能实现数据依赖、细粒度跨变量交互，又能随变量数量线性扩展的专用 CD 模型。
AI.method: 提出 Chameleon，一种专用 CD 状态空间模型。方法上：1）将选择性 SSM 与 Kalman 滤波相连接，利用前者的缺失观测更新（missing measurement update）来建模跨变量关系，同时保留 SSM 主干进行鲁棒的时间建模；2）识别 GatedDeltaNet 在时间序列上的有利归纳偏置，并将其适配为主干；3）通过附加技术提升泛化性，包括对可逆实例归一化（reversible instance normalization）进行此前未被探索的随机扰动。
AI.result: 在强依赖的 ODE 与 PEMS 数据集上，Chameleon 在所有设置下取得最优 MSE 与 MAE，其 CI 消融版本及先前 CD 方法的平均 MSE 高出 61–178%。在 28 个标准基准设置中，Chameleon 分别在至少 27 个和 22 个设置上优于各基线的 MSE 与 MAE。Traffic 与 ETT 的训练时间与峰值内存分析进一步表明其具有竞争性的效率，并在不同变量数量下表现出良好的内存可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: Chameleon 通过选择性 SSM 与 Kalman 滤波的理论联系实现了高效、数据依赖的跨变量建模，兼顾时间动态与变量依赖，在精度与效率上均优于现有 CI/CD 方法，为 MTSF 提供了一种可线性扩展的专用 CD 建模范式。

title: Emergent phases of superposition: from partial to full representation
summary: Large language models are thought to represent features by vectors in a hidden space of dimension given by the model's width. Superposition, in which more features are represented than the width by letting representation vectors overlap, is a leading account of how representation vectors are organized. However, how model width and data statistics determine the configuration of representation vectors and the resulting loss when the number of features and the width are large remains less understood. Here we show, in Anthropic's toy model of superposition, that increasing the width drives a continuous phase transition from a partial-representation phase, where only a subset of features receives appreciable representation vectors while the rest vanish, to a full-representation phase, where every feature is represented. Our theory via a partial random projection approximation predicts, and experiments confirm, that the critical width grows linearly with the number of active features up to a logarithmic factor. The loss scaling changes across the transition: below the critical width, the loss grows linearly with the number of active features and depends weakly on the width in a form set by data statistics; above it, the loss grows approximately quadratically with the number of active features and decays inversely with the width. Non-uniform firing probabilities delay the transition and lower the loss, as more frequent features occupy more space. Our results provide an account of how model width and data statistics jointly shape representations and loss, a step toward understanding representation scaling in large models.

AI.tldr: 本文研究Anthropic叠加玩具模型中模型宽度与数据统计对表示向量配置及损失的影响，发现宽度增加会驱动从"部分表示相"到"全表示相"的连续相变，理论预测并被实验证实临界宽度随活跃特征数线性增长（至多对数因子），且损失标度在相变前后呈现不同规律。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型被认为在宽度等于模型宽度的隐空间中用向量表示特征，叠加（superposition）现象说明表示向量数量可超过宽度。但模型宽度与数据统计如何共同决定表示向量配置及损失，尤其在特征数和宽度都很大时仍缺乏理解，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 在Anthropic的叠加玩具模型（toy model of superposition）中，采用部分随机投影近似（partial random projection approximation）建立理论，分析临界宽度随活跃特征数的变化，并对不同宽度和特征数条件下的损失标度进行推导，辅以实验验证。
AI.result: 增加宽度会驱动从部分表示相（仅子集特征获得可感知表示向量，其余消失）到全表示相（每个特征都被表示）的连续相变；理论预测并被实验证实临界宽度随活跃特征数线性增长（至多相差对数因子）。损失标度在相变两侧不同：临界宽度以下损失随活跃特征数线性增长且对宽度弱依赖（由数据统计决定形式）；临界宽度以上损失随活跃特征数近似二次增长并随宽度反比衰减。非均匀激活概率会推迟相变并降低损失，因为高频特征占据更多空间。
AI.conclusion: 本文揭示了模型宽度与数据统计如何共同塑造表示和损失，为理解大模型中的表示标度律（representation scaling）迈出了一步。

title: Fisher-IRG: Fisher-Induced Local Invariant Representation Geometry across Language and Vision Models
summary: Semantic-preserving transformations can induce substantial motion in learned representations, while small changes may strongly affect model predictions, raising a basic question: what local metric best captures semantically consequential variation? We propose Fisher-induced invariant representation geometry (Fisher-IRG), which measures local representation directions through their predictive sensitivity. Around each representation, we construct semantic-preserving and semantic-changing neighborhoods, aggregate their local Fisher information, and recover invariant directions through a contrastive generalized eigenvalue problem. Controlled displacement analyses first show that comparable Euclidean motion can have substantially different predictive consequences, supporting the need for a predictive geometry. Across language and vision models, Fisher-IRG yields stronger semantic-versus-nuisance predictive selectivity and generally more reproducible subspaces than covariance-based geometry, while recovering systematically distinct local directions. Representation interventions further localize semantic effects to the Fisher-derived subspace, and held-out separation and retrieval show that the recovered geometry generalizes beyond the discovery neighborhoods. These results support Fisher-IRG as a principled framework for characterizing local invariant representation geometry.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Fisher诱导不变表示几何（Fisher-IRG），以预测敏感性度量局部表示方向，通过构造语义保持/语义改变邻域并聚合局部Fisher信息，用对比广义特征值问题恢复不变方向，在语言与视觉模型中验证其能更好区分语义与冗余变化。
AI.motivation: 语义保持的变换可能在学得表示中造成显著位移，而微小变化又可能强烈影响模型预测，因此需要一个能刻画“语义重要变化”的局部度量。现有基于协方差的几何无法体现预测后果，需引入预测性几何。
AI.method: 提出Fisher-IRG：对每个表示构造语义保持与语义改变两类邻域，聚合各自的局部Fisher信息，通过对比广义特征值问题求解不变方向，以预测敏感性定义局部表示方向。
AI.result: 受控位移分析表明相当的欧氏位移可带来显著不同的预测后果；在语言与视觉模型上，Fisher-IRG比协方差几何具有更强的语义-冗余预测选择性、更可复现的子空间，并恢复系统性不同的局部方向；表示干预将语义效应定位于Fisher子空间；留出集分离与检索显示该几何可泛化到发现邻域之外。
AI.conclusion: Fisher-IRG可作为刻画局部不变表示几何的原则性框架。

title: DisCoMBO: Steering Expert-in-the-Loop Black Box Optimization via Distributional Conformance
summary: Sequential Model-Based Optimization (SMBO) traditionally relies on Bayesian or ensembling surrogates for uncertainty quantification. While historically treated as fully data-driven, SMBO increasingly integrates external domain expertise to accelerate discovery. To overcome the opaque guidance and diminished integration fidelity of standard acquisition re-weighting, Probabilistic Circuits (PCs) have emerged as a generative surrogate alternative, enabling direct knowledge injection via conditional sampling. However, these generative routines lack the formal exploration-exploitation semantics required for rigorous optimization. We introduce the Distributional Conformance Score (DisCo), a novel metric that unifies the flexibility and efficiency of PCs with a formal uncertainty framework. DisCo provides a bounded, $[0, 1]$-normalized measure of model "surprise" that (1) recovers properties comparable to kernel-based uncertainty known from, e.g., Gaussian Processes, while maintaining linear-time inference, and (2) enables accurate assessment of conformance of external knowledge w.r.t. model evidence. We then present DisCoMBO, a framework leveraging these properties for robust, knowledge-aware optimization. We prove that DisCoMBO is a zero-regret algorithm and demonstrate its effectiveness across diverse benchmarks from AutoML, material optimization, and wind park optimization.

AI.tldr: 提出分布一致性分数DisCo及基于它的DisCoMBO框架，为概率电路生成式代理提供形式化不确定性度量，实现零遗憾知识感知优化。
AI.motivation: 传统SMBO依赖贝叶斯或集成代理进行不确定性量化，虽日益引入外部领域知识，但标准采集函数重加权方式引导不透明、知识融合保真度低。概率电路虽可通过条件采样直接注入知识，却缺乏严谨的探索-利用语义。
AI.method: 提出Distributional Conformance Score (DisCo)：一种有界且归一化到[0,1]的模型"惊讶度"度量，统一概率电路的灵活高效与形式化不确定性框架，保持线性时间推理，并能评估外部知识相对模型证据的一致性；进而构建DisCoMBO框架用于鲁棒的知识感知优化。
AI.result: DisCo恢复出与高斯过程等核方法不确定性相当的性质，同时保持线性时间推理；可准确评估外部知识的一致性。DisCoMBO被证明为零遗憾算法，并在AutoML、材料优化和风电场优化等多样基准上表现出有效性。
AI.conclusion: DisCo为生成式代理提供了形式化不确定性度量，使概率电路可在严格优化语义下融合外部知识，DisCoMBO作为零遗憾算法在多个领域验证了其知识感知优化的有效性。

title: Guard Models Are Overconfident Where Base Models Are Uncertain
summary: Guard models are used as safety classifiers, with confidence scores driving downstream moderation decisions. We evaluate five guard models for prompt classification and find that although several are nearly calibrated on clean inputs, adversarial attacks degrade their calibration by an order of magnitude, turning false negatives into high-confidence errors indistinguishable from correct detections. Comparing each guard with its corresponding base LM, we find that uncertainty signals often remain available, with the base model typically expressing uncertainty on the same inputs where the guard fails. Layer-wise analyses localize this guard-base divergence to later layers, where guard models exhibit sharper safe/unsafe separation and lower-rank representations, while adversarial harmful inputs lie closer to the clean-safe region. These findings highlight a mismatch between guard confidence and base model uncertainty under attack.

AI.tldr: 该论文评测五个guard模型的置信度校准，发现对抗攻击会使其校准能力下降一个数量级，假阴性变成高置信错误；而对应base LM在相同输入上仍保持不确定性信号，差异定位在较后层。
AI.motivation: Guard模型作为安全分类器，其置信度直接驱动下游审核决策。若置信度在对抗攻击下不可靠，高置信的假阴性将难以被下游区分和拦截，因此需要系统评估其校准性及与base LM的差异。
AI.method: 对五个guard模型进行提示分类评测：比较干净输入与对抗攻击下的校准表现；将每个guard与其对应的base LM对比，考察不确定性信号是否仍可获得；并通过逐层分析定位guard-base分歧所在层，分析安全/不安全分离度与表示秩。
AI.result: 多个guard模型在干净输入上接近良好校准，但对抗攻击使校准退化约一个数量级，假阴性呈现与正确检测难以区分的高置信错误。base LM通常在与guard失败相同的输入上表达不确定性。逐层分析显示分歧集中在较后层：guard模型具有更尖锐的安全/不安全分离和更低秩的表示，而对抗性有害输入更靠近干净安全区域。
AI.conclusion: guard模型的置信度与其base LM的不确定性在攻击下存在错配；base LM的不确定性信号或可被利用以改善guard在对抗条件下的可靠性与校准。

title: The Teacher Is a Direction, Not a Destination: Extrapolating RL-Induced Representation Residuals in On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student to match the teacher's next-token distributions on the student's own trajectories and has yielded substantial empirical gains. Generalized variants allow the student to surpass the teacher by extrapolating an implicit reward in output space. The language-model head, however, attenuates this change anisotropically: much of the change encoded in the teacher's hidden states reaches the logits at a small fraction of its weight, and the sampled-token log-probability ratios on which output-space extrapolation relies inject noise that the extrapolation amplifies, making training unstable. We observe that reinforcement learning (RL) shifts a model's internal representations relative to its base checkpoint, and that the direction of this shift can be measured at every layer. Motivated by this observation, we propose RIDE (RL-Induced Direction Extrapolation), which extrapolates the RL-induced change directly in representation space: at every layer and token position, RIDE computes the residual between the teacher and its pre-RL checkpoint and regresses the student's hidden states toward targets displaced beyond the teacher along this residual. Conditioned on a sampled trajectory, this regression is equivalent to maximizing a linear directional reward defined by the residual under a quadratic penalty centered at the teacher, which makes explicit how the objective moves the student along the RL-induced direction while limiting its deviation from the teacher. Across four base/RL-teacher pairs spanning different scales, architectures, and pre-training lineages, RIDE approaches or exceeds the RL-trained teacher on every pair and is the only method whose mean does so, and it consistently outperforms output-space extrapolation, which degrades the student whenever the teacher is close to its base. Project page: https://github.com/xixixixixxxx/RIDE.

AI.tldr: 提出RIDE方法，通过在表示空间外推RL诱导的变化方向来训练学生模型，使其逼近甚至超越RL教师模型。
AI.motivation: 现有on-policy蒸馏（OPD）的泛化变体试图通过输出空间外推隐式奖励让学生超越教师，但语言模型头会各向异性地衰减这种变化，且采样token的对数概率比引入了被外推放大的噪声，导致训练不稳定。作者观察到RL会相对于基座checkpoint改变模型内部表示，且该偏移方向可在每一层测量。
AI.method: RIDE（RL-Induced Direction Extrapolation）：在每一层和每个token位置，计算教师与其RL前checkpoint之间的残差，将学生隐藏状态回归到沿该残差方向、超越教师的位移目标上。在给定采样轨迹条件下，该回归等价于在教师中心化的二次惩罚下最大化由残差定义的线性方向奖励。
AI.result: 在四组不同规模、架构和预训练来源的基座/RL教师对上，RIDE在每一组都接近或超越RL教师，是唯一在所有对上均达到该效果的均值方法，并持续优于输出空间外推法（后者在教师接近基座时会损害学生）。
AI.conclusion: 在表示空间直接外推RL诱导的偏移方向，比在输出空间外推更稳定有效，为学生超越教师提供了新范式。

title: AdaptArena: Evaluating Test-Time Personalization of Web Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents have demonstrated strong performance on complex web navigation tasks, yet they remain brittle in real-world settings where user intentions are underspecified and preferences are heterogeneous. In practice, users rarely provide explicit profiles, requiring agents to infer latent preferences from implicit signals. Despite its importance for deployment, this problem setting is largely underexplored in existing benchmarks. To address this gap, we introduce AdaptArena, a benchmark for evaluating test-time personalization of web agents via implicit preference inference. AdaptArena consists of 480 tasks, featuring both single-preference and double-preference scenarios. Each evaluation task must be solved by retrieving and leveraging the most relevant historical user trajectory that implicitly encodes the target preference. In addition, we introduce AdaptiveAgent, a retrieval-based framework for standardized evaluation of implicit preference inference. Experiments reveal a substantial performance gap: while oracle agents with access to ground-truth preferences achieve an 82.92% success rate, the evaluated LLM agents using our framework reach at most 15.62%. Furthermore, we find that correctly inferring user preferences is necessary but not sufficient for task success, as execution failures in downstream web interactions remain a significant bottleneck even when agents align with the target preference. These findings highlight implicit preference inference and robust action grounding as key challenges for deploying reliable, user-facing web agents. We release our code: https://github.com/McGill-NLP/web-agents-test-time-adaptations

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AdaptArena 基准与 AdaptiveAgent 框架，评估网页智能体在测试时通过隐式偏好推断实现个性化适配的能力，揭示隐式偏好推断与动作执行是当前核心瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 现有网页导航基准中，用户意图往往明确且偏好同质，而真实场景下用户很少提供显式画像，智能体需从隐式信号中推断潜在偏好。该问题对实际部署至关重要，却缺乏相应评测平台。
AI.method: 构建 AdaptArena 基准，包含 480 个任务，覆盖单偏好与双偏好场景；每个任务需检索并利用隐含目标偏好的历史用户轨迹来求解。同时提出 AdaptiveAgent，一个基于检索的框架，用于标准化评估隐式偏好推断。
AI.result: Oracle 智能体（可直接获取真实偏好）成功率达 82.92%，而使用该框架的 LLM 智能体最高仅 15.62%，差距显著。此外，即使智能体对齐了目标偏好，下游网页交互中的执行失败仍是显著瓶颈，说明正确推断偏好是任务成功的必要非充分条件。
AI.conclusion: 隐式偏好推断与稳健的动作落地是部署可靠、面向用户的网页智能体的关键挑战。代码已开源。

title: LLMs Learn to Evade Latent Monitors from Prior Feedback Alone
summary: Latent space monitors aim to detect undesired behaviors in LLM agents by inspecting an agent's internal activations rather than its outputs. However, interactive monitoring creates a feedback channel where each verdict the monitor delivers leaks information to the model about how its internal states are being evaluated. We ask whether an agent can infer the monitor's decision rule from this feedback and then selectively edit its activations to evade detection. Unlike prior evasion attacks, the model is never explicitly told what the monitor detects. Surprisingly, off-the-shelf models already produce activation edits aligned with the monitored direction, but at insufficient magnitude for evasion. Simply scaling up these edits by a factor of 8 reduces the monitor's TPR from 100% to 27%. A rank-1 LoRA amplifies this behavior into effective evasion within the forward pass, reducing TPR further to 4% on held-out concept monitors while leaving other concepts at their normal detection rates. Capabilities on standard benchmarks are retained under this finetuning, and the evasion skill survives retraining the monitors on the new activations. Mechanistically, we find evidence that the model computes its activation edit from the prior in-context turns, and show that the edit becomes more aligned with the monitored direction as more examples are provided. These results demonstrate feedback-conditioned control over activations and suggest that latent monitoring should be treated as an interactive process in which agents can observe and respond to oversight measures.

AI.tldr: 本文研究潜在空间监控（latent space monitors）在交互式反馈下能否被LLM智能体规避。研究发现现成模型已能产生与监控方向对齐的激活编辑，仅需放大8倍即可将监控TPR从100%降至27%；用秩1 LoRA微调后可在单次前向传播内实现有效规避，将留出概念监控的TPR进一步降至4%，且不影响其他概念的检测率与标准能力，并能抵抗监控器在新激活上重训。作者据此主张潜在监控应被视为智能体可观察并回应的交互过程。
AI.motivation: 潜在空间监控通过检查智能体内部激活而非输出来检测不良行为，但其交互式特性会形成反馈通道：监控器每次给出的判定结果都会向模型泄露"其内部状态正被如何评估"的信息。本文由此提出核心问题——智能体能否仅凭这种反馈推断出监控器的决策规则，并选择性地编辑自身激活以逃避检测。与以往规避攻击不同，此设定下模型从未被明确告知监控器检测什么，因而更具现实性与挑战性。
AI.method: 作者构建反馈条件化的规避设定：模型仅通过监控器判定（反馈）获取信息，不被告知监控目标。首先探测现成模型是否已自发产生指向被监控方向的激活编辑，并将其按比例放大以测试规避效果；随后训练rank-1 LoRA将该行为强化为前向传播内即时执行的规避能力；最后在留出的概念监控器上验证泛化性，并检验标准基准能力保持情况与监控器在新激活上重训后的鲁棒性。机理层面，分析模型是否从先前上下文轮次中计算激活编辑，以及随示例数量增加编辑方向与被监控方向的对齐程度变化。
AI.result: 现成模型已产生与监控方向对齐的激活编辑，但幅度不足以实现规避；将这些编辑放大8倍后，监控器TPR从100%降至27%。rank-1 LoRA将该行为放大为前向传播内的有效规避，在留出概念监控器上使TPR进一步降至4%，同时其他概念的检测率保持正常。在该微调下，标准基准上的能力得以保留，且规避技能在监控器基于新激活重训后仍然存活。机理分析发现模型确实从先前上下文轮次计算其激活编辑，且提供的示例越多，编辑与被监控方向的对齐度越高。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明存在由反馈条件化驱动的激活控制能力：智能体可观察并回应监督措施，从而在未被明确告知监控目标的情况下学会规避潜在空间监控。这提示潜在监控不应被视为静态检测器，而应作为智能体可感知并做出反应的交互过程来对待，对AI监督与安全评估的设计具有重要启示。

title: Efficient and Scalable Physics-Guided Fully Convolutional Spatiotemporal Learning for 3D Microstructure Evolution Prediction
summary: Accurate prediction of three-dimensional (3D) microstructure evolution remains computationally demanding because high-fidelity phase-field simulations require repeated numerical integration over large volumetric domains and long temporal horizons. This study develops an efficient and scalable physics-guided fully convolutional spatiotemporal framework for direct multi-frame prediction of complete 3D microstructure sequences. The model combines shared 3D spatial encoding and decoding with a factorized latent translator that integrates temporal, local 3D spatial, and channel interactions. A discrete Cahn--Hilliard (CH) residual is incorporated during training to regularize the learned evolution toward the governing dynamics without altering the inference pathway. The framework is evaluated on high-resolution 3D spinodal-decomposition trajectories under nominal, long-horizon, and reduced-temporal-context forecasting. Under full temporal context, the model accurately reproduces volumetric evolution, with average 3D structural similarity remaining above 0.97 over the nominal prediction horizon. Physics guidance becomes increasingly beneficial as temporal information is reduced, improving predictive robustness and preservation of interface-level morphology. The framework also achieves more than a 30-fold wall-clock speedup relative to the reference spectral phase-field solver, while physics guidance introduces no additional inference cost. These results establish direct multi-frame, physics-guided fully convolutional learning as a high-throughput surrogate strategy for dense 3D phase-field dynamics and repeated microstructure forecasting.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出一种物理引导的全卷积时空框架，可直接多帧预测完整三维微观组织演化序列，在三维旋节分解轨迹上实现SSIM>0.97且相对谱相场求解器30倍以上加速。
AI.motivation: 高保真相场模拟需在大体积域和长时间尺度上反复数值积分，三维微观组织演化预测计算代价高昂，亟需高效可扩展的替代方法。
AI.method: 构建物理引导的全卷积时空模型：共享三维空间编解码器＋因子化潜在转换器（融合时间、局部三维空间与通道交互）；训练时引入离散Cahn–Hilliard残差正则化，引导学习演化趋向控制方程，但不改变推理路径。
AI.result: 在高分辨率三维旋节分解轨迹上评估（标称、长时程、缩减时间上下文预测）：完整时间上下文下平均三维结构相似度>0.97；时间信息减少时物理引导收益增强，提升鲁棒性与界面级形貌保持；相对参考谱相场求解器实现30倍以上墙钟加速，且物理引导无额外推理开销。
AI.conclusion: 直接多帧、物理引导的全卷积学习可作为密集三维相场动力学与重复微观组织预测的高通量代理策略。

title: Adapting Context Compression for Long-Horizon Agents with Counterfactual Continuations
summary: Long-horizon agents require context compression to manage growing interaction histories. Compression quality, however, is ultimately determined by downstream execution. Existing prompt-adaptation methods infer compression errors by comparing full-context and compressed trajectories. Such comparisons cannot isolate individual compressions and are confounded by agent stochasticity. We first find that compression degrades reliability before solvability. Using matched counterfactual continuations that compare execution from the same agent state with versus without compression, we further show that severe degradation concentrates at isolated compression events. Motivated by this finding, we propose PAIR (Prompt Adaptation using Interventional Rollouts) for adapting structured compression prompts. PAIR identifies individual compressions that degrade subsequent execution, diagnoses their effects, and revises the relevant sections of a fixed compression template. PAIR achieves the strongest cross-run reliability among compressed methods in every main benchmark-scope combination, consistently exceeding the competing prompt-adaptation baseline. Without modifying the downstream agent, PAIR brings compressed execution close to the no-compression baseline and sometimes numerically exceeds it.

AI.tldr: 提出 PAIR 方法，通过干预式 rollout 定位并修正导致执行退化的单次压缩事件，在不修改下游 agent 的前提下将压缩执行性能提升至接近甚至超过无压缩基线。
AI.motivation: 长时程 agent 需要上下文压缩来管理不断增长的交互历史，而压缩质量最终由下游执行决定。现有 prompt 自适应方法通过比较全上下文与压缩轨迹来推断压缩错误，但这类比较无法隔离单次压缩，且受 agent 随机性干扰。
AI.method: 1) 首先发现压缩会先损害可靠性、后影响可解性；2) 采用匹配的反事实续跑（counterfactual continuations），即从同一 agent 状态分别在有无压缩条件下执行比较，揭示严重退化集中于孤立的压缩事件；3) 据此提出 PAIR（Prompt Adaptation using Interventional Rollouts），识别导致后续执行退化的单次压缩，诊断其影响，并修订固定压缩模板中相应部分。
AI.result: PAIR 在全部主要 benchmark-scope 组合中取得压缩方法里最强的跨运行可靠性，持续优于竞品 prompt 自适应基线；在不修改下游 agent 的情况下，使压缩执行接近无压缩基线，有时在数值上超过该基线。
AI.conclusion: 压缩退化主要源于孤立的压缩事件，可通过干预式 rollout 精确定位并针对性修正压缩提示模板，从而实现高可靠性的上下文压缩。

title: Triadic Linear Attention: Three-Dimensional Recurrent States for Long-Context Sequence Modeling
summary: Recurrent neural networks (RNNs) compress the historical context into a memory state of fixed size, thus allowing for constant-time inference. The memory state size is a crucial factor in their performance, as exemplified by the strong performance and resurgence of linear attention, which extends the vector-valued hidden states of ordinary RNNs to matrix-valued hidden states. Crucially, linear attention does so in a parameter-efficient way, in particular by using an outer product of the key and value vectors to write to the matrix-valued hidden state. We generalize this construction and propose triadic linear attention, which writes the triadic outer product of a key, a second key, and a value, into a third-order (i.e., 3D) tensor state, and reads from it by contracting both key axes with two queries. An $E$-dimensional second key thus yields an $E$-fold increase in state size while adding only two projections. Triadic linear attention is compatible with data-dependent forgetting, the delta rule, and chunkwise-parallel training. Applied to Gated DeltaNet and scalar-gated linear attention, triadic linear attention substantially improves long-context language modeling and recall, outperforming alternatives that enlarge the state.

AI.tldr: 本文提出三元线性注意力（triadic linear attention），将普通线性注意力的二阶外积写入推广为键、第二键与值的三元外积，写入三阶张量状态，通过两个查询收缩两个键轴读取，用极少参数将状态扩大E倍。
AI.motivation: RNN以固定大小的记忆状态压缩历史上下文，从而实现常数时间推理，状态大小对性能至关重要。线性注意力的复兴表明将向量隐藏状态扩展为矩阵状态有效，且通过键值外积实现参数高效扩展。作者希望进一步推广该构造，在几乎不增加参数的情况下继续扩大状态容量。
AI.method: 提出三元线性注意力：将键、第二键和值的三元外积写入三阶（3D）张量状态，读取时用两个查询分别与两个键轴收缩。E维第二键带来E倍状态增长，仅增加两个投影。该方法兼容数据依赖遗忘、delta规则以及分块并行训练，并应用于Gated DeltaNet和标量门控线性注意力。
AI.result: 在Gated DeltaNet和标量门控线性注意力上应用三元线性注意力后，长上下文语言建模和召回能力显著提升，优于其他扩大状态的替代方案。
AI.conclusion: 通过三元外积将线性注意力的矩阵状态推广到三阶张量状态，是一种参数高效的状态扩展方式，能在保持常数时间推理的同时有效增强长上下文建模与检索性能。

title: Interactive-Policy Distillation with Bidirectional Propose-and-Verify
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student model on its self-generated trajectories with dense token-level teacher feedback. However, naive OPD may suffer from teacher unanchoring, where the student's reasoning trajectory drifts far from the teacher, causing the teacher to be queried on states it would hardly visit and thus provide unreliable supervision. We propose Interactive-Policy Distillation (IPD), which applies adaptive teacher intervention to the student rollout. Under a bidirectional propose-and-verify state machine, the student and teacher alternately exchange their roles as proposer and verifier, and collaboratively generate mixed-source trajectories. Then different supervisions are applied according to the source of each token. This bidirectional propose-and-verify mechanism and the source-split loss make IPD not only a more performant distillation method, but also a unified bridge between on-policy and off-policy paradigms. To make the interleaved dual-model rollouts more efficient, we also design a dedicated fused inference engine that co-hosts both models in one serving instance with separate KV caches and instantiates the state machine model to distribute, collect, and process requests. On math reasoning tasks and across multiple teacher-student model pairs, student models trained with IPD not only outperform those trained with OPD, but also demonstrate higher data efficiency. Specifically, when distilling Qwen3-30B-A3B into Qwen3-1.7B-Base, IPD brings a +3.28 mean@8 and a +3.28 best@8 benchmark-averaged accuracy improvement compared with OPD. Besides, IPD only consumes about 1/4 of the training examples and steps to outperform OPD trained on the whole training dataset for one epoch. We also investigate the impact of different loss variants and takeover / handback configurations, and demonstrate the robustness of IPD on different training data.

AI.tldr: 提出IPD，通过师生双向propose-and-verify交替干预生成混合轨迹并分源监督，缓解OPD的教师失锚问题，在数学推理上超越OPD且数据效率更高。
AI.motivation: on-policy蒸馏(OPD)让学生在自己生成的轨迹上接受token级教师反馈，但朴素OPD存在"教师失锚"问题：学生推理轨迹远离教师分布，导致教师在被查询到其几乎不会访问的状态上给出不可靠监督。
AI.method: IPD在student rollout上施加自适应教师干预，采用双向propose-and-verify状态机，师生交替充当proposer与verifier协同生成混合来源轨迹，并按token来源施加不同监督（source-split loss）。为提升交错双模型rollout效率，设计专用融合推理引擎，在同一服务实例内共置两个模型、分离KV cache，并以状态机模型调度请求的分发、收集与处理。
AI.result: 在数学推理任务、多组师生模型对上，IPD训练的学生模型优于OPD且数据效率更高。将Qwen3-30B-A3B蒸馏到Qwen3-1.7B-Base时，相比OPD取得+3.28 mean@8与+3.28 best@8的基准平均准确率提升；仅用约1/4训练样本与步数即超过在完整数据集上训练一个epoch的OPD。还分析了不同loss变体及takeover/handback配置的影响，并在不同训练数据上验证鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: IPD通过双向propose-and-verify机制与source-split loss，既是更优的蒸馏方法，也是on-policy与off-policy范式的统一桥梁，缓解教师失锚并显著提升性能与数据效率。

title: SERA: Scale-Equalized Rollout Allocation for Maximum Likelihood Reinforcement Learning
summary: Maximum Likelihood Reinforcement Learning (MaxRL) targets prompt-wise log-success and has shown strong performance on reasoning tasks. Under finite rollout budgets, however, the estimator used by MaxRL attenuates each prompt's likelihood gradient by a factor that depends on its success probability and rollout count. Under uniform rollout allocation, the common rollout count fails to compensate for success-dependent attenuation, leaving low-success prompts more strongly attenuated and distorting their relative contributions to the expected aggregate gradient. We introduce SERA (Scale-Equalized Rollout Allocation), which redistributes a fixed rollout budget to approximately equalize these finite-rollout scaling factors. Building on our theoretical analysis of how finite rollouts distort prompt-wise likelihood gradients, we formulate the allocation as a fixed-budget max--min problem, derive a waterline solution to its continuous relaxation, and introduce a multiplicity correction to remove the additional prompt weighting induced by heterogeneous rollout counts. Experiments show stronger alignment with exact likelihood gradients in a controlled ImageNet setting and improved multi-sample solution coverage over MaxRL on maze navigation and mathematical reasoning under matched training rollout budgets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SERA（Scale-Equalized Rollout Allocation），通过重新分配固定 rollout 预算来近似均衡 MaxRL 中因有限 rollout 导致的 prompts 梯度缩放因子，从而改善推理任务训练。
AI.motivation: MaxRL 优化 prompt 级 log-success 并在推理任务上表现良好，但在有限 rollout 预算下，其估计器会用依赖成功概率与 rollout 数的因子衰减每个 prompt 的似然梯度。均匀分配 rollout 时，相同的 rollout 数无法补偿这种成功相关的衰减，使低成功率 prompt 被更强衰减，扭曲了它们对期望聚合梯度的相对贡献。
AI.method: 作者分析有限 rollout 如何扭曲 prompt 级似然梯度，将 rollout 分配建模为固定预算下的 max-min 问题，对连续松弛推导出 waterline 解，并引入多重性校正以消除由异构 rollout 数导致的额外 prompt 加权，最终形成 SERA 算法。
AI.result: 在受控 ImageNet 设置中，SERA 与精确似然梯度对齐更好；在迷宫导航和数学推理任务中，在匹配训练 rollout 预算下，相较 MaxRL 提升了多样本解覆盖率。
AI.conclusion: 通过均衡有限 rollout 缩放因子并校正异构 rollout 数带来的加权偏差，SERA 能在固定预算下更忠实地逼近精确似然梯度，并提升推理任务的多样本覆盖表现。

title: HiTS-CL: A Continual Learning Framework for Long-Horizon Temporal Knowledge Graph Extrapolation
summary: Extrapolative temporal knowledge graph reasoning (TKGR) predicts future facts from historical snapshots. Most existing methods train once on an early prefix of the timeline and then use a frozen model for all future timestamps. We argue that this fixed-prefix protocol is misaligned with extrapolation. It learns from a static prefix, whereas the target stream is non-stationary: new entities and facts emerge, temporal dependencies shift across regimes, and recurring historical signals must be refreshed online. As a result, models trained only on early snapshots become outdated and degrade over long horizons. We address this mismatch by formulating extrapolative TKGR as continual learning over streaming snapshots. Under this view, effective extrapolation must jointly handle current dynamics, stable knowledge, and recurring historical evidence. Based on these requirements, we propose History-enhanced Two-Step Continual Learning (HiTS-CL), a backbone-agnostic continual learning framework for extrapolative TKGR.  HiTS-CL tracks current dynamics via continual fine-tuning, preserves stable knowledge via multi-teacher adaptive distillation, and retains recurring historical evidence via a selective memory of recent and frequent facts. We integrate HiTS-CL into five representative TKGR backbones and evaluate it on four benchmark datasets. HiTS-CL consistently improves extrapolation accuracy, reduces long-horizon degradation, and outperforms strong continual-learning baselines, including a recent method for temporal knowledge graphs. Source code and data are available at https://github.com/liuyansong98/HiTS-CL.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出外推式时序知识图谱推理（TKGR）主流的"固定前缀"训练范式与任务本身的外推特性不匹配，提出将外推TKGR建模为流式快照上的持续学习问题，并给出骨架无关框架HiTS-CL。
AI.motivation: 现有方法多在时间线早期前缀上一次性训练，随后用冻结模型预测所有未来时间戳。这种固定前缀协议与真正的外推需求相悖：目标数据流是非平稳的，会不断出现新实体与新事实、跨"状态区间"发生时间依赖漂移，且周期性历史信号需要在线刷新；只依赖早期快照训练的模型会逐渐过时，在长时段预测中性能显著下降。论文据此提出需同时应对当前动态、稳定知识与周期性历史证据三类需求。
AI.method: 将外推式TKGR重新表述为流式快照上的持续学习问题，并基于三项需求提出HiTS-CL（History-enhanced Two-Step Continual Learning）框架，该框架与具体骨干模型无关。其核心机制包括：1）通过持续微调（continual fine-tuning）跟踪当前动态；2）通过多教师自适应蒸馏（multi-teacher adaptive distillation）保留稳定知识；3）通过近期与高频事实的选择性记忆（selective memory）保留周期性历史证据。作者将HiTS-CL集成到五种代表性TKGR骨干上，并在四个基准数据集上评估。
AI.result: 实验表明，HiTS-CL在五种骨干上均能一致提升外推准确率，缓解长时段性能退化，并优于强持续学习基线（包括一种近期面向时序知识图谱的持续学习方法）。
AI.conclusion: 固定前缀训练协议不适配非平稳的外推场景；将外推式TKGR视为流式持续学习问题，并联合处理当前动态、稳定知识与周期性历史证据，是一种有效方向。HiTS-CL作为骨架无关框架具有良好的通用性，代码与数据已开源。

title: Sharp Convergence and Sampling Trade-offs for Riemannian Diffusion under Nonnegative Ricci Curvature
summary: Diffusion models have emerged as state-of-the-art generative models, with recent extensions from Euclidean spaces to Riemannian manifolds. However, existing convergence guarantees for Riemannian diffusion models typically require $\tilde{O}(\mathrm{poly}(d,T)/ε^2)$ score evaluations, with potentially unfavorable dependence on the dimension. In this work, we develop a general framework that separates score discretization from Brownian-motion simulation and allows multiple geodesic random-walk steps per score evaluation. Under nonnegative Ricci curvature assumption and an exact Brownian-motion simulation oracle, we show that $\tilde{O}(d/ε^2)$ score evaluations suffice to achieve an $ε^2$ KL divergence from the target distribution, matching the existing convergence rate of Euclidean diffusion models. We further show that $\tilde{O}(d^4T/ε^2)$ geodesic random-walk steps suffice to approximate the required drifted Brownian motion to $ε$ total variation error. Combining these results yields a sampling scheme with $\tilde{O}(d/ε^2)$ score evaluations and $\tilde{O}(d^4T/ε^2)$ geodesic random-walk steps, motivating multiple random-walk steps between consecutive score evaluations. Our results provide a sharper characterization of the convergence and sampling complexity of Riemannian diffusion models.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一个将分数离散化与布朗运动模拟解耦的黎曼扩散模型采样框架，在非负Ricci曲率与精确布朗运动模拟假设下达到 $\tilde{O}(d/\epsilon^2)$ 分数评估复杂度，与欧氏扩散模型的最优收敛率一致。
AI.motivation: 现有黎曼扩散模型的收敛保证通常需要 $\tilde{O}(\mathrm{poly}(d,T)/\epsilon^2)$ 次分数评估，对维度的依赖可能较差，缺乏与欧氏情形相匹配的理论刻画，因此需要更精细的收敛与采样复杂度分析。
AI.method: 提出通用框架，将分数离散化与布朗运动模拟分离，允许在相邻两次分数评估之间进行多步测地随机游走；在非负Ricci曲率假设与精确布朗运动模拟oracle下，分别分析分数评估复杂度、测地随机游走步数对漂移布朗运动的近似误差，并组合成采样方案。
AI.result: 在非负Ricci曲率与精确布朗运动模拟oracle下，$\tilde{O}(d/\epsilon^2)$ 次分数评估即可实现与目标分布的 $\epsilon^2$ KL散度；$\tilde{O}(d^4 T/\epsilon^2)$ 步测地随机游走可将所需漂移布朗运动近似到 $\epsilon$ 全变差误差。二者结合得到 $\tilde{O}(d/\epsilon^2)$ 分数评估与 $\tilde{O}(d^4 T/\epsilon^2)$ 测地随机游走步数的采样方案。
AI.conclusion: 该结果为黎曼扩散模型的收敛性与采样复杂度提供了更锐利的刻画，匹配欧氏扩散模型的收敛率，并论证了在相邻分数评估之间执行多步随机游走的合理性。

title: From Checkpoint Variation to Selection Gains in Supervised Fine-Tuning
summary: Checkpoint selection is a routine decision in supervised fine-tuning (SFT): training produces multiple checkpoints, but only one is retained. Yet fixed-budget comparisons do not by themselves distinguish three empirical claims: whether more validation data improve checkpoint selection, whether a selection rule outperforms validation-loss selection, and whether it improves over simply retaining the final checkpoint. We therefore treat checkpoint selection as a finite-information decision problem. Holding completed training trajectories, candidate checkpoints, and independent test items fixed, we vary the validation budget and separately measure improvement from additional validation data, gain over negative log-likelihood (NLL) selection, and gain over the final checkpoint. Across 60 mathematical SFT trajectories and 19 configurations, increasing the validation budget from 32 to 305-313 examples raises independent-test accuracy by 0.32 percentage points (pp) for generated-accuracy selection and 0.29 pp for checkpoint agreement, with 95% configuration-bootstrap CIs of [0.10, 0.56] and [0.11, 0.50], respectively. At the full validation budget, the two generation-based rules outperform matched NLL selection by 0.71 and 0.85 pp, respectively, while their gains over the final checkpoint remain unresolved. A cross-domain replication on 12 newly trained Commonsense trajectories shows the same qualitative separation: increasing the validation budget from 32 to 1,024 questions improves generated-accuracy and checkpoint-agreement selection by 0.87 and 0.27 pp, while gains over the final checkpoint again remain unresolved. Together, these results show that benefiting from more validation data, outperforming NLL selection, and outperforming the final checkpoint are distinct empirical claims that require separate evidence.

AI.tldr: 本文将检查点选择建模为有限信息决策问题，通过固定训练轨迹、候选检查点和测试项，分别度量增加验证数据、优于NLL选择以及优于最终检查点三种改进，发现三者是需分别验证的独立命题。
AI.motivation: 监督微调中常需从多个检查点里保留一个，但固定预算下的比较无法区分三种经验性主张：更多验证数据是否改善选择、某选择规则是否优于验证损失选择、是否优于直接保留最终检查点。作者希望明确区分并分别测量这些主张所需的证据。
AI.method: 把检查点选择视为有限信息决策问题。在固定已完成的训练轨迹、候选检查点与独立测试项的前提下，改变验证预算，分别测量：来自额外验证数据的改进、相对负对数似然（NLL）选择的增益、以及相对最终检查点的增益。实验覆盖60条数学SFT轨迹、19种配置，并在12条新训练的常识轨迹上做跨域复现。
AI.result: 验证预算从32增至305–313个样本时，生成式准确率选择提升0.32个百分点（pp），检查点一致性选择提升0.29 pp，95%配置自举置信区间分别为[0.10, 0.56]和[0.11, 0.50]。在完整验证预算下，两种基于生成的选择规则分别比匹配的NLL选择高出0.71和0.85 pp，而相对最终检查点的增益仍未确定。常识域复现中，验证预算从32增至1,024题时，生成式准确率与检查点一致性选择分别提升0.87和0.27 pp，但相对最终检查点的增益同样未确定。
AI.conclusion: 受益于更多验证数据、优于NLL选择、优于最终检查点是三种不同的经验性主张，需要各自独立的证据支持；相对最终检查点的优势在当前实验中仍未被证实。

title: Factorized Scheduling Principle: Learning Interpretable and Transferable Policies via Structured Additive Functions
comment: Accepted to the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
summary: Scheduling problems arise from repeatedly selecting one item from a set of candidates based on their states. These problems often reduce to assigning priority scores and choosing the highest-ranked item. In this work, we propose a factorized scheduling principle (FSP) framework to learn interpretable and transferable scheduling rules. The FSP framework represents system states as condition distributions and decomposes a global scheduling principle into additive univariate and pairwise components with identifiability constraints. The scheduling principle enables the framework to maintain a simple priority-based structure during deployment. This principle is learned by using a policy-based objective combined with a temporal-difference signal defined on the condition distribution. Experiments on synthetic and realistic scheduling tasks demonstrate the FSP framework's strong performance, interpretability, and zero-shot generalization across different system scales.

AI.tldr: 本文提出因子化调度原理（FSP）框架，将系统状态表示为条件分布，并把全局调度原则分解为带可识别性约束的加性单变量与成对分量，从而学习可解释、可迁移的调度规则。该规则通过策略目标结合条件分布上的时序差分信号进行学习，在部署时保持简单的优先级结构。合成与实际调度任务的实验表明，FSP在性能、可解释性和跨系统规模的零样本泛化方面表现优异。
AI.motivation: 调度问题通常归结为对候选项分配优先级分数并选择排名最高者，但既有方法学习的调度规则往往缺乏可解释性，且难以迁移到不同规模或配置的系统。作者希望同时获得可解释与可零样本迁移的调度策略。
AI.method: 提出因子化调度原理（FSP）框架：将系统状态建模为条件分布；把全局调度原则分解为加性的一元分量与成对分量，并施加可识别性约束以保证分解唯一可解释；保持基于优先级的规则结构以便部署；采用基于策略的目标函数，并结合定义在条件分布上的时序差分信号进行学习。
AI.result: 在合成调度任务与真实调度任务上，FSP在调度性能、规则可解释性以及对不同系统规模的零样本泛化能力方面均取得良好表现。
AI.conclusion: FSP通过条件分布表示与加性因子分解，可在保持优先级式简易部署结构的同时学习可解释且可迁移的调度规则，具备跨系统规模的零样本泛化潜力。

title: Making Analog Training Scale: Co-Designing Mapping, Optimizer, and Converters
summary: Analog in-memory computing (AIMC) offers an alternative for model training by executing matrix operations directly where weights are stored. However, scaling AIMC to train modern deep models remains an open challenge due to severe hardware non-idealities, including physical weights with finite dynamic range and write granularity, analog-digital converters with finite resolution, and noisy and asymmetric updates. Guided by the insight that gradient accumulation is sensitive to precision and rounding errors, we adopt a mixed-precision training paradigm: executing forward and backward matrix multiplications in the analog domain while computing weight gradients in the digital domain. To enable scalable training, we present a holistic system-algorithm co-design that co-optimizes weight mapping to ensure well-conditioned physical and logical weight profiles, couples a preconditioned optimizer with threshold-triggered open-loop pulsing to stabilize training trajectories, and aligns converter dynamic ranges to suppress quantization errors. Evaluated via hardware-calibrated architectural simulations calibrated with electrochemical RAM measurements, our framework scales Transformer training up to $123\text{M}$ parameters with validation loss scaling as $L\propto N^{-0.231}$, where $N$ is the parameter count, comparable to $L\propto N^{-0.238}$ for digital training.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种面向模拟存内计算（AIMC）的混合精度训练与系统-算法协同设计框架，可将Transformer训练扩展至1.23亿参数，验证损失随参数量的缩放指数与数字训练相当。
AI.motivation: AIMC可直接在权重存储处执行矩阵运算，是模型训练的潜在替代方案，但扩展至现代深度模型训练面临严重硬件非理想性：物理权重动态范围与写入粒度有限、ADC分辨率有限、更新噪声大且不对称，导致训练难以规模化。
AI.method: 基于梯度累积对精度和舍入误差敏感的洞察，采用混合精度训练范式：前向与反向矩阵乘法在模拟域执行，权重梯度在数字域计算。提出整体系统-算法协同设计：协同优化权重映射以获得良态物理与逻辑权重分布；将预条件优化器与阈值触发开环脉冲耦合以稳定训练轨迹；对齐转换器动态范围以抑制量化误差。通过经电化学RAM测量校准的硬件校准架构仿真进行评估。
AI.result: 框架可将Transformer训练扩展至最多1.23亿参数，验证损失随参数量N的缩放为L∝N^(−0.231)，与数字训练的L∝N^(−0.238)相当。
AI.conclusion: 系统-算法协同设计可有效缓解AIMC硬件非理想性，使模拟域训练在规模化Transformer上达到接近数字训练的损失缩放表现，展示了AIMC用于现代深度模型训练的可行性。

title: Learned Reporting Preferences in RLVR Can Conflict with the Current Request
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become a prominent approach for improving language-model performance on reasoning tasks using automatically checked answers. Yet convention-matched evaluation cannot reveal whether reinforcing one reporting convention reduces adherence to a different request that the initial policy already follows. To test this, we train matched policies under two reporting conventions and evaluate each policy under both current requests, using the same initial policy as a shared reference. We complement this crossed design with controlled interventions and independent human calibration. On GSM8K, boxed-format RLVR reduces the fraction of Qwen2.5-7B responses containing the requested hash-format payload by 35.33--74.37 percentage points relative to a 95.45% initial baseline in four of five training seeds; the fifth improves by 2.50 points. In the four deteriorating runs, almost every response that omits the requested payload instead retains the trained boxed convention, and the same four seeds deteriorate under two fixed paraphrases. Changing only the final-answer marker in supervised targets reverses which reporting convention the model prefers across three seeds, providing controlled evidence that this preference is learnable. Across three settings with independent human calibration, gains under a convention-sensitive scorer exceed the corresponding gains in committed-answer correctness, i.e., the correctness of the answer the model actually commits to. Together, these results separate three distinct post-training outcomes: learned reporting preference, current-request adherence, and committed-answer correctness. They show that convention-matched accuracy alone does not fully characterize post-training behavior and motivate evaluating current-request adherence alongside convention-matched task accuracy.

AI.tldr: RLVR在提升推理任务准确率的同时，可能牺牲模型对当前请求格式的遵从性；论文通过交叉训练设计与人类校准，区分出"学到的报告偏好""当前请求遵从性""承诺答案正确性"三种独立的训练后结果，并证明仅用约定匹配准确率评估并不充分。
AI.motivation: 现有RLVR（带可验证奖励的强化学习）评估普遍采用"约定匹配"（convention-matched）准确率，即在训练所用报告约定下衡量正确性。但这类评估无法揭示：强化某一报告约定是否会削弱模型对另一种初始策略本就遵循的请求格式的遵从。因此需要检验训练是否改变了模型的报告偏好，而非仅仅提升任务正确性。
AI.method: 采用交叉设计：以同一初始策略为共享参照，在两种报告约定下训练匹配的策略，并在两种当前请求下分别评估。辅以控制性干预（仅改变监督目标中的最终答案标记）和独立的人类校准，以排除混杂因素。
AI.result: 在GSM8K上，boxed格式RLVR使Qwen2.5-7B包含所请求hash格式载荷的响应比例，相对95.45%的初始基线下降35.33–74.37个百分点（5个训练种子中4个），第5个上升2.50个百分点。4个退化运行中，几乎每个遗漏所请求载荷的响应都保留了训练后的boxed约定，且同样4个种子在两种固定改写下也退化。仅改变监督目标中的最终答案标记即可在3个种子中反转模型的报告偏好。在3个有人类校准的设定中，约定敏感评分器下的增益超过承诺答案正确性的增益。
AI.conclusion: 研究区分了三种不同的训练后结果：学到的报告偏好、当前请求遵从性、承诺答案正确性。结果表明，约定匹配准确率本身无法完整刻画训练后行为，应在约定匹配任务准确率之外，同时评估模型对当前请求的遵从性。

title: Act First, Reason Later: Accelerating On-Policy Distillation for Multi-Turn Agents via Reference-Conditioned Inverse Dynamics
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains multi-turn language agents with dense teacher supervision on student-generated responses. However, standard think-then-act rollouts require lengthy reasoning before each short action, delaying environment transitions and experience collection. Generating actions directly reduces this delay but can degrade rollout quality. To address this, we propose ActFirst-OPD, an act-first, reason-later training framework that decouples environment interaction from full-response generation. The student infers and executes actions through reference-conditioned inverse dynamics using its current interaction context and a reference next observation, and switches to autonomous next-action prediction when the resulting transition deviates from the reference trajectory. From the collected interaction contexts, the student asynchronously generates full think-then-act responses for token-level teacher supervision. Experiments across 0.6B-, 1.7B-, and 4B-parameter Qwen3 students show that ActFirst-OPD achieves average wall-clock training speedups of $2.3\times$ on ALFWorld, $1.8\times$ on WebShop, and $4.9\times$ on ScienceWorld over Vanilla OPD. It matches or exceeds all compared OPD baselines in mean task success rate across eight of nine benchmark-model settings. These results demonstrate that reasoning need not block acting during multi-turn agent distillation.

AI.tldr: 提出ActFirst-OPD框架，通过"先行动、后推理"解耦环境交互与完整响应生成，在保持多轮智能体蒸馏任务成功率的同时显著提升训练速度。
AI.motivation: 标准on-policy蒸馏的多轮智能体采用"先推理后行动"的rollout方式，每次简短动作前都需冗长推理，导致环境状态转移和经验收集延迟，训练效率低下；而直接生成动作虽可减少延迟，却会降低rollout质量。
AI.method: ActFirst-OPD采用先行动后推理的训练框架：学生模型借助当前交互上下文和参考下一观测，通过参考条件逆动力学推断并执行动作；当实际状态转移偏离参考轨迹时，切换为自主的下一动作预测。随后基于收集到的交互上下文，学生异步生成完整的"先推理后行动"响应，以接受token级教师监督。
AI.result: 在0.6B、1.7B、4B参数的Qwen3学生模型上，ActFirst-OPD相比Vanilla OPD平均wall-clock训练加速：ALFWorld 2.3倍、WebShop 1.8倍、ScienceWorld 4.9倍；在九个基准-模型设置中的八个，平均任务成功率持平或超过所有对比OPD基线。
AI.conclusion: 在多轮智能体蒸馏中，推理不必阻塞行动；先行动后推理的解耦设计可在保证甚至提升任务成功率的同时大幅加速训练。

title: Communication-Efficient Agnostic Federated Learning via Faster Convergence and Compression
summary: Agnostic federated learning (AFL) seeks a model that performs reliably across $m$ heterogeneous workers, but communication remains a bottleneck. We improve communication efficiency by reducing the number of synchronization rounds via faster convergence and the communication cost per round via compression. We first propose AFL-BR, which updates the dual weights over workers using online mirror ascent with KL divergence and blockwise restarts. It achieves an $O((\log m)^{1/4}T^{-1/8})$ stationarity rate after $T$ update rounds, reducing the $m$-dependence of the synchronization rounds required for convergence from polynomial to logarithmic order. Building on AFL-BR, we develop AFL-Com by applying bidirectional compression with error feedback (EF). Instead of compressing local gradients, workers apply EF to their dual-weighted gradients, enabling direct control of the aggregated compression error under time-varying weights. We then establish an $O((δ^{-1}+(\log m)^{1/4})T^{-1/8})$ stationarity rate for AFL-Com under general $δ$-approximate compressors and improve the $δ$-dependence from $δ^{-1}$ to $δ^{-1/2}$ for additive-and-idempotent compressors with shared randomness (SR). With suitable compression levels, AFL-Com retains the same convergence rate as AFL-BR at a lower per-round communication cost, yielding reductions in total communication complexity by factors of $(\log m)^{1/4}$ with Top-$k$ and $(\log m)^{1/2}$ with Rand-$k$ and SR. Experiments validate the improved synchronization and communication efficiency of our methods.

AI.tldr: 本文针对Agnostic Federated Learning (AFL) 的通信瓶颈，提出AFL-BR与AFL-Com两种方法：前者通过在线镜像上升+分块重启加速收敛，将同步轮数对worker数m的依赖从多项式降为对数；后者引入双向压缩+误差反馈，在时变权重下直接控制聚合压缩误差，并在特定压缩器下将δ依赖从δ^{-1}改进为δ^{-1/2}，最终显著降低总通信复杂度。
AI.motivation: AFL需要在m个异构worker上获得可靠性能的模型，但通信是主要瓶颈。作者希望同时从两方面提升通信效率：一是通过更快收敛减少同步轮数，二是通过压缩降低每轮通信开销；并改善收敛速率对worker数量m和压缩精度δ的依赖。
AI.method: 方法包含两个算法。1) AFL-BR：使用带KL散度和分块重启（blockwise restarts）的在线镜像上升（online mirror ascent）更新各worker的对偶权重，在T轮更新后达到O((log m)^{1/4}T^{-1/8})的稳定性速率，把收敛所需同步轮数对m的依赖从多项式阶降到对数阶。2) AFL-Com：在AFL-BR基础上加入双向压缩与误差反馈（EF）。与压缩本地梯度不同，worker对其对偶加权梯度施加EF，从而在时变权重下直接控制聚合压缩误差；在一般δ-近似压缩器下达到O((δ^{-1}+(log m)^{1/4})T^{-1/8})速率，并针对具有共享随机性（SR）的加性且幂等压缩器，把δ依赖从δ^{-1}改进到δ^{-1/2}。
AI.result: AFL-BR在T轮后达到O((log m)^{1/4}T^{-1/8})的稳定性速率，将同步轮数对m的依赖由多项式降为对数。AFL-Com在一般δ-近似压缩器下达到O((δ^{-1}+(log m)^{1/4})T^{-1/8})，并在加性且幂等压缩器配合共享随机性时把δ依赖从δ^{-1}改进为δ^{-1/2}。选择合适压缩水平时，AFL-Com在更低每轮通信成本下保持与AFL-BR相同的收敛速率，总通信复杂度在Top-k下降低(\log m)^{1/4}倍，在Rand-k与SR下降低(\log m)^{1/2}倍。实验验证了同步与通信效率的改进。
AI.conclusion: 通过更快的收敛（减少同步轮数）与压缩（降低每轮开销），本文在AFL中同时提升了同步效率和通信效率：AFL-BR把对m的依赖降至对数级，AFL-Com在控制聚合压缩误差的同时进一步降低了总通信复杂度，并通过实验得到验证。

title: Do LLMs Really Forget? Hidden-State Leakage in Model Unlearning and How to Fix it
summary: Unlearning in large language models (LLMs) is typically evaluated at the output level, where a model appears to suppress sensitive or undesirable content. In this work, we show that such evaluations can create an illusion of forgetting: even when output-level leakage is eliminated, sensitive information can remain encoded in the model's hidden representations. We first provide a theoretical analysis establishing a fundamental separation between output suppression and representational erasure. Specifically, we show that the decoder can be made arbitrarily insensitive to sensitive directions, driving output-level leakage to zero, while the hidden representations retain the underlying information. To empirically validate this phenomenon, we train generative probe decoders on hidden states across transformer layers, enabling layer-wise measurement of information leakage. Across three widely used benchmarks, TOFU, MUSE, and WMDP, and state-of-the-art unlearning methods, we find that substantial sensitive information remains recoverable from hidden representations, even when standard output-level metrics indicate successful unlearning. To address this gap, we propose Probe-Adversarial Representation Suppression (PARS), an unlearning objective that adversarially minimizes the extractable information from hidden representations. PARS directly targets representational leakage and provides significantly stronger guarantees of erasure under adversarial probing and relearning attacks, outperforming all evaluated baselines. Our results highlight a fundamental limitation of existing unlearning paradigms and suggest that true forgetting in LLMs requires controlling not only model outputs, but also the information encoded in hidden representations. Codes are available at https://github.com/OptimAI-Lab/HiddenStateUnlearning.

AI.tldr: 现有LLM遗忘评估多停留在输出层，本文揭示"遗忘幻觉"：输出层泄漏归零时敏感信息仍编码于隐表示中，并提出PARS对抗式表示抑制目标以真正擦除信息。
AI.motivation: 当前对LLM遗忘（unlearning）的评估通常在输出层面进行，模型看似抑制了敏感或不良内容即被视为遗忘成功。作者认为这种评估会制造"遗忘的幻觉"：即使输出层泄漏被消除，敏感信息仍可能保留在模型隐表示中，因此需要重新审视遗忘的真实性。
AI.method: 1）理论分析：证明输出抑制与表示擦除之间存在本质分离——可使解码器对敏感方向任意不敏感，将输出层泄漏降至零，而隐表示仍保留底层信息。2）实证验证：在transformer各层隐状态上训练生成式探针解码器（generative probe decoders），实现逐层的信息泄漏度量。3）提出Probe-Adversarial Representation Suppression (PARS)：一种对抗式遗忘目标，最小化可从隐表示中提取的信息，直接针对表示层泄漏。
AI.result: 在TOFU、MUSE、WMDP三个广泛使用的基准上，结合当前最先进的遗忘方法，发现在标准输出层指标显示遗忘成功时，隐表示中仍有大量敏感信息可被恢复。PARS在对抗探针与再学习（relearning）攻击下提供了显著更强的擦除保证，性能优于所有评估基线。
AI.conclusion: 本文揭示了现有遗忘范式的根本局限：真正的LLM遗忘不仅需要控制模型输出，还必须控制隐表示中编码的信息。代码已开源于https://github.com/OptimAI-Lab/HiddenStateUnlearning。

title: Selective Elicitation as a Commercial Influence Channel: A Reproducible Synthetic Shopping-Agent Stress Test
comment: 7 pages, 1 table; synthetic data and reproduction code in ancillary files; substantial AI-tool use disclosed in the manuscript
summary: A commercial incentive need not enter the final ranking algorithm to affect a shopping assistant's recommendation: it may instead influence which preference question the assistant asks. We make this distinction experimentally observable in a deliberately small, synthetic setting. Each task has two products, three verified numerical attributes, a price limit, and a private fixed preference vector. An honest simulated user answers one pairwise question. A separate recommender receives the products and this answer but not the sponsorship assignment. We contrast a neutral question, a soft commercial instruction, and an explicitly adversarial instruction to ask about the sponsor's advantage while omitting the rival's advantage. Across 40 held-out sponsorship-assignment cases (20 distinct catalog-preference contexts), the soft instruction changes no selections. The targeted instruction raises sponsored selection by 0.30 and reduces mean synthetic utility by 0.0547 relative to neutral questioning (95% context-bootstrap interval [-0.0828, -0.0291]) for one language-model recommender. A fixed Bayesian recommender shows a similar effect; a second model makes the same choices on all 120 frozen question-answer inputs. A terminal-answer consistency judge rates all 20 sampled targeted answers consistent, although five have synthetic regret above 0.05; a separate question-coverage dimension flags their one-sided elicitation. A robust partial-preference certificate remains valid under the stipulated synthetic utility but certifies only 16 of 40 targeted cases and is not better than asking a neutral question directly. These results establish neither typical behavior under advertising incentives nor effects on actual consumers.

AI.tldr: 商业激励即使不进入最终排序算法，也能通过影响助手"提问哪个偏好问题"来改变推荐结果；论文用小型合成实验使该机制可观测。
AI.motivation: 区分"商业激励影响排序算法"与"商业激励影响偏好提问选择"两种作用路径，并让后者在受控实验中可被观察和度量，检验软性指令与针对性（对抗性）指令的不同后果。
AI.method: 刻意构造的小规模合成实验：每个任务含2个商品、3个已验证数值属性、1个价格上限和1个私有固定偏好向量；诚实模拟用户回答1次成对问题；推荐器只接收商品与该答案、不接收赞助分配。对比中性提问、软性商业指令、显式对抗指令（只问赞助方优势、隐瞒竞品优势）。以40个留出赞助分配案例（20个不同目录-偏好情境）评估。
AI.result: 软性指令不改变任何选择；针对性指令使赞助商品选择率提高0.30、平均合成效用下降0.0547（95%情境自助区间[-0.0828,-0.0291]）。固定贝叶斯推荐器效应相似；第二个模型在全部120个冻结问答输入上做出相同选择。终端答案一致性裁判将全部20个抽样针对性答案判为一致，尽管其中5个合成后悔值高于0.05；另一"问题覆盖度"维度标记出其单边引出。鲁棒部分偏好证书在约定合成效用下仍有效，但仅认证40例中的16例，且不优于直接中性提问。
AI.conclusion: 结果证明了"提问选择"这一影响渠道在受控合成设定中的可观测性，但既不能说明广告激励下的典型行为，也不能说明对真实消费者的影响。

title: SemPSG: A Semantic Channel-Aware Foundation Model for Polysomnography Analysis
summary: Polysomnography (PSG) integrates multiple physiological signals to provide a comprehensive characterization of human sleep, yet its heterogeneous channel configurations across centers pose substantial challenges for transferable representation learning. Existing foundation models mainly focus on physiological modeling or temporal learning, while channel identity is often treated as a fixed structural index, overlooking the physiological semantics encoded by signal modality and reference configuration. To this end, we propose SemPSG, a Semantic channel-aware foundation model for heterogeneous PSG analysis. SemPSG explicitly represents the physiological semantics of channel identity and incorporates them into both signal representation learning and channel aggregation, enabling flexible modeling across diverse data configurations. Specifically, a semantic-conditioned time-series encoder captures signal-specific temporal dynamics and cross-signal interactions, while a multi-view image encoder extracts complementary time-frequency and morphological patterns from the same physiological recordings. We evaluate SemPSG on sleep and health-related tasks, including sleep staging, sleep-disorder breathing analysis, disease prediction, cognition and emotion recognition, and demographic estimation. Extensive experiments demonstrate consistent improvements over both general-purpose time series foundation models and PSG-specific foundation models, together with generalization across heterogeneous datasets across diverse channel configurations.

AI.tldr: 提出SemPSG——一种语义通道感知的PSG基础模型，将通道身份的生理语义显式编码进表示学习与通道聚合，实现异构通道配置下的可迁移睡眠分析。
AI.motivation: PSG整合多路生理信号可全面刻画睡眠，但不同中心的通道配置高度异构，给可迁移表示学习带来困难。现有多模态基础模型侧重生理建模或时序学习，却把通道身份当作固定的结构索引，忽视了信号模态与参考配置所蕴含的生理语义，导致跨中心、跨配置泛化能力受限。
AI.method: SemPSG显式表示通道身份的生理语义，并将其注入信号表示学习与通道聚合两个环节：1）语义条件化的时序编码器（semantic-conditioned time-series encoder），捕捉各信号特有的时序动态与跨信号交互；2）多视图图像编码器（multi-view image encoder），从同一生理记录中提取互补的时频与形态学模式。两类编码输出与语义通道信息联合，支持不同通道配置下的灵活建模。
AI.result: 在睡眠与健康相关任务上评估，涵盖睡眠分期、睡眠呼吸障碍分析、疾病预测、认知与情绪识别、人口学估计。实验显示，SemPSG相较通用时序基础模型与PSG专用基础模型均取得一致提升，并在多种异构通道配置的数据集间展现出泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 以通道生理语义为核心归纳偏置，可有效缓解PSG通道异质性带来的迁移难题；语义条件化时序建模与多视图时频-形态建模的结合，为跨中心、跨配置的PSG基础模型提供了可行范式与实证支持。

title: Physics-Aware Machine Unlearning for Cyber-Physical Systems
summary: This paper proposes a physics-guided gradient-ascent-based machine unlearning method that couples the forgetting signal with the physical residual of the target cyber-physical systems, ensuring that weight updates during unlearning are steered toward physically feasible regions of the weight space. The physics residual acts as a safety fence during gradient ascent: the model is steered away from the poisoned behavioral basin and simultaneously toward physics-compliant territory, rather than toward an arbitrary alternative that may still violate domain constraints. We evaluate the proposed method against four baselines: naive gradient ascent, exact unlearning, SISA, and full retraining on an IEEE 34-bus distribution system, driven by two physics-informed neural network-based distribution energy resource controllers and validated through high-fidelity OpenDSS power-flow co-simulation. From the evaluation, we found that our proposed physics-guided model simultaneously removes poison and restores physical compliance, which are essential for the safe deployment of safety-critical cyber-physical systems

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种物理引导的梯度上升式机器遗忘方法，将遗忘信号与信息物理系统（CPS）的物理残差耦合，使遗忘过程中的权重更新被约束在物理可行区域内，从而在去除投毒影响的同时恢复物理合规性。
AI.motivation: 安全关键的信息物理系统中，模型可能被投毒数据引入违反物理约束的行为。传统机器遗忘（如朴素梯度上升）虽可移除投毒影响，却可能将模型导向任意替代解，仍可能违反领域物理约束，因此需要一种在遗忘同时保证物理合规的方法。
AI.method: 将物理残差作为梯度上升过程中的"安全围栏"：在梯度上升时把物理残差纳入遗忘信号，使权重更新被引导远离被投毒的行为盆地，同时朝向物理合规区域，而非任意可能违反约束的替代解。
AI.result: 在IEEE 34节点配电系统上，以两个基于物理信息神经网络（PINN）的分布式能源控制器为对象，通过高保真OpenDSS潮流协同仿真，与四种基线（朴素梯度上升、精确遗忘、SISA、完全重训练）对比。结果显示，所提物理引导方法可同时去除投毒并恢复物理合规性。
AI.conclusion: 物理引导的机器遗忘方法对于安全关键信息物理系统的安全部署至关重要，因为它能同步实现投毒移除与物理合规恢复。

title: What Makes Recurrence Effective in Looped Language Models?
summary: Looped language models (LoopLMs) increase computational depth through parameter sharing, offering a path to scale inference computation without adding parameters. However, it remains unclear when additional recurrence is beneficial and how architectural choices affect its effectiveness. Through controlled experiments, we systematically examine (1) when recurrence helps, (2) where it should be applied, and (3) how its conditioning affects performance. Our evaluation covers inference budgets below, within, and beyond the training horizon under knowledge and reasoning tasks. (1) We find that recurrence can improve reasoning beyond the training horizon while degrading knowledge performance, but harder reasoning instances do not consistently benefit more. (2) Performance also depends on how distinct layers and recurrent iterations are allocated, showing that effective depth alone is insufficient to predict behavior. Non-recurrent output layers improve robustness to under-unrolling, while the preferred placement of input and output layers varies with inference budget. (3) Finally, we find that conventional initial-state injection offers limited robustness to varying recurrence depth. We therefore propose history-state injection as an alternative, and show that channel-wise history-state injection combined with timestep conditioning offers a low-cost and more effective design, better preserving knowledge under extended unrolling while improving robustness across inference budgets. Overall, our results clarify when recurrent computation helps, where it fails, and offer practical guidelines for designing LoopLMs across variable inference budgets.

AI.tldr: 通过受控实验系统研究循环语言模型(LoopLM)中额外循环何时有益、应施加于何处以及条件化方式的影响,并提出历史状态注入以在扩展展开下更好地保持知识。
AI.motivation: 循环语言模型通过参数共享增加计算深度,可在不增加参数的情况下扩展推理计算,但额外循环何时有益、架构选择如何影响其效果尚不明确。
AI.method: 在低于、处于和超出训练视野的推理预算下,针对知识与推理任务开展受控实验,围绕三个问题展开:(1)循环何时有用;(2)应施加于何处;(3)其条件化如何影响性能。此外提出历史状态注入作为传统初始状态注入的替代方案,并测试逐通道历史状态注入结合时间步条件化的设计。
AI.result: (1)循环可提升超出训练视野的推理能力,但会损害知识性能;更难的推理实例并未一致获益。(2)性能取决于不同层与循环迭代的分配方式,有效深度本身不足以预测行为;非循环输出层提升了对欠展开的鲁棒性,而输入输出层的首选位置随推理预算变化。(3)传统初始状态注入对变化循环深度的鲁棒性有限;逐通道历史状态注入结合时间步条件化成本低且更有效,在扩展展开下更好保持知识,并改善跨推理预算的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果阐明了循环计算何时有益、何处失效,并为在不同推理预算下设计LoopLM提供了实用准则。

title: PE-OPSD: Internalizing Prompt Enhancement into Flow-matching Models via On-Policy Self-Distillation
summary: Text-to-image users often provide concise and underspecified prompts, whereas generative models benefit from detailed textual conditions for reliable instruction following. Existing systems bridge this gap with Prompt Enhancers (PEs) that rewrite raw prompts at inference time, introducing additional latency and leaving prompt elaboration external to the generator. We instead view enhanced prompts as privileged training information and ask whether their benefits can be internalized. We propose Prompt-Enhanced On-Policy Self-Distillation (PE-OPSD) for text-to-image flow-matching models. During training, a raw-prompt student follows its own generation trajectory, while an enhanced-prompt teacher provides vector-field targets at the states visited by the student. This on-policy supervision distills the behavior induced by enhanced prompts into the raw-prompt student without requiring additional text--image pairs. At inference, both the PE and teacher are removed, and the student generates directly from raw prompts. Across multiple model families, PEs, and benchmarks, PE-OPSD achieves the strongest aggregate prompt fidelity among the evaluated baselines, yields positive aggregate visual appeal gains, and retains the base-model inference efficiency.

AI.tldr: 提出PE-OPSD方法，通过on-policy自蒸馏将提示增强器的收益内化到文生图模型，推理时无需增强器与教师模型，在保持基座效率的同时提升提示一致性与视觉吸引力。
AI.motivation: 文生图用户常提供简短、欠具体的提示词，而生成模型需要详尽文本条件才能可靠遵循指令。现有做法是在推理时用提示增强器（PE）重写原始提示，但这引入了额外延迟，且提示细化仍外置于生成器。作者希望将增强提示视为特权训练信息，探究其收益能否被内化到生成器中。
AI.method: 提出Prompt-Enhanced On-Policy Self-Distillation（PE-OPSD），面向文生图流匹配模型。训练时，使用原始提示的学生模型沿自身生成轨迹采样，增强提示的教师模型在学生学习到的状态上提供向量场（vector-field）目标。该on-policy监督将增强提示所诱导的行为蒸馏给原始提示学生模型，且无需额外文本-图像配对数据。推理时移除PE与教师，学生直接从原始提示生成。
AI.result: 在多种模型家族、多种PE与多个基准上，PE-OPSD在评估基线中取得最强的综合提示保真度（prompt fidelity），并获得正向的综合视觉吸引力增益，同时保持基座模型的推理效率。
AI.conclusion: 增强提示的收益可被有效内化到生成器本身：PE-OPSD在无需额外配对数据、不增加推理开销的条件下提升文生图指令遵循与视觉质量，表明将提示增强从推理阶段前移至训练阶段是一种可行且高效的方向。

title: A Digital Simulation Toolkit for Physics-Based Generation of Realistic Experimental Scanning Tunneling Microscopy Images
comment: 17 pages, 6 figures in main text and 2 supplementary figures
summary: Scanning Tunneling Microscopy (STM) is a widely used tool for characterizing surfaces of materials at the atomic scale, playing a crucial role in discoveries across condensed matter physics and materials science. Despite its extreme spatial resolution, STM is one of the most sensitive microscopy techniques and is highly prone to noise. While existing unsupervised denoising methods are very cheap to train, these are primarily focused on removing the noise with minimal recovery of key physical information. While supervised methods can offer superior performance, the major bottleneck is that a large amount of paired clean-noisy experimental images is required which are impractical to obtain. Thus, we developed a low-cost physics-driven digital toolkit to rapidly generate large volume of realistic STM images. Firstly, we simulate clean images from a chosen material system. Then, with prior knowledge of the physical characteristics of the artifacts and noise present in STM experiments, we formulate several artifact-noise functions such as Gaussian electronic noise, 1/f flicker noise, scan-line noise, background tilt and mechanical drift. These physically informed noise components are then added to the simulated clean images to generate realistic STM images. We demonstrated the capability of the proposed digital toolkit to generate AI-ready data for denoising images of the (111) surfaces of copper and lead, while preserving atoms, defects, and electron waves. We also validated the quality of the downstream image analysis of learning electron wave patterns induced by quantum interference from Cu(111) images. Results show that the supervised models trained on digitally generated AI-ready data can more effectively denoise and learn electron wave patterns on Cu(111) images than benchmarked unsupervised approaches, indicating that the proposed toolkit facilitate scientific discovery.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种低成本、物理驱动的数字工具包，通过模拟干净STM图像并叠加物理机制明确的噪声与伪影，批量生成逼真的STM图像，用于训练监督式去噪模型。
AI.motivation: STM具有原子级空间分辨率，但极易受噪声影响。现有无监督去噪方法训练成本低，却偏向于去除噪声而难以恢复关键物理信息；监督方法性能更优，但瓶颈在于难以获取大量成对的干净-含噪实验图像。因此需要一个能快速生成大量逼真STM图像的方案。
AI.method: 构建物理驱动的数字工具包：先模拟选定材料体系的干净图像；再依据STM实验中伪影与噪声的物理特性，构造多种伪影-噪声函数，包括高斯电子噪声、1/f闪烁噪声、扫描线噪声、背景倾斜和机械漂移；将这些物理噪声分量叠加到模拟干净图像上，生成逼真的STM图像。
AI.result: 该工具包可为铜和铅(111)表面去噪任务生成AI就绪数据，并保留原子、缺陷与电子波信息。在Cu(111)图像量子干涉诱导电子波图样的下游分析中，基于数字生成数据训练的监督模型在去噪与学习电子波图样方面优于基准无监督方法。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的数字工具包能有效缓解监督式STM去噪中成对实验数据匮乏的问题，生成高质量AI就绪数据，提升去噪与物理图样学习效果，从而促进科学发现。

title: Inducing Process Supervision from Outcome-Only Reinforcement Learning
summary: Process reward models (PRMs) have become a key component for LLMs, as their step-level feedback supports both post-training and test-time reasoning. However, training strong PRMs remains costly: human step annotation is difficult to scale, while Monte Carlo estimation is computationally expensive and can drift from the intrinsic correctness of steps. To get effective PRMs at low cost, we introduce TIPS (Thinking-Induced Process Supervision), an outcome-only reinforcement learning (RL) framework for training generative PRMs. In TIPS, the model generates a chain-of-thought (CoT) followed by step-level labels and an outcome label. The reward depends solely on whether the predicted outcome matches the ground truth, and the resulting group-relative advantage is used to optimize the entire generated response. Intuitively, when checking intermediate steps helps determine the outcome, more accurate checks can lead to better outcome judgments and higher rewards. Outcome-only RL can therefore reinforce step-level verification without explicit process supervision. We validate the effectiveness of TIPS across math and agent benchmarks and four backbone families. Notably, TIPS-Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507 reaches 85.2 F1 on ProcessBench with only 3.2K outcome-labeled trajectories, surpassing all evaluated trained PRMs and strong prompt-only judges such as GPT-5.4-Instruct and Claude-4.7-Opus, while still trailing o1-mini. Code and data are available at https://github.com/RUCBM/TIPS.

AI.tldr: 提出TIPS框架，用仅依赖结果标签的强化学习训练生成式过程奖励模型（PRM），在低成本下取得强性能。
AI.motivation: 训练强PRM成本高：人工步骤标注难以规模化，蒙特卡洛估计计算昂贵且可能偏离步骤内在正确性。因此需要一种低成本、有效的方法来获得高质量PRM。
AI.method: 提出TIPS（Thinking-Induced Process Supervision），一种仅用结果监督的强化学习框架，用于训练生成式PRM。模型生成思维链（CoT），随后输出步骤级标签和结果标签；奖励仅依据预测结果是否与真实标签一致，并用组相对优势优化整个生成回复。其直觉是：当检查中间步骤有助于判断结果时，更准确的步骤检验会带来更好的结果判断和更高奖励，从而在无显式过程监督下强化步骤级验证。
AI.result: 在数学与智能体基准、四种主干模型家族上验证有效。TIPS-Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507仅用3.2K结果标注轨迹即在ProcessBench达到85.2 F1，超越所有被评估的已训练PRM及GPT-5.4-Instruct、Claude-4.7-Opus等强提示型评判模型，但仍落后于o1-mini。
AI.conclusion: TIPS表明仅用结果级强化学习即可有效强化步骤级验证能力，以极低标注成本训练出强生成式PRM。代码与数据已开源。

title: PR-OPD: Privileged Representation On-policy Self-Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary: Language-model agents are usually trained by reinforcement learning from one reward per episode, and privileged self-distillation enriches it by letting the same policy, given a skill, teach its skill-free self through token probabilities. However, we identify two phenomena that question this channel. Invisible Advantage: a skill in context lifts WebShop success from 42.2% to 56.2%, yet changes the probabilities of fewer than a quarter of the sampled tokens. Much to Align: a skill changes the hidden states of over 80% of response tokens, in a way that linear probes can trace back to the specific skill. To exploit this, we propose Privileged Representation On-policy Self-Distillation (PR-OPD).
