After a GRPO warm start, the policy writes a hindsight skill for each trajectory, re-reads its own responses with that skill as a stop-gradient teacher, and aligns its projected hidden states to the teacher's at every layer alongside the reward objective, with no external skill library, separate teacher, or inference overhead. On ALFWorld and WebShop with two backbones, PR-OPD achieves the best overall results in every setting, improving over GRPO by up to 4.7 points in ALFWorld success and 14.0 points in WebShop accuracy. Code is available at https://github.com/balibata/PR-OPD.

AI.tldr: 本文发现语言模型智能体中的技能主要通过隐藏状态而非输出概率影响行为，据此提出PR-OPD方法，在隐藏状态层面进行特权表征在线自蒸馏，在ALFWorld和WebShop上取得最优结果。
AI.motivation: 现有语言模型智能体依靠每回合单一奖励进行强化学习，特权自蒸馏通过同一策略在给定技能时以token概率指导无技能自身来增强学习。但作者发现两个问题现象：一是"不可见优势"（Invisible Advantage），技能在上下文中将WebShop成功率从42.2%提升到56.2%，却只改变不到四分之一采样token的概率；二是"对齐偏移"（Much to Align），技能改变了超过80%响应token的隐藏状态，且线性探针可追溯至具体技能。这表明技能的关键作用在隐藏状态而非概率分布，因此需要新的蒸馏通道。
AI.method: 提出Privileged Representation On-policy Self-Distillation (PR-OPD)。在GRPO热启动后，策略为每条轨迹撰写事后技能（hindsight skill），以该技能重新阅读自身响应作为stop-gradient教师，在每一层将自身投影隐藏状态与教师对齐，并与奖励目标联合优化，无需外部技能库、独立教师或推理开销。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld和WebShop两个环境、两种骨干模型上，PR-OPD在所有设置中均取得最佳综合结果，相较GRPO在ALFWorld成功率上最高提升4.7个点，在WebShop准确率上最高提升14.0个点。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 技能信息主要通过隐藏状态而非输出概率传递，基于隐藏状态对齐的特权表征在线自蒸馏是一种有效且高效的语言模型智能体训练范式。

title: Scheduling Recursive Reasoning in Looped Transformers
summary: Recurrent reasoning models have attracted growing attention for scaling test-time computation, typically by iteratively refining latent states with shared parameters. However, these models apply each learned update with a fixed unit scale, which can be conservative when updates make persistent progress and overly aggressive when they fluctuate, limiting the benefit of additional loops. To understand how the scale should vary along the trajectory, we first analyze the sensitivity of terminal loss to recurrent update scale. We show that its temporal average admits an exact decomposition into persistent-progress and centered-fluctuation contributions. Based on this, we introduce the Trajectory Adaptive Progress-Fluctuation Scheduler (TAPS), which tracks their balance across recurrent updates and adapts the step size online. Theoretically, we establish sufficient conditions under which TAPS reduces expected terminal loss and reaches a target quality in fewer recurrent loops. Empirically, we show that TAPS improves terminal accuracy across structured reasoning tasks without retraining. By further incorporating the progress-fluctuation principle into training, TAPS yields additional accuracy gains with up to 1.56 times wall-clock speedup at matched baseline accuracy. The broad applicability of TAPS is supported by its effectiveness across diverse recurrent architectures and inference strategies. Together, these results establish update scale as complementary control axis of recurrent inference alongside architecture and depth.

AI.tldr: 论文提出TAPS（轨迹自适应进展-波动调度器），通过在线调整循环推理中每次更新步长来优化测试时计算。
AI.motivation: 循环推理模型以固定单位尺度应用每次学习更新，导致更新持续进展时过于保守、波动时过于激进，限制了额外循环带来的收益。需要理解步长应如何沿轨迹变化。
AI.method: 首先分析终端损失对循环更新尺度的敏感性，证明其时间平均可精确分解为"持续进展"和"中心化波动"两部分贡献。基于此提出TAPS，在循环更新中追踪二者的平衡并在线自适应调整步长。理论证明使TAPS降低期望终端损失、以更少循环达到目标质量的充分条件。
AI.result: 在结构化推理任务上无需重训即提升终端准确率；将进展-波动原则引入训练后进一步获得准确率增益，在匹配基线准确率时实现最高1.56倍墙钟加速；在多种循环架构和推理策略上均有效。
AI.conclusion: 更新尺度可作为循环推理中与架构、深度并列的补充控制轴。

title: Replay the Curvature: Accurate and Scalable NVFP4 Quantization for Large Language Model Inference
summary: Large language models make weight storage and memory traffic major inference costs, motivating low-precision formats that represent each weight with only a few bits. Such formats use a scale to map floating-point values into a small codebook; NVFP4 improves local range utilization by letting every 16 E2M1 weights share an E4M3 block scale. Choosing that scale is difficult in GPTQ because quantizing one column updates those that follow, so evaluating a block independently can misestimate its final reconstruction error. Large models pose a second challenge: full-precision weights, calibration activations, and second-order state cannot all remain on one accelerator, while assigning complete layers to devices leaves each time-consuming layer solve serial. We introduce \emph{Schur Replay}, a scale-selection algorithm that reproduces the GPTQ updates caused by each block scale and scores the resulting block error after accounting for compensation from unquantized columns. Separately, our execution infrastructure keeps only the active layer resident, tiers activations across device, host, and disk, retires full-precision layers after export, and distributes independent output rows across tensor-parallel ranks. Together, the algorithm and infrastructure attain $99.35\%$ and $100.84\%$ question-weighted recovery from BF16 across seven benchmarks on Qwen3.5-397B-A17B and Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct. On the 397B model, the infrastructure reduces measured per-layer time by $15.17\times$ over ModelOpt and $23.14\times$ over LLM Compressor, with lower memory used per GPU.

AI.tldr: 提出 Schur Replay 尺度选择算法与配套执行基础设施，在超低精度 GPTQ 量化中提升块尺度估计精度，并解决大模型显存与串行求解瓶颈，实现接近 BF16 的精度恢复与显著加速。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型推理中权重存储与显存访问是主要开销，因此需要每权重仅数比特的低精度格式。NVFP4 采用 E2M1 权重共享 E4M3 块尺度以改善局部范围利用，但在 GPTQ 中选择尺度困难：量化一列会更新后续列，独立评估某块会误估其最终重建误差。此外，大模型无法把全精度权重、校准激活与二阶状态同时驻留单卡，而按整层分配设备又使每层求解串行。
AI.method: 算法侧：Schur Replay 复现由每个块尺度引起的 GPTQ 更新，并在计入未量化列补偿后对所得块误差打分。系统侧：执行基础设施仅保留当前活跃层驻留，将激活按设备-主机-磁盘分级存储，导出后释放全精度层，并将独立输出行分发到张量并行 rank 上并行求解。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3.5-397B-A17B 与 Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct 上，跨七个基准获得相对 BF16 的 99.35% 与 100.84% 问题加权恢复。在 397B 模型上，实测单层时间较 ModelOpt 降低 15.17 倍，较 LLM Compressor 降低 23.14 倍，且每 GPU 显存占用更低。
AI.conclusion: 通过将尺度选择与 GPTQ 顺序更新的补偿效应相结合，并以分层存储、层退役与张量并行行分发的执行方案支撑大模型量化，可在极低比特格式下保持接近全精度的性能，同时大幅缩短单层求解时间并降低显存占用。

title: Constitutional adapters: Inference-time interventions for misalignment and misuse
summary: Training models to act in accordance with an explicitly defined set of principles, or "constitution," has shown promise as a robust and transparent mechanism for AI alignment. However, the generality and flexibility of such methods remain unclear. Here, we show that constitution-consistent behavior can be distilled from synthetic corpora into lightweight objects (low-rank adapters and steering vectors). Despite never seeing a harmful request or jailbreak during training, such objects increase jailbreak defense success and measured alignment -- particularly at long context lengths and against multi-turn attacks, where they outperform both prompted and steered baselines. Subtracting control-trained from constitution-trained objects further accentuates these effects, yielding defenses we call "constitutional adapters" (CAs). CAs can be trained on a base model, transferred zero-shot to its post-trained checkpoint, and scaled at inference time to predictably trade off defense for benign compliance. Taken together, these results recommend CAs as a lightweight, portable, and tunable lever for mitigating misalignment and misuse in API deployments.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出从合成语料中蒸馏“宪法一致性”行为到轻量对象（低秩适配器与引导向量），得到“宪法适配器”（CAs），可在无需见过有害请求或越狱数据的条件下提升越狱防御与对齐，尤其在长上下文与多轮攻击中优于提示与引导基线。
AI.motivation: 基于明确原则（“宪法”）训练模型是稳健透明的对齐机制，但其泛化性与灵活性尚不明确。作者希望验证：宪法一致性行为能否被压缩为轻量、可移植、可调节的组件，并在未见有害样本的情况下仍具备防御与对齐增益。
AI.method: 1）用合成语料蒸馏宪法一致性行为至轻量对象：低秩适配器（low-rank adapters）与引导向量（steering vectors）；2）对比“按宪法训练”与“对照训练”的对象，作差以放大对齐效应，得到“宪法适配器”（CAs）；3）可在基座模型上训练，零样本迁移至其后训练检查点（post-trained checkpoint）；4）推理时按比例缩放，以在防御与良性合规间进行可预测权衡。
AI.result: 这些轻量对象在训练中从未接触有害请求或越狱，却提升越狱防御成功率与测得的对齐水平；在长上下文长度与多轮攻击场景下，优于提示基线与引导基线；相减得到的CAs进一步强化上述效果。
AI.conclusion: CAs可作为一种轻量、可移植、可调的对齐杠杆，用于缓解API部署中的错位与滥用问题；同时支持零样本迁移与推理时可调权衡。

title: On-Policy Parameter Update Direction Underlies Generalization in LLM Post-Training
summary: The strong generalization performance of on-policy post-training paradigms has motivated studies of their parameter update behaviors. However, these studies treat the observed behaviors only as byproducts in on-policy training, overlooking their potential to serve as optimization principles for improving the generalization of other paradigms such as supervised fine-tuning (SFT). To address this limitation, we investigate whether there exists a specific on-policy update behavior that can achieve such improvements. First, our analyses reveal that SFT updates parameters along consistent directions, while the on-policy paradigm continuously adjusts the direction during training. This difference inspires us to focus on the cumulative update direction of each parameter as a promising behavior. Then, we evaluate its effectiveness for improving generalization by proposing On-Policy direction-constrained Supervised Fine-Tuning (OPSFT), which constrains SFT updates to the direction identified by on-policy paradigms. The strong performance of OPSFT indicates that the generalization advantage of on-policy paradigms can be transferred to SFT through the parameter update direction. Once such a direction is identified, even SFT can generalize with its updates constrained to this direction. This finding offers two practical benefits by combining the strong generalization of on-policy paradigms with the advantages of SFT, including the high training efficiency and ability to leverage high-quality trajectories. For efficiency, we identify update directions that support strong generalization using a few on-policy training steps, and subsequently apply OPSFT to achieve high training efficiency. For leveraging high-quality trajectories, OPSFT can utilize these trajectories to continue improving a post-trained model along its update direction without disrupting the ability learned from on-policy training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OPSFT，将在线策略范式的累积更新方向作为优化原则约束SFT更新，从而把在线策略的泛化优势迁移至SFT。
AI.motivation: 现有研究仅把在线策略后训练中的参数更新行为视为副产品，未挖掘其作为优化原则以提升SFT等其他范式泛化能力的潜力。
AI.method: 分析发现SFT沿一致方向更新参数，而在线策略范式在训练中持续调整方向；据此关注各参数的累积更新方向，提出OPSFT，将SFT更新约束到在线策略范式所识别的方向上。
AI.result: OPSFT表现强劲，表明在线策略范式的泛化优势可通过参数更新方向迁移到SFT；仅需少量在线训练步骤即可识别有效方向并应用于OPSFT；OPSFT还可利用高质量轨迹沿该方向继续改进后训练模型而不破坏其已学能力。
AI.conclusion: 参数更新方向是在线策略泛化优势向SFT迁移的有效载体，OPSFT兼具在线策略的强泛化与SFT的高训练效率及利用高质量轨迹的能力。

title: AutoLoCo: Communication Efficient Distributed LLM Training via Adaptive Synchronization
summary: The pre-training of Large Language Models (LLMs) is increasingly conducted across multiple data centers. As training scales to a larger number of accelerators, the fraction of time spent on computation decreases, while the fraction spent on communication increases. Therefore, frequent synchronization becomes a growing bottleneck. Local update methods reduce this cost by allowing workers to perform several optimizer steps between synchronizations. Most local update methods set the number of local optimizer steps between synchronizations before training and keep this interval fixed throughout the run. However, the best interval can change during the entire train process. If the interval and optimizer are adapted to the current training state, the communication frequency is reduced while maintaining the training performance. In this work, we introduce AutoLoCo, an adaptive training framework to reduce communication in LLM training. It adapts the local interval using scalar training statistics and corrects each outer update. Our method is motivated by two observations: 1) the appropriate local interval varies across training stages, and 2) changing the number of inner steps per interval creates a mismatch with an unchanged outer optimizer, requiring a correction to the outer update. We optimize this mismatch by correction of the outer optimizer for the momentum and the learning rate using the accumulated inner learning rate. Our experiments under communication constraints demonstrate that AutoLoCo reduces communication frequency by 27% relative to DiLoCo while maintaining training performance.

AI.tldr: AutoLoCo：依据训练统计量自适应调整本地更新间隔并修正外层次更新，在通信受限下相较DiLoCo减少27%通信频率且保持性能。
AI.motivation: LLM预训练日益跨多数据中心进行，加速器规模扩大使计算占比下降、通信占比上升，频繁同步成为瓶颈。本地更新方法通过在同步之间执行多步优化器更新来降低通信成本，但多数方法在训练前设定固定间隔并全程不变；而最优间隔会随训练阶段变化，若能让间隔与优化器适配当前训练状态，就可在保持性能的同时降低通信频率。
AI.method: 提出AutoLoCo自适应训练框架：1）利用标量训练统计量自适应调整本地间隔；2）对每次外层次更新进行修正。其动机基于两点观察：不同训练阶段适宜的本地间隔不同；改变每个间隔内的内步数会与固定的外层优化器产生不匹配，需要修正外层次更新。具体通过累计的内部学习率，对外层优化器的动量与学习率进行修正，以消除该不匹配。
AI.result: 在通信受限条件下的实验表明，AutoLoCo相较DiLoCo将通信频率降低27%，同时保持训练性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过自适应内步间隔与外层优化器修正，AutoLoCo有效缓解了大规模分布式LLM预训练中的同步瓶颈，在性能不损失的前提下显著减少通信。

title: GenLimitLib: A Formal Library for Language Generation in the Limit and AI-Assisted Mathematical Research
summary: We present GenLimitLib, a source-aligned Lean 4 library for language generation in the limit. Introduced by Kleinberg and Mullainathan at NeurIPS 2024, language generation in the limit studies a theoretical question motivated by LLMs: how to generate valid new strings from observed examples. This young and rapidly evolving field offers a natural testbed for studying large-scale formalization. GenLimitLib contains formal developments for 30 papers. It extracts shared definitions and reusable proof components while preserving paper-specific assumptions and statements, and records relationships across papers. In this way, GenLimitLib provides a concrete and structured view of the literature. We show through mathematical case studies and LLM experiments how our library can support both human mathematical research and AI-assisted research. Our Library: https://github.com/pengzhang91/generation-in-the-limit-lib.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 GenLimitLib，一个面向“极限语言生成”领域的 Lean 4 形式化库，整合 30 篇论文的共享定义与可复用证明组件，并通过数学案例研究与 LLM 实验展示其在人类数学研究与 AI 辅助研究中的应用价值。
AI.motivation: “极限语言生成”由 Kleinberg 与 Mullainathan 在 NeurIPS 2024 提出，是受 LLM 启发的理论问题：如何从观测样例中生成有效的新字符串。该领域年轻且发展迅速，适合作为大规模形式化的试验场；但其文献分散，缺乏跨论文的统一、结构化形式化基础。
AI.method: 构建源对齐的 Lean 4 库 GenLimitLib：抽取各论文的共享定义与可复用证明组件，同时保留论文特有的假设与陈述，并记录跨论文之间的关系，从而形成对该文献的具体且结构化的表示。
AI.result: GenLimitLib 覆盖 30 篇论文的形式化开发，实现定义与证明组件的复用，并显式刻画论文间关系；通过数学案例研究与 LLM 实验验证其可用性。
AI.conclusion: GenLimitLib 能够同时支持人类数学研究与 AI 辅助研究，为极限语言生成领域提供了一个具体、结构化的形式化基础设施。

title: Human-inspired, Task-Dimension-Guided Exploration for Efficient Learning in High Dimensions
summary: Efficient exploration in high-dimensional decision spaces remains a central challenge for decision-making systems. Humans, in contrast, can navigate large decision spaces with remarkable efficiency. Recent behavioral studies suggest that humans reduce dimensionality in large decision spaces by probing candidate feature dimensions, identifying reward-relevant ones, and restricting the effective decision space. Inspired by this mechanism, we propose TDGE (Task-Dimension-Guided Exploration), a human-inspired, model-agnostic algorithm with an automatically constructed task-dimension--feature--item hierarchy. TDGE follows a top-down exploration strategy: it first selects task-relevant feature dimensions, then identifies informative features within those dimensions, and finally recommends concrete items based on the selected features. Experiments on MovieLens-20M, Last.fm, and Amazon recommendation datasets show that TDGE substantially improves exploration efficiency and cold-start adaptation over baseline algorithms. Comparisons with other structured algorithms and ablation studies attribute these gains to TDGE's hierarchical structure and semantic feature-space exploration, with robust results across clustering methods and hierarchy depths. Recommendation-trajectory visualizations also show exploration patterns similar to human dimension-guided behavior.

AI.tldr: 受人类在高维决策空间中"探测特征维度—识别奖励相关维度—收缩有效决策空间"这一行为机制启发，提出模型无关算法TDGE，通过自动构建"任务维度—特征—物品"层级结构实现自上而下的高效探索，在三个推荐数据集上显著提升探索效率与冷启动适应能力。
AI.motivation: 高维决策空间中的高效探索是决策系统的核心难题；而人类在此类空间中表现出极高的效率。近期行为研究表明，人类通过探测候选特征维度、识别与奖励相关的维度并限制有效决策空间来降低维度。作者希望将这一机制引入算法设计。
AI.method: 提出TDGE（Task-Dimension-Guided Exploration）：一种受人类启发、模型无关的算法，自动构建"任务维度—特征—物品"层级结构。其采用自上而下探索策略：先选择任务相关的特征维度，再在所选维度内识别信息量高的特征，最后基于所选特征推荐具体物品。
AI.result: 在MovieLens-20M、Last.fm与Amazon推荐数据集上，TDGE较基线算法显著提升探索效率与冷启动适应能力。与其他结构化算法的对比及消融实验表明，这些增益源于TDGE的层级结构与语义特征空间探索，且在不同聚类方法与层级深度下结果稳健。推荐轨迹可视化显示出与人类维度引导行为相似的探索模式。
AI.conclusion: TDGE验证了将人类维度引导的降维探索机制迁移至算法中的有效性，实现了高效的高维决策空间探索与冷启动适应；其层级语义结构是性能提升的关键来源。

title: MARCO: Multi-Round Agentic Reinforcement for Conditional Molecular Optimization
summary: Molecular optimization is inherently iterative: a candidate is proposed, evaluated against several objectives, and revised while preserving a relationship to the source molecule. Most instruction-following models instead emit one edited molecule, forcing validity, property improvement, and similarity control into a single response. We introduce MARCO, an evaluator-grounded reinforcement-learning framework that trains molecular editors on bounded proposal--feedback--revision trajectories. MARCO aggregates shaped turn rewards into an undiscounted trajectory return for group-relative policy optimization. We evaluate two consequences of this training: Same-1 tests the trained policy under a one-response budget, while Same-5 tests whether the same policy can use verifier feedback when up to five responses are available. Across the three-objective MuMOInstruct benchmark, three Qwen backbones, and seen/unseen instruction splits, SFT-initialized MARCO obtains the highest product of property success rate and similarity in every reported primary setting. Same-5 further improves the observed score under the tested budget, while four-objective and public-checkpoint experiments test transfer across constraint sets and initialization regimes.

AI.tldr: MARCO 是一个基于评估器反馈的强化学习框架，通过在“提案—反馈—修正”轨迹上训练分子编辑器，在 MuMOInstruct 三目标基准上取得了性质成功率与相似度乘积的最优结果。
AI.motivation: 分子优化本质上是迭代过程：提出候选分子、针对多个目标进行评估、并在保持与源分子关系的前提下进行修正。然而多数指令跟随模型只输出一个编辑后分子，把有效性、性质改进与相似度控制压缩进单次响应，无法利用迭代反馈。
AI.method: 提出 MARCO：以评估器为依托的强化学习框架，在有界的“提案—反馈—修正”轨迹上训练分子编辑器；将分步（shaped）轮次奖励聚合为无折扣的轨迹回报，用于组相对策略优化（group-relative policy optimization）。SFT 初始化。设置两种评估条件：Same-1（单次响应预算）与 Same-5（最多五次响应，考察策略能否利用验证器反馈）。
AI.result: 在 MuMOInstruct 三目标基准、三种 Qwen 骨干网络以及已见/未见指令划分上，SFT 初始化的 MARCO 在全部报告的主要设置中均取得性质成功率与相似度乘积的最高值；Same-5 在给定预算下进一步提升了观测得分；四目标实验与公开检查点实验检验了跨约束集与跨初始化方式的迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: 将分子编辑建模为有界的迭代轨迹并配合评估器驱动的强化学习，优于单次输出的指令跟随范式；模型在多次响应预算下能有效利用验证器反馈，且该方法在约束集合与初始化方式上具备一定迁移性。

title: Where Root Cause Analysis Fails: A Retrieval-Reranking Decomposition
summary: Identifying the root cause of an anomaly among hundreds of sensors is critical for preventing safety incidents and costly downtime in complex monitored systems. Existing studies evaluate root cause analysis (RCA) methods using top@k accuracy. We show that this metric has a fundamental blind spot: it conflates two failure modes, retrieval failure, where the true cause is never considered, and reranking failure, where it is considered but ranked too low. In this work, we introduce a retrieval-reranking decomposition and audit four well-known benchmarks to expose this blind spot. Our experiments show that, on benchmarks with complex faults, statistical baselines mis-rank the true cause 79-100% of the time, and graph-based methods never clearly beat the best statistical baseline, whether their causal graphs are learned on short fault windows, on retrieved candidate pools guaranteed to contain the cause, or on multi-day normal-operation data. Meanwhile, on simple benchmarks where faults manifest significantly at their origin, retrieval is nearly solved (98-100%). Guided by the decomposition, we build a two-stage pipeline combining a multi-signal retriever with an LLM reranker that, as one fixed configuration, matches or exceeds the best baseline's top@1 accuracy on all six benchmark suites (by up to +12 points), with no causal graph or labeled data required. When all methods rank the same retrieved candidates with the true cause guaranteed present, adding a short system-description document lets the reranker lead the best baseline by +7 to +18 points on every benchmark. Code is available at https://github.com/cruiseresearchgroup/DecompRCA.

AI.tldr: 本文将RCA评测指标拆解为"检索+重排"两阶段，揭示top@k指标的盲点，并提出多信号检索器+LLM重排器的两阶段流水线，在六个基准上达到或超过最优基线（最多+12点），且无需因果图或标注数据。
AI.motivation: 现有RCA研究普遍以top@k准确率评估方法，但该指标混淆了两类本质不同的失败：检索失败（真实根因从未进入候选集）与重排失败（进入候选集却排名过低）。这种混淆导致研究者无法定位方法缺陷，也高估了图方法在复杂故障场景下的有效性。
AI.method: 提出检索-重排分解（retrieval-reranking decomposition）框架，对四个知名基准进行审计式评测；统计基线、基于因果图的方法（分别在短故障窗口、保证含根因的检索候选池、多日正常运行数据上学习因果图）进行对比；构建两阶段流水线：多信号检索器 + LLM重排器，作为单一固定配置在六个基准套件上评测。
AI.result: 在复杂故障基准上，统计基线将真实根因错排的比例高达79%-100%；图方法在任何因果图学习设置下都未能明确优于最佳统计基线。在故障在源头显著显现的简单基准上，检索几乎被解决（98%-100%）。两阶段流水线以单一固定配置在所有六个基准套件上达到或超过最佳基线top@1（最高+12点），无需因果图或标注数据。在候选集保证含根因的同条件重排中，加入简短系统描述文档可使重排器领先最佳基线+7至+18点。
AI.conclusion: top@k指标掩盖了RCA方法的真实失效模式，检索-重排分解提供了更细粒度的诊断视角。该视角揭示图方法收益有限，并指引出一个无需因果图与标注、由LLM重排驱动的两阶段方案，在复杂故障场景下显著优于现有基线；系统描述文本可进一步放大重排收益。

title: CHAIN: Calibrated LLM Forecasting via Causal-Temporal Hypergraph Inference
summary: Large language models have achieved significant progress in event forecasting, yet their probability outputs exhibit systematic calibration bias that varies heterogeneously across different domains and question types, undermining the trustworthiness of probabilistic outputs for decision-making under uncertainty. However, existing calibration methods typically correct probability outputs after prediction is complete, without modeling the structural sources of bias within the prediction process itself. To address this challenge, we decompose probabilistic prediction over causal-temporal hypergraphs into three stages, evidence weighting, evidence aggregation, and source fusion, and propose CHAIN, which designs stage-specific mechanisms to mitigate bias at each stage: (i) modulating the temporal decay function by causal topological distance, (ii) aggregating approximately independent causal chains via Noisy-OR after direction-aware deduplication, and (iii) driving adaptive fusion by causal coverage and directional balance. Experimental results on cross-domain forecasting benchmarks show CHAIN outperforms existing methods in expected calibration error, Brier score, and accuracy. Our project is available at https://github.com/QwenQKing/Chain.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出CHAIN方法，将大语言模型的概率预测分解为证据加权、证据聚合与来源融合三阶段，在因果-时序超图上进行阶段特异性去偏，实验表明在校准误差、Brier分数与准确率上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在事件预测中虽取得进展，但其概率输出存在系统性校准偏差，且该偏差在不同领域和问题类型间呈现异质性，损害了不确定性决策中概率输出的可信度。现有校准方法通常在预测完成后才修正概率输出，未对预测过程内部的结构性偏差来源进行建模。
AI.method: 将因果-时序超图上的概率预测分解为证据加权、证据聚合、来源融合三个阶段，并设计阶段特异性机制： (i) 以因果拓扑距离调制时间衰减函数； (ii) 在方向感知去重后，用Noisy-OR聚合近似独立的因果链； (iii) 由因果覆盖率与方向平衡驱动自适应融合。
AI.result: 在跨领域预测基准上，CHAIN在期望校准误差（ECE）、Brier分数和准确率三项指标上均优于现有方法。项目代码见 https://github.com/QwenQKing/Chain。
AI.conclusion: 通过在预测过程内部的三个结构阶段显式建模并缓解偏差来源，而非仅在输出端后处理，可有效改善大语言模型概率预测的校准性与准确性。

title: Normalize-Then-Precondition: A Hierarchical Approach to Marginal Scale and Interaction Geometry for LLM Training
summary: Matrix optimizers have emerged as a promising direction, with Muon standing out as a prominent design. Revisiting Muon through its full-Gram representation, we observe that it jointly processes marginal-scale and interaction information. This opens an alternative way to organize geometric information hierarchically, motivating the Normalize-Then-Precondition framework. Specifically, it first uses diagonal-Gram information to construct a marginally normalized update, then applies spectral preconditioning to its directional interaction geometry. Building on this framework, we develop NormPre with NormPre-G and NormPre-L adopting global and localized spectral preconditioning, grounded in spectral-norm steepest descent and a regularized formulation followed by leading mode selection, respectively. To enable large-scale training, NormPre-G uses Newton-Schulz iterations and NormPre-L employs randomized sketching to approximate the leading interaction eigenspace. Theoretically, we establish $\mathcal{O}(T^{-1/2})$ convergence guarantees for simplified versions of NormPre. Across extensive pretraining experiments on GPT-2 Small, LLaMA and Qwen3, both variants consistently outperform AdamW, Muon and MANO under matched training budgets. Further efficiency and spectral analyses reveal the complementary strengths of two variants and characterize their performance-efficiency trade-off. We open-source our code through a GitHub repository at https://github.com/zx-gong/NormPre.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出Normalize-Then-Precondition（NTP）框架，并据此设计矩阵优化器NormPre（含NormPre-G与NormPre-L），在大规模预训练中优于AdamW、Muon与MANO。
AI.motivation: 矩阵优化器（以Muon为代表）是新兴方向。通过全Gram表示重新审视Muon，作者发现Muon同时处理边际尺度信息与交互信息；这启发将几何信息分层组织，从而获得更灵活的优化设计空间。
AI.method: 提出Normalize-Then-Precondition（NTP）框架：先利用对角Gram信息构造边际归一化更新，再对其方向性交互几何施加谱预条件。基于此实现NormPre：NormPre-G采用全局谱预条件（基于谱范数最速下降），NormPre-L采用局部谱预条件（基于正则化公式并选取主导模式）。为支持大规模训练，NormPre-G使用Newton-Schulz迭代，NormPre-L使用随机草图近似主导交互特征子空间。理论上给出简化版本的O(T^{-1/2})收敛保证。
AI.result: 在GPT-2 Small、LLaMA与Qwen3的广泛预训练实验中，相同训练预算下两种变体均一致优于AdamW、Muon与MANO。效率与谱分析进一步揭示两者的互补优势，并刻画了性能-效率权衡。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: NTP框架为矩阵优化提供了分层组织几何信息的新视角；NormPre-G与NormPre-L在性能与效率上各有优势，可作为强基线并推进大规模矩阵优化器的实用化。

title: Know Thyself, Teach Thyself: Internal Information Flow for Selective Self-Distillation
summary: Self-distillation turns knowledge distillation into a closed learning loop and offers a path toward recursive self-improvement. Without an external teacher, however, the model must determine both what information can improve its supervision and which induced changes should be learned. Existing methods typically improve teacher-generated data or select training examples in isolation, leaving the information transferred between these stages unmeasured. We introduce InFlow, a retrieval-guided on-policy self-distillation framework that models this process as potential-to-realized information flow. InFlow first retrieves potentially informative sources using certainty-calibrated hidden-state trajectories, then measures their realized effect through the Jensen--Shannon divergence between the teacher's initial and retrieval-conditioned answer beliefs. Examples with larger belief shifts are selected for on-policy distillation. Our analysis formalizes the information optimized by retrieval and selection and relates the answer-level shift to the teacher--student distillation gap. Across four open-weight language models and three knowledge domains, InFlow achieves the strongest cross-model average among the compared selection methods, with ablations supporting both stages of the framework. Our code is available at https://github.com/1240148048/INFLOW.

AI.tldr: 提出InFlow，将检索引导的on-policy自蒸馏建模为"潜在信息→已实现信息"的流动，先检索、再测量、后选择，实现跨模型最优的平均表现。
AI.motivation: 自蒸馏构成闭环学习回路，具备递归自我改进的潜力，但缺少外部教师时，模型需自行判断"哪些信息能改善监督"以及"哪些诱导变化值得学习"。现有方法要么改进教师生成的数据，要么孤立地选择训练样本，二者之间传递的信息未被度量。
AI.method: InFlow框架：第一阶段用"确定性校准的隐状态轨迹"检索具有潜在信息量的来源；第二阶段用教师初始答案信念与检索条件化答案信念之间的Jensen–Shannon散度度量已实现效果，选取信念偏移更大的样本进行on-policy蒸馏。同时给出理论分析，形式化检索与选择所优化的信息，并将答案层面的信念偏移与教师—学生蒸馏差距关联起来。
AI.result: 在四个开放权重语言模型和三个知识领域上，InFlow在对比的选择方法中取得最强的跨模型平均表现；消融实验验证了框架两个阶段各自的贡献。代码已开源于 https://github.com/1240148048/INFLOW。
AI.conclusion: 将自蒸馏中的检索与选择统一为可度量的信息流动（潜在→已实现），既能筛选高信息量样本，又能解释信念偏移与蒸馏差距的关系，为无外部教师的递归自我改进提供了有效且可分析的路径。

title: Learned Queries and Keys Are All You Need: Replacing the Value Projection with Structured Transforms
summary: To reduce the number of parameters and cache memory requirements of transformers we introduce dual-headed transformers instead of three heads. We studied Walsh-Hadamard Transform (WHT), Discrete Cosine Transform (DCT), Discrete Fourier Transform, filterbank based Shearlet Transform, and Multiplication-Avoiding (MA) operators to construct dual heads. We combine spatial patches and their orthogonal transforms (or Shearlet and MA operators) in a structure similar to the attention block. We obtained better results than triple headed transformers in ImageNet. Extensive simulation examples are presented.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出用双头（dual-headed）注意力结构替代三头注意力，以降低Transformer的参数量与缓存需求。作者采用WHT、DCT、DFT、Shearlet变换及乘法规避算子构建双头，将空间patch与其正交变换组合进类注意力块，在ImageNet上优于三头Transformer。
AI.motivation: Transformer的三头注意力结构带来较大的参数量和缓存内存开销，需要一种更轻量的替代方案，在保持或提升性能的同时减少资源占用。
AI.method: 以双头结构替代三头，利用Walsh-Hadamard变换、离散余弦变换、离散傅里叶变换、基于滤波器组的Shearlet变换以及乘法规避（MA）算子构造双头；将空间patch与其正交变换（或Shearlet与MA算子）以类似注意力块的结构进行组合。
AI.result: 在ImageNet上取得优于三头Transformer的结果，并给出了大量仿真示例。
AI.conclusion: 双头Transformer是一种可行且高效的结构，能够在减少参数与缓存的条件下超越传统三头Transformer，正交变换与MA算子可作为构造双头的有效手段。

title: CALIBUDGET: Calibration-Guided Source Allocation for Fixed-Budget Mixed-Reasoning Adaptation
summary: Fixed-budget adaptation from heterogeneous data sources requires deciding not only how much data to use, but how much exposure each source receives. Size-proportional rules can crowd out small sources, whereas difficulty-only rules can chase noisy estimates or allocate residual budget to nearly saturated pools. We introduce CALIBUDGET, a floor-protected, reliability-aware integer allocator that treats source exposure as an explicit adaptation variable. From small train-internal calibration splits, it combines model need, post-floor availability, and bootstrap stability, then produces exact capacity-respecting quotas without changing the model, objective, or total budget. In a controlled setting combining mathematical and commonsense data, CALIBUDGET improves CommonAvg, FragileAvg, and MacroAvg over validation-error-with-floor, the strongest matched comparator, in all three paired LLaMA-2-7B LoRA+ runs. The respective mean gains are 0.56, 0.46, and 0.41 percentage points (pp). Overall increases by 0.18 pp, whereas MathAvg decreases by 0.20 pp, exposing a coverage-retention boundary rather than a uniform gain. CALIBUDGET changes only 1.14-1.42% of the source budget but improves performance in 15 of 24 comparisons across commonsense tasks and seeds. These results suggest that small changes in source quotas can matter; example-level selection can then determine which examples fill each quota.

AI.tldr: CALIBUDGET是一种带下限保护、可靠性感知的整数配额分配器，将数据源曝光量作为显式自适应变量，在固定预算下改进异构数据源适配效果。
AI.motivation: 固定预算下从异构数据源适配时，不仅需决定用多少数据，还需决定各数据源的曝光量。按规模比例分配会挤出小数据源，而仅按难度分配可能追逐噪声估计或将剩余预算分给近乎饱和的数据池。
AI.method: CALIBUDGET利用小规模训练内部校准划分，结合模型需求、扣减下限后的可用量以及bootstrap稳定性，生成严格满足容量约束的整数配额；不改变模型、目标函数或总预算。
AI.result: 在数学与常识数据组合的受控设置中，CALIBUDGET在三次配对的LLaMA-2-7B LoRA+运行中均优于最强匹配比较器（带下限的验证误差法）。CommonAvg、FragileAvg、MacroAvg平均增益分别为0.56、0.46、0.41个百分点；Overall提升0.18 pp，但MathAvg下降0.20 pp，揭示覆盖-保留边界而非一致增益。该方法仅改变1.14%–1.42%的源预算，却在常识任务与随机种子的24次比较中15次提升性能。
AI.conclusion: 源配额的小幅变化即可产生显著影响；在此基础上可再由样本级选择决定各配额内填充哪些样本。

title: Routing in Gradient Space: Balanced Usage Is Not Expert Specialization
summary: Sparse expert models can distribute traffic evenly while still grouping incompatible training signals within the same experts. We study routing as a gradient-partitioning problem and introduce gradient-aligned routing (GAR), whose load-normalized router objective rewards grouping observations with aligned gradients. On five multi-task text-classification mixtures, we compare GAR with task-loss-only routing, gradient-combination and gradient-conflict methods, and load-balancing losses. With a fully trainable RoBERTa backbone and classification-head experts, GAR has the highest aggregate validation accuracy, 1.07 percentage points above task-loss-only routing. With frozen DeBERTa and Qwen3-1.7B backbones and low-rank adapter experts, it again ranks first, 1.10 points above task-loss-only routing, with better-balanced expert load and higher gradient-mass purity, the share of each expert's gradient-norm mass from its dominant task; the load-balancing losses flatten load further but leave this purity near its task-loss-only level. Top-1 routing, trainable full-parameter feed-forward network (FFN) experts, and a larger backbone also show positive aggregate gains. The results distinguish expert-load balance from gradient-based routing organization and indicate the predictive value of gradient-informed routing in multi-task text classification.

AI.tldr: 提出梯度对齐路由（GAR），将MoE路由视为梯度划分问题，用负载归一化目标奖励梯度一致的样本聚入同一专家，在多任务文本分类中一致优于任务损失路由等基线。
AI.motivation: 稀疏专家模型虽能均衡流量，但可能把训练信号不兼容的样本分到同一专家；现有路由多基于任务损失或负载均衡，未直接考虑梯度层面的兼容性。
AI.method: 将路由建模为梯度划分问题，引入GAR：其负载归一化路由目标奖励将梯度方向一致的观测分入同一专家。在五组多任务文本分类混合数据上与任务损失路由、梯度组合、梯度冲突方法及负载均衡损失对比；设置包括RoBERTa全参数骨干+分类头专家、冻结DeBERTa与Qwen3-1.7B骨干+低秩适配器专家；并考察Top-1路由、可训练全参数FFN专家与更大骨干。
AI.result: RoBERTa设置下GAR聚合验证准确率最高，较任务损失路由高1.07个百分点；冻结骨干+LoRA专家设置下同样第一，高1.10个百分点，且专家负载更均衡、梯度质量纯度更高（各专家梯度范数中来自其主导任务的占比）。负载均衡损失能进一步压平负载，但纯度仍停留在任务损失路由水平。Top-1路由、可训练全参数FFN专家和更大骨干也带来正向聚合增益。
AI.conclusion: 结果区分了专家负载均衡与基于梯度的路由组织，表明梯度信息引导的路由在多任务文本分类中具有预测价值。

title: Backpropagated Output Momentum: Relocating Optimizer History from Parameters to Task Space
summary: Optimizer momentum is usually stored as a parameter-sized moving average of past gradients, which makes history costly and fixes each past signal in the coordinates in which it was computed. We introduce Backpropagated Output Momentum (BOM), which instead stores a compact moving average of prediction errors at the model output and reprojects that history through the current network at every step. A batch-level analysis characterizes the information retained and omitted by this relocation, while the implementation preserves the current supervised gradient and can replace the first-moment component of several adaptive optimizers. As a plug-in for momentum-based optimizers, including ones that already compress their state, BOM reduces parameter-shaped optimizer state by 49.7-99.8% in three compositions and, averaged over three language backbones, paired step time by 4.0%. It also improves mean validation performance across language and vision fine-tuning, by 1.42 points in the primary five-task comparison. Language and vision pretraining studies, together with matched mechanism controls, further test the construction across output spaces and model scales.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Backpropagated Output Momentum (BOM)，将优化器动量从参数空间的梯度移动平均改为输出空间预测误差的紧凑移动平均，并在每步通过当前网络重投影，从而大幅压缩优化器状态。
AI.motivation: 传统优化器动量以参数规模的移动平均存储历史梯度，导致显存/存储开销大，且将历史信号固定在计算时的坐标中，无法适应网络参数更新后的坐标变化。
AI.method: BOM 在模型输出端存储预测误差的紧凑移动平均，并在每一步通过当前网络将该历史重投影；作者给出批次级分析刻画这种"位置迁移"所保留与丢失的信息，同时保持当前监督梯度不变，可作为多种自适应优化器一阶动量组件的替代插件，包括本身已压缩状态的优化器。
AI.result: 在三种组合下将参数形优化器状态减少 49.7–99.8%；在三个语言主干上平均配对步时降低 4.0%；在语言与视觉微调中提升平均验证性能，主五项任务比较中提升 1.42 分；语言与视觉预训练研究及匹配机制对照进一步验证了该构造在不同输出空间与模型规模下的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 将动量存储从参数空间迁移到输出空间并用当前网络重投影，是一种有效且通用的优化器状态压缩方案，在显著降低状态开销与步时的同时还能提升微调性能，具有良好的可扩展性与兼容性。

title: Efficient Offline Learning of Ranking Policies via Top-$k$ Policy Decomposition
comment: Published as a conference paper at CIKM 2026
summary: Many recommender systems such as for e-commerce and news platforms aim to provide users with rankings they are likely to interact with. Off-Policy Learning (OPL) of ranking policies enables us to learn new ranking policies using only historical logged data. However, ranking settings make OPL remarkably challenging because their action spaces consist of permutations of unique items, being extremely large. Existing methods primarily use either policy- or regression-based approaches. The policy-based approach, which typically uses importance-weighted policy gradients, can suffer from high variance due to large action spaces. The regression-based approach, on the other hand, estimates the expected reward using conventional machine learning methods, avoiding variance issues but potentially suffering from severe bias. To circumvent these issues of existing methods, we propose a new OPL method for ranking, named Ranking Policy Optimization via Top-$k$ Policy Decomposition (R-POD), which combines the policy- and regression-based approaches in an effective fashion. Specifically, R-POD decomposes a ranking policy into a first-stage policy for selecting top-$k$ actions and a second-stage policy for choosing the bottom actions given the top-$k$ actions. It learns the first-stage policy using a new policy gradient estimator and the second-stage policy via the regression-based approach. This method can substantially reduce variance, since it applies importance weighting only to the top-$k$ actions. We also demonstrate that our policy-gradient estimator for the first-stage policy is unbiased under a conditional pairwise correctness condition, which only requires that the expected reward differences of pairs of rankings sharing the same top-$k$ actions can be estimated correctly.

AI.tldr: 提出R-POD方法，将排序策略分解为top-k选择的第一阶段策略与底部排序的第二阶段策略，分别用新的策略梯度估计器和回归方法学习，以降低方差并保持无偏性。
AI.motivation: 排序推荐系统的动作空间由唯一项目的排列构成，规模极大，导致现有OPL方法面临困境：基于策略的重要性加权梯度方法方差高，基于回归的方法虽避免方差问题却可能产生严重偏差。
AI.method: R-POD将排序策略分解为两阶段：第一阶段策略用于选择top-k动作，第二阶段策略在给定top-k动作的条件下选择底部动作。第一阶段策略使用新的策略梯度估计器学习，第二阶段策略通过基于回归的方法学习。由于重要性加权仅施加于top-k动作上，从而显著降低方差。
AI.result: 该方法能显著降低方差，并在条件成对正确性条件下证明了第一阶段策略梯度估计器的无偏性；该条件仅要求共享相同top-k动作的成对排序之间的期望奖励差可被正确估计。
AI.conclusion: R-POD有效结合策略与回归两类方法，缓解了排序OPL中方差与偏差的权衡问题，为大规模排序策略的离线学习提供了新思路。

title: Group-Marginalized Self-Rewarding RL Drives Zero-Label Self-Evolving
summary: Self-rewarding reinforcement learning (RL) enables large language models (LLMs) to self-evolve without human labels. Existing ensemble-based methods construct reward references from rollout groups and assign rewards accordingly. However, a response's reward representation also depends on its randomly sampled group context, i.e., the other responses in its group. Using only one group-context realization may miss desired reward signals and provide unreliable guidance for policy optimization. To address this issue, we propose Group-Marginalized Advantage Estimation (GMAE), which aggregates reward realizations across possible contexts into a response-level distribution and estimates expected advantages. Experiments across eight benchmarks and four base models demonstrate strong performance and cross-domain generalization. GMAE also exhibits stable learning, low extra cost, and good applicability across training datasets and RL backbones.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出GMAE（组边缘化优势估计），通过将奖励实现跨可能的组上下文聚合为响应级分布并估计期望优势，解决了现有基于集成的自奖励RL方法中因单次随机分组导致奖励信号缺失与指导不可靠的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有基于集成的自奖励强化学习方法从rollout组构造奖励参考并分配奖励，但一个响应的奖励表示还依赖于其随机采样的组上下文（即同组中的其他响应）。仅使用一种组上下文实现可能遗漏所需的奖励信号，并对策略优化提供不可靠的指导。
AI.method: 提出组边缘化优势估计（GMAE），将跨可能上下文的奖励实现聚合为响应级分布，并据此估计期望优势。
AI.result: 在八个基准和四个基础模型上的实验表明性能强劲且具有跨域泛化能力；GMAE还表现出学习稳定、额外开销低，并在训练数据集与RL骨干网络上具有良好的适用性。
AI.conclusion: GMAE通过边缘化组上下文来获得更可靠的奖励与优势估计，提升了自奖励RL的稳定性、泛化性与适用性，且计算成本低。

title: cktFormer: Transformer-Based Approach for Automated Analog Circuit Design
comment: 6 pages, 6 figures, IECON 2025 51st Annual Conference of the IEEE Industrial Electronics Society
summary: Circuit design is a complex and iterative process that requires expertise in electronic engineering. It involves selecting components while meeting performance constraints, such as power efficiency, cost-effectiveness, and signal integrity. However, manual design is time-consuming and prone to errors. Although other stages of the manufacturing pipeline have benefited from AI-driven optimizations, circuit design remains a bottleneck, limiting overall productivity. Generative AI and machine learning offer the potential to automate and improve this stage, boosting efficiency and accuracy. To address this, we introduce a dual transformer architecture that bridges the gap between AI and circuit design by leveraging attention mechanisms to model complex, non-sequential circuit relationships. Our approach structures netlist data into graph-based representations, enabling effective learning of circuit topology and component interactions. The system consists of two interlinked models: a node prediction model that proposes components and an edge prediction model that infers valid connections. This collaborative and decoupled design captures both component-level semantics and global structural coherence. In our experiments, this architecture outperforms recent models such as AnalogGenie and cktGNN in the validity of generated circuits. By addressing key limitations in existing methods, our work advances automation in electronics engineering and contributes a benchmark for AI-driven circuit synthesis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种双Transformer架构，将网表数据组织为图表示，通过节点预测模型推荐元件、边预测模型推断有效连接，协同且解耦地学习电路拓扑与元件交互，实现电路设计的AI自动化，生成电路的合法率优于AnalogGenie与cktGNN。
AI.motivation: 电路设计复杂且需迭代，依赖电子工程专业知识，需在功耗效率、成本效益、信号完整性等约束下选择元件；人工设计耗时长、易出错。尽管制造流程其他环节已受益于AI优化，电路设计仍是瓶颈，制约整体生产率。生成式AI与机器学习有望自动化并改进该环节，提升效率与准确性。
AI.method: 提出双Transformer架构，利用注意力机制建模复杂的非序列化电路关系。将网表数据结构化为基于图的表示，以有效学习电路拓扑与元件交互。系统由两个相互关联的模型组成：节点预测模型负责生成/推荐元件，边预测模型负责推断有效连接。该协同且解耦的设计同时捕获元件级语义与全局结构一致性。
AI.result: 在实验中，该架构在生成电路的合法性（validity）上优于近期模型，如AnalogGenie与cktGNN。
AI.conclusion: 通过解决现有方法的关键局限，该工作推进了电子工程自动化，并为AI驱动的电路综合提供了基准。

title: QuantMLA: Function-Aligned Dual-Path Quantization for Low-Bit MLA KV Caching
summary: Multi-Head Latent Attention (MLA) enables expressive multi-head attention with compact caches for its content and decoupled RoPE paths, yet cache memory still scales linearly with context length and batch size. In this work, we establish a systematic model of MLA's dual-path quantization errors, characterizing their distinct effects on attention-output distortion and explaining the pronounced amplification of RoPE-path errors. Guided by this analysis, we introduce QuantMLA, a function-aligned framework for low-bit dual-path quantization. We derive path-specific transformation spaces that preserve full-precision computation while remaining fully fusible into model parameters offline, eliminating online transformation overhead. Within these spaces, QuantMLA learns path-specific transformations with function-aligned objectives: attention-output reconstruction captures the content path's coupled matching and aggregation errors, while positional QK reconstruction preserves the RoPE-induced component of the attention logits and admits a theoretical bound on output distortion. Across four MLA model families, QuantMLA enables, to our knowledge, the first reported joint INT4 caching of the content and RoPE caches with minimal accuracy degradation. Further compressing the content cache to INT2 while retaining the RoPE key cache at INT4 maintains competitive performance on challenging reasoning and code benchmarks. We develop a native low-bit MLA attention kernel that integrates unpacking and dequantization directly into attention computation. The physical cache layout provides 3.59x compression at 128K context, while a cache-pressure serving workload achieves 5.168x higher whole-job output throughput than BF16. The code will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 提出QuantMLA，一个针对MLA双路径(内容+RoPE)低比特量化的函数对齐框架，首次实现内容缓存与RoPE缓存的联合INT4缓存，并开发原生低比特注意力核，实现显著压缩与吞吐提升。
AI.motivation: MLA虽具备紧凑缓存和双路径(RoPE解耦)特性，但缓存显存仍随上下文长度与批大小线性增长。现有量化方法未针对MLA双路径误差特性建模，尤其RoPE路径误差被显著放大，缺乏针对性分析。
AI.method: 1. 建立MLA双路径量化误差的系统模型，刻画两类路径对注意力输出失真的不同影响并解释RoPE路径误差放大现象；2. 提出QuantMLA函数对齐框架，推导路径特定的变换空间，保持全精度计算且可离线融合进模型参数，消除在线变换开销；3. 在该空间内以函数对齐目标学习路径特定变换：内容路径用注意力输出重建(捕获匹配与聚合耦合误差)，RoPE路径用位置QK重建(保留注意力logits中RoPE分量并给出输出失真理论界)；4. 开发原生低比特MLA注意力核，将解包与反量化直接集成进注意力计算。
AI.result: 在四种MLA模型族上，首次实现内容缓存与RoPE缓存的联合INT4缓存且精度损失极小；进一步将内容缓存压至INT2而RoPE键缓存保持INT4，在推理与代码基准上仍保持竞争力；物理缓存布局在128K上下文下实现3.59x压缩，缓存压力服务负载下整任务输出吞吐达BF16的5.168x。
AI.conclusion: 通过双路径误差建模与函数对齐低比特量化，QuantMLA在保持精度前提下大幅压缩MLA缓存并提升服务吞吐，验证了路径特定量化设计的有效性与实用性。

title: Graph-Spectral Flow Matching for Multivariate Time Series Anomaly Detection
summary: Multivariate time series anomaly detection typically relies on evaluating discrepancies between observations and outputs produced by models trained on normal data. An alternative perspective is to characterize the distribution of normal data through the generative dynamics, i.e., the velocity field, of flow matching models. However, standard flow matching typically adopts linear probability paths that overlook dependencies among variables, leading to a misalignment with the structured data distribution. To address this issue, we propose GRASP, a flow matching framework with a graph-spectral path for multivariate time series anomaly detection. GRASP incorporates graph structure into the probability path by minimizing a fixed-endpoint action that combines kinetic energy with graph Dirichlet energy. This formulation yields a closed-form path based on graph-frequency-dependent hyperbolic interpolation. A velocity predictor trained on normal data then detects anomalies using weighted velocity discrepancies aggregated across source samples, flow times, and graph frequencies. Theoretically, we establish that GRASP is invariant to the choice of Laplacian eigenbasis and decompose its expected oracle anomaly score into bounded endpoint uncertainty and graph-frequency-weighted Fisher discrepancy. Experiments on four benchmarks demonstrate the superior anomaly detection performance of GRASP and validate the effectiveness of its graph-spectral path and weighting mechanism.

AI.tldr: 提出GRASP：一种基于图-谱路径的流匹配框架，用于多变量时间序列异常检测，将图结构融入概率路径并给出闭式解与理论分解。
AI.motivation: 现有多变量时间序列异常检测通常通过比较观测与模型输出来判断，而基于流匹配刻画正常数据生成动态（速度场）是一种替代思路。但标准流匹配采用线性概率路径，忽略了变量间依赖，导致与结构化数据分布不匹配。
AI.method: GRASP在概率路径中引入图结构，通过最小化结合动能与图Dirichlet能量的固定端点作用量，得到基于图频率依赖的双曲插值闭式路径。基于正常数据训练速度预测器，并聚合源样本、流时间与图频率上的加权速度差异进行异常检测。
AI.result: 理论上证明了GRASP对拉普拉斯特征基选择的不变性，并将期望oracle异常分数分解为有界端点不确定性与图频率加权Fisher差异。在四个基准数据集上实验显示其异常检测性能优越，并验证了图-谱路径与加权机制的有效性。
AI.conclusion: GRASP通过图-谱概率路径有效对齐结构化数据分布，提升多变量时间序列异常检测性能，兼具理论保证与实验验证。

title: When Can Prefixes Compile LoRA? Exact Resource-Capped Tests for Frozen Attention
summary: Can a fixed continuous prefix replace a given low-rank adapter while the attention head stays frozen? In this research, we show that the answer depends on the adapter's target through three conditions. First, observability: at one causal readout, every independent key--value prefix sees the content only through the query, attention partition, and value numerator, so a target that differs on two inputs with equal summaries incurs an error floor at every prefix length; norm caps extend this floor to nearly equal summaries. Second, realizability: at a common query, any prefix reduces exactly to two aggregate variables, and the norm-capped optimum is an attained second-order-cone program, also after a fixed output projection; it places two equal-norm rank-one value updates on opposite sides of compilability. Third, implementation: under affine query exposure, $2r$ signed slots approximate a rank-$r$ value update, but their values grow as $O(ε^{-3/2})$, and the construction passes all 400 tolerance checks in float64 yet only 38 in bfloat16. A first-layer GPT-2 readout with fixed token and position meets the common-query condition without clamping activations; at three such heads, the capped optimum leaves 18.4\% to 74.2\% of the projected adapter effect uncompiled, with a head-dependent value--query ordering. All claims concern local approximation at one head, not whole-network equivalence.

AI.tldr: 本文研究固定连续前缀能否替代给定低秩适配器（注意力头保持冻结），并给出可观测性、可实现性与实现三个层次的条件性结论。
AI.motivation: 探究在注意力头冻结的前提下，用固定连续前缀替代低秩适配器的可行性边界，明确何种适配器目标可被前缀精确或近似编译。
AI.method: 从单头局部近似出发，建立三个条件：可观测性（因果读出下KV前缀仅通过query、注意力划分与value分子影响输出，给出误差下界及范数上限扩展）、可实现性（共同query下前缀约化为两个聚合变量，范数受限最优解为可达的二阶锥规划，并施加固定输出投影）、实现性（仿射query暴露下用2r个带符号槽位近似秩r的value更新）。
AI.result: 可观测性给出误差下限；可实现性将两个等范数秩一value更新置于可编译性两侧；实现性中槽位数值以O(ε^{-3/2})增长，浮点64位通过全部400项容差检查而bfloat16仅通过38项。首层GPT-2读出满足共同query条件；三个此类头上，受限最优解未编译投影适配器效应的18.4%–74.2%，且存在依赖头的value–query排序。
AI.conclusion: 固定前缀替代低秩适配器的可行性取决于适配器目标，受可观测性、可实现性与数值实现三重约束；结论仅限单头局部近似，不涉及整网等价。

title: Harnessing Large Language Models to Compile Task-Relevant Context into Bayesian Optimisation
summary: Incorporating rich task-relevant context, such as domain knowledge and external observations, is a key capability yet remains challenging for Bayesian optimisation (BO). Recently, practitioners have started to use large language models (LLMs) to generate and execute BO programs through coding harnesses. In such emerging practices, the posterior belief is shaped not only by Bayesian inference but also by LLM-generated model and data artefacts, offering a flexible route for task context to enter BO as executable code. To study whether and how LLMs can be harnessed to compile diverse contextual signals for BO, we formulate LLM-compiled BO as generalised-context decision making. We propose HarBO, a BO-specialised harness that compiles generalised context into the core artefacts of standard BO through a validated multi-stage workflow. Our theory analyses the regret under imperfect compilation and the effect of adding new context. Across synthetic functions and real-world benchmarks, we find that LLM harnesses can effectively compile context into standard BO, achieving competitive performance with specialised LLM-embedding-based and direct LLM-in-the-loop BO methods. General coding harnesses can be effective in familiar domains such as hyperparameter optimisation, but fall short in unfamiliar, context-rich domains. Together, these results establish LLM harnesses as a promising, but not automatically reliable, route for making rich task context usable in BO.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究如何利用LLM编译上下文信息以增强贝叶斯优化（BO），提出HarBO框架，通过多阶段工作流将广义上下文编译为BO核心构件，并分析不完美编译下的遗憾界。
AI.motivation: 贝叶斯优化中融入领域知识与外部观测等任务相关上下文是关键但具挑战性的能力；新兴实践中人们用LLM通过编码工具生成和执行BO程序，使后验信念不仅由贝叶斯推断塑造，也受LLM生成的模型与数据产物影响，为任务上下文以可执行代码形式进入BO提供了灵活途径，但其可行性与机制尚不明确。
AI.method: 将LLM编译的BO形式化为广义上下文决策问题；提出HarBO——一个面向BO的专用harness，通过经验证的多阶段工作流将广义上下文编译为标准BO的核心构件；并从理论上分析不完美编译情形下的遗憾以及新增上下文的影响。
AI.result: 在合成函数和真实世界基准上，LLM harness能有效将上下文编译进标准BO，性能与基于LLM嵌入的专用方法和直接LLM-in-the-loop的BO方法相当；通用编码harness在超参数优化等熟悉领域表现有效，但在不熟悉且上下文丰富的领域表现不佳。
AI.conclusion: LLM harness是将丰富任务上下文用于BO的一条有前景但并非自动可靠的路径，需针对BO进行专门化设计以应对不熟悉领域的编译不足。

title: RAE-PPG: Duration-Grounded Retain-and-Extend Pretraining for PPG Foundation Models
summary: Signal features derived from photoplethysmography (PPG) require different signal durations to characterize. Existing PPG foundation models treat duration as a pretraining or evaluation condition rather than using the different durations required by PPG features to organize self-supervision. We hypothesize that self-supervision should expand with signal duration, allowing a single encoder to progressively acquire additional features while preserving and reusing earlier learning. We introduce Retain-and-Extend PPG (RAE-PPG), which trains a single Transformer encoder successively on 10 s, 30 s, and 240 s inputs, adding supervision for signal features supported by each longer observation. The encoder is partitioned into duration-specific parameter groups, allowing later stages to reuse earlier groups while updating only the group assigned to the current stage. Selected earlier targets are reused to supervise later stages, encouraging the corresponding features to remain accessible in longer-input representations. Direct decoding from the final encoder shows that earlier features remain recoverable from longer-input representations, while later-stage features show higher mean decoding performance at their introduction durations. Controlled comparisons further show that prior-stage learning provides a better basis for learning newly introduced features at both transitions. Across 18 tasks from eight datasets, the final frozen encoder achieves the best observed score on 12 tasks compared with five existing PPG foundation models.

AI.tldr: 提出RAE-PPG，将PPG自监督学习按信号时长递进组织（10s→30s→240s），通过时长特定参数组与旧目标复用，使单一编码器在延长输入时逐步获得新特征并保留旧特征，在18个任务中12个取得最优。
AI.motivation: PPG信号的不同特征需要不同的信号时长才能被刻画，但现有PPG基础模型仅把时长当作预训练或评估条件，未利用"不同特征需要不同时长"这一先验来组织自监督学习。作者假设自监督应随信号时长扩展，使单一编码器在获取新特征的同时保留并复用早期学到的特征。
AI.method: RAE-PPG对单个Transformer编码器依次在10 s、30 s、240 s输入上训练，为每个更长观测所支持的特征添加相应监督。编码器被划分为时长特定的参数组：后续阶段可复用早期参数组，但只更新当前阶段对应的参数组。同时复用部分早期监督目标来监督后续阶段，促使相应特征在长输入表示中保持可访问。
AI.result: 从最终编码器直接解码显示，早期特征在长输入表示中仍可恢复，而后期阶段特征在其引入时长上取得更高的平均解码性能。受控对比表明，在两个阶段转换处，先前阶段的学习都为学习新引入特征提供了更好的基础。在来自8个数据集的18个任务上，最终冻结编码器在其中12个任务上取得与五个现有PPG基础模型相比的最佳观测得分。
AI.conclusion: 将自监督按信号时长递进扩展、并结合时长特定参数组与旧目标复用，可使单一PPG编码器在延长观测时持续累积特征且不遗忘早期能力，最终冻结编码器在多任务上优于现有PPG基础模型。

title: Where Does Randomness Matter in Neural Cellular Automata?
summary: Stochastic cell updates are often used throughout the life of a neural cellular automaton (NCA), from backpropagation through time to final rollout. This leaves two questions entangled: does update randomness help learn a useful rule, and must that randomness remain at execution? We separate training and evaluation update modes in controlled Growing NCA experiments, then vary the states shown during training. Under the standard constant-rate persist recipe, asynchronous training passes the short-horizon quality test in 10/10 runs, compared with 3/10 synchronous runs. All ten asynchronous models also retain the target for 4,096 steps under deterministic evaluation. For a scalar translation-invariant lattice, we derive an exact mean-square criterion: random masking can damp mean modes, but it also injects variance, and a mean-only test misclassifies four non-marginal settings. Finally, among 30 models that all pass the same reconstruction test, eight of ten grow-trained models become off-target at 4,096 steps, while all persist and regenerate models retain the target; damage recovery separates persist from regenerate. The results distinguish optimization reliability, execution mode, and task-specific behavior instead of treating them as one stability property.

AI.tldr: 论文将神经细胞自动机(NCA)训练与评估的随机更新解耦，研究随机性对学习规则与执行阶段的作用，并给出均方判据与任务行为差异分析。
AI.motivation: NCA整个生命周期（BPTT到最终rollout）都使用随机细胞更新，导致两个问题纠缠：随机性是否有助于学到有用规则，以及执行时是否必须保留该随机性。作者希望将"优化可靠性、执行模式、任务特定行为"区分开，而非笼统当作单一稳定性属性。
AI.method: 在受控的Growing NCA实验中分离训练与评估更新模式，并改变训练时展示的状态；对常速率persist配方比较异步与同步训练。针对标量平移不变格点推导精确均方判据，分析随机掩码对均值模态的阻尼与方差注入，并检验仅用均值判据的误判情况。最后在30个通过同一重建测试的模型上比较grow、persist、regenerate训练范式的长期保持与损伤恢复。
AI.result: 常速率persist配方下，异步训练10/10通过短时程质量测试，同步训练仅3/10；十个异步模型在确定性评估下均保持目标4096步。均方分析显示随机掩码可阻尼均值模态但引入方差，仅均值判据误分类四个非边缘设置。30个通过重建测试的模型中，10个grow训练模型有8个在4096步偏离目标，而persist与regenerate模型全部保持目标；损伤恢复可区分persist与regenerate。
AI.conclusion: 异步随机更新主要提升优化可靠性，且不必然需要在执行时保留；执行模式与任务特定行为是不同维度。仅凭均值或单一重建测试不足以刻画稳定性，需结合方差判据与损伤恢复等任务相关评估。

title: EasyPPO: Stabilizing the Critic Is Key
summary: A key strength of Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) is its learned critic, which uses historical trajectories collected during reinforcement learning to estimate expected returns and reduce policy-gradient variance. However, we find that the critic is also a major source of instability in reinforcement learning for large language models (LLMs). We identify two critic failure modes that destabilize PPO. First, filtering truncated rollouts from both actor and critic shifts the policy objective to reward conditioned on completion, allowing truncation to increase even as conditional reward improves. Second, heterogeneous return noise can cause high-variance prompts to dominate critic updates in finite batches. We introduce EasyPPO to address these failures. Actor-only overlong filtering trains the critic on returns from both completed and truncated rollouts. Noise-normalized critic regression weights each prompt's critic loss by the inverse standard deviation of its sampled returns, balancing noise contributions across prompts. Moderately smaller critic mini-batches confine outlier influence to fewer rollouts during gradient clipping. Across continuous-reward coding on FrontierCS, binary-reward mathematical reasoning on AIME24, and multi-turn search on Search-R1, EasyPPO remains stable throughout the full training horizon and consistently outperforms vanilla PPO, VAPO, and HL-Gauss PPO. Its best validation scores show relative gains of 14.89%, 2.28%, and 9.47% over PPO, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文发现PPO中critic是LLM强化学习不稳定的主要来源，识别出两种critic失效模式，并提出EasyPPO通过actor-only超长过滤、噪声归一化critic回归和适度缩小的critic mini-batch来稳定训练，在多个任务上超越PPO、VAPO和HL-Gauss PPO。
AI.motivation: PPO的critic虽能利用历史轨迹估计期望回报并降低策略梯度方差，但在大语言模型强化学习中，作者发现critic反而是不稳定性的主要来源，因此需要针对critic的失效机制进行诊断与修复。
AI.method: EasyPPO包含三项设计：(1) actor-only超长rollout过滤，即仅对actor过滤截断轨迹，而critic在完整与截断rollout的回报上均进行训练；(2) 噪声归一化critic回归，按每个prompt采样回报标准差的倒数对其critic损失加权，以平衡不同prompt的噪声贡献；(3) 采用适度更小的critic mini-batch，在梯度裁剪时限制离群点的影响范围。
AI.result: 在FrontierCS连续奖励编码、AIME24二值奖励数学推理以及Search-R1多轮搜索任务上，EasyPPO在整个训练过程中保持稳定，并持续优于vanilla PPO、VAPO和HL-Gauss PPO；最佳验证分数相对PPO分别提升14.89%、2.28%和9.47%。
AI.conclusion: 识别出的两种critic失效模式——过滤截断rollout导致的策略目标偏移（截断率上升而条件奖励改善）以及异构回报噪声导致的有限batch内高方差prompt主导critic更新——是PPO不稳定性的关键原因；EasyPPO通过针对性设计有效缓解这些问题，实现了跨任务的稳定训练与性能提升。

title: Diffusion Policy Improvement with Proposal-Conditioned Refinement Flows
summary: Diffusion and flow policies can model complex behaviors in offline reinforcement learning (RL). However, penalizing their KL divergence from the behavior policy can discourage actions having high critic values with low behavior density. Directly refining behavior proposals may be an alternative, yet Gaussian or deterministic editors limit expressiveness to represent multiple separated modes for the same proposal. In this work, we introduce Proposal-Conditioned Refinement Flows (PReFlow), a policy extraction method combining critic-based proposal selection with a conditional refinement flow. To optimize proposal selection and refinement together, we formulate a KL-regularized objective whose optimum induces a Gibbs policy over final actions under a Gaussian-smoothed behavior prior. The refinement flow can represent multiple high value modes, while a proposal-centered Gaussian reference regulates large action changes. This Gaussian reference further enables us to make use of simulation-free, closed form adjoint matching targets from sampled endpoints and critic gradients, yielding a single velocity regression loss without a backward adjoint solve. On 50 OGBench tasks, PReFlow achieves competitive offline performance and the highest aggregate score among the compared methods after online fine-tuning, reaching 91\% after 500K environment steps.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PReFlow，一种将基于 critic 的提案选择与条件精化流相结合的策略提取方法，在离线 RL 中兼顾高价值模式表达与行为策略贴近性，并在 OGBench 上取得优异表现。
AI.motivation: 扩散与流策略能建模离线 RL 中的复杂行为，但对其与行为策略的 KL 散度施加惩罚，会抑制那些 critic 价值高但行为密度低的动作。直接精化行为提案是替代思路，然而高斯或确定性编辑器在表达同一提案下的多个分离模式方面能力有限。
AI.method: 提出 Proposal-Conditioned Refinement Flows（PReFlow），将基于 critic 的提案选择与条件精化流结合。通过公式化一个 KL 正则化目标来联合优化提案选择与精化，其最优解在高斯平滑行为先验下诱导出关于最终动作的 Gibbs 策略。精化流可表示多个高价值模式，而以提案为中心的高斯参考项约束动作的大幅变化。该高斯参考还支持利用来自采样端点与 critic 梯度的无模拟、闭式伴随匹配目标，从而得到单一的速度回归损失，无需反向伴随求解。
AI.result: 在 50 个 OGBench 任务上，PReFlow 取得有竞争力的离线性能；经在线微调后，在对比方法中取得最高聚合得分，在 500K 环境步后达到 91%。
AI.conclusion: PReFlow 通过提案条件精化流的联合优化，缓解了 KL 惩罚抑制高价值低密度动作的问题，并在离线和在线微调场景下均展现出强劲性能。

title: RESCUE: Repairing Language Model Errors to Sparse Circuits via Reinforcement Learning
summary: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit strong general capabilities that mechanistic interpretability has attributed to sparse computational circuits. However, existing circuit studies emphasize preserving functionality or explaining safety, leaving the mechanisms underlying failures across a broader range of tasks largely unexplored. Extending circuit analysis from abilities to errors, we explore the perspective that such failures may likewise arise from erroneous internal computations and that targeted tuning of the corresponding parameters can correct such errors while largely preserving other capabilities. Motivated by this insight, we introduce RESCUE (Reasoning-Error Sparse-Circuit Uncovering and Editing), a framework that localizes error-associated circuits and surgically repairs them for performance enhancement. General tasks typically involve multi-step reasoning and long-form generation, where early deviations can cause prefixes to drift from supervised references, leading SFT-based mask optimization to overlook circuits involved in generation-time errors. RESCUE therefore refines these masks through reinforcement learning with multiple masked-model rollouts, improving their relevance to observed task failures. Finally, RESCUE introduces a pruning technique and precisely fine-tunes error circuits to correct task failures, thereby translating error localization into a sparse and targeted model update. We validate RESCUE on heterogeneous repair sets across two domains: (1) mathematical reasoning, identifying a math error circuit of 1.40% density whose repair raises accuracy from 6.0% to 75.5%; and (2) medical QA, where a similarly compact 1.44% circuit improves repair-set accuracy from 0% to 81%. Our code is available at: https://github.com/chuanpupig/RESCUE.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出RESCUE框架，将机制可解释性的电路分析从"能力"扩展到"错误"，通过定位并精准编辑错误相关稀疏电路来修复大模型在多步推理任务中的失败，同时保留其他能力。
AI.motivation: 现有电路研究主要关注保留功能或解释安全性，对跨任务失败背后的机制探索不足。作者探索的视角是：任务失败同样源于错误的内部计算，且针对相应参数进行定向调优可纠正错误而基本保留其他能力。
AI.method: RESCUE（Reasoning-Error Sparse-Circuit Uncovering and Editing）框架：1）定位错误相关电路；2）针对多步推理与长文本生成中早期偏差导致前缀漂移、使基于SFT的掩码优化忽略生成期错误电路的问题，采用强化学习配合多次掩码模型rollout来优化掩码；3）引入剪枝技术并精准微调错误电路，将错误定位转化为稀疏、定向的模型更新。
AI.result: 在两个领域的异构修复集上验证：（1）数学推理中识别出密度1.40%的数学错误电路，修复使准确率从6.0%提升至75.5%；（2）医学问答中，同样紧凑的1.44%密度电路将修复集准确率从0%提升至81%。
AI.conclusion: 任务失败可从错误内部计算的角度进行机制分析，并通过定位和编辑稀疏错误电路进行外科式修复，在显著提升特定任务性能的同时保持模型其他能力，为机制可解释性与模型修复的结合提供了新路径。

title: Towards Better Training Signal: Advantage Clipped Policy Optimization
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a cornerstone for improving the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs), but the need for on-policy data substantially limits training efficiency. Reusing off-policy data through importance sampling (IS) can improve efficiency but introduce considerable instability. Hence, algorithms such as PPO and GRPO widely adopt IS-ratio clipping to stabilize training. However, training stability and gradient estimate are mainly determined by the product of IS ratio and advantage. To further stabilize training, we propose ACPO, which clips the product of the IS ratio and the advantage, leading to more stable gradient estimates. We also establish a connection between ACPO and gradient clipping in policy mirror descent (PMD), which is a standard technique to stabilize optimization process, and prove the convergence of clipped-PMD under the standard RL setting. Experiments on widely used mathematical reasoning benchmarks show that ACPO consistently outperforms PPO and GRPO in both accuracy and training efficiency, delivering 4-6 percentage points gains on standard math benchmarks, with Qwen3-8B+PPO. Hence, ACPO is a practical and effective alternative to conventional IS-ratio clipping for RL post-training of LLMs.

AI.tldr: 提出ACPO算法，通过裁剪重要性采样比率与优势函数的乘积来稳定LLM强化学习训练，并与策略镜像下降的梯度裁剪建立理论联系，实验上在数学推理基准上稳定超越PPO和GRPO。
AI.motivation: 强化学习已成为提升大语言模型推理能力的关键手段，但依赖同策略数据严重限制训练效率；重用异策略数据虽可通过重要性采样提升效率，却会引入显著的不稳定性。PPO、GRPO等采用IS比率裁剪来稳定训练，然而训练稳定性与梯度估计主要由IS比率与优势的乘积决定，仅裁剪比率本身存在局限。
AI.method: 提出ACPO算法，直接裁剪IS比率与优势函数的乘积，从而获得更稳定的梯度估计；并建立ACPO与策略镜像下降（PMD）中梯度裁剪之间的联系，在标准RL设定下证明裁剪版PMD的收敛性。
AI.result: 在广泛使用的数学推理基准上，ACPO在准确率与训练效率上均持续优于PPO和GRPO，在标准数学基准上以Qwen3-8B+PPO取得4-6个百分点的提升。
AI.conclusion: ACPO是LLM强化学习后训练中替代传统IS比率裁剪的实用且有效的方案，兼具理论支撑与实证优势。

title: CorrGRPO: Correlation-Normalized GRPO for Multi-Reward Learning
summary: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) is widely used to train reasoning language models, where it computes advantages by centering and normalizing rewards across rollouts of the same prompt. For multiple rewards, GRPO sums the reward components and normalizes the total reward by its within-group standard deviation. The corresponding variance equals the sum of all pairwise reward covariances. For a fixed centered reward, larger aggregate covariance produces smaller advantages, and vice versa, allowing update magnitudes to adapt to reward dependence. However, correlated rewards with large scales can dominate this normalization and suppress signals from smaller-scale rewards. We propose Correlation-Normalized GRPO (CorrGRPO), which normalizes pairwise covariances into Pearson correlation coefficients. CorrGRPO keeps the centered total reward unchanged while balancing the influence of differently scaled rewards on the correlation-based normalization. This allows advantage magnitudes to adapt to reward correlations without the normalization being dominated by large-scale reward components. We compare CorrGRPO with GRPO and other variants on code generation, tool calling, and agent security, using models ranging from 0.5B to 8B parameters. These tasks all involve multiple rewards that can improve together or present tradeoffs. Results show improvements across three domains, including code generation, tool calling, and agent security. Our code is available at https://github.com/HKUST-KnowComp/CorrGRPO.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CorrGRPO，将 GRPO 多奖励归一化中的成对协方差转换为皮尔逊相关系数，避免大尺度奖励主导归一化，从而更合理地调节优势幅度。在代码生成、工具调用和智能体安全三类多奖励任务上（0.5B–8B 模型）均取得提升。
AI.motivation: GRPO 在多奖励场景下将各奖励分量求和后用组内标准差归一化，其方差等于所有成对奖励协方差之和。这虽能让更新幅度适应奖励相关性，但尺度较大的相关奖励会主导归一化，压制小尺度奖励的信号。
AI.method: 提出 Correlation-Normalized GRPO（CorrGRPO）：将成对协方差归一化为皮尔逊相关系数，保持中心化后的总奖励不变，同时平衡不同尺度奖励对基于相关性的归一化的影响。
AI.result: 在代码生成、工具调用和智能体安全三个领域的多种多奖励任务上，使用 0.5B 至 8B 参数的模型，CorrGRPO 相较 GRPO 及其他变体均取得改进。
AI.conclusion: CorrGRPO 使优势幅度能够适应奖励相关性，同时避免归一化被大尺度奖励分量主导，在多奖励推理训练场景中有效优于 GRPO 及其变体。

title: RolloutFaith: Auditing Persistent Internal Interventions in Visual World Model
summary: Interpretability methods such as probes, activation patches and learned editors are designed to reveal or modify a model's current computation. World models pose a harder requirement: because their predictions become inputs to later predictions, a useful internal correction must survive after editing stops. We therefore propose RolloutFaith, a framework that measures semantic improvement both in the prediction produced at intervention time and over later autonomous predictions under fixed events, actions, noise, and information budgets. We evaluate ten fitted editors on three world models across Crafter, Cartpole, and CoinRun. We also use Reference Activation Patching, which replaces a model activation with the paired activation computed from the real observation, to measure the correction available at the chosen interface. This reference intervention improves later predictions in all nine model and task combinations and outperforms the best fitted editor in eight, yet its sustained gain decreases with horizon in five of nine combinations. Current fitted editors recover only limited and inconsistent long term effects. By restoring individual state components to their untouched values, we find that persistent effects travel through the newest generated frame in DIAMOND, recurrent memory in DreamerV3, and both in STORM. These findings suggest that training should reward future consequences. To test this hypothesis, we propose Delayed LoReFT, which optimizes the same low rank intervention through four frozen future transitions and improves sustained intervention effects to some extent.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 RolloutFaith 框架，用于衡量世界模型内部干预在编辑停止后能否持续影响后续自主预测，并据此分析十种编辑器与参考激活修补，进而提出 Delayed LoReFT 以训练具有长远效应的干预。
AI.motivation: 世界模型的预测会成为后续预测的输入，因此有效干预必须在编辑结束后仍能持续。而现有可解释性方法（探针、激活修补、学习型编辑器）多只关注当前计算，缺乏对长期持续效应的评估与训练机制。
AI.method: 提出 RolloutFaith 框架：在固定事件、动作、噪声与信息预算下，同时衡量干预时刻预测的语义改进与后续自主预测的持续改进。在 Crafter、Cartpole、CoinRun 三个任务、三个世界模型上评估十种拟合编辑器，并使用 Reference Activation Patching（用真实观测计算的配对激活替换模型激活）度量所选接口可用到的修正量；进一步通过将单个状态分量恢复到未干预值来定位持续效应的传播路径；据此提出 Delayed LoReFT，在四个冻结的未来转移动上优化同一低秩干预。
AI.result: 参考干预在全部九种模型-任务组合中均改善后续预测，并在八种中优于最佳拟合编辑器；但其持续增益在九种组合中的五种随预测时域延长而下降。现有拟合编辑器仅能恢复有限且不一致的长期效应。持续效应在 DIAMOND 中经由最新生成帧传播，在 DreamerV3 中经由循环记忆传播，在 STORM 中二者兼有。Delayed LoReFT 在一定程度上提升了持续干预效果。
AI.conclusion: 评估世界模型干预应关注其跨自主预测的持续性；持续效应依赖具体架构中的特定状态通道（生成帧、循环记忆或二者）。训练目标应奖励未来后果，Delayed LoReFT 验证了该假设的初步可行性，但仍未完全解决长期持续性问题。

title: An Effective, Reliable, and Robust Framework for Human Activity Recognition Using Wearable Sensors
summary: Human Activity Recognition (HAR) through wearable sensors greatly improves the quality of human life through its multiple applications. For HAR, multi-sensor channel information is vital for optimal performance. Current work states that applying an attention neural network to prioritize discriminatory sensor channels helps the model classify activity more precisely. However, obtaining discriminatory information from multisensory channels is not always trivial, such as when collecting data from older hospitalized patients. In this context, existing HAR methods struggle to classify activities, particularly activities with similar natures. Moreover, HAR models predominantly suffer from overfitting due to the small size of available datasets, which leads to poor performance. Data augmentation (DA) is a viable solution to this problem. However, available DA methods have various drawbacks, including the possibility of being domain-dependent, resulting in distorted models for test sequences. To address these HAR problems, we propose a novel framework, ALAE-TAE-CutMix+, which focuses on two aspects. First, it enhances the latent information across each sensor channel and learns to exploit the relation among multiple latent features and the ongoing activity. Consequently, the discriminatory feature representations of each activity is enriched. Second, a new augmentation strategy is introduced to address the shortcomings of existing multi-sensor channel data augmentation. We then extend the framework to create a further enhanced version, namely ALAE-CIE-TAE-CutMix+, which learns to capture the interactions between the features of each pair of sensor channels. We find that although the first framework performs slightly better than the latter, the latter is nonetheless more reliable and robust. Both frameworks significantly outperform SOTA approaches on the four HAR datasets from diverse domains.

AI.tldr: 该文提出ALAE-TAE-CutMix+及扩展版ALAE-CIE-TAE-CutMix+框架，通过增强多传感器通道潜在信息、建模通道间关系并引入新的数据增强策略，解决HAR中小样本过拟合与相似活动难分类问题，在四个跨域HAR数据集上显著优于SOTA。
AI.motivation: HAR中多传感器通道信息对性能至关重要，注意力机制虽可优先选择判别性通道，但在老年住院患者等场景下难以获取有效判别信息；同时数据集规模小导致过拟合，现有数据增强方法存在领域依赖、对测试序列产生失真模型等缺陷。
AI.method: 提出ALAE-TAE-CutMix+框架，一方面增强各传感器通道的潜在信息并学习多个潜在特征与当前活动的关系，丰富活动的判别性特征表示；另一方面引入新的增强策略以克服现有多传感器通道数据增强的不足。进一步扩展为ALAE-CIE-TAE-CutMix+，学习捕获每对传感器通道特征之间的交互。
AI.result: 第一个框架性能略优于后者，但后者更可靠、更鲁棒；两个框架在来自不同领域的四个HAR数据集上均显著优于SOTA方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过增强通道潜在信息、建模通道间关系并结合新数据增强策略，可有效缓解HAR小样本过拟合与相似活动分类难题，ALAE-CIE-TAE-CutMix+在鲁棒性与可靠性上更具优势。

title: Markovian Nonconvex ADMM for Reinforcement Learning: Bellman-Resolvent Stability Beyond Smooth Blocks
summary: We identify and study a structural mechanism for Markovian nonconvex ADMM in reinforcement learning. Using finite discounted MDPs as a canonical proving ground, we show that the discounted Bellman resolvent $(I-γP_π)^{-1}$ can provide the multiplier stability that classical nonconvex ADMM analyses often obtain from a designated smooth block. Starting from this mechanism, we establish convergence under controlled Markov sampling and then under stochastic observations using an empirical Bellman surrogate that jointly represents the random residual and its Jacobian. Markov mixing, initialization drift, observation noise, and decaying bias enter as one operator perturbation, avoiding unbiased product and double sampling requirements. When the perturbations are square summable, the true KKT residual converges almost surely to zero. Under a finite conditional fourth moment condition, a companion iterate satisfies $ \mathbb{E}[\widetilde G_{K+1}] \le A/T+(B/T)\sum_{k<T}m_k^{-1}, $ which becomes $O(T^{-1}+T/N)$ for total Markov sample budget $N$, giving $O(ε^{-1})$ iteration complexity and $O(ε^{-2})$ sample complexity for squared KKT accuracy $ε$. Beyond stationarity, discounted occupancy coverage yields $J^\star-J(π)=O(\sqrt G)$ for direct tabular policies, so covered exact KKT points are globally optimal, while a statewise quadratic Bellman-improvement condition sharpens the relation to $O(G)$. Finally, nonlinear policy, projected Bellman, and explicit occupancy formulations exhibit the same chain of operator invertibility, dual representation, and multiplier stability. This supports discounted operator invertibility as a reusable structural principle for primal-dual reinforcement learning.

AI.tldr: 该文揭示了折扣MDP中Bellman预解算子(I-γP_π)^{-1}为Markov非凸ADMM提供乘子稳定性，从而在Markov采样与随机观测下建立KKT残差几乎必然收敛、迭代复杂度O(ε^{-1})与样本复杂度O(ε^{-2})，并给出KKT点全局最优性条件。
AI.motivation: 经典非凸ADMM分析通常依赖某个专门的光滑块来保证乘子稳定性，这种结构假设在强化学习场景中并不自然。作者希望在折扣有限MDP这一典型设定下，寻找一种内生于Bellman算子的结构性机制来替代该假设，从而把非凸ADMM的收敛理论扩展到带有Markov采样、观测噪声和策略梯度式参数化的强化学习问题中。
AI.method: 以有限折扣MDP为证明平台，指出折扣Bellman预解算子(I-γP_π)^{-1}可充当乘子稳定性的来源。先在有控Markov采样下建立收敛，再引入经验Bellman代理量（同时表示随机残差及其Jacobian）处理随机观测；将Markov混合、初始化漂移、观测噪声与衰减偏置统一为单个算子扰动，从而避免无偏乘积与双采样要求。进一步分析非平稳性之外的全局最优性，使用折扣占用覆盖与状态逐点二次Bellman改进条件，并将框架推广到非线性策略、投影Bellman与显式占用形式。
AI.result: 当扰动平方可和时，真实KKT残差几乎必然收敛到零。在有限条件四阶矩假设下，伴随迭代满足 E[G̃_{K+1}] ≤ A/T + (B/T)Σ_{k<T} m_k^{-1}；对总Markov样本预算N，该界为O(T^{-1}+T/N)，对应平方KKT精度ε的迭代复杂度O(ε^{-1})与样本复杂度O(ε^{-2})。此外，折扣占用覆盖给出表格策略的J^★-J(π)=O(√G)，故被覆盖的精确KKT点全局最优；状态逐点二次Bellman改进条件将该关系强化为O(G)。非线性策略、投影Bellman与显式占用形式呈现相同的算子可逆性—对偶表示—乘子稳定性链条。
AI.conclusion: 折扣算子可逆性可作为primal-dual强化学习中可复用的结构性原理：它既为非凸ADMM提供乘子稳定性，又统一处理Markov采样与随机观测，并连接收敛速率与全局最优性。该机制在多种策略与Bellman形式下具有一致性，具备推广价值。

title: Where the Model Changes Its Mind: Hindsight-Divergence Localization for Efficient Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards
summary: Group-relative methods for reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) learn from differences in rollout outcomes. Independently sampling complete trajectories is costly and does not explicitly explore the decision space at critical positions. Feedback on a completed trajectory can reveal which earlier choices the policy reconsiders, suggesting where to sample alternative continuations. We introduce Hindsight-Divergence Localization (HDL), which uses hindsight-induced changes in token log-likelihoods to select branch points. HDL generates a small number of complete root trajectories and fills each training group with continuations from the selected positions under the original task context. Each continuation reuses its root prefix and contributes policy updates only through its newly generated suffix, reducing generation cost while focusing additional exploration and learning on decisions after branching. Experiments with three models across math, code, and agent tasks show gains in both rollout efficiency and task performance. Compared with GRPO at matched group sizes and training steps, HDL yields up to a 2.5$\times$ reduction in generated tokens and a 1.8$\times$ speedup in rollout wall-clock time. Despite this reduced generation budget, HDL improves performance across all three domains, with gains of up to 12.5 points on agent tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出Hindsight-Divergence Localization (HDL)方法，利用后见之明引起的token对数似然变化定位分支点，用少量根轨迹的分支续写填充训练组，在降低生成成本的同时提升RLVR性能。
AI.motivation: 组相对方法（如GRPO）依赖rollout结果差异学习，但独立采样完整轨迹成本高昂，且未在关键决策位置显式探索决策空间；完整轨迹的反馈可揭示策略会重新考虑哪些早期选择，从而指示应采样的替代续写位置。
AI.method: HDL通过后见之明引起的token对数似然变化选择分支点；生成少量完整根轨迹，并在原始任务上下文下从选定位置续写以填充每个训练组；每条续写复用其根前缀，仅通过新生成的续写后缀贡献策略更新。
AI.result: 在数学、代码和智能体任务上使用三个模型实验：与GRPO在相同组大小和训练步数下相比，HDL最多减少2.5倍生成token，rollout墙钟时间加速1.8倍；尽管生成预算降低，但三个领域性能均提升，智能体任务提升最高达12.5分。
AI.conclusion: HDL通过分支续写将额外探索与学习聚焦于关键决策之后的步骤，在显著降低生成成本的同时提升rollout效率与任务性能，验证了后见之明似然变化定位分支点的有效性。

title: Seeing Time: Visual-Temporal Representation Learning for Interpretable Time Series Clustering
summary: Multivariate Time Series (MTS) clustering is an important tool in temporal data mining, aiming to discover latent group structures from complex observations without supervision. Although existing deep clustering methods can learn discriminative temporal representations, the resulting latent clusters are often difficult to relate back to waveform characteristics that practitioners can directly inspect and compare, limiting their ability to assess whether the discovered patterns reflect meaningful temporal behaviors. This paper, therefore, proposes WAVE (Waveform Aligned Visual-temporal Embedding), which treats time series and their deterministically rendered waveform plots as complementary views of the same observations. To produce discriminative representations whose cluster structures can be traced to observable waveform characteristics, WAVE aligns and integrates fine-grained temporal variations with holistic visual patterns, while associating each discovered cluster with its centroid-nearest authentic sample. Accordingly, interpretability in this work specifically refers to waveform-level traceability rather than a general explanation of model decisions. Extensive evaluations across 10 real-world public datasets show that WAVE achieves the highest macro-averaged clustering performance and the best average rank among the compared methods, while qualitative case studies illustrate how the discovered clusters can be inspected through authentic waveform records. The source code is available at https://github.com/Zheng-Zhu1/WAVE.

AI.tldr: 提出WAVE方法，将时间序列与其确定性渲染的波形图视为同一观测的互补视图，通过对齐细粒度时序变化与整体视觉模式实现可溯源至波形特征的多变量时间序列聚类。
AI.motivation: 现有多变量时间序列（MTS）深度聚类虽能学习判别性时序表示，但潜在簇难以对应到从业者可直接检查比较的波形特征，导致无法评估所发现模式是否反映有意义的时序行为。
AI.method: WAVE（Waveform Aligned Visual-temporal Embedding）将时间序列与其确定性渲染的波形图作为互补视图，对齐并融合细粒度时序变化与整体视觉模式，并将每个发现的簇与距其质心最近的真实样本关联。本文的可解释性特指波形级可溯源性，而非一般意义上的模型决策解释。
AI.result: 在10个真实公开数据集上的大量实验表明，WAVE取得最高的宏平均聚类性能与最佳平均排名，定性案例研究展示所发现簇可通过真实波形记录进行检查。
AI.conclusion: WAVE通过视觉-时序互补对齐实现了高聚类性能与波形级可溯源的聚类结果，代码已开源。

title: What You Observe Determines How You Identify Causal Effects: Evaluating Causal Models across Observational Views
summary: Causal foundation models (CFMs) pre-trained on data generated from various structural causal models (SCMs) have been proposed for estimating causal effects from observational data. However, differences in pre-training environments and evaluation protocols make it difficult to assess how their performance depends on the information available for causal identification. To enable controlled comparisons, we introduce CausalIDView, a multi-view benchmark that holds fixed SCM realization and target estimand while varying only the observational view available to the estimator. Each observational view corresponds to a distinct identification regime under the benchmark's maintained causal assumptions. Across these matched views, no CFM consistently performs best and model rankings vary substantially. Under controlled structural changes, CFMs exhibit model-specific failures to maintain stable estimates when true effects are unchanged and to track genuine effect changes. We also examine whether combining explicit identification with strong predictive estimation is effective. A modular approach that pairs a predictive tabular foundation model with regime-specific identification procedures is competitive with CFMs and outperforms several of them. These findings motivate cross-regime comparisons to assess the empirical value of CFMs.

AI.tldr: 提出 CausalIDView 多视图基准，固定 SCM 与目标估计量、仅变化可观测视图，对照评估因果基础模型的识别能力，发现无模型稳定最优、排名随视图与结构变化波动，模块化"预测+识别"方法可与 CFM 竞争。
AI.motivation: 因果基础模型（CFMs）虽已在多种 SCM 生成的数据上预训练用于观测数据因果效应估计，但预训练环境与评估协议不一致，导致无法判断其性能如何依赖因果识别所需的信息，缺乏可控对比条件，因此需要可固定 SCM 实现与目标估计量、仅改变可观测视图的基准。
AI.method: 构建 CausalIDView 多视图基准：在保持 SCM 实现与目标估计量不变的前提下，仅改变估计器可获得的观测视图；每个观测视图对应基准所维持因果假设下的一个不同识别机制；在此基础上进行跨视图匹配比较、受控结构变化测试，并评估将显式识别与强预测估计相结合的模块化方法（预测性表格基础模型 + 各机制专用识别流程）。
AI.result: 在匹配视图之间，没有任何 CFM 始终表现最佳，模型排名波动显著；在受控结构变化下，CFM 出现模型特有的失效：真实效应不变时估计不稳定，真实效应变化时又无法追踪；模块化方法（预测表格基础模型 + 机制专用识别）与 CFM 竞争力相当，并优于其中若干模型。
AI.conclusion: 应开展跨识别机制的对比评估，以衡量 CFM 的经验价值；仅凭单一视图或单一协议不足以评判因果基础模型的识别能力与稳健性。

title: Architecture Alignment With Sparse Priors in Tabular Foundation Models
summary: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) are increasingly popular because they deliver strong predictions on new datasets through in-context learning, without task-specific training or extensive tuning. Yet released TFMs differ simultaneously in their pretraining priors, architectures, and objectives, obscuring their respective inductive biases. We therefore examine one concrete capability: irrelevant-feature suppression. Across synthetic tasks and real-world datasets, adding null features causes substantially greater predictive degradation in the row-token model TabDPT, whereas the cell-token alternating-axis model TabPFN v2 and other TFMs remain comparatively stable. This gap motivates us to ask whether architecture contributes to irrelevant-feature suppression. Because released TFMs remain confounded by other design choices, we train streamlined row-token and alternating-axis transformers under identical sparse-to-dense linear priors.
