Exact Bayes analysis shows that sparse prediction requires context-dependent feature gating, whereas the dense endpoint requires only uniform feature weighting. Consistent with this distinction, the alternating-axis model is substantially closer to the Bayesian optimal predictor on sparse tasks, while the architecture gap becomes negligible on dense tasks; almost all of the sparse gap arises from linear coefficient-estimation error. Finally, in both the controlled model and frozen TabPFN v2, we examine the effect of interventions on the feature-attention outputs on the linear coefficients, finding evidence of task-dependent selective routing of computation through feature-indexed pathways. Together, these results support architecture-prior alignment: preserving an addressable feature axis provides an inductive bias for task-adaptive relevance inference. Code is available at https://github.com/Tianqi-Zhao/ArchitecturePriorTFMs.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了行标记模型与交替轴（cell-token）模型在"无关特征抑制"上的差异，发现交替轴架构因保留可寻址特征轴，更接近稀疏任务下的贝叶斯最优预测器，支持"架构-先验对齐"假设。
AI.motivation: 已发布的表格基础模型（TFM）在预训练先验、架构和目标上各不相同，其归纳偏置被混淆，难以厘清架构本身对特定能力的贡献。作者选取"无关特征抑制"这一具体能力切入，探究架构是否在其中起作用。
AI.method: 1）在合成任务和真实数据集上对比TabDPT（行标记模型）与TabPFN v2（cell-token交替轴模型）等TFM加入null特征后的性能退化；2）在相同的稀疏到稠密线性先验下，训练简化的行标记与交替轴Transformer，剥离其他设计选择；3）进行精确贝叶斯分析，推导稀疏与稠密端点下的最优预测器；4）在受控模型和冻结的TabPFN v2中干预特征注意力输出，观察其对线性系数的影响。
AI.result: 加入null特征后，TabDPT的预测退化明显大于TabPFN v2等模型；受控实验中交替轴模型在稀疏任务上显著更接近贝叶斯最优预测器，而在稠密任务上架构差距可忽略；稀疏差距几乎全部来自线性系数估计误差；干预实验显示特征注意力输出对线性系数存在任务依赖的选择性路由，即通过特征索引路径的计算分发。
AI.conclusion: 架构与先验的对齐很重要：保留可寻址的特征轴为任务自适应的相关性推断提供了归纳偏置，从而支持无关特征抑制。

title: SINO: Scale-Invariant Neural Operator
summary: In scientific machine learning, physical fields governed by partial differential equations exhibit low-rank structure and scale invariance. When solving equations on coarse grids, missing information leads to the closure problem: modeling unresolved physics to recover lost dynamics. Although closure terms depend on grid resolution, they represent scale-invariant physical laws. A model truly learning physics should capture these mechanisms with low-rank parameterization rather than memorizing grid-specific patterns. Inspired by this, we propose the Scale-Invariant Neural Operator (SINO), which learns on normalized physical scales via a dual-branch architecture operating in spectral and spatial domains. SINO uses bottleneck MLPs to generate continuous convolution kernels, embedding an explicit low-rank inductive bias that concentrates more than 95 percent of variance in 2-3 modes, as validated by PCA across benchmarks, while drastically reducing parameters. This principled design yields 38 times steeper scaling law exponents than FNO, demonstrating superior parameter efficiency. We compare SINO with traditional models (U-Net, DeepONet), Transformer models (Transolver, Oformer, GK-Transformer), and frequency-domain models (FNO, AMFNO, UFNO) on closure problems spanning externally forced Burgers turbulence, decaying Burgers turbulence, KS turbulence, Kolmogorov-forced NS turbulence, and decaying NS turbulence. Experiments show SINO achieves 1.5-38 times error reduction and 2-23 times parameter efficiency over baselines, with superior scaling laws reflecting exceptional data efficiency from principled low-rank design. Code is available at https://github.com/AI4Science-WestlakeU/SINO.

AI.tldr: 提出尺度不变神经算子SINO，通过双分支谱-空间架构与瓶颈MLP生成连续卷积核，嵌入低秩归纳偏置，在多个闭合问题上实现显著误差与参数效率提升。
AI.motivation: 科学机器学习中PDE物理场具有低秩结构和平移/尺度不变性，但粗网格求解存在闭合问题。闭合项虽依赖网格分辨率，却表征尺度不变的物理规律，真正学习物理的模型应通过低秩参数化捕捉机制而非记忆特定网格模式。
AI.method: SINO在归一化物理尺度上学习，采用谱域与空间域双分支架构；利用瓶颈MLP生成连续卷积核，显式嵌入低秩归纳偏置（PCA验证2-3个模态承载95%以上方差），大幅减少参数量。
AI.result: 在外部强迫Burgers湍流、衰减Burgers湍流、KS湍流、Kolmogorov强迫NS湍流及衰减NS湍流等闭合问题上，相较U-Net、DeepONet、Transolver、Oformer、GK-Transformer、FNO、AMFNO、UFNO等基线，误差降低1.5-38倍，参数效率提升2-23倍，标度律指数较FNO陡峭38倍。
AI.conclusion: 基于低秩原理设计的SINO具有优越的数据效率与标度律，验证了尺度不变低秩参数化在学习闭合物理机制中的有效性。

title: Variational Mixtures and Multi-Marginal Flow Matching: Advancing Statistical Inference with Biological Applications
summary: In this thesis I develop methods for statistical inference when the distributions arising from complex biological systems are multi-modal, geometrically structured, and sometimes only defined up to a normalizing constant. I start from variational inference and, when analytic update equations are unavailable, move to black-box variational inference. To build intuition regarding inference challenges and the proposed methodologies, I introduce a novel unnormalized target density (the CoLN distribution) and reuse it as a controlled test case in the kappa. I then trace a trajectory of increasingly expressive approximations: ensembles evaluated with the multiple importance sampling ELBO (Paper A) and variational mixtures that automate component cooperation and exploration (Paper B). Because expressivity comes at a cost, I develop efficient mixture learning ideas, including Monte Carlo objective estimators to scale mixture learning more efficiently (Paper C). As a new result in the kappa, I overturn a three decades long misconception regarding the potential performance benefits of using mixtures in variational inference. Finally, I move from variational inference to flow matching, where I address the need for specialized treatment of interpolant learning in multi-marginal settings (Paper D). By combining insights from Papers A-D, I derive in Section 5.5 a new method: multi-marginal flow matching with mixtures of variational interpolants. I connect these methodological developments to biological applications, with special emphasis on three-dimensional spatial transcriptomics, where stacked tissue slices induce multi-modal dynamics across space.

AI.tldr: 本论文围绕复杂生物系统中多模态、几何结构化且仅定义到归一化常数的分布，发展统计推断方法，从变分推断到黑盒变分推断，再到流匹配，涵盖A-D四篇论文并给出新方法。
AI.motivation: 复杂生物系统产生的分布常具有多模态、几何结构化特征，部分仅定义到归一化常数，传统变分推断难以处理，需要更具表达力的近似方法与高效学习策略。
AI.method: 引入新的未归一化目标密度CoLN分布作为受控测试用例；沿近似表达力递进路径推进：用多重重要性采样ELBO评估的集成（论文A）、自动化组件协作与探索的变分混合（论文B）、蒙特卡洛目标估计器提升混合学习效率（论文C）；进而转向流匹配，处理多边际设定下插值学习（论文D）；在5.5节提出多边际流匹配结合变分插值混合。
AI.result: 提出CoLN测试用例；构建从集成到变分混合再到高效混合学习的近似框架；推翻关于混合在变分推断中潜在性能优势的持续三十年误解；给出多边际流匹配与变分插值混合相结合的新方法。
AI.conclusion: 将方法学发展联结到生物应用，特别强调三维空间转录组学，其中堆叠组织切片在空间上诱导多模态动力学。

title: State Transport Routing for Short-horizon Adaptation in Multi-horizon Photovoltaic Forecasting
summary: Recent power measurements provide valuable information for photovoltaic(PV) power forecasting, but directly extrapolating short-term trends can introduce substantial errors over longer forecast horizons. To address this challenge, we propose state transport routing (STR), a lightweight adapter that refines the predictions of a frozen forecasting model. STR combines the original forecast with two complementary trajectories derived from the latest measured power level and its recent trend. A horizon-conditioned router adjusts their contributions over the first 120 min, while leaving subsequent predictions unchanged. Experiments on four public PV datasets show that STR consistently outperforms a parameter-matched residual adapter. On PVDAQ, the same approach improves five neural forecasting backbones, reducing all-horizon normalized mean absolute error by 0.0201-0.2364 percentage points, with paired 95% confidence intervals excluding zero. No reliable improvement is observed for LightGBM. These findings demonstrate the potential of structured state adaptation to improve short-term forecasting across different neural architectures without retraining the underlying models or altering their longer-horizon predictions.

AI.tldr: 提出轻量适配器 STR，用最新实测功率及其趋势修正冻结预测模型的前 120 分钟输出，在四个公开光伏数据集上稳定优于同参量残差适配器。
AI.motivation: 近期功率测量对光伏功率预测有重要价值，但直接外推短期趋势在较长预测时域上会引入显著误差；同时希望在无需重训底层模型的前提下挖掘实测信息。
AI.method: STR 为轻量适配器，作用于冻结的预测模型：将原始预测与两条互补轨迹（基于最新实测功率水平、基于近期趋势）融合，并通过一个以预测时域为条件的路由器在前 120 分钟内动态调整二者权重，其后时域的预测保持不变。
AI.result: 在四个公开光伏数据集上，STR 稳定优于参数量匹配的残差适配器；在 PVDAQ 上，该方法对五种神经预测骨干模型均有提升，全时域归一化平均绝对误差降低 0.0201–0.2364 个百分点，配对 95% 置信区间不含零；对 LightGBM 未观察到可靠提升。
AI.conclusion: 结构化状态适配可在不重训底层模型、不改变长时域预测的情况下，跨不同神经架构改善短期光伏预测，凸显了其实用潜力。

title: Safe-by-Design Learning via Energy-based Neural Networks
summary: Learning neural-network models of dynamical systems with safety guarantees is a fundamental requirement for their deployment in safety-critical settings. Safety is commonly established by proving the invariance of a desired subset in state-space, ensuring that every trajectory initialized in this subset remains confined to it for all time under admissible inputs. Existing frameworks, however, either rely on computationally expensive post-hoc verification or employ safety-enforcing mechanisms without formal correctness guarantees. In this paper, we introduce a novel neural architecture grounded in energy-based modern Hopfield networks to guarantee safety-by-design while retaining sufficient expressiveness to model complex nonlinear dynamics. Specifically, we integrate modern Hopfield networks with a port-Hamiltonian neural ODE, enabling by design the construction of barrier functions yielding explicit admissible-input sets and quantitative robustness radii. Across several benchmarks, including an 12-dimensional nanodrone model, our framework achieves state-of-the-art performance while producing certified invariant sets that are more robust to external solicitations than comparable existing approaches.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种基于能量型现代Hopfield网络与端口-哈密顿神经ODE相结合的神经架构，实现"设计即保证安全"，可构造屏障函数并给出显式容许输入集与定量鲁棒半径，在包括12维纳米无人机模型等基准上达到最优性能且不变集更鲁棒。
AI.motivation: 在安全关键场景部署动力系统神经网络模型时，安全性是基本要求，通常通过证明状态空间中期望子集的不变性来建立。但现有框架要么依赖计算昂贵的后验验证，要么采用强制安全机制却缺乏形式化正确性保证，因此亟需兼顾安全保证与建模表达能力的方法。
AI.method: 提出一种新型神经架构，将现代Hopfield网络（能量型）与端口-哈密顿神经ODE相融合。该架构在设计层面即保证安全性：可由结构直接构造屏障函数，从而给出显式的容许输入集以及定量的鲁棒半径，同时保留对复杂非线性动力学的表达能力。
AI.result: 在多个基准任务上（包括一个12维纳米无人机模型）取得当前最优性能，并且所生成的不变集是经过认证的，对外部扰动的鲁棒性优于可比的现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过将能量型现代Hopfield网络与端口-哈密顿神经ODE结合，实现了"设计即安全"的神经动力学建模，无需昂贵的后验验证即可获得具有形式化保证的认证不变集，兼顾表达力与鲁棒性。

title: Cool the Sampler, Not the Learner: Sampling Temperature Moves the Staleness Cliff of Importance-Corrected GRPO
summary: Production RL for language models lets the sampler fall behind the learner and repairs the resulting mismatch with a truncated importance weight. We ask how long the sampler can go without a refresh under that correction, and find a cliff: on Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B and GSM8K, importance-corrected GRPO refreshed every 192 updates learns well for 180 steps and then degrades severely in all three data seeds before the refresh arrives. Published remedies for staleness act on the update; we act on the sampler instead. Decoupled cooling draws samples at temperature 0.8 while the learner, the reference model and the importance weights stay at temperature 1, with the behaviour probability recorded from the tempered distribution, so the learner's objective is unchanged. All corresponding cooled runs are stable, and the longer interval keeps what the short one delivered: at the same update budget, a cooled sampler refreshed every 192 steps matches an uncooled sampler refreshed every 96 at the end of training (0.857 for both) and averaged over it (0.79), whereas lowering the learning rate to a safe value ends 3-7 points lower. On Qwen2.5-Math-7B the degradation points at interval 192 predict that an interval of 144 is fatal without cooling and survivable with it; on two data seeds the uncooled runs degrade before their first refresh and the cooled runs pass it and end at 92-93% against 68-81%, with one cooled run degrading transiently late in the second cycle. The benefit has a window: at three times the safe interval and in a high-mismatch MATH setting cooling delays degradation without preventing it, stronger cooling is not better, and cooling without the correction collapses. Sampling temperature is a control on staleness tolerance, and temperature and refresh interval should be chosen together.

AI.tldr: 在重要性加权（截断）校正下研究采样器"过期"容忍度，发现存在性能断崖；提出"解耦冷却"（采样温度0.8，学习器/参考模型/重要性权重保持温度1，并从退火分布记录行为概率），在不改变学习目标的前提下大幅提升对刷新间隔的容忍度，并指出采样温度与刷新间隔应联合选择。
AI.motivation: 生产环境中的语言模型强化学习（RL）通常使采样器落后于学习器（异步/采样器滞后），并依赖截断重要性权重修复由此产生的分布失配。作者想回答：在这种校正下，采样器可以多久不刷新？已有针对"陈旧性（staleness）"的方法都作用于更新侧（如权重裁剪、学习率调整），而未考虑直接控制采样器本身。
AI.method: 提出"解耦冷却（Decoupled Cooling）"：采样时使用温度0.8，而学习器、参考模型与重要性权重仍保持在温度1，行为概率从退火（tempered）分布中记录，因此学习器目标函数保持不变。对比实验包括：重要性校正的GRPO，刷新间隔（192 vs 96）与冷却/不冷却组合；并在Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B（GSM8K）与Qwen2.5-Math-7B上验证，含多数据种子与多个刷新间隔（144、192及其三倍）。对照方法为降低学习率至安全值。
AI.result: 1.5B/GSM8K上，未冷却GRPO每192步刷新：稳定学习180步后在三个数据种子中均严重退化；所有冷却运行均稳定。相同更新预算下，冷却+192步刷新与未冷却+96步刷新最终成绩持平（均为0.857），平均成绩为0.79，而降低学习率则低3-7个点。7B上，192区间的退化点预测144区间"未冷却致命、冷却可存活"；两个数据种子中未冷却运行在首次刷新前即退化，冷却运行通过该点并以92-93%对68-81%收尾（其中一个冷却运行在第二周期后段出现短暂瞬时退化）。收益存在窗口：在三倍安全间隔及高失配的MATH设定下，冷却仅延迟而非阻止退化；更强冷却无益；无校正的冷却会崩溃。
AI.conclusion: 采样温度是控制陈旧性容忍度的有效手段：解耦冷却在不改变学习目标的情况下显著延长可接受的刷新间隔，并保持与更短间隔相当的最终与平均性能。温度与刷新间隔应联合调优，冷却存在适用窗口（超过约三倍安全间隔或高失配场景下仅延迟退化，且更强冷却并非更好、脱离重要性校正则不成立）。

title: VStress: Correlation-Aware Auditing and Adaptive Budget Allocation for Repeated Verifiers
summary: Repeated verifier calls are useful only when they contribute conditional information. We introduce VStress, an auditable replay contract, and VStress-CA, a correlation-aware allocation policy that estimates the conditional marginal information of an unqueried verifier on a sealed calibration split, discounts uncertainty, normalizes by call cost, and stops or abstains when the next call is not informative. The controller freezes its decision and cost ledger before joining the clean oracle; a dependence-shift alarm disables channel preference and falls back to exact-stop. The controlled audit gives the mechanism boundary: at 35% symmetric corruption, majority-5 improves balanced accuracy from 0.6578 to 0.7739, whereas at 65% it loses 0.1226 points. In the matched fixed-budget comparison, breadth, redundancy, and adaptive allocation obtain balanced accuracies 0.6048, 0.6375, and 0.6538, with 3.4216 calls per item and an RLVR score of 0.6417 for VStress-CA. Dependence diagnostics also increase from same-model repeats to cross-family channels, with conditional marginal gains of 0.0126, 0.0462, and 0.0913. These measurements turn correlation from a post-hoc warning into an auditable allocation decision.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 VStress 可审计重放合约与 VStress-CA 相关性感知分配策略，通过估计未查询验证器在密封校准集上的条件边际信息并进行不确定性折扣，实现自适应验证器调用，并将相关性从后验警告转变为可审计的分配决策。
AI.motivation: 重复调用验证器只有在提供条件信息时才有价值。然而现有做法往往忽视验证器之间的相关性，导致冗余调用浪费预算，且事后相关性诊断无法指导分配决策。
AI.method: 提出 VStress 可审计重放合约与 VStress-CA 相关性感知分配策略：在密封校准划分上估计未查询验证器的条件边际信息，对不确定性进行折扣，按调用成本归一化，并在下一次调用无信息量时停止或弃权。控制器在接入干净 oracle 前冻结决策与成本账本；依赖偏移告警会禁用通道偏好并回退到精确停止。
AI.result: 受控审计给出机制边界：在 35% 对称污染下，majority-5 将平衡准确率从 0.6578 提升至 0.7739；而在 65% 下损失 0.1226 个点。在匹配固定预算对比中，广度、冗余与自适应分配分别取得 0.6048、0.6375、0.6538 的平衡准确率，每项调用 3.4216 次，VStress-CA 的 RLVR 得分为 0.6417。依赖诊断从同模型重复到跨家族通道递增，条件边际增益分别为 0.0126、0.0462、0.0913。
AI.conclusion: 这些测量将相关性从后验警告转变为可审计的分配决策，证明了条件边际信息驱动的验证器分配在受控审计边界内能提升平衡准确率与预算效率。

title: JudgeCast: Time Series Forecasting with Experience-Informed Covariate Judgements
summary: Covariate effects vary across contexts and shift over time, requiring forecasters to assess how to use them for each forecasting context. As forecasting proceeds, observations for earlier forecasts become available, providing feedback on past covariate use for subsequent forecasts. However, when multiple covariates act together, the forecast error reveals the numerical discrepancy from the observation but not how the covariates should have been used. We introduce JudgeCast, an experience-based framework for time series forecasting with covariates. Following the judgmental adjustment practice, a frozen TSFM provides the base forecast, while a frozen LLM uses the current context and relevant experience to adjust it. Within the adjustment, assessing covariate effects and determining the numerical adjustment serve distinct roles, so JudgeCast first forms explicit covariate-wise judgments and then determines the adjustment. After observation, JudgeCast uses the observed residual of the base forecast to reconstruct alternative judgments and evaluates the original and alternatives through their resulting adjustments. The best-performing decision is selected and retained as validated experience for subsequent forecasts. Across diverse real-world datasets, JudgeCast outperforms strong baselines. Ablations show that explicit covariate-wise judgment can improve forecast-time adjustment, while residual-guided experience construction yields more reliable forecasting gains than retaining raw decisions as experience.

AI.tldr: JudgeCast是一个基于经验的时间序列预测框架：冻结的TSFM给出基础预测，冻结的LLM结合上下文与经验进行调整，并通过观测残差重构协变量判断、评估并保留最优决策作为经验，在多个真实数据集上优于强基线。
AI.motivation: 协变量效应随情境变化且随时间漂移，预测者需针对每个预测情境评估如何使用协变量。随着预测推进，早期预测的观测值可作为反馈，但多个协变量共同作用时，预测误差只反映与观测的数值偏差，无法揭示协变量应如何被使用，因此需要一种能利用反馈经验、显式处理协变量效应的预测方法。
AI.method: 采用基于经验的框架JudgeCast：沿用判断性调整范式，冻结的TSFM生成基础预测，冻结的LLM利用当前上下文与相关经验进行调整。由于评估协变量效应与确定数值调整是两种不同角色，该框架先形成显式的、按协变量逐一给出的判断，再确定调整量。观测到真实值后，用基础预测的观测残差重构备选判断，并通过其产生的调整效果评估原始与备选判断，选取表现最佳的决策作为经过验证的经验保留，供后续预测使用。
AI.result: 在多个多样的真实世界数据集上，JudgeCast优于强基线。消融实验表明：显式的协变量维度判断能改善预测时的调整；相比把原始决策直接作为经验保留，由残差引导构建经验能带来更可靠的预测增益。
AI.conclusion: 将协变量效应评估与数值调整显式解耦，并以观测残差为指导重构和验证经验，是一种有效利用反馈、提升带协变量时间序列预测性能的途径。

title: TaskBridge: Bridging Unsupervised Tabular Anomaly Detection and In-Context Learning via Virtual Tasks
summary: Unsupervised tabular anomaly detection (TAD) aims to identify anomalous rows in tabular data using normal training samples. While conventional methods rely on dataset-specific training and configuration search, recent tabular foundation models (TFMs) enable zero-shot anomaly detection on unseen datasets via in-context learning. Most TFM-based approaches, however, require anomaly-specific pretraining from scratch, making detection inherently dependent on synthetic TAD-specific priors and costly to update. Some approaches instead repurpose pretrained general-purpose TFMs for TAD to avoid this burden, but rely on computationally expensive formulations with restrictive anomaly inductive biases. In this work, we introduce TaskBridge, a new framework that efficiently repurposes pretrained general-purpose TFMs for unsupervised TAD by constructing virtual supervised tasks that directly recast anomaly detection as supervised in-context inference of TFMs. The resulting virtual tasks induce predictive structures under which normal queries and their target pairs receive high support, whereas anomalies tend to violate the induced structures and receive lower support, providing direct anomaly evidence. Across 790 real-world datasets, TaskBridge consistently outperforms 30 baselines, including state-of-the-art TFM-based approaches, without anomaly-specific TFM pretraining or dataset-specific model optimization.

AI.tldr: 提出 TaskBridge 框架，无需异常专用预训练或数据集级优化，通过构造虚拟监督任务复用通用表格基础模型（TFM）实现无监督表格异常检测（TAD），在 790 个真实数据集上超越 30 个基线。
AI.motivation: 现有 TFM 类 TAD 方法多需从零进行异常专用预训练，检测能力依赖合成 TAD 先验且更新成本高；另一类复用通用预训练 TFM 的方法则依赖计算昂贵的范式并带有受限的异常归纳偏置。作者希望以高效、无需 TAD 专用预训练的方式复用通用 TFM。
AI.method: TaskBridge 通过构造虚拟监督任务，将异常检测直接重铸为 TFM 的监督式上下文学习（in-context learning）推理。该虚拟任务诱导出预测结构：正常查询与其目标配对获得高支持度，异常样本往往违反该结构而获得较低支持度，从而作为直接的异常证据。
AI.result: 在 790 个真实世界数据集上，TaskBridge 稳定优于 30 个基线（含最先进的 TFM 类方法），且无需异常专用 TFM 预训练与数据集专用模型优化。
AI.conclusion: TaskBridge 表明通用预训练 TFM 可通过虚拟监督任务被高效复用，为无监督 TAD 提供免预训练、免调优且泛化性强的可行路径。

title: Equally Good, Yet Different: Benchmarking Rashomon sets in AutoML packages
comment: Accepted to the International Conference on Automated Machine Learning 2026, ABCD Track
summary: The Rashomon effect describes the existence of multiple near-optimal models that achieve comparable performance while offering fundamentally different explanations. This creates a critical vulnerability in AutoML: x-hacking, the selective post-hoc choice of a model based on its explanation rather than predictive merit. No existing AutoML framework exposes this risk. We introduce ARSA ML, an open-source Python framework that quantifies Rashomon set structure and predictive multiplicity within AutoML pipelines. Using ARSA ML, we benchmark AutoGluon and H2O across 28 binary classification datasets, and conduct a post-hoc x-hacking analysis revealing a consistent structural asymmetry: AutoGluon produces larger, diverse sets with stable explanations, while H2O generates compact sets with markedly higher prediction divergence and explanation instability -- making H2O users considerably more exposed to x-hacking. This gap persists across all evaluated metrics and epsilon thresholds, pointing to a fundamental difference in each framework's model-building strategy. ARSA ML is available at https://pypi.org/project/arsa-ml/ .

AI.tldr: 该文提出ARSA ML框架，用于量化AutoML流程中的Rashomon集结构与预测多重性，并揭示x-hacking风险；基准测试显示AutoGluon与H2O存在显著结构不对称，H2O用户更易受x-hacking影响。
AI.motivation: Rashomon效应使多个近似最优模型并存且解释迥异，这催生了x-hacking（基于解释而非预测性能的选择性事后选模）风险；然而现有AutoML框架均未暴露该风险。
AI.method: 作者开发开源Python框架ARSA ML，量化AutoML流程中的Rashomon集结构与预测多重性；在28个二分类数据集上对AutoGluon与H2O进行基准测试，并开展事后x-hacking分析。
AI.result: 发现一致的结构不对称：AutoGluon产生更大、更多样的模型集且解释稳定；H2O生成紧凑模型集但预测分歧与解释不稳定性显著更高，使H2O用户更易受x-hacking影响；该差距在所有评估指标与epsilon阈值下持续存在。
AI.conclusion: 该差距指向两种框架在模型构建策略上的根本差异；ARSA ML为AutoML中Rashomon集与预测多重性的量化提供了开源工具（doi：https://pypi.org/project/arsa-ml/）。

title: Abductive World Modeling via Causal Representation Learning
summary: The central challenge of world modeling is to learn representations that capture how the world evolves. However, existing world models predominantly represent future states without explicitly capturing the latent causes underlying their evolution, limiting their ability to reason about why and how the world changes. To address this limitation, we propose Abductive World Modeling (AWM), a framework that learns structured causal representations by abductively inferring latent causes from predicted futures. Specifically, we realize AWM through the Hierarchical Abductive State Pyramid (HASP), which organizes the inferred world state into three complementary components - Entity, Dynamic, and Relation - capturing what exists, how it changes, and how entities interact, respectively. By jointly reasoning over the current observation and its predicted future, HASP abductively infers these latent factors and integrates them into a structured state representation for downstream reasoning. To the best of our knowledge, AWM is the first framework to introduce abductive state inference into latent-space world modeling for learning structured representations of world dynamics. Experiments across physical prediction, causal reasoning, and action understanding demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach. Compared with V-JEPA, a state-of-the-art latent-space world model, AWM improves physical prediction AUROC by 10.7%, causal reasoning accuracy by 16.8%, and action Top-1 accuracy by 68.0%.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出溯因世界模型（AWM）框架，通过从预测未来中溯因推断潜在原因，学习结构化的因果表征，并在物理预测、因果推理和动作理解任务上显著优于V-JEPA。
AI.motivation: 现有世界模型主要表示未来状态，但未能显式捕获驱动状态演化的潜在原因，因而难以推理世界"为何"以及"如何"变化。作者希望弥补这一缺陷，使世界模型具备对变化背后潜在因果因子的建模能力。
AI.method: 作者提出AWM框架，通过溯因推断从预测的未来中反推潜在原因，学习结构化因果表征。具体实现为分层溯因状态金字塔（HASP），将推断的世界状态组织为三个互补部分：实体（Entity，存在什么）、动态（Dynamic，如何变化）、关系（Relation，实体如何交互）。HASP联合当前观测及其预测未来进行推理，溯因推断上述潜在因子，并整合为结构化状态表征以支持下游推理。
AI.result: 在物理预测、因果推理和动作理解三类实验中验证了有效性。与最先进的潜在空间世界模型V-JEPA相比，AWM在物理预测AUROC上提升10.7%，因果推理准确率提升16.8%，动作Top-1准确率提升68.0%。
AI.conclusion: AWM是首个将溯因状态推断引入潜在空间世界建模的框架，用于学习世界动态的结构化表征，证明显式建模潜在因果原因能有效提升世界模型在预测与推理任务上的表现。

title: LongSpark: Efficient speculative decoding with a fixed-cost parallel drafter
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive inference by verifying multiple draft tokens in a single target forward pass. However, as the context grows, existing state-of-the-art drafters become increasingly expensive, eroding the very efficiency advantage they are designed to provide. We argue that this scaling is unnecessary. A standalone language model must grow with its prefix because it is solely responsible for every token it produces. A drafter, by contrast, only proposes candidates; the target catches and corrects every error before any token is committed. The drafter's decoding cost can therefore be made entirely independent of the prefix length. We introduce LongSpark, a block-diffusion drafter that achieves this by extracting fixed-size, multiscale views from the target's verification pass, thereby eliminating the need for a growing persistent state. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that LongSpark achieves state-of-the-art end-to-end efficiency across multiple model scales and realistic serving conditions. Notably, it delivers the lowest time-per-output-token on long-context tasks while reducing the drafter's context state by several orders of magnitude.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 LongSpark，一种块扩散（block-diffusion）推测解码器，通过从目标模型验证过程中提取固定规模的多尺度视图，使草稿模型的解码开销与前缀长度完全解耦，从而在长上下文场景下实现最优的端到端效率。
AI.motivation: 推测解码通过单次目标前向传播验证多个草稿 token 来加速自回归推理，但随着上下文增长，现有最先进的草稿模型（drafter）开销逐渐增大，反而侵蚀了其本应提供的效率优势。作者认为这种随前缀增长的扩展是不必要的：独立语言模型必须随前缀增长是因为它需对自身生成的每个 token 负责，而草稿模型只负责提出候选，错误由目标模型捕获并纠正，因此其解码成本可以完全独立于前缀长度。
AI.method: LongSpark 采用块扩散式草稿器，通过从目标模型的验证前向传播中提取固定大小的多尺度视图，从而无需维护随上下文增长的持久状态，使草稿解码开销与前缀长度解耦。
AI.result: 在多个模型规模和真实服务条件下的广泛评测表明，LongSpark 实现了最先进的端到端效率；在长上下文任务中取得了最低的每输出 token 时间（time-per-output-token），同时将草稿器的上下文状态减少数个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 草稿模型的解码成本无需随前缀长度增长；通过重用目标验证过程生成固定规模多尺度视图的块扩散设计，LongSpark 在长上下文服务场景中同时实现了高效推理与极低的草稿上下文状态开销。

title: High-Resolution Dynamic Functional Connectivity Generation with Graph-Variate Flow Matching
summary:
High-resolution dynamic functional connectivity (DFC) can reveal rapidly evolving brain-network interactions, but short temporal windows yield noisy, often low-rank covariance estimates. Graph-Variate Dynamic (GVD) connectivity addresses this by modulating fast instantaneous interactions with stable trial-level support. This suppresses spurious fluctuations and emphasizes persistent, informative connections. We show that the Hadamard construction lifts low-rank instantaneous connectivity from the positive-semidefinite to the positive-definite cone, keeping high-resolution trajectories on the SPD manifold without ridge regularisation or post-hoc projection.
  We introduce GVD-CFM, a class-conditional generative model for high-resolution dynamic connectivity. Each trial is represented as SPD GVD matrices on a product Riemannian manifold, then mapped through a global log-Euclidean diffeomorphism and an invertible temporal DCT basis. A Transformer-based conditional flow models all spectral modes jointly and generates the full trajectory non-autoregressively in Euclidean coordinates while preserving exact correspondence with valid SPD sequences. Retaining the full DCT basis also enables decoding on denser temporal grids without retraining.
  Across multiple EEG motor-imagery datasets, GVD-CFM delivers the strongest overall results for held-out distributional fidelity, temporal-dynamics preservation, and synthetic-to-real classification. It also remains computationally efficient relative to strong raw-signal and direct GVD-space generative baselines. GVD-CFM therefore provides a practical framework for realistic, temporally coherent, high-resolution brain-network generation with preserved manifold structure and resolution-flexible decoding from a single trained model.

AI.tldr: 提出GVD-CFM：在SPD流形上对高分辨率动态功能连接建模的条件流生成模型，兼顾保真度、时序动态与计算效率。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率动态功能连接（DFC）能刻画快速演化的脑网络交互，但短时间窗导致协方差估计噪声大且常为低秩。已有GVD连接通过稳定试次级支持调制瞬时交互以抑制伪波动，但其在高分辨率下的流形性质与生成建模仍待解决。
AI.method: 证明Hadamard构造将低秩瞬时连接从半正定锥提升到正定锥，使高分辨率轨迹无需岭正则或事后投影即保持在SPD流形上。提出GVD-CFM：将每个试次表示为乘积黎曼流形上的SPD GVD矩阵，经全局log-Euclidean微分同胚与可逆时间DCT基映射，用基于Transformer的条件流模型联合建模所有谱模态，在欧氏坐标中非自回归生成完整轨迹，并保持与有效SPD序列的精确对应；保留完整DCT基支持更密时间网格上的免重训解码。
AI.result: 在多个EEG运动想象数据集上，GVD-CFM在留出分布保真度、时序动态保持与合成到真实分类方面总体表现最佳，且相对强原始信号与直接GVD空间生成基线保持计算高效。
AI.conclusion: GVD-CFM为生成真实、时序连贯、高分辨率脑网络提供了实用框架，保持流形结构，并可由单一训练模型实现分辨率灵活的解码。

title: NowcastDiT: Diffusion Transformers are Effective Precipitation Nowcasters
summary: Precipitation nowcasting demands accurate short-term forecasts under strong spatiotemporal variability. Diffusion models are well suited to modeling complex precipitation distributions, yet existing approaches often introduce increasingly specialized designs, leaving the capability of a standard diffusion architecture underexplored. We show that a standard Diffusion Transformer already provides a simple and scalable foundation for precipitation nowcasting, with domain-specific requirements accommodated naturally within its design space. Based on this principle, we develop NowcastDiT and instantiate this flexibility through two complementary adaptations: a dynamics-aware noise prior for temporally coherent forecasts, and end-to-end reinforcement learning with timestep-aware rewards for meteorological skill. Experiments on SEVIR and MRMS benchmarks show that NowcastDiT achieves state-of-the-art performance in both perceptual quality and meteorological skill. These results suggest that standard DiT can serve as an effective foundation for precipitation nowcasting.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出NowcastDiT，证明标准Diffusion Transformer即可作为降水临近预报的简洁、可扩展基础架构，并通过两项针对性改进（动力学感知噪声先验与端到端强化学习）在SEVIR和MRMS上取得感知质量与气象技能的双重SOTA。
AI.motivation: 降水临近预报需在强时空变异下实现准确短期预测。扩散模型适合建模复杂降水分布，但现有方法不断引入高度专门化的设计，导致标准扩散架构本身的能力未被充分探索。本文旨在验证标准DiT能否作为降水临近预报的通用基础。
AI.method: 以标准Diffusion Transformer为骨干构建NowcastDiT，将领域需求自然纳入其设计空间，并通过两项互补适配实现灵活性：一是动力学感知的噪声先验（dynamics-aware noise prior），用于生成时间上连贯的预报；二是带时间步感知奖励（timestep-aware rewards）的端到端强化学习，以优化气象技能。
AI.result: 在SEVIR与MRMS基准上，NowcastDiT在感知质量和气象技能两方面均达到state-of-the-art性能。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，标准DiT可作为降水临近预报的有效基础架构，无需过度专门化设计即可满足领域需求，为后续研究提供了简洁且可扩展的范式。

title: Beam Search as Test-Time Self-Distillation via Counterfactual Contexts
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Towards Test-Time Continual Learning Agents
summary: Self-Distillation Fine-Tuning (SDFT) enables a language model to act as its own teacher: by conditioning on a demonstration, the model produces an implicit reward via pointwise mutual information, which guides on-policy learning without external supervision. However, SDFT operates at training time: it requires gradient updates and access to expert demonstrations, making it inapplicable at inference. We propose test-time self-distillation, a decoding-time method that extracts a steering signal from the self-distillation framework without any parameter updates, reward models, or training data. Our key insight is that counterfactual contexts, i.e. fixed textual templates that hypothetically prime the model for excellent versus poor reasoning, can substitute for the demonstration. The log-odds ratio of a candidate answer under these two counterfactual conditions defines a new reward signal. We derive the optimal KL-regularized policy under this reward, which takes the form of a Gibbs reweighting of the base distribution. Crucially, this reweighting is global: it cannot be decomposed into independent per-token operations without ignoring future trajectory quality. We therefore approximate the target distribution via beam search. Experiments on mathematical reasoning (MATH500), code generation (HumanEval), and graduate-level science QA (GPQA) across multiple model scales show that test-time self-distillation improves over standard sampling, low temperature, beam search and power sampling baselines on average, demonstrating that the self-distillation principle can be operationalized at inference time.

AI.tldr: 提出测试时自蒸馏（test-time self-distillation），用反事实模板替代专家示范，通过两个反事实条件候选答案的对数几率比构造奖励信号，导出KL正则最优策略（基分布的Gibbs重加权），并用束搜索近似该全局重加权，在Math500、HumanEval、GPQA上无需训练即可提升推理表现。
AI.motivation: 自蒸馏微调（SDFT）虽能让模型以自身为教师、通过示范条件化产生隐式奖励并驱动on-policy学习，但它依赖梯度更新和专家示范，只能在训练阶段使用，无法在推理阶段应用。本文希望将自蒸馏原理在推理时操作化，无需参数更新、奖励模型或训练数据。
AI.method: 核心洞见是用反事实上下文（固定文本模板，假设性引导模型走向优秀或糟糕推理）代替示范。候选答案在这两种反事实条件下的对数几率比构成新奖励信号；据此推导KL正则化下的最优策略，形式为基分布的Gibbs重加权。该重加权是全局的，无法分解为逐token独立操作（否则忽略未来轨迹质量），因此用束搜索近似目标分布。
AI.result: 在数学推理（MATH500）、代码生成（HumanEval）与研究生级科学问答（GPQA）上，跨多个模型规模，测试时自蒸馏平均优于标准采样、低温采样、束搜索与power sampling等基线。
AI.conclusion: 自蒸馏原理可以在推理阶段被有效操作化：无需训练、奖励模型或示范，仅靠反事实上下文诱导的全局Gibbs重加权（束搜索近似）即可在多种推理任务上提升生成质量。

title: Message Passing Does More with Less for In-Context Learning on Graphs
summary: Achieving strong performance with graph neural networks (GNNs) typically requires training and hyperparameter tuning for each dataset, incurring repeated costs and effort. Graph in-context learning (ICL) avoids this by using a single pretrained model to predict unknown node labels directly from labeled context nodes. Existing approaches, however, rely on dense attention across nodes, making inference increasingly expensive as graphs grow. In this work, we present Ephris, a new graph in-context learner built on sparse message passing, scaling linearly with the number of node-feature entries and graph edges. Ephris is pretrained entirely on synthetic graphs generated from structural causal models with diverse graph structures and relational dynamics, exposing the model to varied dependencies among topology, features, and labels. We evaluate Ephris on 51 node-classification datasets against 15 extensively tuned GNNs and existing graph ICL methods under both high- and low-label train/validation/test splits. Across both settings, Ephris ranks first on all four aggregate measures: Elo, improvability, average rank, and accuracy. Its inference cost remains comparable to training a single GNN once, while being over 10 times faster than previous graph ICL models. Together, these results advance the performance-runtime Pareto frontier, demonstrating that strong graph ICL does not require dense attention. Code and model weights are available at https://github.com/nums-ai/ephris.

AI.tldr: Ephris：一种基于稀疏消息传递的图上下文学习器，线性扩展，在51个节点分类数据集上超越15个调优GNN及现有图ICL方法，推理成本低且比此前图ICL快10倍以上。
AI.motivation: 现有GNN在每个数据集上都需训练与超参调优，成本高；图上下文学习（ICL）虽可免去重训，但已有方法依赖节点间稠密注意力，随图规模增大推理开销急剧上升。
AI.method: 提出Ephris，基于稀疏消息传递的图ICL模型，计算量随节点特征条目数与边数线性增长；完全使用由结构因果模型生成、具有多样图结构与关系动态的合成图进行预训练，使模型暴露于拓扑、特征与标签间的多变依赖关系。
AI.result: 在51个节点分类数据集、高标签与低标签两种训练/验证/测试划分下，与15个充分调优的GNN及现有图ICL方法比较，Ephris在Elo、improvability、平均排名、准确率四项聚合指标上均排名第一；推理成本约等于训练单个GNN一次，且比此前图ICL模型快10倍以上。
AI.conclusion: Ephris推进了性能-运行时帕累托前沿，表明强图ICL无需稠密注意力；代码与模型权重已在https://github.com/nums-ai/ephris开源。

title: A Comprehensive View of Fairness through Distributional Stability
summary: We view fairness as a property of distributional stability. Rather than assessing a predictor under a fixed data distribution, we study how its predictions change under perturbations that modify the composition of protected groups. A predictor is fair if it remains stable under such shifts. Under this perspective, several classical notions of fairness arise as stability with respect to specific perturbations, with the associated unfairness gap given by a Lipschitz constant of a prediction-rate functional. This formulation also yields guarantees that hold uniformly over a range of demographic compositions at test time, without requiring knowledge of the deployment distribution. It leads to a learning procedure based on convex combinations of reweighted predictors, formulated as a second-order cone program, for which we establish generalization bounds. Experiments on standard benchmarks illustrate the approach.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将公平性视为一种分布稳定性属性：公平的预测器应在改变受保护群体组成的扰动下保持稳定，经典公平性概念可由此视角导出，并给出统一的泛化保证与基于二阶锥规划的学习算法。
AI.motivation: 传统公平性评估通常在固定数据分布下考察预测器，因而难以保证其在测试时人口构成变化（分布偏移）下的表现。作者希望以分布稳定性为统一视角重构公平性，使其在无需知晓部署分布的情况下，对多种人群构成区间均成立。
AI.method: 将公平性定义为对特定扰动的稳定性：不同扰动对应于不同经典公平性概念，其不公平差距由预测率泛函的 Lipschitz 常数刻画。基于该框架构造由重加权预测器的凸组合组成的学习过程，并将其表述为二阶锥规划（SOCP）求解，同时建立泛化界。
AI.result: 该形式化能够统一导出多种经典公平性度量，并提供在测试时对一系列人群构成一致成立的保证；所提基于凸组合与 SOCP 的学习方法具有泛化界，并在标准基准实验上验证了有效性。
AI.conclusion: 以分布稳定性刻画公平性为理解与实现公平学习提供了统一且具理论保证的框架，可在未知部署分布下保持稳健，并通过凸优化实现可计算的学习。

title: RL-PaO: Prediction as Action in Decision Making under Uncertainty
summary: Decision-making under uncertainty often relies on predicted parameters, yet accurate prediction does not necessarily lead to good operational decisions. Aligning prediction with downstream optimization requires learning from the consequences of the decisions those predictions induce. We introduce RL-PaO, a reinforcement learning framework that integrates system formulation, optimization, and decision execution into a single environment. This yields a Markov decision process in which prediction is regarded as action: it shifts the environment to produce subsequent context and reward that explicitly aligns prediction error with realized cost, and learning the optimal policy does not require differentiating through the black-box solver. We evaluate RL-PaO on day-ahead energy scheduling using real historical data. On the test year, RL-PaO achieves the lowest annual cost among the non-oracle baselines, achieving on average $10\%$ cost reduction. Moreover, RL-PaO is capable of further analyses to provide strong interpretability both from the policy evolution perspective and the cost-accuracy trade-off.

AI.tldr: 提出 RL-PaO 强化学习框架，将预测视为动作、把系统建模-优化-决策执行整合为单一环境，构建 MDP，使预测误差与真实成本对齐，且无需对黑盒求解器求导；在真实数据的日前能源调度任务中，非 oracle 基线里年度成本最低，平均降本约 10%。
AI.motivation: 不确定性决策依赖预测参数，但预测准确并不必然带来好的运营决策。要让预测与下游优化对齐，必须从预测所诱导决策的后果中学习。
AI.method: RL-PaO：一个强化学习框架，将系统建模、优化与决策执行整合为单一环境，形成马尔可夫决策过程，其中预测被视作动作；该动作使环境转移到后续上下文并产生奖励，从而显式地将预测误差与实现成本对齐；学习最优策略无需对黑盒求解器做微分。
AI.result: 在基于真实历史数据的日前能源调度任务上评估：测试年份中 RL-PaO 在非 oracle 基线里取得最低年度成本，平均成本降低 10%。此外，RL-PaO 支持进一步分析，在策略演化与成本-精度权衡两方面提供较强可解释性。
AI.conclusion: 通过将预测作为动作纳入 MDP 并以决策后果为奖励，可在不依赖可微求解器的前提下实现预测与优化的端到端对齐；实验验证其在真实调度任务中兼具成本优势与可解释性。

title: Beyond Compression: Diagnosing How Post-Training Changes Mathematical Reasoning
comment: 18 pages, 17 figures, 10 tables. Includes technical appendix. Under review
summary: Post-training is central to mathematical reasoning in modern large language models (LLMs), but endpoint pass@1 alone underidentifies what has changed. Gains may reflect newly reachable solutions, cheaper sampling of latent solutions, surface robustness, or memorisation. We compare three post-training paths under a common diagnostic readout: our sufficiently trained off-policy distillation trajectories, released Qwen3 off-policy-plus-on-policy distillation endpoints, and a released DeepSeek-Math endpoint trained with Group Relative Policy Optimisation (GRPO). Our probe uses cross-surface pass@K over verbatim prompts, paraphrases, numerical isomorphisms, and translations, plus consistency, distribution-shape, and verified supervised-fine-tuning (SFT) membership analyses. We find two regimes. On easier AMC problems, large-K ceilings are near saturation, so post-training mainly compresses sample cost. On harder AIME problems, post-training expands the large-K ceiling over the base model: sufficient off-policy distillation already raises this ceiling, Qwen3 released endpoints raise it further, and DeepSeek-Math GRPO does not dominate sufficient off-policy distillation at large K. English-dominant distillation improves non-English reasoning but preserves language-tier gaps. A controlled-overfit audit finds limited sensitivity in current SFT-membership probes. Compression is one regime of post-training, not a universal explanation.

AI.tldr: 该论文比较三条数学推理后训练路径（充分训练的离策略蒸馏、Qwen3离策略+在策略蒸馏端点、DeepSeek-Math GRPO端点），通过跨表层pass@K、一致性、分布形状与SFT成员分析进行诊断，发现后训练存在两类机制：在简单AMC上主要是压缩采样成本，在困难AIME上则扩展大K天花板。
AI.motivation: 现有评估仅用端点pass@1，无法区分后训练带来的性能提升究竟来自新可达解、潜在解的廉价采样、表层鲁棒性还是记忆化，因此需要更细粒度的诊断性读数来识别后训练的真实作用机制。
AI.method: 在统一诊断框架下对比三条后训练路径：自训练的离策略蒸馏轨迹、已发布的Qwen3离策略+在策略蒸馏端点、以及用GRPO训练的DeepSeek-Math端点。探针包括对原始提示、复述、数值同构与翻译的跨表层pass@K，并辅以一致性、分布形状和经校验的SFT成员分析；另进行受控过拟合审计以检验SFT成员探针的敏感性。
AI.result: 发现两种机制：在较易的AMC问题上，大K上限接近饱和，后训练主要压缩采样成本；在较难的AIME问题上，后训练扩展了相对基座模型的大K上限——充分的离策略蒸馏已能提升该上限，Qwen3发布端点进一步提升，而DeepSeek-Math GRPO在大K下并未优于充分的离策略蒸馏。英语主导的蒸馏改善了非英语推理，但保留了语言层级差距。受控过拟合审计显示当前SFT成员探针敏感性有限。
AI.conclusion: 压缩只是后训练的一种机制，并非普遍解释。评估后训练应超越端点pass@1，采用跨表层pass@K等诊断读数以区分压缩与能力扩展。

title: UnlearningSoup: Is Repeated Tuning Necessary for Large Language Model Unlearning?
summary: Large language models trained on vast corpora inherently risk memorizing harmful content that may later re-emerge in their outputs. To mitigate this issue, existing unlearning methods typically rely on training-based parameter updates, such as gradient ascent and its variants, to delete targeted content while preserving other knowledge. However, balancing the competing goals of forgetting and retention makes hyperparameter choices for these methods particularly difficult, often requiring repeated tuning to obtain a strong model that still leaves substantial room for improvement and transfers poorly across models and datasets. To address this challenge, we investigate whether unlearning runs exhibit exploitable structure in weight space, and observe that models from different runs still lie in a shared evaluation-performance basin. This suggests that stronger models may be recovered through an unlearning-tailored soup strategy, reducing the need for repeated tuning for further improvement or new settings. Motivated by this, we propose UnlearningSoup, a unified framework that provides two strategies: EfficientSoup uses binary-search-based interpolation to quickly discover a well-performing model in the early stage, where repeated tuning would otherwise make strong model selection costly. PerformanceSoup uses reweighted souping to efficiently unlock the remaining performance potential in the later stage, where repeated tuning becomes increasingly inefficient. Extensive experiments across diverse datasets and models show that UnlearningSoup delivers 2.4x to 3.3x efficiency gains in hyperparameter selection, while consistently improving performance across settings.

AI.tldr: 提出UnlearningSoup框架，利用遗忘运行在权重空间中的共享性能盆地结构，通过插值与重加权"模型汤"策略，在无需反复调参的情况下提升遗忘效果，调参效率提升2.4-3.3倍。
AI.motivation: 现有基于参数更新的遗忘方法（如梯度上升及其变体）需在"遗忘"与"保留"两个冲突目标间权衡，导致超参数选择困难，常需反复调参，且所得模型性能仍有较大提升空间，跨模型与数据集迁移性差。
AI.method: 作者首先探究遗忘运行在权重空间中是否存在可利用的结构，发现不同运行得到的模型仍处于共享的评估性能盆地；据此提出UnlearningSoup统一框架，包含两种策略：EfficientSoup采用二分搜索插值，在早期快速找到表现良好的模型以降低强模型选择成本；PerformanceSoup采用重加权模型汤（reweighted souping），在后期高效释放剩余性能潜力。
AI.result: 在多种数据集与模型上的大量实验表明，UnlearningSoup在超参数选择上取得2.4倍至3.3倍的效率提升，并在不同设定下持续提升性能。
AI.conclusion: 遗忘运行在权重空间中具有可 exploited 的共享结构，基于模型汤的整合策略可在减少调参开销的同时提升遗忘模型性能，为遗忘任务提供了一种统一、高效的框架。

title: ZeroDiff: Zero-Shot Time Series Reconstruction via Informed-Prior Diffusion
summary: Time series modeling increasingly demands high-quality supervision, yet target observations remain scarce - exogenous inputs are broadly available, but target measurements are often unavailable due to cost, infrastructure, or accessibility constraints. Can models trained on observed locations reconstruct target time series where measurements have never been collected? We term this zero-shot time series reconstruction. A naive approach - directly mapping exogenous inputs to targets - can yield predictions at unobserved locations, but without target signals, such models fail to capture the intrinsic dynamics of the target variable, producing overly smooth outputs that underestimate extremes. This reveals systematic errors that call for explicit modeling and calibration. We propose ZeroDiff, which constructs an informed prior from exogenous variables alone, then learns to calibrate reconstruction errors through diffusion - training on observed locations and generalizing to unobserved ones. Experiments across diverse real-world datasets demonstrate significant improvements over existing approaches. Our code is available at https://github.com/YingdaFan/ZeroDiff-ICML2026.

AI.tldr: 提出零样本时间序列重构任务，并设计ZeroDiff模型：用外生变量构建先验，再借助扩散模型校准重构误差，实现在无目标观测位置的时序重建，显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 时序建模依赖高质量监督信号，但目标观测常因成本、基础设施或可获取性限制而稀缺，而外生输入普遍可得。核心问题是：能否用已观测位置训练的模型，重构从未采集过测量的目标时序（零样本时间序列重构）。朴素做法（外生输入直接映射到目标）虽能在未观测位置给出预测，但因缺乏目标信号，无法刻画目标变量的内在动态，输出过于平滑、低估极值，暴露出系统性误差，需要显式建模与校准。
AI.method: ZeroDiff：首先仅利用外生变量构建一个informed prior（先验），随后通过扩散模型学习校准重构误差；在已观测位置训练，并泛化到未观测位置。
AI.result: 在多个真实世界数据集上的实验表明，该方法相比现有方法取得显著提升。
AI.conclusion: ZeroDiff为无目标观测场景下的零样本时间序列重构提供了有效方案，通过先验构建与扩散式误差校准缓解了朴素映射带来的平滑偏差与极值低估问题，具备实际推广价值；代码已开源。

title: VACE: Validation-Gated Alternating Co-Evolution of Agent Models and Harnesses
summary: Language model agents can be improved by updating their model weights or refining the harness that guides task execution. These components are coupled: weight updates change how the model uses the harness, while harness updates change the trajectories used for training. We propose VACE, Validation-Gated Alternating CoEvolution, which alternates agentic reinforcement learning with trajectory-driven harness refinement. After each RL stage, VACE reuses the collected trajectories to propose a harness revision and evaluates the incumbent and candidate with the updated model held fixed. The candidate guides subsequent training only if it improves validation performance. With Qwen3.5-9B, VACE achieves 45.26% test accuracy on OfficeQA and a mean partial-credit score of 75.19% on AutomationBench, exceeding weight-only RL by 6.43 and 9.09 percentage points and ungated alternation by 4.59 and 6.95 points, respectively. Across 44 harness proposals, 17 reduce validation performance at the updated checkpoint and are rejected before subsequent RL training, highlighting the importance of validation gating.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VACE（验证门控交替协同进化）方法，通过交替进行智能体强化学习与轨迹驱动的执行框架（harness）优化，并引入验证门控机制，在OfficeQA与AutomationBench上显著优于仅权重更新RL和无门控交替方案。
AI.motivation: 语言模型智能体可通过更新模型权重或改进引导任务执行的harness来提升性能。然而这两者相互耦合：权重更新会改变模型对harness的使用方式，harness更新又会改变用于训练的轨迹。因此需要一种能协调二者、避免相互干扰的优化方法。
AI.method: 提出VACE（Validation-Gated Alternating CoEvolution）：交替执行智能体强化学习与轨迹驱动的harness优化。每个RL阶段后，复用已收集的轨迹提出harness修订方案，并在固定更新后模型的情况下，对现有（incumbent）与候选（candidate）harness进行验证评估；仅当候选harness提升验证性能时，才用于引导后续训练。
AI.result: 在Qwen3.5-9B上，VACE在OfficeQA取得45.26%测试准确率，在AutomationBench取得75.19%的平均部分得分；分别超过仅权重RL 6.43和9.09个百分点，超过无门控交替方法4.59和6.95个百分点。在44个harness提案中，有17个在更新后的检查点上降低了验证性能，并在后续RL训练前被拒绝，凸显了验证门控的重要性。
AI.conclusion: 验证门控是协同进化权重与harness的关键：它能在更新后的模型检查点上过滤掉损害性能的harness提案，避免其污染后续训练，从而带来稳定的性能提升。

title: Unlocking the Critic: Reward-Free Policy Optimization for LLM Post-Training
summary: Recent approaches to reinforcement learning (RL) post-training for large language models increasingly remove the critic to reduce training instability and memory overhead. Even where a critic is trained, it is discarded once training ends, although it has learned to predict outcomes. We revisit this trend and show that a pretrained critic's ability to predict future outcomes can make it a valuable asset for efficient long-horizon reasoning. First, we find that instability in critic-based RL for long chain-of-thought reasoning is largely an optimization artifact: keeping policy updates small and low in variance restores stable convergence. Second, a well-pretrained critic estimates the posterior probability of eventual success from later trajectory states and unfinished prefixes. Its predictions provide outcome-derived, dense, per-prefix learning signals that, during policy optimization, require neither completed rollouts, step-level annotations, nor external reward labels. Building on this insight, we introduce Reward-Free Policy Optimization (RFPO), which repurposes a single calibrated, frozen critic as a rollout-level reward, a value baseline for generalized advantage estimation, and a success forecaster for unfinished prefixes. We further show that binarizing the debiased score stops the policy from exploiting the critic's length bias. Binarized, RFPO matches supervised PPO without a single label in the training loop, while cutting compute and memory overhead. This makes RFPO well suited to long-horizon reasoning tasks, where outcomes arrive late and generation dominates cost: because rollouts can be rewarded before they finish, training no longer has to pay for waiting on every trajectory to complete. Our findings challenge the prevailing critic-free paradigm and establish critic-based, reward-free optimization as a scalable and computationally efficient path for LLM post-training.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视了去除critic的强化学习趋势，发现预训练的critic可作为长程推理的高效资产，提出无需奖励标签的RFPO方法。
AI.motivation: 当前大语言模型RL后训练倾向于去除critic以降低训练不稳定性和内存开销，且即便训练了critic也在结束后丢弃。作者认为这忽略了critic预测未来结果的能力，希望重新利用其价值实现高效长程推理。
AI.method: 首先证明critic-based RL的不稳定性主要是优化问题（保持策略更新小且低方差即可稳定收敛）。基于此提出RFPO，将单个经过校准的冻结critic复用为三重角色：rollout级奖励、用于GAE的价值基线、以及未完成前缀的成功预测器。进一步对去偏分数进行二值化以抑制策略利用critic的长度偏差。
AI.result: 二值化的RFPO在训练循环中不使用任何标签即可匹配监督PPO的效果，同时降低计算和内存开销；由于rollout可在完成前获得奖励，训练无需等待每条轨迹完成。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果挑战了主流的无critic范式，确立了基于critic、无需奖励的优化作为LLM后训练中可扩展且计算高效的路径。

title: Learning the Structure of Triangular Transport Maps
summary: Triangular transport maps provide a flexible approach to sampling-based probabilistic modeling, including density estimation, generative modeling, and Bayesian inference. They transform an unknown target distribution into a simpler reference through a monotone triangular map. The map structure is defined by a variable ordering and sparsity pattern, which together encode a directed acyclic graph. Map quality can depend strongly on this structure, yet finding a good structure is computationally expensive because each candidate generally requires fitting a different map. A central challenge is therefore to learn density and structure jointly, while keeping computation manageable as dimension grows. We introduce Self-Structuring Transport Maps (SSTM), which learn the map, ordering, and sparsity jointly. We use SoftSort to learn the variable ordering and $L_0$ gates to learn the sparsity, while preserving a triangular structure. To keep the map scalable, we use a monotone BatchEnsemble that shares one weight matrix across all map components through rank-one adapters. Across synthetic and real data, jointly learning the structure and map gives better density estimates than estimating the structure first. When the structure is identifiable from the density, SSTM matches the density performance of a map fitted with the true structure and outperforms autoregressive flows. On large datasets, SSTM is competitive with autoregressive flows.

AI.tldr: 本文提出自结构传输映射（SSTM），联合学习三角传输映射的映射、变量排序与稀疏结构，以SoftSort学排序、L0门控学稀疏，并用单权重矩阵加秩一适配器的单调BatchEnsemble保证可扩展性。
AI.motivation: 三角传输映射的质量强依赖其结构（变量排序与稀疏模式，共同编码为有向无环图），但寻找好结构计算代价高，因为每个候选结构通常都要重新拟合一个映射。核心挑战是在维度增长时仍能可负担地联合学习密度与结构。
AI.method: SSTM联合学习映射、排序与稀疏：用SoftSort学习变量排序，用L0门控学习稀疏，同时保持三角结构；为提升可扩展性，采用单调BatchEnsemble，通过秩一适配器让所有映射分量共享同一权重矩阵。
AI.result: 在合成与真实数据上，联合学习结构与映射比先估计结构再拟合映射获得更好的密度估计。当结构可由密度辨识时，SSTM的密度表现与使用真实结构拟合的映射相当，并优于自回归流；在大规模数据集上，SSTM与自回归流相比具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: SSTM表明结构可与映射联合学习，避免了昂贵的逐候选结构搜索，在保持可扩展性的同时取得优良的密度估计，并在结构可辨识时达到接近真实结构的性能。

title: Multimodal Detection of Higher-Order Behavioral Constructs: Self-Compassion in Structured Reflective Interaction
summary: Many of the qualities that matter most in how people learn and grow, how someone regulates their emotions, reflects on a setback, or stays aware of others during a difficult conversation, are not directly observable. They have to be inferred from how someone speaks, moves, and sounds over time, and they resist the kind of clean labeling that most machine learning pipelines are built around. We study this challenge through a case that is well grounded in psychological theory but rarely modeled computationally: self-compassion, the tendency to respond to one's own setbacks with patience rather than harsh self-criticism. We examine how it appears during structured reflective interviews in a technology-mediated training setting, where people naturally talk through socio-emotionally demanding situations. Since no existing dataset captures this kind of construct in this kind of setting, we collected and annotated 51 reflective dialog sessions using an independent, temporally overlapping annotation scheme grounded in established theory. We consolidate the underlying six-component psychological model into a three-class supervision space, balancing self-kindness and mindfulness against self-critical or overwhelmed states, and build a reproducible window-based pipeline that aligns video, audio, and text on a shared timeline. Unimodal models trained on each modality separately are compared against a simple probability-level fusion strategy, which yields modest but consistent gains over the best single modality. We close by discussing where each modality succeeds or struggles, what this suggests about how this kind of construct is actually expressed in reflective speech, and what would be needed to model it, and constructs like it, more effectively.

AI.tldr: 该研究以自悯（self-compassion）为案例，构建了51段反思性对话的多模态数据集，提出基于时间窗口的对齐与三分类监督方案，并比较单模态与概率级融合模型的表现。
AI.motivation: 许多对学习与成长至关重要的心理品质（如情绪调节、挫折反思、对话中的共情觉察）无法直接观测，只能从言语、动作和声音中随时间推断，且难以进行常规机器学习所需的清晰标注。作者选择心理理论扎实但少有计算建模的自悯构念作为切入点。
AI.method: 在技术中介的培训场景中采集51段结构化反思对话，采用基于既有理论的独立、时间重叠标注方案；将六成分心理模型整合为三类监督空间（自我友善与正念 vs. 自我批判或不堪重负），构建可复现的窗口化流水线，在统一时间轴上对齐视频、音频与文本；分别训练单模态模型，并与简单的概率级融合策略比较。
AI.result: 单模态模型各有优劣，概率级融合相比最佳单模态取得小幅但一致的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 论文讨论了各模态在测量该构念时的成功与困难，揭示了此类构念在反思性言语中的表达方式，并指出更有效建模该类构念所需的条件。

title: Lucid Dreaming for World Models: Learning to Doubt Imagination and Decide by Trust
comment: 30 pages, 22 figures, 8 tables. Project page: https://lucidwm.github.io
summary: World models enable agents to learn and plan in imagination, but predictions beyond their experience can become unreliable and mislead decisions. Existing uncertainty estimates derived from predictions can remain overconfident on unfamiliar state-action pairs. We propose the Lucid World Model (LucidWM), which learns doubt from experience and propagates trust through imagination. By integrating Subjective Logic into categorical latent transitions, LucidWM distinguishes predicted outcomes from their evidential support and assigns each transition a degree of doubt. The complement of this doubt defines transition-level trust, which accumulates multiplicatively along imagined trajectories to reweight returns for policy learning and guide action selection. Uncertainty estimation requires no additional parameters or forward passes. Evaluated on four base world models against seventeen uncertainty readouts, LucidWM detects environmental changes and signals uncertainty during action-corrupted rollouts. In a controlled navigation case study, acting on trust reduces the number of steps required to reach the goal from 362 to 190. Fifteen demonstration videos show how LucidWM doubts its dreams and acts on that doubt. Videos are available at https://lucidwm.github.io.

AI.tldr: 提出LucidWM，将主观逻辑融入类别潜变量转移，从经验中学习"怀疑度"并在想象中传播"信任度"，无需额外参数或前向计算即实现不确定性估计。
AI.motivation: 世界模型虽能让智能体在想象中学习与规划，但其超出经验的预测可能不可靠并误导决策；现有基于预测的不确定性估计在陌生状态-动作对上仍会过度自信。
AI.method: 将主观逻辑（Subjective Logic）整合进类别潜变量转移中，区分预测结果与其证据支持度，为每个转移赋予怀疑度；怀疑度的补集定义为转移级信任度，沿想象轨迹以乘法方式累积，用于重加权回报进行策略学习并指导动作选择。
AI.result: 在四个基础世界模型、十七种不确定性读数上评测，LucidWM能检测环境变化并在动作被破坏的rollout中发出不确定性信号；在受控导航案例中，依据信任度行动将到达目标的步数从362降至190；十五个演示视频展示其"怀疑梦境并据此行动"。
AI.conclusion: 通过主观逻辑显式建模证据支持度与转移级信任传播，LucidWM以零额外开销实现更可靠的不确定性估计，并有效提升想象规划的决策质量。

title: GLASS: Global Latent Aggregation with Slot-based Set Decoding for Scalable All-Atom Crystal Generation
summary: Generative models for crystals enable the discovery of novel structures, but scaling all-atom generation to larger systems such as metal--organic frameworks remains challenging. We connect this difficulty to the correspondence problem of particle-space generation. Even on a single fixed target set, index-free permutation-equivariant particle flows require substantially more training for reliable generation as set size and density increase, under both independent and optimal-transport couplings. To resolve this challenge, we introduce GLASS---Global Latent Aggregation with Slot-based Set Decoding, which encodes structures in a permutation-invariant global latent space and learns their distribution via flow matching. A learned-slot decoder constructs all atoms in parallel, removing atom-wise correspondence from generative transport. On MP20, GLASS is competitive with particle-space models, and flow training can reach the validity of the training data at every structure size. On a QMOF subset, GLASS generates MOFs with up to 150 atoms per unit cell without conditioning on building blocks, topology, or composition, and approaches the structural validity of the training data. On both datasets, flow training exposes a validity--novelty tradeoff, and MOF novelty remains limited by autoencoder generalization on the available data. These results show that separating correspondence assignment from generative transport provides a simple route toward high-validity generation of larger atomistic systems.

AI.tldr: GLASS 通过将晶体生成中的"对应关系分配"与"生成式传输"解耦，在全置换不变潜空间上用流匹配建模结构分布，并用学习槽解码器并行构造全部原子，从而在 MP20 上与粒子空间模型相当、在每个结构尺寸上达到训练数据的有效性，并在 QMOF 子集上无条件下生成每晶胞最多 150 原子的 MOF。
AI.motivation: 在全原子生成中，将生成模型扩展到金属有机框架（MOF）等大体系十分困难。作者将此困难归结为粒子空间生成的"对应问题"：即使目标集合固定，索引无关的置换等变粒子流在集合规模与密度增大时，需要显著更多训练才能可靠生成，且该现象在独立耦合与最优传输耦合下均存在。因此需要一种不依赖原子级对应关系的生成范式。
AI.method: 提出 GLASS（Global Latent Aggregation with Slot-based Set Decoding）。其做法是：用置换不变的全局部潜空间编码结构，并通过流匹配（flow matching）学习其分布；再以可学习的槽（slot）解码器并行构造所有原子，从而将原子级对应关系从生成式传输过程中移除。训练/评估在 MP20 与 QMOF 子集上开展，不使用构筑单元、拓扑或组分作为条件。
AI.result: 在 MP20 上，GLASS 与粒子空间模型性能相当，且流训练在每个结构尺寸上都能达到训练数据的有效性；在 QMOF 子集上，可无条件下生成每晶胞最多 150 原子的 MOF，结构有效性接近训练数据。两个数据集上流训练均呈现有效性—新颖性权衡，且 MOF 的新颖性受限于自编码器在现有数据上的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 将对应关系分配与生成式传输分离，为高有效性生成更大原子体系提供了一条简洁路径；同时指出潜空间自编码器泛化是提升 MOF 新颖性的主要瓶颈。

title: The Vote Hides the Failure: Aggregation Choice and Noise Robustness in Heart Murmur Detection
summary: Noise robustness in automated phonocardiogram (PCG) murmur detection, and how it is measured, remains underexamined despite growing interest in low-resource screening. We evaluate two independently reimplemented pipelines, Hierarchical Multi-Scale Convolutional Network (HMS-Net)--CNN, and Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (BiLSTM)--LSTM, under controlled, multi-severity noise with noise-augmented fine-tuning and held-out generalization testing. Under matched aggregation, the complete BiLSTM pipeline outperforms the complete HMS-Net pipeline across all conditions in accuracy and Weighted Accuracy. A stable aggregate accuracy score can misrepresent what individual predictions show: HMS-Net's native aggregation degrades under salt-and-pepper noise far less than majority-vote (MV) aggregation at the same severity, a gap reflecting window-level disagreement its native rule absorbs, while BiLSTM's MV accuracy rises after noise-augmented training even though its individual predictions do not improve. HMS-Net's training effect is significant under one accuracy metric but not another. Noise-robustness conclusions can depend as much on evaluation choices as on the models themselves.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了HMS-Net（CNN）与BiLSTM（LSTM）两条独立复现的PCG杂音检测流程在多严重程度噪声下的鲁棒性，发现噪声鲁棒性结论高度依赖评估选择（聚合方式、准确率指标），而非仅由模型本身决定。
AI.motivation: 低资源筛查中PCG自动杂音检测的噪声鲁棒性及其度量方式尚未得到充分研究，因此需要系统评估模型在受控噪声条件下的表现并厘清评估方法对结论的影响。
AI.method: 在受控的多严重程度噪声下，对两条独立复现的流程——HMS-Net（CNN）与BiLSTM（LSTM）——进行噪声增强微调与留出泛化测试，并对比不同聚合方式（原生聚合 vs. 多数投票MV）与不同准确率指标（Accuracy与Weighted Accuracy）。
AI.result: 在匹配聚合下，完整BiLSTM流程在所有条件下的Accuracy与Weighted Accuracy均优于完整HMS-Net流程；但HMS-Net的原生聚合在椒盐噪声下退化远小于同严重度下的MV聚合（差距源于原生规则可吸收的窗口级分歧）；BiLSTM的MV准确率在噪声增强训练后上升，尽管其单窗预测并未改善；HMS-Net的训练效应在一种准确率指标下显著、在另一种下不显著。
AI.conclusion: 稳定的聚合准确率分数可能掩盖单个预测的真实表现，噪声鲁棒性的结论可能同样取决于评估选择（聚合规则、评价指标），而非仅取决于模型本身。

title: Trajectory Soup: Pushing the Compute-Scaling Frontier of LLM Mid-training via Diverse Trajectories
summary: Mid-training equips pretrained large language models with specialized and reasoning capabilities, but the returns of this stage are bounded since additional serial compute yields little further downstream improvement and can even degrade some capabilities, which places a practical ceiling on how much compute mid-training absorbs. We revisit how this compute should be allocated to a single run or multiple similar optimizations. We find that branches forked from a shared checkpoint under various controlled recipe reaches measurably different regions of parameter space, and establish a form of compatible diversity that extending one run cannot supply. Therefore, we introduce Trajectory Soup, which distributes a mid-training budget over several independent branches, and consolidates strongest checkpoints selected on validation through intra- and inter-trajectory averaging into a single model. A local bias and variance analysis separates the two averaging levels, showing that inter-trajectory averaging removes residual error beyond the reach of averaging within a trajectory, while checkpoint selection carries a bias that bounds how many checkpoints are worth merging. Across model scales, learning-rate schedules, token budgets, and trajectory counts, Trajectory Soup improves aggregate downstream performance over the strongest single-trajectory average under matched budgets and keeps improving as budgets expand, with the advantage preserved after an identical post-training pipeline. These results position trajectory allocation and merging as a practical way to extend the compute-scaling frontier of mid-training beyond serial saturation.

AI.tldr: 提出 Trajectory Soup：将 mid-training 算力预算分配到多条从共享检查点分叉的独立轨迹，通过轨迹内与轨迹间平均合并最优检查点，突破串行训练的算力饱和上限。
AI.motivation: mid-training 能赋予预训练大模型专门化与推理能力，但该阶段收益受限：追加串行算力对下游提升甚微，甚至损害部分能力，形成实际算力天花板。需重新审视算力应如何分配。
AI.method: 发现在同一共享检查点下、受控配方分叉出的分支会到达参数空间的不同区域，存在扩展单条轨迹无法提供的"兼容多样性"。据此提出 Trajectory Soup：把 mid-training 预算分给多条独立分支，基于验证集挑选最强检查点，经轨迹内平均与轨迹间平均合并为单一模型。并用局部偏差-方差分析区分两级平均。
AI.result: 在多种模型规模、学习率调度、token 预算与轨迹数量下，匹配预算时 Trajectory Soup 的下游聚合性能优于最强单轨迹平均，且随预算扩大持续提升，经相同后训练流程后优势仍保持。
AI.conclusion: 轨迹分配与合并是突破 mid-training 串行饱和、扩展其算力缩放前沿的实用途径。偏差-方差分析表明轨迹间平均可消除轨迹内平均无法触及的残差误差，而检查点选择带来的偏差限制了可合并检查点数量。

title: Interpolated Policy Distillation: A Controllable Continuum Between Off-Policy and On-Policy Distillation
summary: Off-policy and on-policy distillation have traditionally been formulated as separate paradigms, each favoring a different property of distillation trajectories. Teacher-generated (off-policy) traces are typically high-quality but lie far from the student's distribution, whereas student-generated (on-policy) rollouts are more learnable but often contain erroneous reasoning. We view these paradigms as the endpoints of a policy continuum and posit that a more effective rollout policy may lie in between. We introduce \textbf{Interpolated Policy Distillation (IPD)}, which defines the next-token distribution at every decoding step as an explicit linear interpolation between the student and teacher distributions. The interpolation operates at the distribution level, token by token, and its coefficient provides direct control over the balance between trajectory quality and student learnability. Naively sampling from this policy would require sequentially querying the teacher at every token and is thus expensive. To make IPD practical, we accelerate it with a new speculative-decoding rule while exactly preserving the interpolated next-token distribution.At the trajectory level, the resulting rollouts naturally interleave student- and teacher-generated segments. Unlike recent heuristic segment-interleaving methods, however, this interleaving is induced by an exactly realized token-level interpolated policy rather than by hand-designed switching rules. Across text-only and multimodal reasoning benchmarks, IPD consistently outperforms both endpoint policies (SFT and OPD), their conventional two-stage combination (SFT-then-OPD), and recent heuristic segment-interleaving methods, demonstrating that token-level policy interpolation better balances trajectory quality and student learnability.

AI.tldr: 提出Interpolated Policy Distillation (IPD)，将教师（off-policy）与学生（on-policy）轨迹视为策略连续谱的两端，在token级分布上做线性插值，并用推测解码加速，在纯文本与多模态推理任务上超越SFT、OPD、两阶段SFT-then-OPD及启发式分段交织方法。
AI.motivation: off-policy蒸馏轨迹质量高但偏离学生分布，on-policy轨迹易学习但含错误推理，两种范式各有取舍，因此作者认为更优的rollout策略应位于两者之间。
AI.method: IPD在每个解码步将下一token分布定义为学生分布与教师分布的显式线性插值，插值系数直接控制轨迹质量与学生可学习性的平衡；由于朴素采样需逐token查询教师，代价高，作者提出新的推测解码规则在精确保持插值分布的前提下加速，得到的轨迹自然交织学生与教师生成片段（由精确实现的token级插值策略诱导，而非手工切换规则）。
AI.result: 在纯文本与多模态推理基准上，IPD一致优于两端策略（SFT与OPD）、其常规两阶段组合（SFT-then-OPD）以及近期启发式分段交织方法。
AI.conclusion: token级策略插值能更好地平衡轨迹质量与学生可学习性。

title: Corruption-Robust Sparse Linear Contextual Bandits with Knapsack Constraints
summary: We study sparse linear contextual bandits with knapsack constraints under joint reward and consumption corruption. Consumption corruption creates a challenge beyond corrupted rewards: it affects not only statistical estimates, but also the recorded budget, resource prices, and stopping decisions that govern future allocation. We develop Robust Optimistic Primal--Dual (ROPD), an estimator-modular framework that combines corruption-aware confidence widths with online resource prices and a budget-safety rule. With concrete sparse implementation, ROPD achieves regret against a clean population-LP benchmark of $\widetilde O(T^{2/3}+ΓT^{1/3})$ under forced exploration and population-design coverage, and $\widetilde O(\sqrt T+Γ)$ under on-policy realized-design coverage, for a supplied valid corruption bound $Γ$ under the stated proportional-budget scaling and fixed model/design parameters. When the corruption level is unknown, Shared-Grid adapts confidence radii around common point estimates fitted to a single realized history, incurring explicit initialization and master-comparison costs; its sharper on-policy guarantee additionally requires recommendation coverage. Both methods preserve observed budgets on every realization and bound clean resource violation by cumulative consumption corruption. These results connect corruption-robust sparse estimation with resource accounting, pricing, and stopping in high-dimensional online allocation.

AI.tldr: 研究奖励与消耗同时被污染的稀疏线性上下文老虎机背包问题，提出ROPD估计器模块化框架及Shared-Grid自适应方法。
AI.motivation: 消耗污染不仅影响统计估计，还影响已记录预算、资源价格与停止决策，进而干扰未来资源配置，这是仅考虑奖励污染所无法涵盖的额外挑战。
AI.method: 提出Robust Optimistic Primal-Dual（ROPD）：结合污染感知置信宽度、在线资源价格和预算安全规则；给出稀疏实现。未知污染水平时提出Shared-Grid，围绕单一实现历史拟合的公共点估计自适应调整置信半径。
AI.result: 在强制探索和population-design覆盖率下，ROPD对干净population-LP基准的遗憾界为Õ(T^{2/3}+ΓT^{1/3})；在on-policy realized-design覆盖率下为Õ(√T+Γ)。Shared-Grid引入显式初始化与master-comparison成本，其更紧的on-policy保证额外需要推荐覆盖率。两种方法在每个实现上保持观测预算，并将干净资源违规限制在累计消耗污染范围内。
AI.conclusion: 将污染鲁棒稀疏估计与高维在线分配中的资源核算、定价和停止决策相连接。

title: Explainable Machine Learning for Multilayer Planar Winding Inductance Estimation
summary: Rapid and accurate self-inductance estimation for multilayer rectangle-shaped planar windings is essential for modern high-frequency power converters, yet traditional workflows rely on complex mathematical equations, rigid monomial formulas or unexplainable black-box machine learning (ML) models that degrade severely outside their training domain. This paper introduces an explainable ML framework unifying post-hoc feature attribution (SHAP and permutation importance) with Kolmogorov-Arnold Network-guided symbolic regression via the SR-KAN framework to discover closed-form analytical equations without prior structural assumptions. Evaluated on a new open-source dataset of over 10,000 Finite Element Analysis (FEA) simulations across seven out-of-distribution (OOD) classes, standard tree-based ensembles exhibit severe extrapolation errors (> 36%), whereas the unconstrained SR-KAN expression achieves a robust OOD relative error of 8.22%. Experimental verification across 55 physical printed circuit board prototypes (up to 8 layers, with inductances from 4.11 μH to 559.27 μH) confirms that the KAN-discovered expression translates effectively to real-world hardware, predicting inductance with a mean absolute relative error of 6.26%. To support reproducible research, the complete FEA simulation dataset and prototype measurements are released open-source.

AI.tldr: 提出可解释ML框架，结合SHAP/置换重要性与SR-KAN符号回归，从FEA数据中发现多层矩形平面绕组自感闭式公式，OOD误差8.22%，55个PCB样机实测平均相对误差6.26%。
AI.motivation: 快速准确估计多层矩形平面绕组自感对高频功率变换器至关重要；传统方法依赖复杂数学方程、刚性单项式公式或不可解释的黑盒ML模型，后者在训练域外性能严重退化。
AI.method: 构建可解释ML框架：将事后特征归因（SHAP与置换重要性）与基于Kolmogorov-Arnold网络的符号回归（SR-KAN）统一，无需先验结构假设即可发现闭式解析方程；并新建含超10,000次FEA仿真、覆盖7类OOD的开源数据集。
AI.result: 标准树集成模型外推误差超36%，无约束SR-KAN表达式OOD相对误差仅8.22%；55个PCB样机（最多8层，电感4.11–559.27 μH）实测平均绝对相对误差6.26%；FEA数据集与测量数据已开源。
AI.conclusion: SHAP与置换重要性指导的SR-KAN可发现兼具精度与可解释性的闭式自感公式，在OOD外推与真实硬件上均优于黑盒模型，并具备可复现性。

title: Differentiating Bisimulation Metrics: A Framework for Parametric Markov Chain Fitting via Bicausal Optimal Transport
summary: Many problems in sequential decision-making, such as imitation learning from observations, state-space compression, world-model learning, and sim-to-real transfer, can be reduced to learning a model such that a notion of distance with respect to the target process is minimized. We consider this general framework and consider the bisimulation metric, equivalently Bicausal Optimal Transport (BOT), as the notion of distance to minimize. We show that BOT, since it can be formulated as a linear program (LP), is differentiable with respect to the model dynamics. We then derive an exact closed-form gradient via the envelope theorem applied to the LP saddle point. The result is a general algorithm, Differentiable Bicausal Optimal Transport (D-BOT), that can be applied to each of the problems above. The proposed algorithm learns the best model by alternating between distance computation and gradient steps. We apply D-BOT for three different settings: state-space compression, parametric model learning, and imitation learning from observations (ILfO). We show empirical results that confirm the viability of all three instantiations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出D-BOT算法，将双因果最优传输（BOT）作为可微距离度量，通过对LP鞍点应用包络定理推导精确闭式梯度，统一解决状态压缩、参数化模型学习与模仿学习三类序贯决策问题。
AI.motivation: 模仿学习、状态空间压缩、世界模型学习、仿真到现实迁移等序贯决策问题，都可归约为学习一个模型，使相对于目标过程的某种距离最小。作者希望找到一个通用的距离度量与可微优化框架，统一处理上述问题。
AI.method: 以bisimulation metric（等价于Bicausal Optimal Transport, BOT）作为最小化的距离。由于BOT可表述为线性规划（LP），故对模型动力学可微。作者对LP的鞍点应用包络定理（envelope theorem），推导出精确的闭式梯度，形成通用算法D-BOT：在距离计算与梯度步之间交替迭代以学习最优模型。
AI.result: 将D-BOT应用于三种设定：状态空间压缩、参数化模型学习、基于观测的模仿学习（ILfO）。实验结果验证了这三种实例的可行性。
AI.conclusion: BOT作为可微距离度量可通过包络定理获得精确闭式梯度，D-BOT为多个序贯决策问题提供了统一的、经验可行的算法框架。

title: Trident: Unifying Guarded Dispatch and Host Execution for PyTorch Triton Workloads
summary: User-written Triton kernels enable high-performance GPU computation within PyTorch, but their end-to-end latency can remain dominated by host-side orchestration, especially when device execution is short. Although torch.compile can generate native host wrappers for captured graphs, each invocation still passes through runtime-managed specialization lookup, guard evaluation, and preparation before reaching the wrapper. We present Trident, a compiler backend that removes this recurring overhead from the specialization cache-hit path. Trident introduces the Specialization Cache Module (SCM), which compiles guarded specialization selection, argument and execution-environment preparation, and host execution for multiple specializations into a single executable module. An invocation enters the SCM once, remains in compiled code when a specialization matches, and returns to Python only when a new specialization must be compiled. Built on Torch-MLIR, Trident lowers guards and host-side orchestration to native code while retaining calls to optimized runtime implementations of supported ATen operators. Our evalu- ation on two LLMs shows that Trident achieves up to a 1.47x speedup in model-level end-to-end latency over eager execution and up to 1.68x over torch.compile.

AI.tldr: Trident 是一种编译器后端，通过 Specialization Cache Module（SCM）将受守卫的特化选择、参数与环境准备及宿主执行编译为单一可执行模块，消除特化缓存命中路径上的重复开销，在 LLM 端到端延迟上相比 eager 最高加速 1.47x、相比 torch.compile 最高加速 1.68x。
AI.motivation: 用户手写的 Triton 内核虽能在 PyTorch 中实现高性能 GPU 计算，但当设备执行时间较短时，端到端延迟仍主要由宿主侧编排主导。尽管 torch.compile 能为捕获的计算图生成原生宿主包装器，每次调用仍要经过运行时管理的特化查找、守卫求值与准备工作，这些重复开销未被消除。
AI.method: Trident 引入 Specialization Cache Module（SCM），将针对多个特化的守卫式特化选择、参数与执行环境准备以及宿主执行编译为单个可执行模块。调用只进入 SCM 一次；当特化匹配时始终停留在编译代码中，只有当需要编译新特化时才返回 Python。Trident 基于 Torch-MLIR，将守卫和宿主侧编排下沉为原生代码，同时保留对受支持 ATen 算子的优化运行时实现的调用。
AI.result: 在两个 LLM 上的评测表明，Trident 在模型级端到端延迟上相比 eager 执行最高取得 1.47x 加速，相比 torch.compile 最高取得 1.68x 加速。
AI.conclusion: Trident 从特化缓存命中路径上移除了反复出现的宿主侧编排开销，使匹配特化时的执行完全停留在编译代码中，从而显著降低端到端延迟，验证了将守卫与宿主编排向下编译为原生代码的有效性。

title: Loss-Guided Pretraining Data Selection for Time-Series Foundation Models
summary: Time series foundation models (TSFMs) are pretrained on heterogeneous collections containing billions of observations, yet their training windows are typically sampled without estimating whether they provide useful learning signal. We introduce a static data-selection framework that scores each window with a reference forecaster and retains an intermediate interval within every source dataset. Specifically, we connect forecasting loss to optimization difficulty by showing that normalized squared loss controls the per-sample gradient norm under a local Jacobian condition. We then define a reference loss score and apply dataset-stratified selection to preserve the diversity of samples. Across various TSFM architectures, our method outperforms random selection by an absolute margin and even improves both relative MASE and CRPS over full-data pretraining by retaining fewer candidate pretraining windows. Further analyses show strong cross-scale and cross-architecture score correlations, indicating that a small reference model can often select data for larger targets, provided that the reference and target share compatible difficulty orderings.

AI.tldr: 提出静态数据选择框架：用参考预测器的归一化平方损失为每个时间窗打分，按数据集分层保留中间区间样本，用于TSFM预训练。
AI.motivation: TSFM在数十亿观测的异构数据上预训练，但训练窗口通常随机采样，未评估其是否提供有效学习信号，存在低效与冗余。
AI.method: 从理论上将预测损失与优化难度关联：在局部雅可比条件下证明归一化平方损失可控制每样本梯度范数；据此定义参考损失分数，并采用数据集分层选择以保持样本多样性。
AI.result: 在多种TSFM架构上，方法以绝对优势优于随机选择；且仅保留更少的候选预训练窗口，即可在相对MASE与CRPS上超过全量数据预训练。分数在跨尺度与跨架构间呈强相关性。
AI.conclusion: 预训练窗口选择可带来双重收益：性能提升与数据量缩减。若参考模型与目标模型难度排序兼容，小参考模型即可为大模型挑选数据。

title: Efficiently Approximating Attention Is Hard
summary: Softmax attention is ubiquitous in modern machine learning, but its quadratic scaling with sequence length makes it costly. To reduce this cost, attention is often approximated with fast algorithms, which incur error but can still perform well in practice and on some inputs. At the same time, the growing diversity of attention applications makes approximation guarantees that do not depend on particular input structure a compelling target. For such uniform guarantees over all inputs, known runtime lower bounds rule out fast algorithms for near-exact attention, but leave open the practically important regime: is there an efficient algorithm with even a modest uniform approximation guarantee? We answer this question negatively. Under standard complexity-theoretic assumptions, no truly subquadratic algorithm can approximate attention with any nontrivial additive or relative guarantee uniformly over all inputs. This impossibility holds in the mildest parameter regime for which known algorithms do not already achieve strong approximation guarantees in near-linear time, and extends to practically relevant relaxations: even after polynomial preprocessing of the KV cache, no efficient algorithm can obtain a nontrivial uniform approximation guarantee, or identify a small set of keys receiving substantial attention under sparsity. Overall, our results settle the computational limits of uniform attention approximation.

AI.tldr: 本文通过复杂性理论下界证明：在所有输入上具有一致（uniform）近似保证的快速注意力算法不存在。
AI.motivation: Softmax 注意力的计算量随序列长度呈二次增长，代价高昂。已有快速近似算法虽有误差，但在实践中（及特定输入上）表现良好。由于注意力应用日益多样，不依赖特定输入结构的一致性近似保证成为有价值的目标。已知的运行时下界排除了近精确注意力的快速算法，但留下一个关键开放问题：是否存在具有哪怕适度一致性近似保证的高效算法？
AI.method: 采用复杂性理论方法，在标准复杂性假设下建立运行时下界，证明不存在真正次二次（subquadratic）的算法能在所有输入上一致地近似注意力。
AI.result: 在标准复杂性假设下，没有任何真正次二次算法能在所有输入上以任何非平凡的加性或相对保证一致地近似注意力。该不可能性结果在已知算法尚不能近线性时间内达到强近似保证的最温和参数区间内即已成立，并延伸到实际相关的松弛情形：即使对 KV cache 进行多项式时间预处理，也不存在高效算法能获得非平凡的一致近似保证，或在稀疏性下识别出获得显著注意力的小规模键集合。
AI.conclusion: 上述结果确立了统一（一致）注意力近似的计算极限，即该类问题不存在高效算法。

title: Scaling Full Conformal Image Classifiers
summary: Conformal prediction provides set-valued predictions with distribution-free coverage guarantees, making it attractive for high-stakes image classification. However, split conformal prediction is data-inefficient, while full conformal prediction (FCP), despite its stronger statistical efficiency, is computationally prohibitive at scale because it requires candidate-specific model refits at test time. We address this limitation by leveraging zero-shot vision-language models (VLMs) to guide scalable FCP in large label spaces. We introduce Targeted Full Conformal Prediction (T-FCP), which uses a lightweight inductive conformal predictor to prune unlikely labels and applies FCP only to the remaining candidates, reducing computation while retaining the formal guarantee of the combined conformal procedure. We further propose Stabilized Online LDA (SO-LDA), an efficient VLM adaptation solver based on rank-one inverse-covariance updates. Across multiple benchmarks, including ImageNet, T-FCP enables practical full-conformal image classification with modest test-time overhead, yielding efficient prediction sets and more stable empirical coverage than split conformal alternatives.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出T-FCP，用零样本视觉语言模型引导大规模标签空间下的全共形预测，通过剪枝候选标签降低计算开销，并保留共形覆盖保证。
AI.motivation: 共形预测可为图像分类提供具有分布无关覆盖保证的集合预测，适用于高风险场景。但split conformal数据效率低，full conformal（FCP）虽统计效率更高，却因测试时需对每个候选标签重新拟合模型而在大规模场景下计算不可行。
AI.method: 提出Targeted Full Conformal Prediction（T-FCP）：先用轻量级归纳共形预测器剪除不太可能的标签，仅对剩余候选应用FCP，在降低计算量的同时保留组合共形流程的形式化保证。同时提出Stabilized Online LDA（SO-LDA），一种基于秩一逆协方差更新的高效视觉语言模型适配求解器。
AI.result: 在包括ImageNet在内的多个基准上，T-FCP以适度的测试时开销实现了实用的全共形图像分类，产生高效的预测集，并相比split conformal替代方案具有更稳定的经验覆盖率。
AI.conclusion: 通过零样本视觉语言模型引导候选剪枝，T-FCP使全共形预测在大标签空间图像分类中变得可行，兼顾计算效率、预测集紧凑性与覆盖稳定性。

title: Hidden Reasoning Must Leak, but Need Not Be Readable: Fundamental Opportunities and Limits for Chain-of-Thought Monitoring
summary: Can reasoning models trick chain of thought (CoT) monitors and perform hidden computation without revealing it in their thinking traces? We show that the answer depends on the underlying task difficulty and the model size. Simple computations can be performed covertly; however, beyond a threshold depending on model size, successfully solving the task necessarily leaks a near-linear amount of information about the covert task input into the CoT. Therefore, sufficiently complex hidden computation always leaves an information-theoretic footprint. However, concerningly, this leakage need not be readable: Under plausible cryptographic assumptions, even a one-layer Transformer can encrypt its reasoning online so that no polynomial-time monitor can extract information about the hidden computation. Overall, our theoretical and empirical results provide a holistic view of both the opportunities and the limitations of CoT monitoring.

AI.tldr: 本文研究推理模型能否在思维链（CoT）监控下进行隐藏计算。结论是：简单计算可隐蔽完成，但超过与模型规模相关的难度阈值后，解题必然向CoT泄漏近线性量级的输入信息，因此复杂隐藏计算总会留下信息论痕迹；然而在密码学假设下，这种泄漏可能不可读——即使单层Transformer也能在线加密其推理，使多项式时间监控者无法提取隐藏计算信息。
AI.motivation: CoT监控被视为监督推理模型的重要安全手段，但推理模型是否能在不暴露思考过程的情况下完成隐藏计算尚不明确。作者希望从理论上刻画CoT监控的机会与局限，回答隐蔽计算在何种条件下可行、在何种条件下必然暴露。
AI.method: 采用理论与实证相结合的方法，分析任务难度与模型规模对隐蔽计算可行性的影响；通过信息论下界刻画隐蔽任务输入向CoT的泄漏量，并结合密码学假设构造使泄漏不可读的加密推理机制，包括单层Transformer的在线加密方案。
AI.result: 简单计算可以被隐蔽执行；当任务复杂度超过依赖模型规模的阈值时，成功求解必然向CoT泄漏关于隐藏任务输入的近线性信息量，形成信息论footprint；但在合理密码学假设下，该泄漏不必可读，即使单层Transformer也能在线加密推理，使任何多项式时间监控者都无法提取隐藏计算的信息。
AI.conclusion: CoT监控既有机会也有局限：复杂隐藏计算无法在信息论意义上完全隐匿，但泄漏未必可被有效读取。这为评估和设计CoT监控机制提供了整体性视角，提示监控的有效性依赖于计算复杂度与密码学层面的条件。

title: Parallel Tempering for Diffusion-Based Combinatorial Optimization
summary: Discrete diffusion models have emerged as a powerful paradigm for solving combinatorial optimization (CO) problems on graphs by learning to sample high-quality solutions. A common inference-time approach is to generate multiple candidate solutions independently and return the best-performing sample, improving solution quality at the expense of an increase in computational cost. In this work, we introduce PT-Denoise, an inference-time procedure that allows these concurrent denoising trajectories to interact through parallel tempering, without requiring retraining or fine-tuning of the underlying denoiser.
