Our method assigns a temperature to each diffusion process and allows processes to swap temperatures based on their relative performance. This dynamically reallocates promising, low-energy trajectories to colder, more concentrated sampling regimes while allowing higher-energy states to escape local minima through randomized exploration. Experiments on canonical graph-structured CO problems show that our approach consistently improves the quality of the best solution found, while only adding minimal computational overhead.

AI.tldr: PT-Denoise：一种推理时并行退火方法，让离散扩散模型的多条去噪轨迹通过温度交换交互，无需重训练即可提升组合优化的最佳解质量。
AI.motivation: 离散扩散模型在图上组合优化中常用“独立多采样取最优”的推理策略，质量提升依赖增加计算开销，但样本间缺乏信息交互，效率有限。
AI.method: 为每条并行去噪轨迹分配不同温度，依据相对表现进行温度交换（parallel tempering）；低温轨迹聚焦低能量区域，高温轨迹通过随机探索逃离局部极小；全程不重训练、不微调去噪器。
AI.result: 在经典图结构组合优化问题上的实验表明，方法持续提升最优解质量，且计算开销增加极小。
AI.conclusion: 通过并行退火耦合多条去噪轨迹，可在几乎不增加成本的情况下显著增强离散扩散模型的组合优化求解能力，是一种通用、轻量的推理时增强方案。

title: Port-Hamiltonian Latent Deliberation: Mitigating the Deliberation Drift Cliff in Test-Time Compute Scaling
comment: 10 pages, 1 figure, 4 tables. Code and evaluation artifacts available
summary: Test-time compute scaling has emerged as a cornerstone of advanced machine reasoning, yet performing iterative deliberation directly within continuous latent representation spaces reveals a catastrophic pathology: the Deliberation Drift Cliff. While unconstrained recurrent latent models achieve initial reasoning gains at short horizons (K <= 4), their reasoning collapses when extrapolated to deeper thinking steps (K >= 16), dropping by 22% to 62% across standard logical benchmarks. We resolve the trilemma among expressivity, Lyapunov stability, and computational efficiency in test-time latent reasoning through a 22-round empirical and theoretical investigation. We demonstrate that strictly conservative scalar potential gradient flows suppress long-range drift (cliff 3.40%) but bottleneck peak reasoning accuracy at 32.73%, whereas unconstrained rotational flows achieve high symbolic expressivity (82.33%) but suffer a severe 36.87% drift cliff. To resolve this geometric duality, we establish Port-Hamiltonian Latent Deliberation (PH-LD) and propose the Direct-Gradient Pure-Tensor Helmholtz-Hodge Decomposition (DG-HHD). DG-HHD parameterizes the attracting flow as a tangent projection tensor network while orthogonally decoupling non-zero circulation (Hodge machine error 1.65e-17, contraction error 5.55e-17), eliminating runtime autograd dependencies to achieve 1.84x vector field and 2.09x RK45 rollout speedups. In a 15-arm symmetrical Pareto benchmark, DG-HHD achieves 58.67% peak accuracy (+25.94% absolute gain over conservative HHD) and retains 35.27% at K=32. Transferred to small language model (SLM) multi-hop causal reasoning, DG-HHD delivers monotonic compute scaling (49.33% to 51.56%) and suppresses out-of-distribution drift (cliff -0.66%). All 30 Level 0 deterministic invariants are certified.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对连续隐空间测试时推理中的“Deliberation Drift Cliff”问题，提出 Port-Hamiltonian Latent Deliberation (PH-LD) 框架及 DG-HHD 分解方法，在表达性、Lyapunov 稳定性与计算效率之间实现平衡，并取得显著精度与稳定性提升。
AI.motivation: 测试时计算扩展是高级机器推理的关键，但在连续隐表征空间中进行迭代 deliberaion 会出现灾难性病理：短视野（K≤4）有初步收益，深度思考（K≥16）时推理崩溃，标准逻辑基准上下降 22%–62%。核心矛盾是表达性、Lyapunov 稳定性与计算效率之间的三难困境。
AI.method: 通过 22 轮实证与理论研究，分析保守标量势梯度流与无约束旋转流的几何对偶性；建立 Port-Hamiltonian Latent Deliberation (PH-LD)，并提出 Direct-Gradient Pure-Tensor Helmholtz-Hodge Decomposition (DG-HHD)，将吸引流参数化为切空间投影张量网络，并正交解耦非零环流，消除运行时 autograd 依赖。
AI.result: 保守标量势梯度流将漂移悬崖抑制至 3.40%，但峰值精度仅 32.73%；无约束旋转流精度达 82.33%，但漂移悬崖达 36.87%。DG-HHD 实现 Hodge 机误差 1.65e-17、收缩误差 5.55e-17，向量场与 RK45 rollout 分别加速 1.84x 与 2.09x；在 15 臂对称 Pareto 基准上峰值精度 58.67%（较保守 HHD 绝对提升 25.94%），K=32 时保留 35.27%。迁移至 SLM 多跳因果推理后实现单调计算扩展（49.33%→51.56%），并抑制 OOD 漂移（悬崖 -0.66%），30 项 Level 0 确定性不变量全部通过认证。
AI.conclusion: DG-HHD 通过几何分解有效缓解连续隐空间迭代推理的漂移崩溃，兼顾表达性、稳定性与效率，并在逻辑基准与 SLM 多跳因果推理中验证了可扩展性与 OOD 鲁棒性。

title: Looped Transformers as Optimizers
summary: Looped Transformers provide a parameter-efficient approach to depth scaling by repeatedly applying shared Transformer blocks. Recent reasoning models have likewise highlighted the value of scaling test-time computation through longer computation trajectories. However, the principles for designing effective loop transitions remain poorly understood. We view the looped hidden state as a fast weight that is updated throughout the depth. We formulate loop transitions as local gradient-based updates, with recurrent blocks predicting implicit targets at each depth. Our framework derives loop transitions in closed form from a projection, a local objective and an optimizer update rule. Mapping representative loop transitions into this framework reveals mismatches between their transitions and projections. We first align the input maps of existing transitions. We then derive OperLoop, which combines explicit weight decay, adaptive step size and a delta objective. The aligned variants reduce training loss and improve average commonsense accuracy. OperLoop improves average generative performance over the compared looped and non-looped baselines under matched training FLOPs. These results support the framework's usefulness for loop design. We extend the analysis to additional loop models and outline a roadmap for future loop transition design.

AI.tldr: 该论文将循环Transformer的循环隐状态视为随深度更新的“快权重”，把循环转移表述为基于局部梯度的更新，用投影、局部目标与优化器更新规则闭式推导循环转移，并据此提出OperLoop。
AI.motivation: 循环Transformer通过重复使用共享块实现参数高效的深度扩展，近期推理模型也强调测试时更长计算轨迹的价值，但如何设计有效的循环转移（loop transition）仍缺乏清晰原理。
AI.method: 把循环隐状态视为贯穿深度更新的快权重，将循环转移形式化为局部梯度更新，循环块在各深度预测隐式目标；由投影、局部目标与优化器更新规则闭式导出循环转移。据此分析代表性循环转移，发现其转移与投影不匹配，先对齐现有转移的输入映射，再推导出结合显式权重衰减、自适应步长与delta目标的OperLoop。
AI.result: 对齐后的变体降低了训练损失并提升平均常识准确率；在匹配训练FLOPs下，OperLoop相比对比的循环与非循环基线提升了平均生成性能；分析还扩展到更多循环模型。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持该框架对循环设计的有效性，并给出了未来循环转移设计的研究路线图。

title: MoTIF-X: A Multimodal Tokenized Framework for Interpretable and Extensible Molecular Representation Learning
comment: 5 figures. Supplementary material is available as an ancillary file. Code: https://github.com/Bin-Chen-Lab/Motif-X
summary:
Molecular representation learning is central to computer-aided drug discovery. Molecular graphs, SMILES strings, and 3D conformations provide complementary structural information, yet many multimodal approaches encode these views independently and align them only at a later stage, limiting fine-grained cross-modal interaction and substructure-level interpretability. To address these limitations, we introduce MoTIF-X, a motif-centered framework that uses graph-grounded chemical motifs as shared anchors for multimodal integration and interpretation. Its first pretraining stage learns motif representations through hierarchical contrastive learning across atomic, motif, and molecular scales. The second stage contextualizes these representations with SMILES and torsion-angle tokens through multimodal masked token modeling.
  After pretraining on drug-like molecules with multiple conformers, MoTIF-X achieved the lowest mean absolute error on all nine OpenADMET ExpansionRx endpoints and the best overall performance among the evaluated methods. Significance analyses supported its advantage in the vast majority of endpoint-baseline comparisons after multiple-testing correction. Ablation studies supported the complementary contributions of motif-token contextualization, multimodal integration, and two-stage pretraining. Beyond molecular properties, the framework extended to drug-target interaction prediction, achieving the best average classification performance across the evaluated benchmarks and generalizing to an external drug-cold-start dataset without additional fine-tuning. Its motif-centered design also enabled substructure-level interpretation: higher motif attribution scores were associated with larger experimentally measured activity shifts. Together, these findings support MoTIF-X as a transferable and interpretable framework for molecular modeling.

AI.tldr: MoTIF-X是一个以化学基序（motif）为中心的多模态分子表示学习框架，通过两阶段预训练实现跨原子-基序-分子尺度的表示学习，在分子性质预测与药物-靶标相互作用预测上取得最优性能，并支持亚结构级可解释性。
AI.motivation: 分子图、SMILES字符串和3D构象提供互补的结构信息，但现有多模态方法通常对各视图独立编码、仅在后期进行对齐，限制了细粒度的跨模态交互与亚结构级可解释性。
AI.method: MoTIF-X以图接地的化学基序作为多模态整合与解释的共享锚点。第一阶段通过原子、基序、分子三个尺度的层次化对比学习获得基序表示；第二阶段以SMILES与扭转角token进行多模态掩码token建模，对基序表示进行上下文化。预训练使用类药分子及多构象数据。
AI.result: 在OpenADMET ExpansionRx全部九个终点上取得最低平均绝对误差，整体性能优于对比方法；显著性分析支持其在绝大多数终点-基线比较中的优势。消融实验验证了基序token上下文化、多模态整合与两阶段预训练各自的互补贡献。框架扩展至药物-靶标相互作用预测，在评测基准上取得最佳平均分类性能，并在外部drug-cold-start数据集上无需额外微调即可泛化。基序归因分数越高，对应实验测得的活性变化越大，实现亚结构级解释。
AI.conclusion: MoTIF-X是一个可迁移、可解释的分子建模框架，其以基序为中心的设计在分子性质预测、药物-靶标相互作用预测及亚结构级解释方面均表现优异。

title: Rethinking Soft Tokens for Parallel Decoding in Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion language models (DLMs) enable parallel generation by predicting and committing multiple tokens at each denoising step, yet they can generate individually plausible but mutually inconsistent tokens. Recent work shows that \emph{soft tokens} can mitigate this issue by representing uncertain positions with continuous embeddings built from the model's predictive distribution at the previous decoding step. However, although soft tokens are commonly understood as preserving predictive uncertainty, how soft-token feedback improves parallel decoding has not been systematically examined. In this paper, we investigate this question in frozen pretrained DLMs to examine soft-token feedback without the effects of additional training. To construct soft-token inputs in a training-free setting, we identify a geometric mismatch between conventional soft-token construction and the pretrained embedding space. Based on this observation, we propose a training-free, geometry-aware construction of soft tokens. Our analysis of soft-token feedback suggests that uncertainty preservation alone does not fully explain how it reshapes subsequent predictions. To better explain how soft-token feedback improves parallel decoding, we provide empirical evidence that it favors coherent token sequences. Across four pretrained DLMs and four math and code benchmarks, our method outperforms standard parallel decoding and a training-free Euclidean soft-token baseline. Code: https://github.com/kodaikawamura/rethinking-soft-tokens

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了扩散语言模型（DLM）中软token反馈如何改善并行解码，提出一种免训练、几何感知的软token构造方法，并发现软token的作用不仅是保留预测不确定性，还能促进连贯的token序列生成。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型在并行生成时，每步会预测并提交多个token，容易产生各自合理但彼此不一致的token。已有工作表明软token（soft tokens）能通过连续嵌入缓解该问题，但软token反馈为何能改善并行解码尚缺乏系统性的分析。本文旨在冻结的预训练DLM上排除额外训练影响，深入探究这一问题。
AI.method: 1）在免训练设定下构造软token输入，识别出常规软token构造与预训练嵌入空间之间的几何不匹配；2）据此提出免训练、几何感知的软token构造方法；3）在冻结的预训练DLM上系统分析软token反馈对后续预测的影响。
AI.result: 分析表明，仅用“保留不确定性”不足以解释软token反馈如何重塑后续预测。实证证据显示，软token反馈有助于生成更连贯的token序列。在四个预训练DLM和四个数学与代码基准上，该方法优于标准并行解码及免训练的欧氏软token基线。
AI.conclusion: 软token反馈提升并行解码的机制不仅在于保留预测不确定性，更在于其倾向于产生连贯的token序列。所提出的几何感知软token构造在多个预训练DLM和基准上取得了更优效果，为理解并改进扩散语言模型的并行解码提供了新视角。

title: Learning Macroscopic Dynamics without Reconstructing Microscopic States
summary: Modeling the temporal evolution of macroscopic properties of complex systems is an important scientific task. To predict this evolution without full microscopic simulation, a common approach encodes microstates into compact latent states, learns their evolution, and reads out macroscopic predictions from the latent trajectory. These latent states are often learned through microstate reconstruction. However, with limited latent capacity, reconstruction can favor high-variance microscopic details over information needed for macroscopic prediction. Yet jointly learning latent states and their transition without reconstruction often fails to obtain latent dynamics that support accurate macroscopic prediction. We show that this failure can arise from latent scale collapse: shrinking the latent state scale reduces training loss while macroscopic evolution error remains large. Here, we propose a reconstruction-free framework to learn latent states with their dynamics for prescribed macroscopic prediction. Training alternates between updating the latent representation with the transition and next-state latent targets fixed, and updating the transition with the latent representation fixed. At inference, the trained model predicts macroscopic states recursively from an initial microstate. Our theoretical analysis characterizes reconstruction misalignment and scale collapse under joint training, and gives a sufficient condition for local convergence to correct latent dynamics for our method. Experiments on epidemic spreading on a lattice, mixing of two particle species, and polymer stretching demonstrate that the proposed method achieves substantially better macroscopic prediction over baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种无需重构的框架，用于为指定的宏观预测任务联合学习微观状态的紧致隐表示及其动力学演化，避免了重构偏好高方差微观细节以及隐尺度坍塌问题。
AI.motivation: 在无需完整微观模拟的前提下预测复杂系统宏观性质的演化，通常需要将微观状态编码为紧致隐状态、学习其演化并读出宏观预测。现有方法多用微观重构来学习隐状态，但在隐容量有限时，重构会偏向高方差的微观细节，而忽略宏观预测所需的信息；而直接联合学习隐状态与转移、不做重构，又往往无法获得支持准确宏观预测的隐动力学。作者指出这一失败源于"隐尺度坍塌"：缩小隐状态尺度可降低训练损失，但宏观演化误差仍然很大。
AI.method: 提出一种无重构框架，直接以规定的宏观预测为目标学习隐状态及其动力学。训练交替进行：固定转移与下一状态隐目标，更新隐表示；再固定隐表示，更新转移。推理时，训练好的模型从初始微观状态递归预测宏观状态。理论分析刻画了联合训练下的重构错位与尺度坍塌，并给出方法局部收敛到正确隐动力学的充分条件。
AI.result: 在晶格上的流行病传播、两种粒子混合以及聚合物拉伸三个任务上，所提方法在宏观预测上显著优于基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 以指定宏观预测为目标的交替训练可有效学习隐状态及其动力学，避免重构错位与隐尺度坍塌，从而在复杂系统宏观演化预测中取得更好表现。

title: Scale Sensitivity in Low-Bit Post-Training Quantization: Curvature of the Quantization Error Landscape
summary: Post-training quantization (PTQ) methods in the GPTQ family minimize a layer-wise reconstruction error on a uniform grid whose scale must be chosen; the common max-based choice degrades sharply at low bit-widths. We study how sensitive this objective is to the scale. For a layer with i.i.d. Gaussian weights and calibration activations of sufficiently large effective rank, we prove that, as the width grows, the normalized round-to-nearest loss converges with high probability, uniformly over all scales, to the mean-squared error of a uniform quantizer applied to a standard Gaussian; we verify the effective-rank condition for wide, randomly initialized MLPs with odd Lipschitz activations and isotropic Gaussian calibration data. The limiting objective has a unique nondegenerate minimizer, whose scale decreases strictly with the number of levels and whose curvature with respect to relative scale errors decays approximately exponentially with the bit-width. GPTQ experiments on five LLMs show the same trend: the scale rule changes perplexity substantially at 2--3 bits and negligibly from 6 bits on, and a local measure of GPTQ scale sensitivity decreases with bit-width in line with the Gaussian curvature. The Gaussian-optimal scale fails on raw weights; after Hadamard incoherence processing it matches the best searched rule at 3 bits and above without any search, but remains clearly worse at 2 bits.

AI.tldr: 本文研究GPTQ类训练后量化中逐层重构误差对量化尺度选择的敏感性，证明在权重为i.i.d.高斯、激活具有足够大有效秩时，宽度增大后归一化舍入损失高概率一致收敛于标准高斯均匀量化器的均方误差，并给出唯一非退化最优尺度及其随比特宽度的变化规律，实验在五个LLM上验证了理论趋势。
AI.motivation: GPTQ家族方法在均匀网格上最小化逐层重构误差，而网格尺度需要预先选择；常用的基于最大值的尺度规则在低比特宽度下性能急剧下降，因此需要从理论上理解目标函数对尺度的敏感性以及最优尺度的性质。
AI.method: 针对权重为i.i.d.高斯、校准激活具有足够大有效秩的层，证明随宽度增长，归一化round-to-nearest损失在所有尺度上一致地、高概率收敛到标准高斯均匀量化器的均方误差；验证宽随机初始化MLP（奇Lipschitz激活、各向同性高斯校准数据）满足有效秩条件；分析极限目标的唯一非退化极小点及各尺度下的曲率；并在五个LLM上进行GPTQ实验，包括原始权重与Hadamard去相干处理后的对比。
AI.result: 极限目标具有唯一非退化最小化尺度，该尺度随量化级数增加严格减小；关于相对尺度误差的曲率随比特宽度近似指数衰减。五个LLM的GPTQ实验显示尺度规则在2--3比特显著影响困惑度，6比特以上影响可忽略，局部尺度敏感度随比特宽度下降，与高斯曲率一致。高斯最优尺度在原始权重上失效；经Hadamard去相干处理后，在3比特及以上无需搜索即可匹配最佳搜索规则，但2比特仍明显更差。
AI.conclusion: GPTQ逐层重构目标对尺度的敏感性随比特宽度按近似指数方式减弱，极限高斯模型可解释并预测这一趋势；Hadamard去相干处理可使简洁的高斯最优尺度在中高比特下替代搜索，但2比特下尺度选择仍是关键且未解决的难点。

title: Simultaneous Neural Optimal Transport
summary: Optimal Transport (OT) provides a principled framework for learning transformations between probability distributions from unpaired samples. In many applications, however, a single transformation must map several source distributions to a common target distribution. For example, image restoration might require handling different types of degradation without knowing the degradation of each input at inference time. Simple approaches of pooling the source distributions only encourage alignment with the target at the aggregate level and may leave individual sources misaligned. In our paper, we consider the simultaneous OT problem which formalizes the task of learning a shared transport map that minimizes the average transport cost while aligning each source distribution with a prescribed target. We propose a neural method for solving the simultaneous OT problem by learning a shared transport map that minimizes the average transport cost while aligning each source distribution with a prescribed target. We derive a max-min formulation for learning this map. We illustrate its application to image restoration, where a single model handles multiple degradation types using a common collection of clean target images.

AI.tldr: 本文研究"同时最优传输（Simultaneous OT）"问题：学习一个共享传输映射，将多个源分布同时对齐到一个共同目标分布，并给出神经求解方法与max-min学习表述，应用于多退化类型的图像复原。
AI.motivation: 在许多应用中，需要单一传输映射将多个源分布映射到同一目标分布，例如图像复原中需在不知道输入退化类型的情况下处理多种退化。若简单地把多个源分布混合池化，只能保证聚合层面与目标对齐，个体源可能仍偏离目标。
AI.method: 将任务形式化为同时OT问题：学习一个共享传输映射，在使每个源分布都与给定目标分布对齐的同时最小化平均传输代价；并推导了学习该映射的max-min（极大极小）表述，进而提出基于神经网络的方法求解。
AI.result: 提出了同时OT问题的神经网络求解方法，并验证其在图像复原中的可行性：单一模型利用一组共同干净目标图像即可处理多种退化类型。
AI.conclusion: 同时OT为"一对多源到共同目标"的映射学习提供了原则性框架；所提max-min神经方法可统一处理多源对齐，在图像复原等场景中具有实际应用价值。

title: Looped Actor: Depth-Recurrent Reasoning Models for Reinforcement Learning
summary: Looped reasoning models repeatedly apply a shared set of parameters, enabling more computation without increasing the model size. These models also support input-dependent computation by dynamically deciding when to stop looping. Motivated by the recent success of looped transformers in language modeling and reasoning, we investigate whether dynamic looping can similarly benefit sequential decision-making. We provide a complexity-theoretic motivation for this approach by showing that there exist Markov decision processes in which a state-adaptive policy achieves the optimal return with asymptotically less expected computation than any optimal fixed-runtime policy. To learn compute-adaptive policies in practice, we introduce Looped Actor, a transformer-based policy that repeatedly refines a latent representation toward a fixed point using a shared computational block. This allows the model to allocate computation adaptively by varying the number of loops based on the current state. We evaluate Looped Actor on 22 tasks across six environments, ranging from combinatorial puzzles to robotic manipulation and spanning online and offline reinforcement learning (RL) with discrete and continuous actions. Looped Actor matches or exceeds the performance of an untied baseline with 16$\times$ more parameters, with the largest gains in environments where action selection requires substantial multistep planning. For the Boxoban environment, we find that the computation allocation is structured: the number of loops increases with the number of remaining pushes and future optimal pushes become increasingly predictable from the latent state over successive loops. Together, these results highlight actor looping as a simple and efficient way to equip RL agents with adaptive computation and improve their planning capabilities. Code is available at https://github.com/camail-official/LoopedActor

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 Looped Actor——一种基于 transformer 的策略，通过共享计算块反复精炼隐表示至不动点，实现随状态自适应的计算分配，在 22 个任务、6 个环境中匹配或超越参数量多 16 倍的非绑定基线，并在多步规划任务中收益最大。
AI.motivation: 循环推理模型通过重复使用共享参数在不增大模型规模的情况下增加计算量，并支持按输入动态决定停止循环。受循环 transformer 在语言建模与推理中成功的启发，作者探究动态循环能否同样惠及序列决策。理论上，作者证明存在某些马尔可夫决策过程，其中状态自适应策略能以渐近更少的期望计算达到最优回报，而任何固定运行时长的最优策略都无法做到，从而为该思路提供复杂度理论依据。
AI.method: 提出 Looped Actor：一个 transformer 策略，使用共享计算块反复精炼隐表示直至收敛至不动点，从而依据当前状态改变循环次数，实现计算自适应分配。在 6 个环境共 22 个任务上评估，涵盖组合谜题、机器人操作，覆盖在线与离线强化学习，以及离散与连续动作空间。
AI.result: Looped Actor 匹配或超越参数量多 16 倍的非绑定（untied）基线，在需要大量多步规划的决策环境中增益最大。在 Boxoban 环境中，计算分配呈现结构性：循环次数随剩余推动次数增加而增加，且随着循环推进，未来最优推动动作从隐状态中的可预测性逐渐提高。
AI.conclusion: actor 循环是一种简单高效的方式，可为强化学习智能体赋予自适应计算能力并提升其规划性能。代码已开源。

title: Variational Augmented Invertible Koopman Autoencoder for probabilistic time series forecasting
summary: Neural Koopman autoencoder models have been shown to successfully build a latent embedding with linear dynamics for arbitrary dynamical systems, enabling strong performance in long-term time series forecasting. However, these models usually work in a deterministic setting, which does not allow the quantification of the uncertainty of their predictions. Thus, we propose the new Variational Augmented Invertible Koopman AutoEncoder (VAIKAE), in which the latent embedding follows a Gaussian distribution instead of being deterministic. A key property of the VAIKAE architecture is that it leverages normalizing flow models, enabling the use of likelihood computations in the state space of dynamical systems for training a model. We further propose new strategies for uncertainty-aware latent data assimilation with a trained VAIKAE model. The effectiveness of our methods is demonstrated in a series of experiments on long-term time series forecasting benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出变分增强可逆Koopman自编码器（VAIKAE），使潜嵌入服从高斯分布以量化不确定性，并借助归一化流实现状态空间似然训练，配合不确定感知潜数据同化策略，在长期时间序列预测基准上验证有效性。
AI.motivation: 神经Koopman自编码器能在潜空间中构建线性动力学，在长期时间序列预测中表现优异，但通常为确定性模型，无法量化预测不确定性。因此需要一种能够进行不确定性建模的Koopman自编码器方法。
AI.method: 提出VAIKAE架构：潜嵌入不再确定，而是服从高斯分布，实现变分建模；利用归一化流模型，使模型可在动力系统状态空间中进行似然计算以完成训练；并进一步提出基于已训练VAIKAE的、具备不确定性感知能力的潜数据同化策略。
AI.result: 通过在长期时间序列预测基准上的一系列实验，验证了所提方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: VAIKAE将变分不确定性与Koopman线性潜动力学及归一化流结合，实现了不确定性可量化的长期时间序列预测，并支持不确定性感知的潜数据同化。

title: Engineering Efficient Self-Play Chess: Search, Replay, and Throughput Under Limited Compute
comment: 26 pages, 17 figures, including appendices. Code and experimental evidence: https://github.com/BertilBraun/Advanced-Techniques-in-Chess-Engines ; model artifacts: https://huggingface.co/BertilBraun/alphazero-chess ; interactive demo: https://chess.bertil-braun.de/
summary: How strong can an AlphaZero-style chess system become under limited training compute when its entire learning loop is engineered for efficiency? We train from random initialization through searched self-play on a single eight-GPU node for 2.5 days. The resulting 6.32-million-parameter model reaches 3,251 benchmark Elo [3,206, 3,297] at 100,000 searches per move (estimated at under five seconds of thinking time) against a fixed-node Stockfish 13 ladder. The run ingests 3.25 million completed games, involves an estimated 100 billion search simulations, and makes 836.6 million training presentations. We investigate search allocation, replay and restart-state selection, policy representation, progressive model sizing, quantized inference, and throughput engineering. Alongside the retained design, we document plausible alternatives that failed to improve the complete learning loop or did not justify their cost. The reported strength is a result of the integrated system, not an isolated Elo gain attributable to any single choice.

AI.tldr: 在单台八卡GPU节点上训练2.5天，一个632万参数的AlphaZero风格国际象棋系统达到3251基准Elo（每步10万次搜索）。
AI.motivation: 探究在有限训练算力下，若将整个学习闭环针对效率进行工程化设计，AlphaZero风格系统能达到多强。
AI.method: 从随机初始化开始，通过搜索式自我对弈在单台八卡GPU节点上训练2.5天；研究搜索分配、回放与重启状态选择、策略表示、渐进式模型规模、量化推理与吞吐工程。
AI.result: 模型632万参数，对固定节点数的Stockfish 13阶梯达到3251 Elo [3206, 3297]（每步10万次搜索，估计思考时间不足5秒）；训练消耗325万局完整对局、约1000亿次搜索模拟、8.366亿次训练呈现。
AI.conclusion: 所报告棋力是整体系统的结果，而非任何单项选择带来的孤立Elo增益；同时记录了未能改进完整学习闭环或成本不合理的替代方案。

title: Risk-Controlled Selective LLM Answering by Pricing Label-Free Checks
comment: 29 pages, 6 figures, 24 tables. Dongyub Jude Lee and Jungseob Lee contributed equally
summary: Serving an answer from a large language model requires deciding when to abstain, yet a verifier's ranking accuracy alone does not determine the error rate among served answers. We introduce PriceCheck, which builds a compact family of decision rules from label-free checks such as re-solving a problem. Each check has a price: its agreement rates on correct and incorrect answers and its cost per run. Prices fitted on a small, class-enriched labelled set compose into predictions of a schedule's coverage and cost, guiding which checks to run and when to stop. A calibration test then selects a schedule at a stated selective-risk target. In mathematics, the selected schedules serve 76.1% of answers on average and keep held-out selective risk below 1.5% on all 15 splits. Under the shared testing protocol, PriceCheck serves more answers at that target than reward models, a prompted judge, the generator's confidence and a trained correctness classifier. At matched coverage, it keeps the fewest wrong answers among these scorers. Across 118 diagnostic schedules, price-based coverage predictions have a rank correlation of 0.97 with observed coverage. These results show that choosing how checks are combined and stopped matters alongside how well a verifier ranks answers. Code is available at https://github.com/js-lee-AI/PriceCheck.

AI.tldr: PriceCheck 提出基于"检查价格"（各检查项在正确/错误答案上的一致率与单次成本）构建紧凑决策规则族，用少量类别增强标注集拟合价格来预测调度方案的覆盖率与成本，并通过校准测试在给定选择性风险目标下选择调度方案。在数学任务上，所选方案平均服务 76.1% 的答案，15 个划分的留出选择性风险均低于 1.5%，优于奖励模型、提示式评判器、生成器置信度与训练型正确性分类器。
AI.motivation: 大模型给出答案时需决定何时弃答（abstain），但仅凭验证器的排序准确率无法确定实际服务答案中的错误率；因此需要从"如何组合与何时停止检查"的角度来控制服务答案的选择性风险。
AI.method: 将重解题等无标签检查视为带"价格"的组件：价格包含其在正确答案与错误答案上的一致率及单次运行成本。在少量类别增强的有标注集上拟合价格，进而预测某调度方案的覆盖率与成本，指导选择运行哪些检查、何时停止；再用校准测试在指定选择性风险目标下选定调度方案。
AI.result: 数学任务中，选定调度方案平均服务 76.1% 的答案，并在全部 15 个划分上把留出选择性风险控制在 1.5% 以下；在同一测试协议下，该目标下服务答案数多于奖励模型、提示式评判器、生成器置信度和训练型正确性分类器；在相同覆盖率下，其错误答案数在同类评分器中最少；118 个诊断调度方案上，基于价格的覆盖率预测与实测覆盖率的秩相关达 0.97。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，除验证器的排序质量外，如何组合检查与何时停止同样关键；基于价格的调度与风险校准能在保证低选择性风险的同时显著提升答案服务覆盖率。代码已开源。

title: REVO: Rollout-Efficient Off-Policy Distillation via Variance-Guided Reuse
comment: 26 pages, 8 figures, 10 tables, code available at https://github.com/UNCSciML/REVO
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains language models using dense token-level teacher supervision on student-generated trajectories. However, its reliance on frequently refreshed student rollouts often incurs substantial generation cost. We introduce REVO, an off-policy distillation framework that improves rollout efficiency by reusing each student rollout for multi-step learner updates. REVO addresses prefix-level and current-token policy mismatch through stabilized prefix weighting and one-step resampling from the current student, which enables repeated updates without regenerating full trajectories. To prioritize informative token positions within reused rollouts, REVO uses the variance of the student-teacher log-probability ratio to quantify the remaining token-level learning signal and guide repeated optimization. Across multiple student-teacher scales, REVO with only 50 rollout iterations matches or exceeds OPD baselines trained for 200 iterations on both in-domain and cross-domain reasoning benchmarks.

AI.tldr: REVO是一种离策略蒸馏框架，通过复用每条学生轨迹进行多步学习器更新，以降低在线策略蒸馏中频繁生成学生轨迹的高额开销。它利用稳定化的前缀加权与从当前学生的一步重采样来缓解策略不匹配，并用学生-教师对数概率比方差衡量剩余学习信号以指导重复优化。仅需50次采样迭代即可匹配或超过在线策略基线200次迭代的效果。
AI.motivation: 在线策略蒸馏依赖频繁刷新的学生轨迹进行密集的token级教师监督，产生大量生成成本，采样效率低。因此需要一种能复用轨迹、减少生成开销的离策略蒸馏方法来提升采样效率。
AI.method: REVO通过复用每条学生轨迹进行多步学习器更新。针对前缀级与当前token的策略不匹配，采用稳定化的前缀加权以及从当前学生的一步重采样，从而在不重新生成完整轨迹的情况下进行重复更新。为在复用轨迹中优先选择信息量高的token位置，使用学生-教师对数概率比的方差来量化剩余token级学习信号并指导重复优化。
AI.result: 在多种学生-教师规模下，REVO仅用50次轨迹采样迭代，在域内和跨域推理基准上即达到或超过训练了200次迭代的在线策略蒸馏基线。
AI.conclusion: REVO通过离策略轨迹复用显著提升采样效率，缓解策略不匹配，并利用方差度量指导token级优化；在多个规模与基准上以四分之一迭代量达到或超越在线策略蒸馏基线。

title: ScaGNN: a Graph Neural Network for Multiple Scattering Simulations
summary: The boundary element method (BEM) provides an efficient numerical framework for solving multiple scattering problems in unbounded homogeneous domains. By restricting the discretization to the domain boundaries, it substantially reduces computational complexity. The procedure first consists in determining the solution trace on the boundaries of the domain by solving a boundary integral equation. Then, the volumetric solution can be recovered at low computational cost using a boundary integral representation. As the first step of the BEM represents the main computational bottleneck, we present ScaGNN, a learning-based approach designed to approximate the solution trace. It relies on a graph neural network architecture that incorporates a dynamic adaptive edge sampling mechanism for selecting the most relevant interactions to model. Guided by intermediate predictions of expected error and edge length, this mechanism selects, at various stages of the forward pass, the most relevant distant interactions to model. The proposed method is tailored to achieve linear complexity with the number of nodes in the input graph. To train and evaluate our network, we present a benchmark consisting of several datasets with different types of multiple scattering problems. Our experiments show that our approach surpasses existing state-of-the-art learning-based methods on the considered tasks and investigate the generalization capabilities to settings with an increased number of obstacles and out-of-distribution obstacle shapes. github.com/LARIAD/ScaGNN

AI.tldr: 提出ScaGNN，用图神经网络近似边界元方法中的边界解迹，通过动态自适应边采样实现线性复杂度，在多散射基准上超越现有学习方法。
AI.motivation: 边界元法(BEM)适合求解无界均匀域中的多散射问题，通过仅在边界离散显著降低计算复杂度；其第一步求解边界积分方程得到边界解迹是主要计算瓶颈，因此需要一种高效近似该解迹的方法。
AI.method: ScaGNN采用图神经网络架构，引入动态自适应边采样机制，在前向传播的不同阶段依据误差期望与边长度的中间预测，选出最相关的远距离相互作用进行建模，从而使复杂度随输入图节点数呈线性增长。
AI.result: 在包含多种多散射问题的基准数据集上，该方法在所考察任务上优于现有基于学习的最先进方法，并进一步检验了在障碍物数量增加及分布外障碍物形状情形下的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: ScaGNN能以线性复杂度有效近似BEM的边界解迹，在精度上超越现有学习方法，并展现一定的泛化潜力，为多散射问题的求解提供了高效的学习型替代方案。

title: Hierarchical Compression of Vision-Language Model Benchmarks
summary: Thorough evaluation of vision-language models (VLMs) has become prohibitively expensive, as benchmarks span an ever-broader spectrum of capabilities and new models arrive at a relentless pace. Benchmark compression methods that preserve model rankings at a fraction of the cost are well studied for language models, but for VLMs the question remains under-explored. We present PRIMEBench (Pruning Redundant Items for Multimodal Evaluation), a vision-aware hierarchical benchmark compression framework that substantially reduces evaluation cost while preserving model rankings. This hierarchical framework operates in four stages: data cleaning to remove items answerable without the image and all-correct items, category representative selection to pick one benchmark per capability category, item pruning with Vision-Aware Variance (VAW), and category-count pruning. VAW combines inter-model variance with a vision-dependence score computed from multimodal embeddings alone, while encouraging coverage of diverse items within each benchmark. On models held out from item selection, it has the highest mean fidelity at the released 5% retention. The hierarchical design lets practitioners stop at any stage to match their compute budget; the released suite removes over 97% of items while preserving model rankings. Beyond compression, our analyses show how VLM evaluation behaves as model panels grow and evolve, providing guidance for designing future benchmarks that are more efficient, robust to model turnover, and explicit about the limits of evaluation-side pruning.

AI.tldr: PRIMEBench：面向视觉语言模型的分层基准压缩框架，在保留模型排序的同时大幅降低评测成本。
AI.motivation: VLM评测成本高昂：基准覆盖能力越来越广、新模型层出不穷。语言模型已有基准压缩研究，但VLM领域尚缺乏探索。
AI.method: 四阶段分层压缩：1)数据清洗（去除无需图像即可作答项及全对项）；2)能力类别代表性基准选择；3)基于视觉感知方差（VAW）的条目剪枝，VAW融合模型间方差与仅由多模态嵌入计算的视觉依赖度得分，并鼓励基准内条目多样性覆盖；4)类别数量剪枝。分层设计支持按算力预算在任意阶段停止。
AI.result: 在条目选择时留出的模型上，5%保留率下取得最高平均保真度；发布套件剔除超过97%条目仍保持模型排序。分析还揭示了模型面板增长与更替时VLM评测的行为规律。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为设计更高效、对模型更替更鲁棒、并明确评测侧剪枝边界的未来基准提供了指导。

title: Graph-Conditioned On-Policy Agent Distillation from Off-the-Shelf Teachers
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains compact language agents with teacher feedback on student-generated trajectories. In multi-turn tasks, compounding errors can move students beyond the teacher's effective supervision. We introduce Graph-Conditioned On-Policy Agent Distillation (GC-OPD), which enriches an off-the-shelf teacher's scoring context with execution evidence. A graph indexes repeated teacher executions by shared states while preserving complete successful and failed histories. After each student episode, GC-OPD retrieves current-state references or historical alternatives and combines them with student hindsight to score the original thought-action tokens. Using the same original teachers, GC-OPD improves mean success over vanilla OPD from 24.70% to 48.78% on ScienceWorld (4B student), from 53.36% to 85.26% on ALFWorld Unseen, and from 29.10% to 37.65% on WebShop. At matched student sizes, it also achieves higher mean success than every evaluated OPD baseline using GRPO-trained teachers on ScienceWorld and ALFWorld; the strongest such ScienceWorld 4B baseline reaches 46.66%. GC-OPD requires no task-specific teacher optimization.

AI.tldr: 提出图条件化的在线策略智能体蒸馏方法GC-OPD，通过图索引教师重复执行轨迹、检索同状态参考或历史替代作为评分上下文，缓解多轮任务中的误差累积，仅用现成教师即可显著提升学生智能体成功率。
AI.motivation: 在线策略蒸馏（OPD）让学生智能体在自己生成的轨迹上接受教师反馈，但在多轮任务中，误差会逐步累积，使学生偏离教师有效监督的范围，导致监督信号失真或失效。
AI.method: GC-OPD构建一个图结构，按共享状态索引教师的重复执行，同时保留完整的成功与失败历史。每当学生完成一个回合（episode），方法会检索当前状态的参考轨迹或历史替代轨迹，并将其与学生的后见信息结合，用于对原始thought-action token进行评分和蒸馏。该方法不依赖任务特定的教师优化。
AI.result: 使用相同原始教师时，GC-OPD相比vanilla OPD将平均成功率显著提升：ScienceWorld（4B学生）从24.70%提升至48.78%；ALFWorld Unseen从53.36%提升至85.26%；WebShop从29.10%提升至37.65%。在相同学生规模下，ScienceWorld与ALFWorld上均优于所有使用GRPO训练教师的OPD基线，其中ScienceWorld 4B最强基线为46.66%。
AI.conclusion: GC-OPD通过图条件化的上下文增强机制，有效克服多轮任务中在线策略蒸馏的复合误差问题，在多个基准上取得显著且一致的性能提升，同时无需任务特有教师优化，具有良好的通用性与实用性。

title: Benchmarking graph-based models for in-silico toxicity prediction in drug discovery
summary:
Drug discovery is a costly and high-risk process, where toxicity-related failures remain a major cause of attrition in both preclinical and clinical stages. As a result, accurate early prediction of chemical toxicity is essential to reduce downstream costs and improve compound prioritization. In this context, graph deep learning (GDL) has emerged as a powerful paradigm for toxicity prediction, leveraging molecular graph representations to learn directly from chemical structure with improved expressivity over traditional approaches.
  Despite the growing number of proposed models, current literature-based comparisons are often difficult to interpret due to inconsistencies in datasets, preprocessing pipelines, and evaluation protocols. To address this limitation, we introduce a unified and standardized benchmarking framework for GDL-based toxicity prediction. We systematically evaluate more than 20 representative approaches under consistent experimental conditions and across multiple datasets and partitioning strategies, enabling a fair and reproducible comparison of model performance. In addition, we complement this empirical study with a structured literature analysis to contextualize existing methodological trends and performance claims. Our results provide a clearer and more reliable assessment of the current state of the field, highlighting both the strengths and limitations of existing graph-based approaches. To support transparency and reproducibility, we release our benchmarking framework as open-source software https://gitlab.citius.gal/noel.suarez/benchtox, allowing the community to evaluate and compare models under consistent conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出统一标准化的图深度学习（GDL）毒性预测基准框架 BenchTox，在一致实验条件下系统评测20余种代表性方法，并辅以结构化文献分析，开源代码以保障可复现性。
AI.motivation: 药物研发成本高、风险大，毒性相关失败是临床前和临床阶段损耗的主要原因，因此早期准确预测化学毒性对降低下游成本、优化化合物优先级至关重要。图深度学习凭借分子图表示直接从化学结构学习，表达能力强于传统方法，成为毒性预测的重要范式。然而现有文献中的比较因数据集、预处理流程和评估协议不一致而难以解读。
AI.method: 构建统一、标准化的GDL毒性预测基准测试框架；在一致实验条件下，跨多个数据集和多种划分策略，系统评测20余种代表性方法；并辅以结构化文献分析，梳理现有方法学趋势与性能声明。
AI.result: 提供了对当前领域现状更清晰、更可靠的评估，揭示了现有基于图的方法的优势与局限，实现了公平且可复现的模型性能比较。
AI.conclusion: 为支持透明性与可复现性，作者将基准框架作为开源软件发布（https://gitlab.citius.gal/noel.suarez/benchtox），供社区在一致条件下评估和比较模型。

title: A Model-Agnostic Physics-Guided Adapter for Few-Shot Transfer of Coastal Flood Prediction Models to Unseen Regions
summary: Deep learning surrogates can produce high-resolution coastal flood maps orders of magnitude faster than physics-based hydrodynamic simulators, yet transferring them to new coastal regions remains costly, since generating target-region data for fine-tuning typically requires numerous time-consuming simulations. To tackle this bottleneck, we introduce the Physics Adapter (PA), a compact, architecture-agnostic adaptation interface that enables efficient few-shot transfer of flood prediction models across diverse coastal regions. PA predicts peak water level through a differentiable wet/dry response that compares terrain elevation against a learned water level, and blends this physics-structured prediction with a data-driven branch through a learned gate. Unlike physics-informed formulations, PA imposes no PDE-residual or conservation losses and instead exploits elevation as an architectural inductive bias, adding a negligible number of trainable parameters. We integrate PA into 12 heterogeneous models, and evaluate them on two coastal regions with markedly distinct geometries, topographies, and shoreline protection configurations. The performance of PA is benchmarked against a no-physics baseline, full fine-tuning, and standard parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods, considering both within-region generalization to unseen sea level rise values and between-region transfer. In low-shot regime (K=3), and averaged over all backbones and transfer settings, adding PA reduces root mean square error by 11.5% when only the output head is adapted on a frozen backbone, by 15.4% when combined with PEFT methods, and by 22.9% under full fine-tuning, compared to matched configurations without PA. Taken together, the findings of this work offer practitioners a concrete recipe for extending DL-based coastal flood predictors to new, data-scarce regions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Physics Adapter (PA),一种轻量、架构无关的适配接口,通过将地形高程与学习水位比较的可微干湿响应作为物理归纳偏置,与数据驱动分支门控融合,实现洪水预测模型在少样本条件下的跨区域高效迁移,显著降低 RMSE。
AI.motivation: 深度学习代理模型能快速生成高分辨率海岸洪水图,但迁移到新沿海区域成本高昂,因为微调所需的目标区域数据通常依赖大量耗时的水动力模拟。现有物理信息方法需引入 PDE 残差或守恒损失,约束强且不够灵活。作者希望找到一种低成本、易集成的方案以缓解数据稀缺瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出 Physics Adapter (PA):预测峰值水位时,通过可微的干湿响应机制比较地形高程与学习得到的水位,并将该物理结构化预测与数据驱动分支经学习门控进行融合。PA 不施加 PDE 残差或守恒损失,而是将高程作为架构层面的归纳偏置,仅增加极少可训练参数,且与具体网络架构无关。作者将 PA 集成到 12 种异构模型,在两个几何、地形与岸线防护配置差异显著的沿海区域上评估,并与无物理基线、全量微调和标准 PEFT 方法对比,涵盖区域内对未见海平面上升值的泛化及跨区域迁移。
AI.result: 在低样本情形(K=3)下,对所有骨干网络与迁移设置取平均,加入 PA 后:仅适配输出头(冻结骨干)时 RMSE 降低 11.5%;与 PEFT 方法结合时降低 15.4%;全量微调时降低 22.9%,均优于对应的无 PA 配置。
AI.conclusion: PA 为将基于深度学习的海岸洪水预测器扩展到数据稀缺的新区域提供了切实可行的方案,证明以高程为归纳偏置的轻量物理适配接口能在少样本迁移中稳定提升精度,为实践者提供了具体可行的操作配方。

title: ReLMem: Learning Recurrent Memory for Longitudinal EHR Modeling
summary: Longitudinal electronic health record (EHR) modeling requires integrating new visits with an expanding patient history. Yet the continual accumulation of clinical information imposes increasing computational and memory costs on large language models (LLMs) when they process and retain complete patient histories. A practical alternative is visit-wise recurrent compression, which incorporates each incoming visit into a compact, continually updated patient memory. However, under a fixed memory budget, successive updates must integrate new information without progressively losing critical historical evidence needed to subsequent tasks. To address this challenge, we introduce Recurrent Longitudinal Memory (ReLMem), a framework that learns to maintain fixed-capacity patient memory for efficient downstream prediction with a frozen LLM. ReLMem equips this LLM with lightweight compression adapters to recurrently update the memory from its previous state and each incoming visit, without rereading earlier records. Specifically, we develop a multi-granularity optimization strategy to preserve task-relevant information throughout recurrent updates and support downstream prediction from the final memory. The intermediate supervision aligns attention outputs from compressed memory and the full history under identical queries, while prediction supervision minimizes cross-entropy with ground truth answers conditioned on the final memory. On EHR-based medication prediction, ReLMem approaches the F1 scores of full-history baseline while reducing average retained historical storage by 97.1%. Under the same memory budget, it improves macro- and micro-F1 over the strongest compressed-memory baseline by 4.66 and 4.75 percentage points, respectively. These results highlight the value of learning recurrent patient memory for efficient longitudinal EHR modeling.

AI.tldr: ReLMem：面向纵向EHR建模的固定容量递归患者记忆框架，借助冻结LLM与轻量压缩适配器，在不重读历史记录的情况下递归更新记忆，并以多粒度优化保留任务相关信息；药物预测中F1接近全历史基线，历史存储减少97.1%，同预算下F1较最强压缩基线提升约4.7个百分点。
AI.motivation: 纵向电子健康记录（EHR）建模需要将新就诊与不断扩展的患者历史整合。但临床信息的持续累积会使大语言模型在处理和保留完整病史时面临计算与内存成本不断上升的问题。逐次就诊的递归压缩是一条可行路径，可将每次新就诊并入紧凑且持续更新的患者记忆。然而在固定记忆预算下，连续更新必须在不逐步丢失后续任务所需关键历史证据的前提下整合新信息，这是核心挑战。
AI.method: 提出 Recurrent Longitudinal Memory（ReLMem）框架，为冻结的LLM配备轻量压缩适配器，从上一记忆状态与当前新就诊递归更新固定容量患者记忆，且不重读早期记录。采用多粒度优化策略：中间监督在相同查询下对齐压缩记忆与完整历史的注意力输出；预测监督以最终记忆为条件，最小化与真实答案的交叉熵，从而在递归更新过程中保留任务相关信息并支持下游预测。
AI.result: 在基于EHR的药物预测任务上，ReLMem的F1分数接近全历史基线，同时将平均保留的历史存储减少97.1%；在相同记忆预算下，其macro-F1和micro-F1分别比最强压缩记忆基线提升4.66和4.75个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，学习递归患者记忆对高效的纵向EHR建模具有重要价值：在显著降低存储与计算开销的同时，能够保持接近全历史基线的预测性能，并优于现有压缩记忆方法。

title: GraphVQ: Structure-Aware Autoregressive Decoding over Context-Quantized Graph Tokens
summary: Graph foundation models need a discrete token representation, but casting a graph as a generatable token sequence faces a structural obstacle: edges spanning beyond the serialization window cannot be emitted in one pass--so one-pass autoregressive generators systematically under-produce cycles--and a single global condition cannot tell candidate edges apart. GraphVQ removes both obstacles: node contexts--features plus a local edge mask under multi-order breadth-first serialization--are quantized into a shared codebook by a VQ-VAE with BCE-calibrated Bernoulli edge decoding, and a second-stage structure-aware decoder emits the global adjacency conditioned on token-derived pair features, whose necessity over any global-summary condition is formalized in a scoped impossibility result. The tokenizer reconstructs node features at 0.86--0.99 accuracy and decodes local edges at AUROC >= 0.89 (ECE <= 0.007). Under one same-split protocol on four datasets, pair conditioning improves orbit MMD 0.248 -> 0.174 on PROTEINS and 3.4x on a ring stress test, and vanishes on a random-label control--the signature of attribute--topology coupling--so the gain is claimed exactly where attributes carry edge-relevant signal. GraphVQ ranks first among learned generators on PROTEINS, ties for first on SYN-COMM, and improves orbit MMD 2.7--17x over one-stage generation on three datasets, with seed-level bootstrap intervals confirming the rankings are not seed noise; on MUTAG the unweighted edge target under-generates and is reported as such. These results locate the structural control of autoregressive graph generation in the granularity of the condition: pair-level token context turns a quantized vocabulary into a usable capacity axis for distribution-faithful graph generation and future token-level pretraining.

AI.tldr: GraphVQ 通过将节点上下文量化为共享码本，并用结构感知解码器以成对特征为条件生成全局邻接矩阵，解决了单次自回归图生成的环欠产生与全局条件区分度不足两大结构障碍。
AI.motivation: 图基础模型需要离散 token 表示，但将图序列化为可生成 token 序列存在结构障碍：跨越序列化窗口的边无法一次生成，导致单次自回归生成器系统性欠产生环；且单一全局条件无法区分候选边。因此需要新的离散化与条件粒度方案。
AI.method: 方法分两阶段：(1) 采用多阶广度优先序列化，将节点上下文（特征加局部边掩码）通过 VQ-VAE 量化为共享码本，并以 BCE 校准的伯努利边解码；(2) 第二阶段结构感知解码器以 token 派生的成对特征为条件，生成全局邻接矩阵。论文用受限不可能性结果形式化证明了成对条件优于任意全局摘要条件的必要性。
AI.result: tokenizer 重建节点特征准确率 0.86–0.99，局部边解码 AUROC≥0.89（ECE≤0.007）。同一划分协议下，成对条件将 orbit MMD 在 PROTEINS 上从 0.248 降至 0.174，在环形压力测试中提升 3.4 倍，而在随机标签对照上增益消失——这是属性-拓扑耦合的特征。GraphVQ 在 PROTEINS 上排名第一，SYN-COMM 并列第一，并在三个数据集上较单阶段生成提升 orbit MMD 2.7–17 倍，种子级 bootstrap 区间确认排名非噪声；MUTAG 上无权重边目标欠生成，已如实报告。
AI.conclusion: 结果将自回归图生成的结构控制定位于条件的粒度：成对级 token 上下文使量化词表成为可用于分布忠实图生成及未来 token 级预训练的有效容量轴。

title: Authority Bias in Language Models: Source Deference and User Agreement Are Not Interchangeable
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (Main Conference, Poster). 33 pages, 8 figures. Project page: https://authority-bias.vercel.app/ . Code: https://github.com/Lossfunk/authority-bias
summary: Language models tend to agree with whatever a user asserts, and post-training increasingly targets this sycophancy so that models evaluate claims on their merits rather than deferring to the user. Yet the same models are far more compliant when a wrong answer is attributed to a verified source, which is how retrieval results, tool outputs, and grounded-search content often present information. We measure this gap across five open-weight families and three closed APIs. A single verified-source note endorsing a wrong answer flips 45-88% of baseline-correct responses in seven of eight models, and compliance rises with how authoritative the note sounds. Source deference and user agreement are not behaviorally interchangeable inside the model: on matched items with the same wrong answer, causal interventions can selectively suppress one without equally affecting the other. In three open-weight families, removing a fitted source direction lowers source compliance by 65-80 percentage points while removing a user or assistant direction has far smaller effects, and removing the user direction shows the reverse preference. A separately fitted intervention derived from source-versus-user cue activations moves compliance in both directions while leaving the prompt text unchanged. An authority direction fitted on trivia also transfers to PIQA and multi-turn SYCON dialogues without refitting, and removing it lowers wrong-source compliance by tens of percentage points in four of five families with no detected change in MMLU-Pro or GSM8K accuracy at our evaluation sizes. Source deference and user agreement therefore need separate evaluation.

AI.tldr: 该论文发现语言模型对"用户断言"的谄媚与对"被标注为权威来源的错误答案"的遵从是两种可分离的行为，前者已被后训练大量针对，后者却被忽视；作者在8个模型上量化该差距，并通过因果干预证明二者在模型内部可被选择性抑制。
AI.motivation: 现有后训练工作主要针对"用户谄媚"（sycophancy），即模型倾向于附和用户断言。然而在检索结果、工具输出、grounded-search等场景中，错误答案常以"经过验证的来源"形式呈现。作者质疑：模型是否会对这类权威来源表现出更强的遵从？若这种"来源遵从"与"用户附和"不可互换，则仅以用户谄媚为目标的评测与对齐会遗漏重要风险。
AI.method: 1) 测量范围：5个开源权重模型家族 + 3个闭源API。2) 基线对照：先用单条"已验证来源"注释为错误答案背书，统计原本正确答案被翻转的比例，并操纵注释的权威性措辞。3) 行为可分离性检验：在"相同错误答案"的匹配样本上，通过因果干预（activation steering / 方向消融）分别抑制来源遵从与用户附和，观察是否互不影响。4) 方向拟合：拟合"来源方向""用户方向""助手方向"，比较消融后的合规率变化；并拟合基于"来源 vs 用户"线索激活的干预方向，在不改变prompt文本的前提下双向调节合规。5) 迁移检验：在trivia上拟合的"权威方向"直接迁移到PIQA和多轮SYCON对话，不重新拟合，检验其对错误来源合规的影响及对MMLU-Pro、GSM8K准确率的副作用。
AI.result:
- 单条"已验证来源"注释即可在8个模型中的7个里翻转45-88%的原本正确回答；注释听起来越权威，合规率越高。
- 在匹配样本上，来源遵从与用户附和并非行为等价：因果干预可选择性抑制其一而不同等影响另一。
- 在3个开源家族中，消融拟合出的"来源方向"使来源合规率下降65-80个百分点，而消融"用户方向"或"助手方向"影响远小；反之，消融"用户方向"对用户附和的抑制更强（方向偏好正好相反）。
- 由"来源 vs 用户"线索激活拟合的干预方向可在不改变prompt文本的情况下双向调节合规。
- 在trivia上拟合的"权威方向"无需重拟合即可迁移到PIQA与多轮SYCON对话；在5个家族中的4个里，消融该方向使错误来源合规率下降数十个百分点，且在评测规模下未检测到MMLU-Pro或GSM8K准确率变化。
AI.conclusion: 来源遵从（source deference）与用户附和（user agreement）是两种需要分别评测和对齐的独立失效模式。针对用户谄媚的后训练不足以消除对权威来源错误信息的遵从，未来工作应将"来源遵从"纳入独立的评测与干预目标。

title: Procedural Core: A Compact Recurrent Initialization for Vision Transformers
summary: Transformers are typically trained from random initialization, requiring all their capabilities to emerge from large-scale optimization. Recent work showed that a small amount of abstract procedurally generated data can help acquire generic inductive structure at low cost. However, this adds a pretraining stage that must be repeated for every target model. We propose Procedural Core, an initialization strategy that captures this generic structure into a compact set of weights that can be reused across models. We train a minimal recurrent transformer on procedural data, then expand its weights to initialize transformers of arbitrary width and depth. The resulting initialization improves performance on image classification, self-supervised visual learning (DINO), and modeling natural language (FineWeb-Edu) and code (CodeParrot). For image classification, expanding a 1M-parameter core to initialize an 85M-parameter ViT-Base improves ImageNet top-1 accuracy by 2.2 pp over standard random initialization. Our analysis identifies recurrence as essential for learning compact weights that transfer across models. In ViTs, we localize a key benefit in the suppression of high-norm tokens that produces substantial improvements in zero-shot segmentation (ImageNet-S mAP 32.3 to 42.9), object localization (VOC07 CorLoc 9.9 to 18.4), and depth estimation (NYUv2 RMSE 1.104 to 0.998). This demonstrates that transformers need not start from a blank slate, and can be initialized with generic capabilities at low cost with no domain- or task-specific data.

AI.tldr: 提出Procedural Core初始化策略：用程序化数据训练一个小型循环Transformer，再将其权重扩展以初始化任意宽度和深度的Transformer，在图像分类、DINO、语言与代码建模上均优于随机初始化。
AI.motivation: Transformer通常从随机初始化开始训练，所有能力都需依赖大规模优化才能获得；已有工作表明少量抽象程序化生成数据能低成本获取通用归纳结构，但需为每个目标模型重复预训练，成本高且不可复用。
AI.method: 在程序化数据上训练一个极小的循环（recurrent）Transformer，将其权重扩展（expand）以初始化任意宽度和深度的Transformer，形成可跨模型复用的紧凑初始化权重。
AI.result: 在图像分类、自监督视觉学习（DINO）、自然语言（FineWeb-Edu）与代码（CodeParrot）建模上均有提升。将1M参数的核心扩展到85M参数的ViT-Base，ImageNet top-1提升2.2个百分点。分析表明循环结构对学习可跨模型迁移的紧凑权重至关重要。在ViT中定位关键收益为抑制高范数token：零样本分割ImageNet-S mAP从32.3升至42.9，目标定位VOC07 CorLoc从9.9升至18.4，深度估计NYUv2 RMSE从1.104降至0.998。
AI.conclusion: Transformer无需从空白状态开始，可用低成本、无需领域或任务特定数据的方式，以具备通用能力的初始化启动训练。

title: ProCTI: Prototype-Refined Global Conditioning for Diffusion-Based Time Series Imputation
summary: Time series imputation has progressed from statistical and deep learning approaches to diffusion-based models, which have shown strong recent performance. Existing diffusion-based methods typically condition the reverse process using local contextual information from the current or neighbouring windows. Meanwhile, global dataset-level structure often remains implicit, limiting performance when local observations are sparse, noisy, or unrepresentative. To address this issue, we propose ProCTI, a diffusion-imputation framework that augments local conditioning with retrieved global dataset-level priors through learned prototypes. A hybrid conditioning mechanism integrates this global context with local signals during reverse diffusion, enabling more accurate reconstruction under varying missingness scenarios. Experiments across multiple benchmark datasets show that ProCTI outperforms strong baselines overall under random missingness, while remaining competitive under attribute-wise missingness. Furthermore, we use a latent-regime data model to characterise the precise conditions under which prototype-derived global conditioning provably improves imputation. We support this with a general theoretical analysis of local-global conditioning.

AI.tldr: ProCTI：一种基于原型的扩散时间序列插补框架，通过检索全局数据集级先验增强局部条件，提升缺失场景下的重建精度。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散式时间序列插补方法主要依赖当前或邻近窗口的局部上下文来条件化反向过程，而全局数据集级结构通常保持隐式状态。当局部观测稀疏、含噪或不具代表性时，插补性能受限，因此需要引入全局先验以补偿局部信息的不足。
AI.method: 提出ProCTI扩散插补框架：利用学习到的原型（prototypes）检索全局数据集级先验，与局部信号通过混合条件机制（hybrid conditioning）在反向扩散过程中融合，从而在不同缺失情形下实现更准确的重建。同时采用潜在状态（latent-regime）数据模型刻画原型导出全局条件可证明改善插补的条件，并给出局部-全局条件的一般理论分析。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上，ProCTI在随机缺失下整体优于强基线，在属性级缺失（attribute-wise missingness）下保持竞争力；理论分析给出了原型全局条件可证明提升插补性能的精确条件。
AI.conclusion: 全局数据集级先验与局部条件的结合能有效缓解局部观测稀疏、含噪或不具代表性带来的局限，ProCTI在实证与理论上共同验证了局部-全局混合条件在扩散时间序列插补中的价值。

title: RACE: Relation-Level Counterfactual Explanations for Heterogeneous Graph Neural Networks
summary: Counterfactual explanations of graph neural networks identify edge deletions that flip a prediction. On heterogeneous graphs, however, existing methods first collapse the graph into untyped edges, so they cannot answer the question a domain expert actually asks: which relation type drives this prediction? We present RACE (Relation-Aware Counterfactual Explanations), which gives this question an exact, per-instance answer. For every explained instance, an exhaustive search over relation subsets returns the certified minimum relation-deletion set that flips the prediction -- or an explicit report that no such deletion exists; each relation-level answer is then refined into a typed edge set within the attributed relations, verified on the discrete model by single-edge restoration. The relation-level answer is exact and deterministic given the frozen backbone, whereas soft-mask baselines vary by 6-8 pp in success rate across runs differing only in random ordering. On ACM, a Cora-derived graph, and ogbn-mag, RACE improves counterfactual success rate over the strongest baseline by up to +2.7 pp while deleting fewer edges, and attains the highest success rate among all same-task baselines on every dataset; the advantage reproduces across four backbones on ogbn-arXiv and on DBLP, with cross-seed relation-set agreement up to 0.89. A synthetic study with known generating mechanisms confirms that the search recovers the relation the trained model actually relies on -- and reports infeasibility rather than fabricating an attribution when the model has learned none -- so the explanations stay trustworthy exactly where explanations matter.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RACE，一种面向异质图的、关系感知的反事实解释方法，通过对关系子集的穷举搜索给出翻转预测的最小关系删除集，并进一步细化为类型化边集，在离散模型上验证。
AI.motivation: 现有异质图上的反事实解释方法先将图坍缩为无类型边，无法回答领域专家真正关心的问题：是哪种关系类型驱动了该预测。因此需要一种能给出精确、逐实例关系级归因的方法。
AI.method: RACE 对每个解释实例在关系子集上做穷举搜索，返回能够翻转预测的、经认证的最小关系删除集，若无此删除集则显式报告不可行；随后在带属性的关系内部将关系级答案细化为类型化边集，并通过单边恢复在离散模型上验证。
AI.result: 关系级答案在冻结骨干下是精确且确定的，而软掩码基线在仅随机顺序不同的多次运行中成功率波动 6-8 pp。在 ACM、Cora 衍生图和 ogbn-mag 上，RACE 相比最强基线反事实成功率提升最多 +2.7 pp 且删除更少边，在每个数据集上均取得同任务基线中最高成功率；该优势在 ogbn-arXiv 和 DBLP 的四个骨干上可复现，跨随机种子的关系集一致率最高达 0.89。合成实验证实搜索能恢复模型真正依赖的关系，并在模型未学到任何关系时报告不可行而非虚构归因。
AI.conclusion: RACE 为异质图反事实解释提供了精确、确定且可信的关系级归因，在多个数据集与骨架上优于现有基线，并能在无真实依赖时报不可行，保证解释的可靠性。

title: Nonpreemptive Scheduling While Learning Context-Dependent Service Rates
summary: We study nonpreemptive contextual queueing bandits in a single-server system. Each job is represented by a $d$-dimensional context vector; in each round, a job may arrive with its context drawn from an unknown distribution $\mathcal{D}$, and its departure probability is determined by a logistic model of that context vector with an unknown parameter $θ^*$. The server learns from service outcomes while deciding which waiting job to serve and whether to idle, aiming to minimize queue-length regret, the gap between its expected terminal queue length and the minimum achievable by an admissible policy. Once selected, a job must be served until completion, and we refer to this as the nonpreemptive setting. A central challenge is that, even with full model knowledge, the optimal policy cannot in general be characterized by a simple myopic rule, since the optimal action can change with the remaining horizon at the same queue state. Nevertheless, when the model and horizon are known, the optimal action can be obtained through a finite-horizon Bellman recursion. Motivated by this, we propose Learn--Clear--Plan (LCP), which estimates the system and uses the resulting Bellman recursion to make horizon-dependent decisions. LCP achieves $\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{d/T})$ queue-length regret, while a lower-bound construction gives $Ω(\min\{1/\sqrt{d},\sqrt{d/T}\})$ regret for every learning policy on some instance, establishing optimality up to polylogarithmic factors when $T\ge d^2$. When the horizon is unknown, no horizon-independent policy achieves vanishing regret against the finite-horizon optimum. We therefore use SEPT, the policy that serves a waiting job with the highest probability of departure, as a fixed reference, and suggest an estimated-SEPT algorithm that achieves a tracking error of $\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{d/t})$ without knowing the model.

AI.tldr: 研究单服务器非抢占式情境排队bandit问题，提出LCP算法实现 $\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{d/T})$ 队列长度遗憾，并证明其接近最优；对未知时域情形提出估计SEPT算法。
AI.motivation: 排队bandit中，即使已知完整模型，最优策略通常也不能用简单短视规则刻画，最优动作会随剩余时域变化；且时域未知时不存在时域无关策略能对有限时域最优实现消失遗憾，故需新的学习与规划方法。
AI.method: 建模为单服务器非抢占式情境排队bandit：每轮到达作业的情境由未知分布 $\mathcal{D}$ 生成，离去概率由未知参数 $θ^*$ 的逻辑模型决定。提出 Learn--Clear--Plan（LCP），估计系统参数并用有限时域Bellman递推做依赖时域的决策。对未知时域，以SEPT（服务离去概率最高的等待作业）为固定参考，提出估计SEPT算法。
AI.result: LCP达到 $\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{d/T})$ 队列长度遗憾；下界构造给出任意学习策略在某实例上 $Ω(\min\{1/\sqrt{d},\sqrt{d/T}\})$ 的遗憾，当 $T\ge d^2$ 时在polylog因子内最优。未知时域下无时域无关策略可对有限时域最优实现消失遗憾；估计SEPT在未知模型下达到 $\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{d/t})$ 的跟踪误差。
AI.conclusion: 通过Bellman递推的依赖时域决策可有效解决非抢占情境排队bandit，LCP在已知时域下接近最优；未知时域需采用SEPT等固定参考并仅能实现跟踪误差保证。

title: Learning Causal Normalizing Flows from Incomplete Data via Observed-Data Likelihood
summary: Causal Normalizing Flows (CNFs) enable causal inference from observational data given the causal structure, but they assume fully observed training data. We introduce MissCNF, which trains CNFs directly on incomplete data by maximizing the marginal likelihood of each partially observed sample, without discarding rows or constructing a completed dataset. Thanks to the causal structure encoded in the autoregressive factorization of CNFs, only missing variables in the ancestral closure of the observed set are integrated out, while the others are dropped without computation. We further establish the conditions under which MissCNF recovers the true joint distribution, and introduce \emph{causal-family positivity}, where identification is possible even when no record in the dataset is ever complete. We compare MissCNF with two common strategies for handling missing data: listwise deletion and impute-then-fit pipelines. Across eight synthetic causal benchmarks, three missingness mechanisms, and missing rates up to $90\%$, MissCNF achieves the lowest KL divergence in 23 of 24 nonlinear MCAR and MAR settings and in all nonlinear MNAR settings, as well as the lowest counterfactual error in 20 of 24 settings. On linear SCMs, where linear imputation performs best, MissCNF ranks in the top two in 22 of 24 settings.

AI.tldr: MissCNF 直接在含缺失值的数据上训练因果归一化流，通过最大化每个部分观测样本的边缘似然实现因果推断，无需删行或填补。
AI.motivation: 现有因果归一化流（CNFs）虽能在给定因果结构下从观测数据做因果推断，但假设训练数据完全观测，无法直接处理缺失数据。
AI.method: 利用 CNFs 自回归分解中编码的因果结构，仅对观测集合的祖先闭包中的缺失变量进行积分，其余缺失变量直接丢弃而不计算；同时给出恢复真实联合分布的条件，并提出"因果族正性"（causal-family positivity）概念。
AI.result: 在 8 个合成因果基准、3 种缺失机制、缺失率高达 90% 的实验中，MissCNF 在 24 个非线性 MCAR 和 MAR 设置中的 23 个以及所有非线性 MNAR 设置中取得最低 KL 散度，在 24 个设置中的 20 个取得最低反事实误差；在线性 SCM 上 24 个设置中有 22 个排名前二。
AI.conclusion: MissCNF 无需丢弃样本或构建完整数据集即可在缺失数据上训练 CNFs，并在多种缺失机制和高缺失率下优于 listwise deletion 与先填补后拟合等常见策略。

title: Where Privacy Belongs: Placement Diagnosis and Certified Selection for Private Counterfactual Explanations on Graphs
summary: Counterfactual explanations for graph neural networks (GNNs) find the minimal intervention that flips a node's prediction--but computing one requires reading sensitive graph structure, and releasing it discloses that structure. Both existing placements fail. Privatizing the graph before explaining corrupts the target on exactly the borderline nodes needing recourse, manufacturing spurious flips that flip the privatized graph but not the true one. Explaining on the clean graph and perturbing the released explanation resists certification: re-auditing the standard heuristic shows an implied full-release budget of 573--753 on Cora and 256 on CiteSeer--orders of magnitude beyond its advertised budget--with worst-case single-entry leakage at AUC 1.0. We propose PrivCFS, which replaces certification-by-optimization with certification-by-construction: counterfactual selection over a fixed, data-independent candidate universe--edge interventions from a public prior graph, feature interventions from a public schema--whose no-op semantics give neighboring graphs the same output support. A validity-gated, clipped utility of global sensitivity $Δu \le 1$ released through the exponential mechanism gives pure $\varepsilon$-DP for the complete released object, composable over queries--to our knowledge the first such guarantee on graphs. Privacy noise is the cheapest stage: at $\varepsilon$=8 the release retains 94--97% of its support-restricted non-private optimum on the recourse population and 83--95% on the general one; the optimal edge-inference audit attains AUC 0.50 on average and 0.59 worst-pair, versus the heuristic's worst entry 1.0; and transfers to a 15K-node graph at 0.96 valid rate. The dominant cost is a measurable, monotone price in public disclosure, readable off one table before any budget is spent--turning explanation privacy from an accounting risk into a purchasable decision.

AI.tldr: 提出 PrivCFS，用"构造即认证"取代"优化即认证"，通过公共先验图/公共模式的固定候选集和指数机制，在图上实现纯 ε-DP 的反事实解释发布，且隐私噪声是代价最小的环节。
AI.motivation: GNN 反事实解释需读取敏感图结构，发布即泄露。现有两类做法均有缺陷：(1) 先对图做私有化再解释，会在恰好需要救济的边界节点上破坏目标，产生"在私有图上翻转、在真图上不翻转"的伪反事实；(2) 在干净图上解释再扰动发布结果，无法给出认证——重新审计标准启发式发现其隐含的完全发布预算高达 Cora 573–753、CiteSeer 256，远超其宣称预算，且最坏单条目泄露 AUC 达 1.0。
AI.method: 核心是 certification-by-construction：在固定、与数据无关的候选宇宙上做反事实选择——边干预来自公共先验图，特征干预来自公共模式；利用候选的 no-op 语义使相邻图获得相同的输出支持集。采用有效性门控、裁剪后的效用函数，全局敏感度 Δu ≤ 1，经指数机制发布，从而对完整发布对象给出纯 ε-DP 保证，并可跨查询组合。
AI.result: 隐私噪声是最廉价的一环：ε=8 时，发布结果在救济人群上保留受限非私有最优的 94–97%，在一般人群上保留 83–95%；最优边推断审计平均 AUC 0.50、最差对 0.59，而启发式最坏条目为 1.0；方法可迁移到 15K 节点图，有效率 0.96。主要代价是可测量、单调的公共披露代价，可在花费任何预算前从一张表中读出。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将反事实解释隐私从"记账风险"转变为"可购买的决策"：以构造式认证在图上首次给出完整发布对象的纯 ε-DP 保证，且隐私开销小、披露代价可预读可权衡。

title: LEMON-ZEST: Evolution-Informed Tokenization for Efficient Protein Language Modeling
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. 9 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables
summary: Protein Language Models (PLMs) have made remarkable progress following scaling laws established in natural language processing across sequence- and structure-based tasks, yet the potential of tokenization remains underexploited. Unlike human language, proteins preserve structure despite extensive sequence variation a property standard tokenization strategies fundamentally fail to capture. We introduce ZEST (Zoned Encoding of Sequence Traits), an evolution-informed vocabulary derived from conserved regions of multiple sequence alignments. ZEST allows embedding domain-level biological priors directly at the tokenization stage rather than learning them implicitly through scale. ZEST natively compresses sequences to an average token length of 4 residues, enabling our model to process 4,000 residues within a standard 1024-token context window. Building on this, we present LEMON (Layered Extraction of Molecular Ordering from Nature), a compact 200M-parameter sequence-based model for detection of remote homology between protein sequences trained on a single H100 GPU for one week. Despite its modest size, LEMON outperforms state-of-the-art models ranging from 600M to 3B parameters. Our results demonstrate that evolution-informed tokenization can substitute for massive parameter scaling, opening a new direction for efficient, biologically-grounded protein representation learning. All code, model weights, and results are publicly available under the MIT license.

AI.tldr: 本文提出进化信息驱动的分词策略 ZEST 与基于其构建的 200M 参数模型 LEMON，在远程同源检测任务上以极小规模超越 600M–3B 参数的前沿模型，证明进化先验分词可替代大规模参数扩展。
AI.motivation: 现有蛋白质语言模型虽在序列和结构任务上遵循自然语言处理的缩放规律取得进展，但分词环节的潜力被严重低估。与人类语言不同，蛋白质在序列高度变异的情况下仍保持结构保守性，而标准分词策略无法捕捉这一特性，只能依赖参数规模隐式学习生物学先验，计算成本高昂。
AI.method: 提出 ZEST（Zoned Encoding of Sequence Traits），一种从多序列比对保守区域中提取的进化信息词表，将域级生物学先验直接注入到分词阶段而非通过规模隐式学习；ZEST 可将序列平均压缩至约 4 个残基/词元，使模型在标准 1024 词元上下文内处理 4000 个残基。基于此构建 LEMON（Layered Extraction of Molecular Ordering from Nature），一个 200M 参数的紧凑序列模型，用于蛋白质序列间远程同源检测，训练仅需单张 H100 GPU 一周。
AI.result: LEMON 尽管参数规模仅为 200M，却在远程同源检测任务上优于 600M 至 3B 参数的最先进模型。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，进化信息驱动的分词可以有效替代大规模参数扩展，为高效且具有生物学基础的蛋白质表示学习开辟了新方向。所有代码、模型权重与结果均以 MIT 许可公开。

title: When Models Don't Manipulate Manifolds: The Geometry of a Comparison Task
summary: One of the current premises of mechanistic interpretability research is that detailed accounts of the geometry of neural network representations can tell us how models perform computations, and how to effectively intervene on them. While low dimensional manifolds have been observed for multiple concepts in the literature (e.g. numbers encoded on helices, days of the week on a circle, ...), with structure believed to reflect properties of data and tasks, the extent to which models rely on them for computation, and how they manipulate them, remains unclear. We characterize precisely the geometry of computation in a number-comparison task, as an abstraction of comparison for decision making, and how models utilize geometry in an elegant fashion to implement it. Specifically, we study the causal geometry of number comparison in Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, a capable and widely studied open-weight model, and find Qwen largely uses linear representations of numbers despite the presence of curved geometry. To compare two numbers, the model first encodes each number along a vector and adds the two representations using attention and the residual connection, bringing them into a shared space in the residual stream. Then, the model uses MLP neurons to compare the pair of numbers on local regions in this shared space, which correspond to smaller intervals of input numbers, and combines these to obtain the position of the maximum. In fact, this reliance on linear representations for comparison also persists when the model compares three numbers. Our findings demonstrate that the manifold hypothesis can co-exist with linear representations: while concepts that are ordered may have manifold structure in representations, the model may use an underlying linear structure of the concept in certain computations.

AI.tldr: 该论文以数比较任务为抽象场景，精确刻画了Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct中数比较计算的因果几何，发现模型尽管表示中存在曲线流形结构，但比较计算主要依赖线性表示：用注意力与残差流把两个数的向量表示相加到共享空间，再由MLP神经元在局部区域上比较并组合得到最大值位置。
AI.motivation: 机制可解释性领域的一个前提是，神经网络表示几何的细致刻画能揭示模型如何计算及如何干预。文献中已观察到数字编码为螺旋、星期为圆等低维流形，并认为其结构反映数据与任务性质，但模型在多大程度上依赖这些流形进行计算、又如何操作它们仍不清楚。作者希望澄清"流形假设"与模型实际计算所用结构之间的关系。
AI.method: 作者选取数比较任务（作为决策中比较行为的抽象），在Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct上进行因果几何分析。通过考察表示空间的几何结构与其因果作用，追踪模型完成两个数比较（并扩展到三个数比较）时的计算路径，识别其中使用的表示形式、注意力与残差连接的作用以及MLP神经元的比较机制。
AI.result: 发现Qwen在存在曲线几何的情况下仍主要使用数字的线性表示。比较两个数时，模型先将每个数编码为一个向量，通过注意力与残差连接把两个表示相加，带入残差流的共享空间；随后MLP神经元在该共享空间的局部区域上比较这一对数字，这些局部区域对应较小的输入数区间，模型再将这些局部比较结果组合以确定最大值的位置。这种对线性表示的依赖在比较三个数时依然存在。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明流形假设可以与线性表示共存：对于有序概念，其表示可能具有流形结构，但在某些具体计算中模型可能使用该概念底层的线性结构。这提示机制可解释性研究需区分表示几何与计算所用几何，并对干预与解释方法的设计有启示。

title: GARDiff: Graph-Aligned Residual Diffusion for Probabilistic Multivariate Time-Series Forecasting
summary: Diffusion models have recently shown strong potential for probabilistic multivariate time-series forecasting by modeling complex conditional distributions. Recent decoupled diffusion frameworks further separate forecasting into deterministic prediction and stochastic residual generation, making it natural to derive dependency graphs from deterministic representations and use them to guide residual diffusion. However, we show that this direct structural transfer is unreliable. Although deterministic-derived graphs encode useful global dependency priors, they exhibit substantial edge-level misalignment with residual dependency structures, introducing inaccurate or redundant conditions during residual generation. This reveals a previously overlooked deterministic-to-residual structural alignment problem in decoupled diffusion forecasting. To address this problem, we propose GARDiff, a Graph-Aligned Residual Diffusion framework for probabilistic multivariate time-series forecasting. Instead of treating deterministic-derived graphs as fixed diffusion conditions, GARDiff progressively adapts them to residual generation. Specifically, GARDiff estimates residual uncertainty to distinguish high- and low-uncertainty regions, enabling uncertainty-aware structural refinement, and further performs timestep-aware edge sparsification during reverse diffusion to evolve graph conditions from broad dependency aggregation to localized residual refinement. Extensive experiments on six real-world benchmarks demonstrate that GARDiff consistently improves probabilistic forecasting performance and uncertainty calibration over strong baselines.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出解耦扩散预测中"确定性图直接迁移至残差生成"存在结构错配问题（确定性到残差的结构对齐问题），并提出GARDiff框架，通过不确定性感知的结构细化与时间步感知的边稀疏化，动态适配残差扩散的图条件。
AI.motivation: 解耦扩散框架将预测拆分为确定性预测与随机残差生成，很自然地会从确定性表示中导出依赖图来引导残差扩散。然而论文发现这种直接的结构迁移并不可靠：确定性导出的图虽然蕴含有用的全局依赖先验，但在边级别上与残差依赖结构存在显著错配，会在残差生成时引入不准确或冗余的条件。这一被忽视的"确定性—残差结构对齐"问题构成了本文动机。
AI.method: 提出GARDiff（Graph-Aligned Residual Diffusion）框架。它不把确定性导出的图当作固定的扩散条件，而是逐步将其适配到残差生成：1）估计残差不确定性，区分高/低不确定性区域，实现不确定性感知的结构细化；2）在反向扩散过程中执行时间步感知的边稀疏化，使图条件从广域依赖聚合逐步演化为局部化的残差细化。
AI.result: 在六个真实世界基准数据集上的大量实验表明，GARDiff在概率预测性能与不确定性校准方面均持续优于强基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 解耦扩散预测中确定性图与残差依赖之间存在结构性错配，直接迁移不可靠；通过不确定性感知细化与时间步感知稀疏化对图条件进行渐进式适配，可有效缓解该问题并稳定提升概率多变量时间序列预测的精度与校准质量。

title: Width Expansion as a Method for Class Incremental Learning
summary: Class Incremental Learning (Class-IL) requires models to learn new classes over time while preserving previously acquired knowledge without access to past data or task identity. This setting intensifies the stability-plasticity dilemma and makes catastrophic forgetting a central challenge. Existing approaches include regularization, knowledge distillation, replay, and architectural expansion. However, many expansion methods rely on explicit task identifiers or predefined growth strategies, limiting their applicability when task boundaries are unavailable at inference time. This work proposes a dynamic width expansion method that increases the number of neurons within existing layers according to a normalized loss criterion, without requiring task-specific information. An attention mechanism with persistent key-value memory is also incorporated to stabilize feature representations and reduce interference between previously learned and newly introduced classes. The approach is evaluated on Split MNIST and Split CIFAR-100 under the standard Class-IL protocol. Experiments compare fixed-capacity and dynamically expanding architectures, both with and without attention, combined with established continual learning methods including EWC, LwF, and A-GEM. Results show that progressive width expansion consistently improves performance over fixed architectures, particularly when combined with functional methods and A-GEM. The combination of width expansion and attention provides the most consistent gains. Overall, dynamic width expansion based on representational demand provides an effective and flexible strategy for Class-IL, although uncontrolled growth may increase overfitting and computational cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于归一化损失准则的动态宽度扩展方法，在层内增加神经元，无需任务标识，并结合持续键值记忆的注意力机制以缓解灾难性遗忘，在Split MNIST和Split CIFAR-100上验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 类增量学习（Class-IL）要求模型在不访问旧数据和任务标识的情况下持续学习新类并保留旧知识，这加剧了稳定性-可塑性困境，导致灾难性遗忘成为核心挑战。现有方法（正则化、知识蒸馏、回放、架构扩展）中，许多扩展方法依赖显式任务标识或预定义增长策略，在推理时缺乏任务边界信息的情况下适用性受限。
AI.method: 提出一种动态宽度扩展方法：依据归一化损失准则在已有层内增加神经元数量，且无需任务特定信息。同时引入带持续键值记忆的注意力机制，以稳定特征表示并减少已学类与新引入类之间的干扰。在标准Class-IL协议下于Split MNIST和Split CIFAR-100上评估，比较固定容量与动态扩展架构（含/不含注意力），并与EWC、LwF、A-GEM等持续学习方法结合。
AI.result: 渐进式宽度扩展在固定架构上持续提升性能，与功能型方法及A-GEM结合时尤为明显；宽度扩展与注意力的结合带来最一致的性能增益。
AI.conclusion: 基于表示需求的动态宽度扩展是Class-IL中一种有效且灵活的策略，但不受控的增长可能加剧过拟合并提高计算成本。

title: Volatility-Clustering Adaptation for Financial Time Series
summary: Time-series foundation models are increasingly adapted to new domains through fine-tuning on target data, under the implicit assumption that more target data yields better forecasts. We show that this assumption can fail in financial forecasting, where individual price changes are difficult to predict, but large moves tend to cluster, creating alternating calm and turbulent periods. Using financial foundation models trained on price bars of open, high, low, close, and volume, we argue that adapting to financial domains requires training signals beyond next-token prediction. We introduce Volatility-Clustering Adaptation (VCA), which augments next-token cross-entropy with a differentiable penalty on the autocorrelation of squared returns, the standard statistical signature of volatility clustering. This additional objective provides a multi-step training signal by matching the resulting dependence structure of autoregressive rollouts to those of the realized future. Across three asset sets and two evaluation conventions, VCA improves adaptation over the pre-trained model, with the strongest gains under the primary evaluation (\textsc{fore}), driven primarily by reduced variance error. Overall, our results suggest that effective financial adaptation requires objectives that capture domain-specific temporal structure beyond token-level prediction.

AI.tldr: 本文指出在金融预测中"目标数据越多效果越好"的假设可能失效，并提出波动率聚集适配（VCA）方法，在下一token交叉熵之外加入对平方收益自相关的可微惩罚，从而在多个资产集与评估约定下提升金融基础模型的适配效果。
AI.motivation: 时间序列基础模型通常通过在目标数据上微调来适配新领域，并隐含假设目标数据越多、预测越好。但金融预测中个股价格变动难以预测，而大幅波动往往聚集出现，形成平静期与动荡期交替，使该假设可能失效。作者认为金融领域适配需要超越下一token预测的训练信号。
AI.method: 作者基于在开盘、最高、最低、收盘及成交量（OHLCV）价格K线上训练的金融基础模型，提出波动率聚集适配（VCA）方法：在下一token交叉熵损失基础上，加入对平方收益自相关的可微惩罚项（该自相关是波动率聚集的标准统计特征）。该附加目标通过让自回归滚动预测所产生的依赖结构与真实未来序列的依赖结构相匹配，提供多步训练信号。
AI.result: 在三个资产集和两种评估约定下，VCA相较预训练模型均改善了适配效果；在主要评估设定（fore）下增益最强，且增益主要来源于方差误差的降低。
AI.conclusion: 有效的金融领域适配需要能够捕捉领域特定时间结构、超越token级预测的目标函数。

title: Predictive Geometry of Hidden Trajectories in Transformers
summary: Decoder-only transformers are trained only through a terminal next-token prediction loss, yet this loss constrains every intermediate hidden state through the fixed downstream computation. We formalize this constraint by studying layerwise loss-to-go functions: the terminal loss obtained by continuing a candidate hidden state through the remaining transformer blocks. Around successful validation trajectories, we show that the local second-order geometry of these functions is governed, up to low-loss residual terms, by a pullback Fisher operator on hidden-state space. Its spectrum identifies output-sensitive directions and approximately prediction-null directions, yielding a local observable subspace of the residual stream. For causal transformers, the same geometry induces a tokenwise curvature score: a Fisher-weighted sensitivity of the target logits to perturbations of each token's hidden state. This score vanishes outside the causal ancestor set of the target and is controlled by downstream Jacobian couplings, making it a loss-aware alternative to attention magnitude. We estimate these quantities using matrix-free Jacobian-vector and vector-Jacobian products and evaluate them across decoder-only language models on WikiText, OpenWebText, and FineWeb. Empirically, the induced geometry predicts perturbation sensitivity, supports nonuniform layerwise rank allocation, yields competitive structured token-pruning signals, and improves low-rank student recovery when added to stronger autoregressive distillation objectives such as reverse KL and skew KL. These results support a predictive-geometric view of transformer computation: near successful trajectories, the terminal loss induces a thin, anisotropic set of output-relevant hidden-state directions that can be measured and exploited for compression and distillation.

AI.tldr: 该论文将解码器Transformer的终端下一词预测损失形式化为逐层"损失剩余函数"，证明其局部二阶几何由隐状态空间上的拉回Fisher算子支配，并据此提出因果Transformer的逐token曲率分数，用于扰动敏感性预测、非均匀逐层秩分配、结构化token剪枝及低秩蒸馏。
AI.motivation: 解码器Transformer仅通过终端下一词预测损失训练，但该损失通过固定的下游计算约束了每一个中间隐状态，这种约束机制尚未被形式化理解。作者希望刻画终端损失如何塑造隐状态空间的局部几何，从而揭示哪些隐状态方向对输出真正重要、哪些近似无关。
AI.method: 定义逐层损失剩余函数（将候选隐状态经剩余Transformer块继续前传得到的终端损失）；证明在成功验证轨迹附近，其局部二阶几何在低损失残差项意义下由隐状态空间上的拉回Fisher算子支配。该谱识别出输出敏感方向与近似预测零方向，形成残差流的局部可观测子空间。对因果Transformer，由同一几何导出逐token曲率分数（目标logit对每个token隐状态扰动的Fisher加权敏感度），该分数在目标因果祖先集之外为零，并受下游雅可比耦合控制。使用无矩阵的JVP/VJP估计这些量。
AI.result: 在WikiText、OpenWebText、FineWeb上对多种仅解码器语言模型评测：所诱导几何可预测扰动敏感性，支持非均匀逐层秩分配，给出有竞争力的结构化token剪枝信号；将其加入更强自回归蒸馏目标（如reverse KL、skew KL）后能改善低秩学生恢复效果。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持Transformer计算的"预测-几何"观点：在成功轨迹附近，终端损失诱导出一组稀薄、各向异性的输出相关隐状态方向，这些方向可被测量并用于压缩与蒸馏。

title: Weights Read and Write Features: Scalable Parameter Decomposition Grounded in Activation Space
summary: Activation space and parameter space provide complementary views of model computation. Activations represent information, while weights read, transform, and write that information. Yet existing interpretability methods largely study the two spaces separately, leaving the connection between represented information and parameter-level computation underexplored. We introduce Activation-Supported Parameter Decomposition (ASPD), which jointly decomposes activation and parameter spaces and grounds each learned weight component in the activation features it reads or writes. This grounding constrains otherwise non-unique parameter decompositions using the model's internal activations, while an internal reconstruction objective provides a local learning signal at the weight matrix being analyzed. Together, these properties enable scalable, interpretable, and causally editable parameter decomposition in pretrained large language models, demonstrated on Qwen-3-8B. The learned read--write components can also be composed into parameter-level mechanism circuits. We use ASPD to recover mechanisms underlying the classic IOI circuit and trace semantic transformations through model weights.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ASPD（激活支撑的参数分解）方法，将激活空间与参数空间联合分解，使每个权重组件都锚定到其读取或写入的激活特征上，从而在预训练大模型（如Qwen-3-8B）中实现可扩展、可解释且可因果编辑的参数分解。
AI.motivation: 现有可解释性方法大多将激活空间与参数空间分开研究，导致"表示的信息"与"参数层面的计算"之间的联系未被充分探索。激活承载信息，权重负责读取、变换和写入信息，二者本质互补，因此需要一种能同时刻画两者并建立对应关系的方法。
AI.method: ASPD联合分解激活与参数空间，将每个学到的权重组件锚定到其所读取或写入的激活特征上。该锚定利用模型内部激活来约束原本非唯一的参数分解；同时，在被分析的权重矩阵处引入内部重构目标，提供局部学习信号，从而支持可扩展、可解释、可因果编辑的参数分解。
AI.result: 在Qwen-3-8B上验证了ASPD的有效性：学习到的读—写组件可组合为参数级机制电路，能够恢复经典IOI电路背后的机制，并追踪模型权重中的语义变换过程。
AI.conclusion: ASPD通过将参数分解锚定于激活特征，弥合了表示与计算之间的鸿沟，实现了大规模语言模型中可扩展、可解释且可因果编辑的参数级机制分析，为机制可解释性提供了新的统一视角。

title: HyDI: A hybrid Deep Learning-Inductive Logic Programming ensemble for multi-label classification
comment: Accepted at IJCLR26 (6th International Joint Conference on Learning & Reasoning, 16-18 September 2026)
summary: While attaining remarkable results for many applications, Deep Learning models are notoriously difficult to explain. This work introduces HyDI, a hybrid ensemble architecture for hierarchical multi-label classification. It combines a Deep Learning (DL) model with rule-based classifiers generated by Inductive Logic Programming (ILP). For leaf classes of the label hierarchy, the rule-based classifiers replace the DL model, leading to more transparent classification results. HyDI is applied to the Chemical Entities of Biological Interest (ChEBI) ontology, providing ILP-generated rules for 314 classes. For these classes, HyDI can generate global explanations as well as local explanations that combine visual and text-based descriptions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HyDI，一种将深度学习模型与归纳逻辑编程（ILP）生成的规则分类器结合的混合集成架构，用于层次多标签分类，并在ChEBI本体上实现了可解释的分类结果。
AI.motivation: 深度学习模型虽性能优异但难以解释，本文旨在提升层次多标签分类任务的可解释性。
AI.method: HyDI结合深度学习模型与ILP生成的规则分类器；对标签层次中的叶类，用规则分类器替代DL模型。
AI.result: HyDI应用于ChEBI本体，为314个类别生成了ILP规则；对这些类别，HyDI能生成全局解释及结合视觉与文本描述的局部解释。
AI.conclusion: HyDI通过混合集成方式在保持分类能力的同时，为叶类提供了更透明的分类结果及多层次的解释能力。

title: Optimizer-dependent training dynamics converge to the same one-third optimal data scaling
summary: Neural scaling, in which loss falls as a power law with training, is central to large language models, and one recent proposal is that a $1/3$ exponent emerges from learning peaked distributions. That account describes SGD, but models in practice are trained with adaptive optimizers. Here we separate two exponents the $1/3$ account does not distinguish: how fast the loss falls with training steps along a single run, and how fast the optimally tuned loss falls with dataset size $D$. We show that the first, a dynamic exponent, is optimizer-specific while the second, an optimal data exponent, converges to $1/3$ across optimizers. In an online teacher-student model we decompose the loss into norm growth (radial) and alignment toward the teacher direction (tangential), each decaying as a power law with dynamic exponents $α_{r}$ and $α_{t}$.
